project.name: Firefox Gecko — CSS & HTML Call Graph (Stage 4: display-list boundary)
project.description: Knowledge graph of the Firefox Gecko CSS+HTML surface (D:/geco-dict/firefox @ 47c5f402c8d3a5369f1fb1b6cd61b0bb92725af1) with the complete chain: property definition (TOML) -> codegen -> parse -> cascade -> computed values -> nsStyleStruct -> getComputedStyle, and tag -> nsHtml5 parser -> factory -> element class -> WebIDL, terminating at the display-list generation boundary (nsCSSFrameConstructor -> nsIFrame::BuildDisplayList -> nsDisplayItems). Basis for the CSS-property/HTML-element call-graph database.

nodes.name: longhands.toml
nodes.summary: Central descriptor file that defines every CSS longhand property (name, Rust value type, initial value, animation behavior, style struct, spec link, flags, prefs, aliases) consumed by the mako codegen. The Python pipeline (data.py/build.py) parses these TOML tables and properties.mako.rs expands them into parsing, cascade, and computed-value Rust code.

nodes.name: shorthands.toml
nodes.summary: Defines all CSS shorthand properties (margin, padding, border-*, font, text-decoration, etc.) as tables listing their longhand sub_properties plus expansion kind (four_sides, two_properties), allowed rule types, and specs. Parsed by data.py/build.py alongside longhands.toml so properties.mako.rs can generate shorthand-to-longhand parsing and expansion code.

nodes.name: counter_style_descriptors.toml
nodes.summary: Lists the descriptors of the @counter-style rule (system, negative, prefix, suffix, range, pad, fallback, symbols, additive-symbols, speak-as) with their Rust types. Fed into the descriptor codegen so the style engine can parse and represent @counter-style rules.

nodes.name: font_face_descriptors.toml
nodes.summary: Lists the descriptors of the @font-face rule (font-family, src, font-style/weight/width ranges, font-display, unicode-range, feature/variation settings, metric overrides, size-adjust) with their Rust types and parsers. Drives codegen for parsing and storing @font-face declarations.

nodes.name: property_descriptors.toml
nodes.summary: Lists the descriptors of the CSS Houdini @property rule (syntax, inherits, initial-value) with their Rust types. Consumed by the descriptor codegen to register custom properties defined via @property in the style system.

nodes.name: view_transition_descriptors.toml
nodes.summary: Lists the descriptors of the @view-transition rule (navigation, types) with their Rust types. Consumed by the descriptor codegen so the style engine can parse @view-transition at-rule declarations.

nodes.name: Element.cpp
nodes.summary: Core implementation of mozilla::dom::Element: attribute handling (SetAttr/GetAttr/UnsetAttr), tree binding (BindToTree/UnbindFromTree) and computed-style access via nsComputedDOMStyle::GetComputedStyleNoFlush. Sits mid-chain: instantiated by NS_New*Element creators, styled through the Stylo FFI.

nodes.name: Element.h
nodes.summary: Declares class Element : public FragmentOrElement, the DOM Element base for all HTML/SVG elements. Includes mozilla/dom/FragmentOrElement.h and defines the attribute/state API every nsGenericHTMLElement inherits.

nodes.name: ElementInlines.h
nodes.summary: Inline helpers for Element and nsINode: activity observer registration, contenteditable checks via nsGenericHTMLElement, and flattened-tree parent-element lookups used by style/binding code.

nodes.name: FragmentOrElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements FragmentOrElement (ctor/dtor chaining to nsIContent), its nsDOMSlots/nsExtendedDOMSlots, and nsIContent slot creation. It is the concrete base the Element ctor chain ultimately reaches.

nodes.name: FragmentOrElement.h
nodes.summary: Declares class FragmentOrElement : public nsIContent (base class include), the generic content-node implementation beneath Element (DocumentFragment, Text, etc.) with DOM slot storage.

nodes.name: nsContentCreatorFunctions.h
nodes.summary: Declares the Gecko-internal element-creator functions: NS_NewElement overloads, NS_NewHTMLElement, NS_NewXMLElement, NS_NewMathMLElement, NS_NewXULElement, NS_NewSVGElement and the table-driven CreateHTMLElement used by the HTML5 parser. Hub of the parser-to-DOM creation chain.

nodes.name: nsIContent.h
nodes.summary: Declares class nsIContent : public nsINode, the abstract content-node interface (content slots, IME state, event attributes) that FragmentOrElement implements.

nodes.name: nsIContentInlines.h
nodes.summary: Inline flattened-tree traversal: GetFlattenedTreeParentNode (normal and style-facing variants), nsIContent::GetFlattenedTreeParent, and slot/shadow-root aware parent resolution used by the style engine.

nodes.name: nsINode.cpp
nodes.summary: Root node implementation: nsINode ctor, slot allocation, and ReplaceOrInsertBefore, the shared machinery behind AppendChild/InsertBefore. Includes nsContentCreatorFunctions.h, nsGenericHTMLElement.h and nsNodeInfoManager.h.

nodes.name: nsINode.h
nodes.summary: Declares class nsINode : public mozilla::dom::EventTarget, the base of the whole node hierarchy, with inline AppendChild/InsertBefore/ReplaceChild delegating to ReplaceOrInsertBefore. Includes nsNodeInfoManager.h.

nodes.name: nsNodeInfoManager.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements nsNodeInfoManager construction (bound to a Document) and GetNodeInfo, the per-document NodeInfo factory/ consulted by every NS_New*Element creator before constructing an element.

nodes.name: nsNodeInfoManager.h
nodes.summary: Declares class nsNodeInfoManager final, which allocates and caches NodeInfo objects (tag name + namespace + node kind) that give elements their identity.

nodes.name: HTMLAnchorElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the <a> element: WrapNode, BindToTree/UnbindFromTree managing DNS prefetch and link state, and click/post-handle event logic. A leaf of the HTMLElementFactory creation chain.

nodes.name: HTMLAnchorElement.h
nodes.summary: Declares class HTMLAnchorElement final : public nsGenericHTMLElement, public Link, public SupportsDNSPrefetch for the <a> tag; includes nsGenericHTMLElement.h.

nodes.name: HTMLBodyElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the <body> element: legacy presentational attribute parsing and MapAttributesIntoRule (bgcolor, background, text/link margins) feeding mapped-attribute styling, plus BindToTree hooks.

nodes.name: HTMLBodyElement.h
nodes.summary: Declares class HTMLBodyElement final : public nsGenericHTMLElement for the <body> tag; includes nsGenericHTMLElement.h.

nodes.name: HTMLElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Concrete HTMLElement implementation plus hand-expanded NS_IMPL_NS_NEW_HTML_ELEMENT creators NS_NewHTMLElement and NS_NewCustomElement, which placement-new the element via its NodeInfoManager. Also hosts form-associated custom element support (AttachInternals).

nodes.name: HTMLElement.h
nodes.summary: Declares class HTMLElement final : public nsGenericHTMLFormElement (transitively nsGenericHTMLElement); the concrete class produced by the NS_NewHTMLElement/NS_NewCustomElement creators.

nodes.name: HTMLElementFactory.cpp
nodes.summary: The HTML element-creation dispatch: builds sHTMLContentCreatorFunctions[] from nsHTMLTagList.inc mapping each tag enum to its NS_New*Element constructor, and NS_NewHTMLElement entry points that validate the XHTML namespace and delegate to nsContentUtils::NewXULOrHTMLElement. The hub the parser reaches after nsHtml5TreeOperation.

nodes.name: HTMLSharedElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Shared implementation for the structurally simple tags html, head and param: href/AfterSetAttr handling, BindToTree/UnbindFromTree and WrapNode.

nodes.name: HTMLSharedElement.h
nodes.summary: Declares class HTMLSharedElement final : public nsGenericHTMLElement, one class shared by the html, head and param tags; includes nsGenericHTMLElement.h.

nodes.name: nsGenericHTMLElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Common behavior for all HTML elements: BindToTree/UnbindFromTree, ParseAttribute/AfterSetAttr, anchor event handling, popover and editability, plus style-adjacent work (includes nsComputedDOMStyle.h and nsIContentInlines.h).

nodes.name: nsGenericHTMLElement.h
nodes.summary: Declares class nsGenericHTMLElement : public nsGenericHTMLElementBase (alias for nsStyledElement, i.e. Element), the common base of all HTML element classes, and the NS_DECLARE_NS_NEW_HTML_ELEMENT/NS_IMPL_NS_NEW_HTML_ELEMENT macros that generate NS_New*Element creators.

nodes.name: GeckoBindings.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the C++ side of the Stylo FFI: the Gecko_* callbacks that the Servo (Rust) style engine calls into Gecko, e.g. Gecko_ComputedStyle_Init, Gecko_IsSignificantChild, Gecko_NoteDirtyElement, Gecko_UpdateAnimations.

nodes.name: GeckoBindings.h
nodes.summary: Header ('FFI functions for Servo to call into Gecko') declaring the Gecko_* callback signatures exposed to the generated Rust bindings; includes nsStyleStruct.h and the Servo binding type plumbing.

nodes.name: CreateHTMLElement
nodes.summary: Table-driven element-creation dispatch: indexes sHTMLContentCreatorFunctions[] (generated from nsHTMLTagList.inc via the HTML_TAG macro, mapping tags to NS_New*Element constructors) by tag enum and invokes the selected creator to build an nsGenericHTMLElement. This is the function the HTML5 parser tree-builder ultimately calls.

nodes.name: NS_NewHTMLElement
nodes.summary: Namespace-checked HTML element entry point: asserts the NodeInfo is kNameSpaceID_XHTML and delegates to nsContentUtils::NewXULOrHTMLElement, which handles custom-element lookup before dispatching to tag-specific NS_New*Element creators.

nodes.name: NS_NewHTMLNOTUSEDElement
nodes.summary: Placeholder creator filling HTML_OTHER table slots; MOZ_ASSERT_UNREACHABLE, never called for valid tags.

nodes.name: NS_NewHTMLElement
nodes.summary: Declares the Element**-returning HTML creator overloads (with FromParser, is-atom, CustomElementDefinition parameters); implemented in HTMLElementFactory.cpp and consumed by the parser and DOM.

nodes.name: NS_NewElement
nodes.summary: Declares overloads dispatching on NodeInfo namespace to the per-language creators (NS_NewHTMLElement, NS_NewXULElement, NS_NewMathMLElement, NS_NewSVGElement, NS_NewXMLElement; implemented in nsNameSpaceManager.cpp).

nodes.name: CreateHTMLElement
nodes.summary: Declares the uint32_t tag-enum-driven creator returning already_AddRefed<nsGenericHTMLElement>; lets the HTML5 parser build elements without depending on parser types.

nodes.name: NS_NewXMLElement
nodes.summary: Declares the XML-namespaced element creator, sibling of the HTML creator in the NS_NewElement namespace dispatch.

nodes.name: Element::BindToTree
nodes.summary: Inserts the element into the document tree: updates binding state, custom-element reactions, and id/name tables; base hook every HTML element's BindToTree chains through.

nodes.name: Element::UnbindFromTree
nodes.summary: Tears down tree binding on removal, clearing state that assumed document membership; counterpart hook chained by HTML subclasses.

nodes.name: Element::SetAttr
nodes.summary: Two overloads setting an attribute with mutation notification, driving BeforeSetAttr/AfterSetAttr hooks and the resulting restyle traffic.

nodes.name: Element::GetAttr
nodes.summary: Attribute lookup overloads (by atom and by namespace+atom) over the element's AttrArray.

nodes.name: Element::UnsetAttr
nodes.summary: Removes an attribute with notification, running the BeforeSetAttr/AfterSetAttr lifecycle and invalidation.

nodes.name: Element
nodes.summary: class Element : public FragmentOrElement - the DOM Element base for all HTML/SVG elements; owns the attribute API, BindToTree/UnbindFromTree lifecycle and style entry points (Element.cpp calls nsComputedDOMStyle::GetComputedStyleNoFlush).

nodes.name: FragmentOrElement::FragmentOrElement
nodes.summary: Constructor chaining to nsIContent with the NodeInfo; the concrete base ctor reached at the end of every Element creation chain (HTMLElement -> ... -> Element -> FragmentOrElement).

nodes.name: nsIContent::GetDesiredIMEState
nodes.summary: Computes the IME state desired for this content by consulting editable ancestors.

nodes.name: FragmentOrElement

nodes.name: nsIContent
nodes.summary: class nsIContent : public nsINode - abstract interface for content nodes (slots, IME state, event attributes) that all elements and text nodes implement.

nodes.name: GetFlattenedTreeParentNode

nodes.summary: Root node constructor taking already_AddRefed<NodeInfo>; initializes the base state every node shares.

nodes.name: nsINode::ReplaceOrInsertBefore
nodes.summary: Shared implementation of InsertBefore/ReplaceChild (and thus AppendChild): handles mutation observers, id/name table updates and script-blocking effects during tree mutation.

nodes.name: nsINode::CreateSlots
nodes.summary: Allocates nsSlots (weak reference and other per-node storage) on demand.

nodes.name: nsINode
nodes.summary: class nsINode : public mozilla::dom::EventTarget - root of the DOM node hierarchy; declares inline AppendChild/InsertBefore that delegate to ReplaceOrInsertBefore.

nodes.name: nsNodeInfoManager::nsNodeInfoManager
nodes.summary: Constructor binding the manager to its owning Document and initializing the NodeInfo hash tables.

nodes.name: nsNodeInfoManager::GetNodeInfo
nodes.summary: Creates or fetches from cache the NodeInfo for (name, prefix, namespace, node kind); the identity lookup every NS_New*Element creator performs before constructing an element.

nodes.name: nsNodeInfoManager
nodes.summary: class nsNodeInfoManager final - per-document factory/cache of NodeInfo objects giving elements their tag+namespace identity.

nodes.name: HTMLAnchorElement::WrapNode
nodes.summary: Creates the JS wrapper object binding HTMLAnchorElement to its DOM binding.

nodes.name: HTMLAnchorElement::BindToTree
nodes.summary: On insertion, registers DNS prefetch and updates link state before chaining to the base implementation.

nodes.name: HTMLAnchorElement::UnbindFromTree
nodes.summary: On removal, cancels DNS prefetch and clears link state.

nodes.name: HTMLAnchorElement::PostHandleEvent
nodes.summary: Post-handler for anchor activation events (link following), sharing the generic anchor logic in nsGenericHTMLElement.

nodes.name: HTMLAnchorElement
nodes.summary: class HTMLAnchorElement final : public nsGenericHTMLElement, public Link, public SupportsDNSPrefetch - the <a> element implementation.

nodes.name: HTMLBodyElement::MapAttributesIntoRule
nodes.summary: Maps legacy presentational <body> attributes (bgcolor, background, text/link/vlink/alink, margins) into declaration blocks for mapped-attribute styling.

nodes.name: HTMLBodyElement::GetAttributeMappingFunction
nodes.summary: Returns the attribute-to-rule mapping callback used by the style system for this element.

nodes.name: HTMLBodyElement::ParseAttribute
nodes.summary: Parses <body> attribute values into typed nsAttrValue storage (colors, lengths, event handler attributes).

nodes.name: HTMLBodyElement
nodes.summary: class HTMLBodyElement final : public nsGenericHTMLElement - the <body> element with legacy attribute-to-style mapping.

nodes.name: NS_NewHTMLElement
nodes.summary: Hand-expanded NS_IMPL_NS_NEW_HTML_ELEMENT creator: placement-news a mozilla::dom::HTMLElement from its NodeInfoManager; one of the NS_New*Element constructors the factory table can select.

nodes.name: NS_NewCustomElement
nodes.summary: Creator whose function pointer deliberately compares unequal to NS_NewHTMLElement's, also constructing HTMLElement; used for customized built-in elements.

nodes.name: HTMLElement::HTMLElement
nodes.summary: Constructor chaining through nsGenericHTMLFormElement/nsGenericHTMLElement toward Element/FragmentOrElement; initializes form-associated custom element state.

nodes.name: HTMLElement::AttachInternals
nodes.summary: Implements attachInternals() for custom elements, creating the ElementInternals object with validity checks.

nodes.name: HTMLElement
nodes.summary: class HTMLElement final : public nsGenericHTMLFormElement (transitively nsGenericHTMLElement) - concrete class produced by the NS_NewHTMLElement/NS_NewCustomElement creators.

nodes.name: HTMLSharedElement::AfterSetAttr
nodes.summary: Post-attribute hook updating href/link state for the shared html/head/param tags.

nodes.name: HTMLSharedElement::BindToTree
nodes.summary: Insertion hook asserting the node is one of the html/head/param tags and updating link state.

nodes.name: HTMLSharedElement::WrapNode
nodes.summary: Creates the JS wrapper for the shared element instance.

nodes.name: HTMLSharedElement
nodes.summary: class HTMLSharedElement final : public nsGenericHTMLElement - one class shared by the structurally simple html, head and param tags.

nodes.name: nsGenericHTMLElement::BindToTree
nodes.summary: Common insertion behavior for every HTML element (name tables, editability, link setup) before subclass hooks and Element::BindToTree run.

nodes.name: nsGenericHTMLElement::UnbindFromTree
nodes.summary: Common removal behavior (name tables, editability, form reset) chained by subclass UnbindFromTree implementations.

nodes.name: nsGenericHTMLElement::ParseAttribute
nodes.summary: Shared attribute parsing (URLs, enums, background attributes) into nsAttrValue for all HTML elements.

nodes.name: nsGenericHTMLElement::AfterSetAttr
nodes.summary: Post-attribute hook handling popover, name-table membership and mapped-attribute/style invalidation for all HTML elements.

nodes.name: nsGenericHTMLElement::PostHandleEventForAnchors
nodes.summary: Shared default-action handling for anchor-like elements (<a>, <area>) after event dispatch.

nodes.name: nsGenericHTMLElement::CopyInnerTo
nodes.summary: Copies inner state/attributes to a destination element, used by cloneNode and node cloning.

nodes.name: nsGenericHTMLElement
nodes.summary: class nsGenericHTMLElement : public nsGenericHTMLElementBase (alias for nsStyledElement, i.e. Element) - common base of all HTML element classes; also home of the NS_IMPL_NS_NEW_HTML_ELEMENT macros generating the NS_New*Element creators the factory table references.

nodes.name: Gecko_ComputedStyle_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes a Gecko ComputedStyle from Servo-produced style data (and optionally its parent), the FFI bridge between Rust style resolution and Gecko's ComputedStyle objects.

nodes.name: Gecko_IsSignificantChild
nodes.summary: FFI predicate telling the Rust style engine whether a child node is significant (e.g. non-whitespace) for selector matching.

nodes.name: Gecko_NoteDirtyElement
nodes.summary: FFI callback marking an element and its descendants dirty for restyle when the Rust traversal invalidates them.

nodes.name: Gecko_GetNextStyleChild
nodes.summary: FFI iterator letting Rust's style traversal step through an element's style children via Gecko's StyleChildrenIterator.

nodes.name: Gecko_GetExtraContentStyleDeclarations
nodes.summary: FFI supplying extra author-level declarations (e.g. for contenteditable/designMode) into Servo's cascade.

nodes.name: Gecko_UpdateAnimations
nodes.summary: FFI entry the Rust style engine uses to trigger CSS animation/transition/timeline updates for an element after style resolution.

nodes.name: GlobalStyleSheetCache.cpp
nodes.summary: Process-wide singleton cache of built-in (agent/user/author) stylesheets, userContent.css/userChrome.css, and sheets shared to content processes via read-only shared memory. Loads sheets through css::Loader::LoadSheetSync and publishes them for IPC sharing.

nodes.name: GlobalStyleSheetCache.h
nodes.summary: Declares GlobalStyleSheetCache, the nsIObserver singleton owning built-in and user stylesheets, with shared-memory plumbing for cross-process sheet reuse.

nodes.name: Loader.cpp
nodes.summary: The CSS loader implementation: sync/async sheet loading, content policy checks, load coalescing/deferral, caching, priority adjustment, and tree insertion of loaded StyleSheet objects. Central entry point for stylesheet load in the CSS pipeline.

nodes.name: Loader.h
nodes.summary: Declares css::Loader (per-document stylesheet loader registered in SharedSubResourceCache), SheetLoadDataHashKey, and the SheetLoadData forward interface used by load completion callbacks.

nodes.name: nsComputedDOMStyle.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the CSSOM getComputedStyle exposure to web content: flushes style via ServoStyleSet (ResolveStyleLazily / pres Shell style set), then computes serialized values for hundreds of properties, calling Servo_* FFI for custom properties and logical-property resolution and reading nsStyle* structs directly.

nodes.name: nsComputedDOMStyle.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsComputedDOMStyle (an nsDOMCSSDeclaration bound to one element + PseudoStyleRequest) and its ComputedStyleMap machinery for property getter dispatch.

nodes.name: nsCSSProps.cpp
nodes.summary: Gecko-side CSS property data tables: builds the IDL-name lookup hash from generated kIDLNameTable, tracks pref-controlled property enabled state (kPropertyPrefTable), exposes property flags from ServoCSSPropList.h, and resolves aliases via Servo_Property_ResolveAlias, bridging to Stylo's generated property data.

nodes.name: nsCSSProps.h
nodes.summary: Declares class nsCSSProps: static lookup helpers (LookupProperty/LookupPropertyByIDLName), enabled-state queries, flag checks, and the generated tables (kIDLNameTable, kPropertyPrefTable, kFontFaceDescs, kCounterStyleDescs) that mirror Stylo's property definitions on the Gecko side.

nodes.name: nsMediaFeatures.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the Gecko_MediaFeatures_* callback functions that Stylo calls to evaluate media queries and @media descriptors (device size, resolution, color depth/gamut, display mode, pointer capabilities) against the Document/pres context.

nodes.name: nsStyleStruct.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the Gecko nsStyle* computed-style structs (nsStyleFont, nsStyleMargin, nsStyleBorder, nsStyleList, nsStyleText, nsStyleDisplay, ...): constructors copying from Stylo's style data, CalcDifference change hints, and dependent-state initialization from the Document.

nodes.name: nsStyleStruct.h (cross-batch)
nodes.summary: Cross-batch reference: C++ definitions of Gecko's nsStyleFont/nsStyleDisplay/nsStyleColor etc., which the Rust ComputedValues mirrors and fills through the generated setters in gecko.mako.rs.

nodes.name: nsStyleStructFwd.h
nodes.summary: Forward declarations to avoid including all of nsStyleStruct.h: defines StyleStructID (from FOR_EACH_STYLE_STRUCT) and StyleStructConstants bitmask helpers for inherited/reset struct counts.

nodes.name: nsStyleStructInlines.h
nodes.summary: Inline helper methods on nsStyleText and nsStyleDisplay (NewlineIsSignificant, WhiteSpaceCanWrap, WordCanWrap, IsBlockOutside, IsInlineOutside, GetDisplay) that combine struct data with frame context such as SVG text subtrees.

nodes.name: nsStyleStructList.h
nodes.summary: High-order macro FOR_EACH_STYLE_STRUCT enumerating all inherited (Font, List, Text, Visibility, UI, TableBorder, SVG) and reset (Background, Position, Display, Margin, Border, ...) style structs in canonical order.

nodes.name: PseudoStyleRequest.h
nodes.summary: Declares mozilla::PseudoStyleRequest, a (PseudoStyleType, optional identifier atom) pair used to request pseudo-element style, plus a PLDHash key wrapper for hashing requests.

nodes.name: PseudoStyleType.cpp
nodes.summary: Pseudo-element plumbing: streaming PseudoStyleType names from the generated list, parsing pseudo-element strings via the Servo_ParsePseudoElement FFI into a PseudoStyleRequest, serializing requests back to strings, and static flag/atom tables for all pseudo types.

nodes.name: PseudoStyleType.h
nodes.summary: Declares the PseudoStyleType enum and PseudoStyleTypeFlags from mozilla/PseudoStyleTypeList.h, and class PseudoStyle with classification helpers (IsPseudoElement, IsViewTransitionPseudoElement, flag/atom tables).

nodes.name: ServoCSSRuleList.cpp
nodes.summary: DOM css::RuleList wrapper over Stylo's StyleLockedCssRules: lazily instantiates Gecko css::Rule objects from raw rule types via Servo_CssRules_Get/ListTypes, and forwards InsertRule/DeleteRule to the Stylo FFI.

nodes.name: ServoCSSRuleList.h
nodes.summary: Declares ServoCSSRuleList, a dom::CSSRuleList holding a RefPtr<StyleLockedCssRules> and a cached array of instantiated Gecko rule objects with lazy SetRule mapping.

nodes.name: ServoStyleSet.h
nodes.summary: The Gecko front door to the Stylo style engine: owns the StyleSetContents raw data (Servo_StyleSet_Init) and exposes style resolution (ResolveStyleLazily, ResolvePseudoElementStyle, anonymous-box and text/placeholder resolution), traversal entry points (StyleDocument, StyleNewSubtree), sheet management, and rule/animation queries, all backed by Servo_* FFI calls.

nodes.name: ServoStyleSetInlines.h
nodes.summary: Inline ServoStyleSet methods that go straight to the FFI: Servo_SourceSizeList_Evaluate for <source size> lists and Servo_ResolveStyle for element style resolution.

nodes.name: StyleSheet.cpp
nodes.summary: DOM-facing stylesheet object: parsing entry points ParseSheet/ParseSheetSync hand bytes to Servo_StyleSheet_FromUTF8Bytes (Stylo), and it manages rule insertion/deletion, applicability (ApplicableStateChanged), unique-inner reuse (EnsureUniqueInner), replace promises, and rule-changed notifications to attached ServoStyleSets.

nodes.name: StyleSheet.h
nodes.summary: Declares mozilla::StyleSheet (base of CSSStyleSheet): the stylesheet DOM interface with inner StyleSheetInfo, parse/replace APIs, rule mutation, principal/subject checks, and the raw Stylo sheet handle (StyleLockedStyleSheet).

nodes.name: nsHtml5AtomTable.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements nsHtml5AtomTable::GetAtom: a 64-entry recently-used atom cache indexed by high bits of a scrambled hash, falling back to NS_Atomize for new strings; avoids repeated interning of short parser attribute/tag strings.

nodes.name: nsHtml5AtomTable.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsHtml5AtomTable, a per-parser atom cache for nsHtml5Parser/nsHtml5StreamParser with single-thread-at-a-time access semantics and bulk release on Clear/destruction.

nodes.name: GlobalStyleSheetCache
nodes.summary: nsIObserver singleton caching built-in agent/user/author sheets and user content/chrome sheets; supports cloning sheet handles into shared memory for content processes.

nodes.name: GlobalStyleSheetCache::Singleton
nodes.summary: Returns/creates the process-wide cache instance and registers it as a pref/observer-driven holder of built-in sheets.

nodes.name: GlobalStyleSheetCache::GetBuiltInSheet
nodes.summary: Returns the pre-loaded built-in stylesheet for a BuiltInStyleSheet id (agent/user/author levels).

nodes.name: GlobalStyleSheetCache::LoadSheet
nodes.summary: Loads a sheet synchronously with system principal via the static css::Loader, used to populate built-in and user sheets at startup.

nodes.name: GlobalStyleSheetCache::LoadSheetURL

nodes.name: GlobalStyleSheetCache::InitSharedSheetsInParent

nodes.name: css::Loader

nodes.name: SheetLoadDataHashKey

nodes.name: Loader::LoadSheet

nodes.name: Loader::LoadSheetAsyncInternal

nodes.name: Loader::LoadSheetSyncInternal

nodes.summary: Runs CSP/content-policy checks before allowing a stylesheet load.

nodes.summary: Flush-free wrapper used by callers that must not mutate layout; delegates to DoGetComputedStyleNoFlush.

nodes.name: nsComputedDOMStyle::DoGetComputedStyleNoFlush
nodes.summary: Core resolution: picks PresShell/ServoStyleSet, handles pseudo-element requests via ResolveStyleLazily, and returns the ComputedStyle whose nsStyle* structs back all getters.

nodes.name: nsComputedDOMStyle::GetUnanimatedComputedStyleNoFlush
nodes.summary: Fetches style with animations stripped via Servo_Element_GetMaybeOutOfDateStyle FFI, used for transition starting points.

nodes.name: nsComputedDOMStyle::DoGetTransform
nodes.summary: Serializes the transform property from nsStyleDisplay's StyleTransform, converting Servo representation into CSS text/CSSValue.

nodes.name: nsComputedDOMStyle::GetGridTemplateColumnsRows
nodes.summary: Builds CSSValue lists for grid-template-columns/rows, combining style-struct data with layout's ComputedGridTrackInfo when a frame exists.

nodes.name: nsComputedDOMStyle::GetOffsetWidthFor
nodes.summary: Computes used top/left/right/bottom values for positioned elements, reading nsStyleDisplay positioning and frame geometry.

nodes.name: nsComputedDOMStyle::GetAdjustedValuesForBoxSizing
nodes.summary: Adjusts width/height used values for box-sizing by subtracting padding/border from the nsStyleMargin/nsStyleBorder/nsStylePadding structs.

nodes.name: nsCSSProps
nodes.summary: Static namespace of Gecko-side CSS property metadata: IDL-name lookup, enabled state, flags, subproperty tables, and font-face/counter-style descriptor lookup; data is generated alongside Stylo's property definitions.

nodes.name: nsCSSProps::Init
nodes.summary: Builds the IDL-name-to-property-id hash table from generated kIDLNameTable and registers pref callbacks controlling per-property enabled state.

nodes.name: nsCSSProps::LookupPropertyByIDLName
nodes.summary: Maps a CSS property IDL name to NonCustomCSSPropertyId, honoring enabled state and resolving aliases through the Servo_Property_ResolveAlias FFI.

nodes.name: nsCSSProps::RecomputeEnabledState
nodes.summary: Pref-change callback that flips gPropertyEnabled entries from kPropertyPrefTable, including special handling for backdrop-filter via gfxVars.

nodes.name: nsCSSProps::PropFlags
nodes.summary: Returns the CSSPropFlags for a property from the kFlagsTable compiled from ServoCSSPropList.h, mirroring Stylo's property flags.

nodes.name: nsCSSProps::LookupFontDesc
nodes.summary: Looks up an @font-face descriptor name against the generated kFontFaceDescs table.

nodes.name: nsCSSProps::LookupCounterStyleDesc
nodes.summary: Looks up a @counter-style descriptor name against the generated kCounterStyleDescs table.

nodes.name: nsCSSPropsGfxVarReceiver
nodes.summary: gfxVarReceiver singleton that recomputes property enabled state when the compositor's backdrop-filter support changes.

nodes.name: GetSize (anonymous)
nodes.summary: Static helper returning the document's viewport/pres-context size used by width/height media features.

nodes.name: GetDeviceSize (anonymous)
nodes.summary: Static helper returning the physical device size for device-width/height media features.

nodes.name: Gecko_MediaFeatures_GetDeviceSize
nodes.summary: FFI callback invoked by Stylo during media query evaluation to obtain CSS-pixel device dimensions.

nodes.name: Gecko_MediaFeatures_GetResolution
nodes.summary: FFI callback reporting device resolution (dppx) for the resolution media feature.

nodes.name: Gecko_MediaFeatures_GetColorDepth
nodes.summary: FFI callback reporting color depth bits, handling monochrome devices via monochrome-bits query.

nodes.name: Gecko_MediaFeatures_GetDisplayMode
nodes.summary: FFI callback returning the web app display mode for the display-mode media feature.

nodes.name: nsStyleFont
nodes.summary: Inherited style struct holding font-family, size, weight, language, and zoom data populated from Stylo's computed font values; includes document-dependent init.

nodes.name: nsStyleText
nodes.summary: Inherited style struct for text layout properties (white-space, word-break, text-align, line-height, etc.) with cached derived flags computed from Stylo values.

nodes.name: nsStyleDisplay
nodes.summary: Reset style struct for display/position/float, transforms, will-change, containment, and appearance; heavily consulted by frame construction and ComputedDOMStyle.

nodes.name: nsStyleFont::nsStyleFont(const Document&)
nodes.summary: Constructs the font struct from document defaults, applying font-size inflation and zoom to base sizes.

nodes.name: nsStyleText::CalcDifference
nodes.summary: Compares old/new nsStyleText to emit nsChangeHint bits driving targeted restyle of text frames.

nodes.name: nsStyleDisplay::CalcDifference
nodes.summary: Compares old/new nsStyleDisplay producing change hints for display/position/transform changes, one of the largest restyle-difference functions.

nodes.name: nsStyleMargin::nsStyleMargin
nodes.summary: Initializes margin struct with auto/zero defaults and cached converted length pairs.

nodes.name: nsStyleBorder::nsStyleBorder
nodes.summary: Initializes border struct defaults (widths, styles, colors, border-image) used across frame painting.

nodes.name: nsStyleList::nsStyleList
nodes.summary: Initializes list style struct (list-style-type/position/image, counter data) with Stylo default values.

nodes.name: StyleStructConstants
nodes.summary: Compile-time counts and bitmasks over StyleStructID (all/inherited/reset masks, BitFor) derived from FOR_EACH_STYLE_STRUCT.

nodes.name: nsStyleText::NewlineIsSignificant
nodes.summary: Inline query combining white-space style with frame suppression state for newline handling in text frames.

nodes.name: nsStyleDisplay::IsBlockOutside
nodes.summary: Inline helper mapping outside display to block, adjusting for SVG text subtrees.

nodes.name: nsStyleDisplay::GetDisplay
nodes.summary: Inline accessor returning the effective display value with SVG text-subtree fixups.

nodes.name: PseudoStyleRequest
nodes.summary: Value type combining PseudoStyleType with an optional identifier atom (functional pseudo-elements like ::part-style or view-transition names), used to request pseudo style resolution.

nodes.name: PseudoStyleRequest::Parse
nodes.summary: Parses a pseudo-element string via the Servo_ParsePseudoElement FFI into a PseudoStyleRequest, filtering anon boxes unless enabled checks are ignored.

nodes.name: PseudoStyleRequest::ToString
nodes.summary: Serializes a request back to its ::pseudo-element string, including functional identifiers for view-transition pseudos.

nodes.name: operator<<(std::ostream&, PseudoStyleType)
nodes.summary: Streams the name of a pseudo style type from the generated PseudoStyleTypeList.h for logging.

nodes.name: PseudoStyle
nodes.summary: Static helper namespace over pseudo types: classification (IsPseudoElement, IsViewTransitionPseudoElement), flag table kFlags, and atom table kAtoms generated from the pseudo list.

nodes.name: PseudoStyleType
nodes.summary: uint8_t enum of all pseudo-element/tree/anon-box types generated from mozilla/PseudoStyleTypeList.h, shared conceptually with Stylo's PseudoElementType.

nodes.name: ServoCSSRuleList
nodes.summary: dom::CSSRuleList subclass wrapping Stylo's StyleLockedCssRules, lazily creating Gecko css::Rule wrappers per index and holding sheet/parent-rule back-references.

nodes.name: ServoCSSRuleList::GetRule
nodes.summary: Materializes the Gecko css::Rule for an index by querying the raw rule type (Servo_CssRules_ListTypes/Get) and constructing the matching rule wrapper.

nodes.name: ServoCSSRuleList::IndexedGetter
nodes.summary: WebIDL indexed getter exposing rules to script with bounds semantics.

nodes.name: ServoCSSRuleList::InsertRule
nodes.summary: Forwards CSSOM insertRule to Stylo (Servo_CssRules_InsertRule) and caches the resulting rule type.

nodes.name: ServoCSSRuleList::DeleteRule
nodes.summary: Forwards CSSOM deleteRule to Stylo and invalidates cached rule entries.

nodes.name: ServoCSSRuleList::SetRawContents
nodes.summary: Swaps in a new StyleLockedCssRules (e.g. after replaceSync) and resets lazily-built rule wrappers.

nodes.name: ServoStyleSet
nodes.summary: Gecko's style-set front end to Stylo: owns StyleSetContents created by Servo_StyleSet_Init, drives whole-document/subtree traversals (StyleDocument, StyleNewSubtree backed by Servo_TraverseTree-style FFI), resolves element/pseudo/anonymous-box ComputedStyle, and manages sheets, rule changes, and animation/keyframe queries.

nodes.name: ServoStyleSet::ResolveServoStyle
nodes.summary: Inline fast path calling Servo_ResolveStyle to obtain an element's already-traversed ComputedStyle.

nodes.name: ServoStyleSet::EvaluateSourceSizeList
nodes.summary: Inline wrapper evaluating a <source size> list via Servo_SourceSizeList_Evaluate for font-size adjust / size-select.

nodes.name: StyleSheet
nodes.summary: Base stylesheet class holding StyleSheetInfo (principal, URI, children), the raw Stylo StyleLockedStyleSheet handle, and DOM APIs (cssRules, insertRule, replace) plus parse entry points.

nodes.name: StyleSheet::ParseSheet
nodes.summary: Async parse entry: hands sheet bytes/UTF-8 input to Stylo via Servo_StyleSheet_FromUTF8Bytes(Async), resolving a StyleSheetParsePromise with the parsed sheet.

nodes.name: StyleSheet::ParseSheetSync
nodes.summary: Synchronous parse path calling Servo_StyleSheet_FromUTF8Bytes directly, with reusable child-sheet support for @import.

nodes.name: StyleSheet::EnsureUniqueInner
nodes.summary: Clones shared sheet data (Servo_StyleSheet_FromSharedData) so a sheet about to be mutated gets its own Stylo rule storage.

nodes.name: StyleSheet::InsertRule
nodes.summary: CSSOM insertRule: permission checks, ensures unique inner, then delegates to the rule list / Servo FFI and notifies style sets.

nodes.name: StyleSheet::RuleAdded
nodes.summary: Notifies attached ServoStyleSets (and document) that a rule was added so Stylo's cascade can be updated.

nodes.name: StyleSheet::ApplicableStateChanged
nodes.summary: Fires load/error events and tells the document/style sets a sheet became applicable or inapplicable.

nodes.name: nsHtml5AtomTable
nodes.summary: Per-parser atom cache providing GetAtom interning for tag/attribute names; guaranteed non-concurrent access across parser threads and bulk release via Clear.

nodes.name: nsHtml5AtomTable::GetAtom
nodes.summary: Looks up the string in a 64-slot recently-used table keyed by scrambled hash high bits; hits return cached nsAtom, misses call NS_Atomize and refill the slot.

nodes.name: nsHtml5ElementName.cpp
nodes.summary: Generated file (from ElementName.java) holding the static element-name tables for the HTML5 parser. Defines ELEMENT_HASHES, ELEMENT_NAMES (197 entries) and initializeStatics(), which allocates each ELT_* singleton, binding nsGkAtoms names and NS_New* HTML/SVG content-creator function pointers plus tree-builder group flags.

nodes.name: nsHtml5ElementName.h
nodes.summary: Header for the generated nsHtml5ElementName class. Each instance pairs an interned nsAtom name and camelCaseName with HTMLContentCreatorFunction/SVGContentCreatorFunction pointers and parser flags (SPECIAL, FOSTER_PARENTING, SCOPING, groups). Provides elementNameByBuffer() with literal fast-paths for div/img/span/li/ul/a/p etc. and a level-order binary search over ELEMENT_HASHES.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TreeBuilder.cpp
nodes.summary: The 4713-line generated tree-construction state machine of the HTML5 parser (starttagloop over insertion modes: before-html, in-head, in-body, in-table, in-template, foreign content). startTag() consults elementName->getGroup()/getName() and routes to appendToCurrentNodeAndPushElement*/appendVoidElementToCurrent*/createAndInsertFosterParentedElement, which call createElement/appendElement to materialize Gecko DOM nodes via the creator function pointers.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TreeBuilder.h
nodes.summary: Class declaration for nsHtml5TreeBuilder (implements nsAHtml5TreeBuilderState for snapshot/restore). Declares startTag and the protected createElement/appendElement/createAndInsertFosterParentedElement DOM-building surface; a trailing #include of nsHtml5TreeBuilderHSupplement.h supplies Gecko-specific inline members (tree-op queue handling executed later by nsHtml5TreeOpExecutor, not part of this batch).

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Top-level Firefox repository readme: short project description, contribution quick-reference link, Bugzilla issue-tracker note, and links to Firefox Source Docs, Nightly builds, and Matrix chat.

nodes.name: applicable_declarations.rs
nodes.summary: Applicable-declarations management for the Stylo style system. Defines the SmallVec-backed ApplicableDeclarationList, CascadePriority (cascade level + layer order + flags with CSS-cascade-5 layering rules), ScopeProximity (cascade-6 proximity), and ApplicableDeclarationBlock, the transient 24-byte block shuttling matched declarations from selector matching into the rule tree.

nodes.name: author_styles.rs
nodes.summary: GenericAuthorStyles (exported as AuthorStyles) holds a set of author stylesheets plus computed Arc<CascadeData>, used e.g. for ShadowRoot styles. flush() flushes the AuthorStylesheetSet and asks the Stylist to rebuild author cascade data, returning a StylesheetInvalidationSet.

nodes.name: bloom.rs
nodes.summary: The style bloom filter used to fast-reject deep descendant selectors during matching. StyleBloom<E: TElement> keeps a thread-local counting BloomFilter plus the stack of pushed elements and hashes, tracking DOM depth so work-stealing parallel traversal can recover to a common ancestor (insert_parents_recovering).

nodes.name: context.rs
nodes.summary: The context within which style is calculated. StyleSystemOptions (env-driven), SharedStyleContext (one per restyle traversal: stylist, guards, snapshot map, traversal flags), CascadeInputs/EagerPseudoCascadeInputs, per-thread TraversalStatistics, SequentialTask (e.g. UpdateAnimations) and ThreadLocalStyleContext<E> bundling thread-local state such as the bloom filter and sharing cache.

nodes.name: data.rs
nodes.summary: Per-node style data for style calculation. ElementStyles wraps the primary ComputedValues plus EagerPseudoStyles; ElementData (in an AtomicRefCell-backed ElementDataWrapper) tracks ElementDataFlags, restyle hints/damage and computed styles, exposing the mutable borrow surface the traversal and Gecko's Servo_Traverse calls operate on.

nodes.name: dom_apis.rs
nodes.summary: Generic DOM-API implementations shared between Servo and Gecko, driven from C++ bindings. element_matches/element_closest run selectors::matching directly; the SelectorQuery trait plus QuerySelectorProcessor implement querySelector/querySelectorAll with a fast path via invalidation-map dependencies and id/attr buckets, falling back to query_selector_slow subtree matching.

nodes.name: dom.rs
nodes.summary: The generic DOM abstraction the style crate is written against. Defines NodeInfo, TDocument, TNode, TShadowRoot and TElement (extending selectors::Element with SelectorImpl), plus DomChildren/DomDescendants iterators and element-state/bloom/restyle helpers; Gecko implements these in gecko/wrapper.rs (GeckoElement), which is how C++ DOM nodes enter Stylo.

nodes.name: error_reporting.rs
nodes.summary: Types used to report CSS parsing errors. ContextualParseError enumerates unsupported declarations/descriptors/rules with Display formatting; ParseErrorReporter is the reporting trait (with a no-op Reporter), RustLogReporter logs to the platform logger, and SelectorWarningKind covers selector-level diagnostics.

nodes.name: gecko_bindings/mod.rs
nodes.summary: Root of Gecko's C++ bindings: includes the bindgen-generated structs.rs from OUT_DIR into a permissive `structs` module, re-exports it as `bindings`, and declares the `sugar` submodule of Rust helpers for Gecko types.

nodes.name: sugar/mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module index for Rust sugar over Gecko types: ns_com_ptr, ns_compatibility, ns_style_auto_array, origin_flags, ownership, and refptr.

nodes.name: ns_com_ptr.rs
nodes.summary: Tiny helper adding nsCOMPtr<T>::raw() returning the underlying mRawPtr.

nodes.name: ns_compatibility.rs
nodes.summary: Converts Gecko's nsCompatibility modes (FullStandards/AlmostStandards/NavQuirks) into Stylo's QuirksMode via From.

nodes.name: ns_style_auto_array.rs
nodes.summary: Index/IndexMut, iter/iter_mut, len and IntoIterator for nsStyleAutoArray<T> (mFirstElement plus mOtherElements), and type-specialized ensure_len() that calls Gecko_EnsureStyleAnimation/Transition/ViewTimeline/ScrollTimelineArrayLength FFI helpers.

nodes.name: origin_flags.rs
nodes.summary: assert_flags_match() checks OriginFlags bit values against OriginSet, and From impls convert between bindgen OriginFlags and Stylo's OriginSet.

nodes.name: ownership.rs
nodes.summary: Helpers for Gecko FFI pointer kinds: Strong<GeckoType> is a repr(C), null-able, deliberately leak-on-drop FFI-safe Arc wrapper, and CopyablePtr gets Deref/DerefMut for C++-shared smart pointers.

nodes.name: refptr.rs
nodes.summary: Rust mirror of Gecko refcounting: unsafe RefCounted/ThreadSafeRefCounted traits, a custom RefPtr<T> with from_addrefed/new/forget/get and Drop that releases, plus Atom interop helpers for marshalling refcounted style-struct types across FFI.

nodes.name: anon_boxes.toml
nodes.summary: Declarative list of Gecko anonymous boxes (-moz-table, -moz-ruby, -moz-viewport, -moz-block-inside-inline-wrapper, etc.) with inherits and wrapper flags, consumed by the style build to generate pseudo/anonymous-box metadata alongside longhands.toml and pseudo_elements.toml.

nodes.name: arc_types.rs
nodes.summary: Lists all Arc'd FFI types shared with Gecko and generates Servo_*_AddRef/Servo_*_Release extern "C" functions via impl_simple_arc_ffi!/impl_locked_arc_ffi! for CssRules, PropertyDeclarationBlock, StyleRule, MediaList, Keyframe, layer/media/namespace/scope rules, ComputedValues and more.

nodes.name: conversions.rs
nodes.summary: Small conversion helpers between Servo and Gecko types kept here for coherence reasons: RulesMutateError -> nsresult and bidirectional conversion between Matrix3D and bindgen Matrix4x4Components.

nodes.name: gecko/data.rs
nodes.summary: Data needed to style a Gecko document. GeckoStyleSheet wraps the DOM StyleSheet (Send/Sync lie with AddRef/Release via Gecko_StyleSheet_* bindings and implements StylesheetInDocument). PerDocumentStyleData is an AtomicRefCell<PerDocumentStyleDataImpl> owning the Stylist plus undisplayed-style cache; flush_stylesheets() drives Stylist::flush, and AuthorStyles is aliased to the GeckoStyleSheet instantiation.

nodes.name: nsHtml5ElementName
nodes.summary: Generated value class mapping one HTML/SVG/MathML tag name to an interned nsAtom, camelCase atom, parser flags (group bitmask, SPECIAL, FOSTER_PARENTING, SCOPING, HTML_INTEGRATION_POINT, OPTIONAL_END_TAG), and NS_New* HTML/SVG content-creator function pointers used when the tree builder instantiates the element.

nodes.name: elementNameByBuffer
nodes.summary: Static lookup from a raw char16_t buffer to an nsHtml5ElementName*: literal-compare fast paths for the hottest tags (a, p, li, ul, div, img, span, label, input, button, strong), otherwise bufToHash + levelOrderBinarySearch over ELEMENT_HASHES and a confirming localEqualsBuffer compare.

nodes.name: levelOrderBinarySearch
nodes.summary: Static binary search over the heap-ordered ELEMENT_HASHES array mapping a tag-name hash to its ELEMENT_NAMES index, returning -1 when not found.

nodes.name: bufToHash
nodes.summary: Static hash combining the tag-name length with shifted first/last characters into the 32-bit key consumed by levelOrderBinarySearch.

nodes.name: initializeStatics
nodes.summary: Allocates the 197-entry ELEMENT_NAMES array and constructs every ELT_* singleton, wiring nsGkAtoms names, the NS_NewHTML*/NS_NewSVG* creator function pointers (e.g. ELT_DIV -> NS_NewHTMLDivElement, unknown/custom-element fallbacks via setNameForNonInterned) and tree-builder group flags.

nodes.name: releaseStatics
nodes.summary: Shutdown counterpart that deletes every ELT_* singleton and the ELEMENT_NAMES array.

nodes.name: ELEMENT_NAMES / ELEMENT_HASHES
nodes.summary: The static element-name table: ELEMENT_NAMES is an array of 197 nsHtml5ElementName* singletons indexed by the level-ordered ELEMENT_HASHES hash array, jointly implementing the tag-name -> element-name-object mapping that carries the creator function pointers.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TreeBuilder
nodes.summary: The HTML5 tree-construction state machine: owns the open-element stack, active formatting elements, template-mode stack and insertion mode. DOM creation is deferred through createElement/appendElement (implemented via the Gecko supplement and tree operations later executed by nsHtml5TreeOpExecutor, not in this batch), which end up invoking the NS_New* creator functions carried on nsHtml5ElementName.

nodes.name: startTag
nodes.summary: Entry point for start tags (the starttagloop): reads elementName->getGroup()/getName(), handles foreign-content (SVG/MathML) and each insertion mode, then dispatches to the appendToCurrentNodeAndPushElement*/appendVoid* family, which create Gecko elements through the element name's creator function pointers.

nodes.name: appendToCurrentNodeAndPushElement
nodes.summary: Canonical in-body element creation: calls createElement(kNameSpaceID_XHTML, elementName->getName(), attributes, currentNode, htmlCreator(elementName->getHtmlCreator())), appends the result to the current node and pushes a stack node, ultimately producing the real Gecko DOM element via the NS_New* creator.

nodes.name: createAndInsertFosterParentedElement
nodes.summary: Creates an element (via createElement with the nsHtml5ContentCreatorFunction) and inserts it foster-parented relative to a table/stack parent, used when mis-nested content appears inside tables and templates.

nodes.name: appendHtmlElementToDocumentAndPush
nodes.summary: Bootstraps the tree by calling createHtmlElementSetAsRoot (the <html> element) and pushing its stack node; part of the initial document-element creation path into Gecko DOM element factories.

nodes.name: startTagGenericRawText
nodes.summary: Handles style/noframes-style raw-text start tags: creates the element via the creator path, switches the tokenizer to RAWTEXT, and pushes the element on the stack.

nodes.name: createElement
nodes.summary: Protected factory declared on the tree builder taking namespace id, atom, attributes, intended parent and an nsHtml5ContentCreatorFunction; the Gecko supplement implementation turns this into a tree operation executed by nsHtml5TreeOpExecutor, which calls the NS_New* creator (HTMLElementFactory machinery) to build the DOM node.

nodes.name: appendElement
nodes.summary: Protected primitive that appends a created child handle to a parent handle through the tree-operation layer, later replayed by nsHtml5TreeOpExecutor against the real Gecko content tree.

nodes.name: ApplicableDeclarationBlock
nodes.summary: 24-byte copyable block of matched declarations (StyleSourceBorrow, source_order, specificity, ScopeProximity, CascadePriority) shuttled between selector matching and rule-tree insertion; provides sort_key() and for_rule_tree().

nodes.name: CascadePriority
nodes.summary: Packed u32 of cascade level, rule-cascade flags and layer order implementing cascade-5 layer ordering (including the style-attribute-layer special case) plus revert/revert-layer/revert-rule allowance logic.

nodes.name: ScopeProximity
nodes.summary: u16 measure of proximity to a CSS-cascade-6 scope root used to order competing @scope declarations, with an infinity sentinel for out-of-scope declarations.

nodes.name: AuthorStyles (GenericAuthorStyles)
nodes.summary: Author stylesheet set plus its computed Arc<CascadeData>, instantiated as AuthorStyles<GeckoStyleSheet> for ShadowRoots; flush() rebuilds the cascade data through the Stylist and collects invalidations.

nodes.name: StyleBloom
nodes.summary: Per-thread ancestor fast-reject filter: a leaked thread-local counting BloomFilter plus the pushed-element stack and pushed-hash stack, with push/pop/rebuild and insert_parents_recovering to handle work-stealing during parallel traversal.

nodes.name: each_relevant_element_hash
nodes.summary: Feeds an element's local name, namespace, id/class-ish attribute hashes into the bloom filter callback, defining what counts as relevant for fast rejection.

nodes.name: is_attr_name_excluded_from_filter
nodes.summary: Excludes very common but rarely matched attributes (class, id, style) from the bloom filter to reduce false-positive pressure.

nodes.name: SharedStyleContext
nodes.summary: Immutable context shared by all worker threads during one restyle traversal: the Stylist, stylesheet guards, StyleSystemOptions, traversal flags, snapshot map, animation time, and viewport/quirks accessors.

nodes.name: ThreadLocalStyleContext
nodes.summary: Per-worker-thread context holding the StyleBloom filter, sharing-cache touch list and SequentialTask queue executed when the thread finishes traversal work.

nodes.name: CascadeInputs
nodes.summary: Intermediate cascade inputs (rule node, visited rule node, ComputedValueFlags, included cascade flags) held temporarily during matching/cascading and folded into ComputedValues afterwards.

nodes.name: SequentialTask
nodes.summary: Task queued during parallel traversal but executed on the main thread, chiefly UpdateAnimations (CSS animations/transitions/effect properties/scroll & view timelines) against an element.

nodes.name: StyleSystemOptions
nodes.summary: Global style-system switches (disable_style_sharing_cache, dump_style_statistics, style_statistics_threshold) read from environment variables on Gecko.

nodes.name: ElementData
nodes.summary: Per-element style container (inside an AtomicRefCell ElementDataWrapper) holding ElementStyles, restyle hint/damage and flags; the unit of state read and mutated during Stylo traversals and by Gecko's style-data bindings.

nodes.name: ElementStyles
nodes.summary: Primary ComputedValues plus the lazy Arc-backed EagerPseudoStyles array for eagerly-cascaded pseudo-elements, with helpers to reuse/share styles.

nodes.name: EagerPseudoStyles
nodes.summary: Option<Arc<EagerPseudoArray>> of per-eager-pseudo ComputedValues with Arc::make_mut copy-on-write so the style sharing cache can share them cheaply.

nodes.name: element_matches
nodes.summary: Implements DOM Element.matches() by driving selectors::matching::matches_selector_list with a MatchingContext scoped to the element and its shadow host.

nodes.name: element_closest
nodes.summary: Implements DOM Element.closest() by walking parent elements and running selector matching on each until a match is found.

nodes.name: query_selector
nodes.summary: Generic querySelector(All) entry: tries query_selector_fast using invalidation-map dependencies and id/attribute buckets from the stylist's cascade data, falling back to query_selector_slow's full subtree matching via QuerySelectorProcessor.

nodes.name: SelectorQuery
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting querySelector vs querySelectorAll (QueryAll/QueryFirst policies over QuerySelectorAllResult SmallVec) used by the query machinery's InvalidationProcessor.

nodes.name: TElement
nodes.summary: The element trait - the main abstraction the style crate acts over - extending selectors::Element (Impl = SelectorImpl) and ElementContext with traversal/inheritance parents, bloom-filter access, namespace checks, style data access and animation hooks; implemented by gecko::wrapper::GeckoElement for the C++ DOM.

nodes.name: TNode
nodes.summary: Generic node trait (parent/sibling navigation, dom_children/dom_descendants iterators, as_element) over which the whole style system is parameterized; its ConcreteElement links nodes to TElement.

nodes.name: TDocument
nodes.summary: Document-node trait: html-ness, quirks mode, shared lock and elements_with_id lookup used by id-based selector fast paths.

nodes.name: TShadowRoot
nodes.summary: Shadow-root trait giving the style system access to shadow hosts and their trees for slotting and cascade scoping.

nodes.name: NodeInfo
nodes.summary: Minimal is_element/is_text_node trait used by LayoutIterator to skip nodes layout ignores.

nodes.name: ContextualParseError
nodes.summary: Enum of every CSS parse failure class Stylo reports (unsupported declarations/descriptors/rules, invalid counter-style/media/keyframes, NeverMatchingHostSelector, view-transition descriptors) with Display formatting for console output.

nodes.name: ParseErrorReporter
nodes.summary: Trait through which stylesheet parsing reports errors with source location and URL; implementations route messages to the platform console or Gecko's error console.

nodes.name: RustLogReporter
nodes.summary: Default ParseErrorReporter that emits formatted CSS parse errors to the Rust log.

nodes.name: structs / bindings
nodes.summary: Module that textually includes the bindgen-generated structs.rs from OUT_DIR under heavy lint allowances and re-exports it as `bindings`; the single FFI surface binding Stylo to Gecko C++ types and Gecko_* functions.

nodes.name: RefPtr
nodes.summary: Custom Rust RefPtr for Gecko refcounted types with FFI-friendly from_addrefed/new/forget and Drop calling release().

nodes.name: RefCounted
nodes.summary: Unsafe trait for types exposing Addref()/Release() so they can live inside RefPtr<T>; ThreadSafeRefCounted marks the Send+Sync subset.

nodes.name: Strong
nodes.summary: repr(C) FFI-safe, nullable Arc handle (leaks on drop by design) used to pass Stylo Arc types to Gecko and back.

nodes.name: nsStyleAutoArray
nodes.summary: Rust ergonomic surface (Index, iter, len, IntoIterator, ensure_len via Gecko_*ArrayLength FFI) over Gecko's first-element-plus-array auto array type used for animations, transitions and timelines.

nodes.name: assert_flags_match
nodes.summary: Debug-time check that bindgen OriginFlags bits equal Stylo OriginSet bits for user-agent, author and user origins.

nodes.name: impl_simple_arc_ffi! / impl_locked_arc_ffi!
nodes.summary: Macros generating #[no_mangle] pub unsafe extern "C" Servo_<Type>_AddRef/_Release pairs (and Locked<..> aliases) for every Arc'd CSS type shared across the Stylo/Gecko FFI boundary.

nodes.name: Matrix conversions
nodes.summary: From impls converting between Gecko's Matrix4x4Components array and Stylo's Matrix3D struct, plus RulesMutateError -> nsresult DOM error mapping.

nodes.name: PerDocumentStyleData
nodes.summary: AtomicRefCell<PerDocumentStyleDataImpl> - the container of all styling state for a Servo-backed Gecko document, created from a raw bindgen Document pointer with borrow()/borrow_mut() accessors used by ServoStyleSet C++ bindings.

nodes.name: PerDocumentStyleDataImpl
nodes.summary: Holds the Stylist (rule processor built over a Device for the document) and the undisplayed-style cache; flush_stylesheets() propagates stylesheet changes into the Stylist and returns invalidations, and default_computed_values() exposes the device defaults.

nodes.name: GeckoStyleSheet
nodes.summary: Wrapper around Gecko's DOM StyleSheet pointer implementing StylesheetInDocument: AddRef/Release via Gecko_StyleSheet_* bindings, media/contents/implicit-scope-root access, deliberately unsafe Send+Sync.

nodes.name: media_features.rs
nodes.summary: Gecko's media-query feature evaluation. Defines the MEDIA_FEATURES table of 60 QueryFeatureDescription entries plus dozens of eval_* evaluator functions that read Device/Context state such as viewport size, color gamut, pointer/hover capabilities, prefers-color-scheme and -moz look-and-feel prefs.

nodes.name: MEDIA_FEATURES
nodes.summary: Static table of 60 QueryFeatureDescription entries describing every supported media feature (name, parser, evaluator, flags) consumed by the media-queries machinery.

nodes.name: eval_width
nodes.summary: Evaluator for the width media feature that reads the viewport size from the style Context.

nodes.name: eval_prefers_color_scheme
nodes.summary: Evaluator for prefers-color-scheme, consulting device light/dark preference and embedder callbacks.

nodes.name: eval_pointer
nodes.summary: Evaluator for the pointer media feature built on primary pointer capabilities (none/coarse/fine).

nodes.name: eval_color_gamut
nodes.summary: Evaluator for the color-gamut media feature, comparing the device gamut (srgb/p3/rec2020) against the query value.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for Gecko-specific style-system bits. Declares the gecko submodule tree: wrapper, selector_parser, snapshot, snapshot_helpers, media_features, pseudo_element, traversal, restyle_damage, and the non_ts_pseudo_class_list macro module.

nodes.name: non_ts_pseudo_class_list.rs
nodes.summary: Macro-driven catalogue of all supported non-tree-structural pseudo-classes (:hover, :checked, -moz-* etc.) with their ElementState bits and enabling flags. Expanded via apply_non_ts_list! wherever Gecko's SelectorImpl needs the full list.

nodes.name: apply_non_ts_list
nodes.summary: macro_rules! helper that applies a caller macro to every (css name, ident, state, flags) tuple of supported non-tree-structural pseudo-classes.

nodes.name: pseudo_element_definition.mako.rs
nodes.summary: Mako template that generates the Gecko PseudoElement enum, EAGER_PSEUDOS tables, per-type PseudoStyleTypeFlags, property restrictions (APPLIES_TO_FIRST_LETTER etc.) and pref/enabling checks from the pseudo-elements TOML data. Rendered by regen_pseudo_elements.py into pseudo_element_definition.rs.

nodes.name: PseudoElement
nodes.summary: Generated #[repr(u8)] enum with one variant per pseudo-element/anon box plus UnknownWebkit; the single canonical representation of pseudo-elements in Gecko selectors.

nodes.name: EAGER_PSEUDOS
nodes.summary: Generated const array (with EAGER_PSEUDO_COUNT and PSEUDO_COUNT) listing pseudo-elements eagerly cascaded during traversal, such as ::before, ::after, ::first-letter and ::first-line.

nodes.name: flags_for_index
nodes.summary: Generated static flag table mapping each PseudoStyleType to its PseudoStyleTypeFlags (enabled-in, pref-gated, element-backed, supports-user-action-state).

nodes.name: property_restriction
nodes.summary: Returns the PropertyFlags restriction (APPLIES_TO_FIRST_LETTER, APPLIES_TO_HIGHLIGHT, ...) that longhands must satisfy to apply to a given pseudo-element, used by the cascade.

nodes.name: pseudo_element.rs
nodes.summary: Gecko PseudoElement support built on the include!'d generated definition: parsing pseudo-element syntax (including functional/element-backed view-transition pseudos), Target-based CSSOM serialization, cascade-type classification, inheritance/animation behavior and property-restriction plumbing.

nodes.name: Target
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing Selector parsing from Cssom serialization contexts when interpreting pseudo-element syntax.

nodes.name: PtNameAndClassSelector
nodes.summary: Argument type for element-backed view-transition pseudo-elements, holding the ::part name and class selector list, with parse and ToCss impls.

nodes.name: PseudoElementTrait
nodes.summary: Implementation of the shared PseudoElementTrait for Gecko's PseudoElement: pseudo kind classification (pseudo-element vs anon box, inheriting/non-inheriting), eager-ness, cascade flags and state support.

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Parses a pseudo-element name (and functional argument, e.g. ::highlight(name) or ::view-transition-group(part)) into a PseudoElement, honoring enabled state per target.

nodes.name: parse_ignore_enabled_state
nodes.summary: Parses a pseudo-element string without checking whether it is currently enabled; used by CSSOM and internal callers.

nodes.name: pseudo_elements.py
nodes.summary: Python data model for pseudo-elements and anonymous boxes: parses pseudo_elements.toml and anon_boxes.toml into Pseudo/PseudoElement/AnonBox objects, computes PseudoStyleTypeFlags, and feeds the pseudo_element_definition.mako.rs codegen.

nodes.name: Pseudo
nodes.summary: Base class holding name, camel/capitalized idents, argument, enabled_in and pref, plus the flags() computation shared by pseudo-elements and anon boxes.

nodes.name: AnonBox
nodes.summary: Represents an anonymous box pseudo (wrapper/inheriting variants) loaded from anon_boxes.toml.

nodes.name: PseudoElement
nodes.summary: Represents one pseudo-element from pseudo_elements.toml with flags such as is_css2, is_eager, is_element_backed, is_tree_abiding and supports_user_action_state.

nodes.name: PseudoElementData
nodes.summary: Loads and sorts the anon box and pseudo-element TOML definitions, exposing all_pseudos() and path dependencies for the build.

nodes.name: pseudo_elements.toml
nodes.summary: Declarative catalogue of supported CSS pseudo-elements (::after, ::before, ::marker, ::highlight, view-transition pseudos, -moz-tree pseudos, form-control pseudos, -webkit-scrollbar...) with flags like is_eager, is_element_backed, argument, pref and enabled_in. Source of truth for the generated PseudoElement enum.

nodes.name: regen_pseudo_elements.py
nodes.summary: Build-script helper that renders pseudo_element_definition.mako.rs with PseudoElementData and writes the generated pseudo_element_definition.rs into the cargo OUT_DIR, emitting rerun-if-changed directives.

nodes.name: generate_pseudo_elements
nodes.summary: Entry point that builds PseudoElementData, renders the pseudo-element definition template via build.render, and writes pseudo_element_definition.rs to the output directory.

nodes.name: restyle_damage.rs
nodes.summary: Gecko's restyle damage representation: GeckoRestyleDamage wraps nsChangeHint with bitwise ops, and compute_style_difference diffs old vs new ComputedValues via the Gecko_CalcStyleDifference FFI (plus custom-property comparison) to produce a StyleDifference.

nodes.name: GeckoRestyleDamage
nodes.summary: Copy-able wrapper over nsChangeHint with empty/reconstruct constructors, containment checks, and BitOr/BitAnd/Not operators.

nodes.name: compute_style_difference
nodes.summary: Computes the StyleDifference (nsChangeHint plus StyleChange) between old and new ComputedValues, calling Gecko_CalcStyleDifference and accounting for changed custom properties.

nodes.name: gecko/selector_parser.rs
nodes.summary: Cross-batch file: Gecko's SelectorImpl implementation defining PseudoElement/PseudoClass parsing (::-moz-* etc.), non-tree-skipping pseudo-classes and element state mapping, re-exported by selector_parser.rs for Gecko builds.

nodes.name: SelectorImpl
nodes.summary: Gecko's selectors::SelectorImpl instantiation binding NonTSPseudoClass, PseudoElement and atom types into the shared selector machinery.

nodes.name: NonTSPseudoClass
nodes.summary: Enum of non-tree-structural pseudo-classes generated by apply_non_ts_list!, with matching state bits, UA-sheet/chrome enabling checks, parsing and serialization.

nodes.name: SelectorParser
nodes.summary: selectors::Parser implementation for Gecko providing namespace handling, pseudo-class/pseudo-element parsing, and nesting/relative-selector support.

nodes.name: parse_pseudo_element
nodes.summary: selectors::Parser hook that turns a ::name token into a Gecko PseudoElement, delegating to the pseudo-element parsing logic.

nodes.name: parse_non_ts_pseudo_class
nodes.summary: selectors::Parser hook that parses a non-tree-structural pseudo-class name into a NonTSPseudoClass via the generated parse arms.

nodes.name: ExtraMatchingData
nodes.summary: Matching-time context (bloom filter, nesting, tree counters, etc.) passed alongside Gecko selector matching.

nodes.name: snapshot_helpers.rs
nodes.summary: Low-level helpers shared by GeckoElement and ServoElementSnapshot to inspect Gecko attribute arrays: finding attrs, id extraction, class/part matching with a bloom-filter fast path, exported/imported parts, and attribute-selector matching against nsAttrValue via FFI.

nodes.name: find_attr
nodes.summary: Finds an internal attribute by atom pointer equality in an AttrArray of internal attrs.

nodes.name: get_id
nodes.summary: Extracts the id attribute as a WeakAtom from a snapshot attribute list.

nodes.name: has_class_or_part
nodes.summary: Checks whether a class/part atom list (single atom or AttrAtomArray with bloom filter) contains the given name under a case sensitivity rule.

nodes.name: each_class_or_part
nodes.summary: Invokes a callback for every class or part atom stored in an nsAttrValue.

nodes.name: classes_changed
nodes.summary: Diffs an element against its snapshot to list classes added or removed since the snapshot, used for restyle invalidation.

nodes.name: attr_matches
nodes.summary: Evaluates an attribute selector (namespace + operator: =, ~=, |=, ^=, $=, *=) against Gecko internal attrs, dispatching to Gecko_Attr* FFI helpers.

nodes.name: snapshot.rs
nodes.summary: Defines GeckoElementSnapshot (ServoElementSnapshot) and SnapshotMap (ServoElementSnapshotTable) and implements the ElementSnapshot trait, so restyle invalidation and selector matching can read an element's pre-change attributes, state and custom states.

nodes.name: GeckoElementSnapshot
nodes.summary: Type alias for ServoElementSnapshot with helper methods (has_other_pseudo_class_state, id_changed, class_changed, each_attr_changed, attr_matches) and the ElementSnapshot trait impl.

nodes.name: SnapshotMap
nodes.summary: Type alias for ServoElementSnapshotTable with a get() accessor that fetches a snapshot for a TElement via Gecko_GetElementSnapshot.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: SnapshotMap::get: returns the stored GeckoElementSnapshot for an element, transmuting the generic TElement to GeckoElement for the FFI call.

nodes.name: attr_matches
nodes.summary: ElementSnapshot::attr_matches implementation delegating to snapshot_helpers::attr_matches over the snapshot's stored attributes.

nodes.name: traversal.rs
nodes.summary: Gecko's DomTraversal implementation: RecalcStyleOnly wraps the SharedStyleContext and drives preorder styling of GeckoElement/GeckoNode trees by ensuring element data and invoking recalc_style_at.

nodes.name: RecalcStyleOnly
nodes.summary: The simple DomTraversal<GeckoElement> used by Gecko; process_preorder ensures style data and calls recalc_style_at, post-order is unused.

nodes.name: process_preorder
nodes.summary: For each node, upgrades it to an element, ensures its ElementData, and calls recalc_style_at to (re)compute styles.

nodes.name: wrapper.rs
nodes.summary: The Rust-to-Gecko DOM bridge: GeckoElement, GeckoNode, GeckoDocument and GeckoShadowRoot wrappers implement TElement/TNode/TDocument (plus selectors::Element), which is how Stylo reads attributes, element state, snapshots, style-attribute declaration blocks and animation rules from Gecko DOM through gecko_bindings FFI; also records snapshots, selector flags and restyle hints back onto nodes.

nodes.name: GeckoElement
nodes.summary: Concrete TElement implementation wrapping RawGeckoElement; bridges Rust styling to the Gecko DOM by answering selector queries (attrs, id/class, state, lang, parts), fetching style-attr/animation rules, ensuring ElementData, and noting restyle damage/selector flags.

nodes.name: GeckoNode
nodes.summary: TNode implementation wrapping RawGeckoNode with child iteration, element upgrade, flags and snapshot bookkeeping.

nodes.name: GeckoDocument
nodes.summary: TDocument implementation wrapping a Gecko Document, giving the style system access to stylesheets, root element and shadow roots.

nodes.name: GeckoShadowRoot
nodes.summary: TShadowRoot implementation wrapping structs::ShadowRoot for shadow-tree styling.

nodes.name: TElement
nodes.summary: The impl TElement for GeckoElement (~800 lines): style data access, animation rule fetching (Gecko_GetAnimationRule), snapshot handling (has_snapshot/handled_snapshot), update_animations, and restyle hint note_explicit_hints plumbing to nsChangeHint.

nodes.name: note_explicit_hints
nodes.summary: unsafe helper converting a RestyleHint plus nsChangeHint into GeckoRestyleDamage and storing them on the element for the Gecko side.

nodes.name: ensure_data
nodes.summary: unsafe TElement hook that lazily creates and returns mutable ElementData for the element via FFI, required before recalc_style_at.

nodes.name: global_style_data.rs
nodes.summary: Global style-system singletons: GLOBAL_STYLE_DATA (leaked SharedRwLock plus StyleSystemOptions) and STYLE_THREAD_POOL, a lazily built rayon pool of Stylo worker threads with startup/shutdown hooks wiring thread state, jemalloc arenas and profiler registration.

nodes.name: GlobalStyleData
nodes.summary: Holds the shared CSSOM RwLock and global StyleSystemOptions; exposed as the GLOBAL_STYLE_DATA LazyLock singleton.

nodes.name: StyleThreadPool
nodes.summary: Manages the parallel styling rayon thread pool: pool() access, shutdown() joining spawned threads, and get_thread_handles() for platform inspection; capped at STYLO_MAX_THREADS (6).

nodes.name: STYLE_THREAD_POOL
nodes.summary: LazyLock global thread pool configured from the layout.css.stylo-threads pref, Gecko overrides, or a cores*0.75 heuristic, with spawn/start/exit handlers.

nodes.name: thread_startup
nodes.summary: Per-thread init for style workers: initializes layout-worker thread state, enables the jemalloc thread-local arena, and registers with the Gecko profiler.

nodes.name: style lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root of Stylo's style component (servo/components/style), a primary consumer of the selectors crate for CSS selector handling in the style engine.

nodes.name: CaseSensitivityExt
nodes.summary: Trait extending selectors::attr::CaseSensitivity with eq_atom for Gecko WeakAtom comparisons (case-sensitive or ASCII-case-insensitive).

nodes.name: reexport_computed_values
nodes.summary: Macro-expanded module that re-exports every longhand's computed_value type as a named computed_values::* type.

nodes.name: matching.rs
nodes.summary: High-level orchestration of CSS selector matching and restyling - the heart of rule matching: MatchMethods/PrivateMatchMethods collect cascade inputs via the stylist/style resolver, update rules at cascade levels, diff old vs new styles, and finish restyles with damage computation and root/font-size bookkeeping.

nodes.name: MatchMethods
nodes.summary: Public trait on TElement implementing match-and-cascade orchestration: layout_parent, line_height_likely_changed, finish_restyle, and compute_style_difference dispatching to RestyleDamage.

nodes.name: PrivateMatchMethods
nodes.summary: Internal trait on TElement with the shared machinery behind MatchMethods: cascading visited/unvisited rules via rule_tree updates, after-change style, transitions/animations triggers, and style diffing.

nodes.name: StyleDifference
nodes.summary: Result of comparing an element's old and new style: the backend RestyleDamage plus a StyleChange (Changed{reset_only, custom_properties_changed} or Unchanged).

nodes.name: StyleChange
nodes.summary: Enum describing whether the style changed, whether only reset properties changed, and whether custom properties changed.

nodes.name: finish_restyle
nodes.summary: Updates an element's styles with newly resolved ones, computes and stores restyle damage, and propagates required changes (root font-size, writing mode, container type).

nodes.name: compute_style_difference
nodes.summary: Trait method that delegates to the backend RestyleDamage::compute_style_difference to obtain a StyleDifference between old and new ComputedValues.

nodes.name: parser.rs
nodes.summary: The context within which CSS is parsed: ParserContext (stylesheet origin, url data, parsing mode, quirks mode, namespaces, error reporter, use counters, attr() taint) and NestingContext for rule nesting, plus the derive-friendly Parse trait.

nodes.name: ParserContext
nodes.summary: Everything a CSS value/rule parser needs from outside: origin, UrlExtraData, ParsingMode, QuirksMode, namespaces, error reporting, counters, nesting and attr()-taint tracking, with helpers like nest_for_rule and in_ua_sheet.

nodes.name: NestingContext
nodes.summary: Tracks nested rule types and whether relative selector parsing is allowed (scope/nesting), with save/restore for nested rules.

nodes.name: Parse
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting parsing of a specified value given a ParserContext; implementable by derive with aliases, conditions and custom parse functions.

nodes.name: build.py
nodes.summary: Entry point of the property-definition codegen pipeline: builds data.PropertiesData for the servo or gecko engine, renders properties.mako.rs into properties.rs via Mako, and emits css-properties JSON/HTML documentation. Also provides the render/write helpers reused by pseudo-element codegen.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Selects the engine, constructs PropertiesData, renders properties.mako.rs, writes properties.rs and (for servo) css-properties json/html docs.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Renders a Mako template file with strict undefined checking and reports formatted Mako errors on failure.

nodes.name: write
nodes.summary: Writes generated content to a directory, creating it if needed, and aborts if leaked Python object reprs appear in the output.

nodes.name: cascade.rs
nodes.summary: Cross-batch file: implements cascade() and apply_declarations(), walking the rule node path to build the cascade priority queue and apply winning declarations (including CSS-wide keywords, custom properties, visited styles) into ComputedValues, invoking StyleAdjuster and property-specific fixups. The cascade stage proper of the CSS pipeline.

nodes.name: cascade
nodes.summary: Public entry point performing the cascade: computes new ComputedValues for an element from its rule node and parent style, delegating to cascade_rules in Unvisited mode.

nodes.name: cascade_rules
nodes.summary: Iterates the rule node building the declaration/priority sequence (with visited-rule fallbacks) and hands it to apply_declarations.

nodes.name: apply_declarations
nodes.summary: Core property-by-property application loop: builds a computed::Context/StyleBuilder, runs the Cascade over declarations (handling shorthands, custom properties substitution, restrictions, rule caching), and returns the final Arc<ComputedValues>; this is where values get stored, ultimately reaching Gecko nsStyle structs via the generated setters.

nodes.name: CascadeMode
nodes.summary: Enum selecting Unvisited cascading (with optional visited_rules) or Visited cascading against an unvisited context for :visited styling.

nodes.name: Cascade
nodes.summary: Stateful helper (with ::first-line reparenting, ignore-colors forced-colors handling) driving per-property application during apply_declarations.

nodes.name: DeclarationIterator
nodes.summary: Iterator over (PropertyDeclaration, CascadePriority) pairs walking the rule node chain, filtering by importance and pseudo-element property restrictions.

nodes.name: substitute_all
nodes.summary: Performs var() substitution over specified declarations during the cascade, resolving custom-property references.

nodes.name: computed_value_flags.rs
nodes.summary: Bitflags of facts about a computed style (viewport/container-unit usage, visited-dependent values, first-line subtrees, font-metric dependencies...) with helpers classifying which flags inherit to descendants and which feed back into the cascade as inputs.

nodes.name: ComputedValueFlags
nodes.summary: u32 bitflags struct describing misc properties of a computed style; carried on ComputedValues and consulted during restyle invalidation and cascading.

nodes.name: inherited_flags
nodes.summary: Mask of flags unconditionally propagated to descendants (visited links, first-line subtrees, text-decoration lines, opacity-0 subtree, contain:style, size containers, appearance:base).

nodes.name: cascade_input_flags
nodes.summary: Mask of flags that are inputs to the cascade (viewport units on container queries, scoped styles, container style/font-relative queries), via for_cascade_inputs().

nodes.name: counted_unknown_properties.py
nodes.summary: List of recognized-but-unimplemented (mostly -webkit- and legacy) property names tracked for telemetry use counters; consumed by data.py to build CountedUnknownProperty entries in the generated property database.

nodes.name: COUNTED_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES
