nodes.summary: Constant list of ~105 property names (e.g. -webkit-user-drag, orphans, widows, speak) counted when seen in author stylesheets.

nodes.name: data.py
nodes.summary: The property-definition data model driving all property codegen: parses longhand/shorthand definitions (from properties.mako.rs data) into Longhand/Shorthand/Alias/StyleStruct/Keyword objects, resolves logical property groups, prefs, IDL methods, counted unknown properties, and exposes helpers (to_camel_case etc.) consumed by Mako templates and build.py.

nodes.name: PropertiesData
nodes.summary: Aggregates all parsed longhands, shorthands, style structs, aliases and counted unknown properties for one engine, computing cross-references (longhands_by_name, logical groups) used by the templates.

nodes.name: Longhand
nodes.summary: Models a single longhand property: ident, gecko name/FFI, initial value, style struct membership, animation behavior, prefs, and computed-value plumbing.

nodes.name: Shorthand
nodes.summary: Models a shorthand property referencing its sub-longhands and expansion behavior for parsing and serialization.

nodes.name: StyleStruct
nodes.summary: Models a style struct (Font, Color, Display, ...) mapping longhands to the Gecko nsStyle FFI struct name and inheritance/alias info.

nodes.name: Keyword
nodes.summary: Helper modeling enumerated keyword values shared between parsing and Gecko gecko_keyword conversion.

nodes.name: Alias
nodes.summary: Models a property alias with its pref and targeting (servo/gecko) information.

nodes.name: to_camel_case
nodes.summary: Identifier conversion helper used across property and pseudo-element codegen (also imported by pseudo_elements.py).

nodes.name: declaration_block.rs
nodes.summary: Parsed declaration storage and CSSOM: PropertyDeclarationBlock holds PropertyDeclarations with Importance, supports insertion (push), importance-aware iteration (DeclarationImportanceIterator, AnimationValueIterator) used by the cascade, and CSSOM-compliant serialization (to_css including shorthand reconstruction).

nodes.name: PropertyDeclarationBlock
nodes.summary: The central storage of parsed declarations (from style attributes and rule bodies) with declaration/importance arrays, first-line/reputation bookkeeping, and lookup/serialization APIs consumed by matching and cascade.

nodes.name: Importance
nodes.summary: Enum marking whether a declaration is !important, packed into the block's bitfields.

nodes.name: DeclarationImportanceIterator
nodes.summary: Reverse iterator yielding declarations with their importance; the unit consumed by cascade.rs DeclarationIterator.

nodes.name: AnimationValueIterator
nodes.summary: Iterates declarations as animation values with a computed Context for CSS transitions/animations.

nodes.name: AnimationDeclarations
nodes.summary: Pair of declaration blocks (normal/important) collected for animation-related declaration sources.

nodes.name: to_css
nodes.summary: Implements the CSSOM 'serialize a CSS declaration block' algorithm, emitting shorthands where possible and tracking already-serialized longhands.

nodes.name: push
nodes.summary: Inserts a PropertyDeclaration with its importance into the block, replacing or removing conflicting longhands/shorthands per CSSOM rules.

nodes.name: gecko.mako.rs
nodes.summary: Cross-batch file: Gecko-side codegen (included by properties.mako.rs) that bridges computed property values into Gecko's nsStyle* structs, including system fonts, font sizing glue and assertion helpers. Final stage of the pipeline where computed values reach Gecko layout.

nodes.name: ComputedValues
nodes.summary: #[repr(C)] wrapper over mozilla::ComputedStyle: the style-system's computed style handle, exposing as_gecko_computed_style, construction from style structs, and accessors for custom properties, flags, writing mode and visited style.

nodes.name: ComputedValuesInner
nodes.summary: Alias for structs::ServoComputedData, the POD payload of style structs, rules pointer, flags and custom properties shared with C++.

nodes.name: style_structs
nodes.summary: Generated module re-exporting one wrapper struct per style struct, each Deref-ing to a ManuallyDrop<nsStyle*> with set_* methods per longhand that convert computed values into Gecko fields.

nodes.name: set_gecko_property
nodes.summary: Mako-level helper macro function emitting the setter glue (nsStyle lookup + field assignment/conversion) used by every generated set_${ident} longhand setter.

nodes.name: assert_initial_values_match
nodes.summary: Debug helper asserting that Rust-side initial property values match Gecko's default nsStyle struct construction, guarding the codegen bridge.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: ComputedValues::new: constructs a ComputedValues from custom properties, writing mode, zoom, flags, rule node and default-constructed or parent-derived nsStyle structs via Gecko_Construct_Default_* FFI.

nodes.name: bindings.rs (cross-batch)
nodes.summary: Cross-batch reference: bindgen-generated FFI declarations (Gecko_* functions and structs:: types) that let the Rust style system call into Gecko C++ for element state, snapshots, nsStyle manipulation and style diffing.

nodes.name: style selector_map.rs
nodes.summary: Stylo component implementing selector maps (indexed rule storage/lookup), built on top of the selectors crate's parsed selectors.

nodes.name: properties.mako.rs
nodes.summary: Main codegen output of the style property system: generated from longhands.toml/shorthands.toml via data.py and build.py, instantiating helpers.mako.rs defs. It emits the longhands/shorthands module tree, the LonghandId/ShorthandId/PropertyDeclaration enums, and static function tables that dispatch LonghandId::parse_value to longhands::*::parse_declared and ShorthandId::parse_into to shorthands::*::parse_into, plus ComputedValues/StyleBuilder glue feeding cascade and the Gecko bridge (includes gecko.mako.rs).

nodes.name: helpers.mako.rs
nodes.summary: Mako template library of <%def> blocks that emit the Rust module for each longhand (parse_declared, computed_value, get_initial_value) and each shorthand (Longhands struct, parse_into, to_css). It is the core codegen building block pulled in by properties.mako.rs; sits at the property-definition/codegen stage of the pipeline (longhands.toml -> data.py/build.py -> generated Rust).

nodes.name: animated_properties.mako.rs
nodes.summary: Codegen for CSS animation: defines the AnimationValue enum over all animatable properties plus Animate/ComputeSquaredDistance/ToAnimatedZero impls for interpolation, and TransitionProperty mappings. Sits between computed values and the animation engine, generated per property from the TOML property data.

nodes.name: properties/mod.rs
nodes.summary: Hand-written module root of the properties system: defines PropertyId/PropertyDeclarationId/NonCustomPropertyId/LonghandIdSet and PropertyDeclaration::parse_into, the declaration-parsing dispatch that routes longhands to generated parse_value and shorthands to ShorthandId::parse_into. Entry point of the declaration-parsing stage of the CSS pipeline.

nodes.name: properties.html.mako
nodes.summary: Tiny Mako template that renders an HTML documentation page listing the CSS properties Servo supports, with their prefs, from the same property data used for codegen. Documentation-only output of the property-definition stage.

nodes.name: shorthands.rs
nodes.summary: Hand-written implementations of shorthand property parsing and expansion (border, margin, background, grid, font, ...): each shorthand has parse_value/parse_into logic using macros like expanded! to parse into per-longhand slots. Called through the ShorthandId::parse_into dispatch table generated in properties.mako.rs.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Short readme for the servo-style crate: states it is the style system for Servo using rust-cssparser, and links to Servo's architecture book for style-system documentation.

nodes.name: rule_cache.rs
nodes.summary: Thread-local cache mapping StrongRuleNode paths to finished ComputedValues for reset properties, guarded by RuleCacheConditions (font-size, line-height, writing-mode, color-scheme, zoom). Used during cascade to skip recomputing styles whose rule node and conditions match; sits at the cascade/computed-values stage.

nodes.name: rule_collector.rs
nodes.summary: RuleCollector gathers all applicable declarations for an element in cascade order: UA/user/author stylist rules via SelectorMaps, :host/::slotted and ::part shadow-DOM rules, presentational hints, style attribute, SMIL/animations/transitions. Its output ApplicableDeclarationList is the cascade input to the rule tree; core of the rule-collection stage.

nodes.name: rule_tree/core.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the RuleTree trie of matched declaration blocks: RuleNode/StrongRuleNode/WeakRuleNode with atomic refcounting, a free list and periodic GC so common rule paths (:hover etc.) are shared and reused. ensure_child inserts sources in cascade-priority order; sits at the rule-tree stage between matching and cascade.

nodes.name: rule_tree/level.rs
nodes.summary: Defines CascadeLevel (packed bitfield of cascade origin, !important bit and shadow order), the CascadeOrigin enum (UA, User, PresHints, Author, PositionFallback, SMIL, Animations, Transitions) and ShadowCascadeOrder, encoding the CSS cascade-sort for rule nodes. Also selects the SharedRwLock guard per origin.

nodes.name: rule_tree/map.rs
nodes.summary: Small map abstraction (Empty | One | full FxHashMap) used for rule node children lists, avoiding heap allocation in the common zero/one-child case. Internal data-structure support for rule_tree/core.rs.

nodes.name: rule_tree/mod.rs
nodes.summary: Public facade of the rule tree: compute_rule_node and insert_ordered_rules_with_important turn an ApplicableDeclarationList into a StrongRuleNode path (handling !important reordering and transitions), plus update_rule_at_level and animation-rule removal used by restyle. Declares the core/level/map/source/unsafe_box submodules; the junction between rule collection and cascade.

nodes.name: rule_tree/source.rs
nodes.summary: StyleSource/StyleSourceBorrow wrap an Arc<Locked<PropertyDeclarationBlock>> stored in each rule node, coming from style rules, style attributes, animations, SMIL or presentational hints; read access goes through SharedRwLock guards. Also marks declaration blocks immutable when they enter the rule tree.

nodes.name: rule_tree/unsafe_box.rs
nodes.summary: UnsafeBox: a ManuallyDrop<Box<T>> helper providing the manual, refcount-free memory management that RuleNode relies on for its intrusive free-list scheme. Pure support code for rule_tree/core.rs.

nodes.name: style selector_parser.rs
nodes.summary: Stylo component defining the SelectorParser and Stylo's selector/pseudo-element support, implementing the selectors crate's parser traits.

nodes.name: shared_lock.rs
nodes.summary: SharedRwLock (AtomicRefCell-backed, supports read-only instances) plus Locked<T> and read/write guards; protects stylesheets, style rules and PropertyDeclarationBlocks shared across threads. The locking substrate used by rule collection, the rule tree and the stylist.

nodes.name: style_adjuster.rs
nodes.summary: StyleAdjuster applies post-cascade fixups to a StyleBuilder: blockification, display:contents handling, top-layer, position/overflow/contain propagation, writing-mode and ruby adjustments, text/field-satisfaction Gecko quirks, invoked from cascade after declarations are applied. Sits between cascade and final ComputedValues.

nodes.name: style_resolver.rs
nodes.summary: StyleResolverForElement drives per-element styling: match_primary/match_pseudo call Stylist::push_applicable_declarations, compute_rule_node builds the rule node, and cascade_style_and_visited delegates to Stylist::cascade_style_and_visited (properties::cascade), consulting the rule cache and style-sharing cache. The pivot between matching, rule tree and cascade stages.

nodes.name: stylesheet_set.rs
nodes.summary: DocumentStylesheetSet tracks the document's stylesheets per origin with append/insert/remove and dirty tracking, producing DocumentStylesheetFlusher/SheetCollectionFlusher with DataValidity (Valid/CascadeInvalid/FullyInvalid) so the Stylist knows what cascade data to rebuild on flush. Bookkeeping stage feeding stylist invalidation.

nodes.name: stylist.rs
nodes.summary: The Stylist is the per-document style engine: it owns the StylistStylesheetSet (a DocumentStylesheetSet), rebuilds CascadeData/DocumentCascadeData (SelectorMaps, Rule, custom properties, keyframes) on flush, and exposes push_applicable_declarations (delegating to RuleCollector) plus cascade_style_and_visited which invokes properties::cascade to produce ComputedValues. Central hub of matching and cascade-data assembly.

nodes.name: traversal_flags.rs
nodes.summary: TraversalFlags bitflags (AnimationOnly, ForCSSRuleChanges, FinalAnimationTraversal, ParallelTraversal, FlushThrottledAnimations) that control style traversal behavior, with an assertion that they match Gecko's ServoTraversalFlags values.

nodes.name: traversal.rs
nodes.summary: Implements DOM style traversal: the DomTraversal trait with pre_traverse/element_needs_traversal, recalc_style_at and compute_style (MatchAndCascade / CascadeWithReplacements / CascadeOnly restyle kinds), plus resolve_style for manually styling undiscovered ancestors. It creates StyleResolverForElement per element, top of the styling call chain.

nodes.name: longhand
nodes.summary: Mako <%def> that generates a full Rust module per longhand property: SpecifiedValue/computed_value types, get_initial_value, parse and parse_declared, wired into the generated longhands::* namespace.

nodes.name: shorthand
nodes.summary: Mako <%def> that generates a Rust module per shorthand: the Longhands/LonghandsToSerialize structs, parse_into (expanding into longhand declarations) and to_css serialization used by ShorthandId::longhands_to_css.

nodes.name: four_sides_shorthand
nodes.summary: Template def generating the common margin/padding/border-style-style four-side shorthand pattern (parse all four sides with shared value logic and CSS serialization).

nodes.name: two_properties_shorthand
nodes.summary: Template def generating two-longhand shorthands (e.g. flex-flow style patterns) with a shared parse_into/to_css skeleton.

nodes.name: single_border_shorthand
nodes.summary: Template def generating single-side border shorthands (border-top, border-right, ...) that expand into width/style/color longhands.

nodes.name: legacy_shorthand
nodes.summary: Template def for legacy shorthand aliases (e.g. -moz- prefixed forms) mapping onto existing longhand parse/serialization paths.

nodes.name: AnimationValue
nodes.summary: Generated enum holding a computed value per animatable property, with per-property animation types (by computed value, computed value with transform-like handling, or discrete), forming the unit of CSS animation interpolation.

nodes.name: AnimationValue::from_declaration
nodes.summary: Generated dispatch that converts a specified PropertyDeclaration into an AnimationValue by computing it, used when building animation effect values.

nodes.name: AnimationValue::uncompute
nodes.summary: Generated dispatch converting an AnimationValue back into a PropertyDeclaration (specified representation) so animated values can re-enter the cascade.

nodes.name: AnimationValue::interpolable_with
nodes.summary: Reports whether two animation values for the same property can be interpolated under the current animation-type rules (discrete properties fall back to step interpolation).

nodes.name: TransitionProperty
nodes.summary: Enumeration of properties animatable via transitions/animations, generated from property data, mapping names (including aliases) to animatable longhands.

nodes.name: PropertyDeclarationId
nodes.summary: ID of a single declaration: either a Longhand or a Custom property name; the unit used when iterating declaration blocks and during cascade property application.

nodes.name: PropertyId
nodes.summary: Identifier of a parsed CSS property name: Custom(name) or NonCustom(NonCustomPropertyId), produced by NonCustomPropertyId::parse and resolved to longhand/shorthand during declaration parsing.

nodes.name: NonCustomPropertyId
nodes.summary: Wrapper distinguishing longhand vs shorthand ids with alias resolution, enabled-state checks, and conversion to/from PropertyId and Gecko's NonCustomCSSPropertyId.

nodes.name: PropertyDeclaration::parse_into
nodes.summary: Core declaration parser: for custom properties stores the unparsed value; for longhands calls LonghandId::parse_value, for shorthands ShorthandId::parse_into, also handling CSS-wide keywords and var() substitution placeholders (WithVariables). Main entry used by declaration_block parsing.

nodes.name: parse_non_custom_property_declaration_value_into
nodes.summary: Shared helper implementing !important-free value parsing with var() and CSS-wide keyword handling, parameterized by longhand/shorthand-specific callbacks.

nodes.name: LonghandIdSet
nodes.summary: Bitset over all longhands (IdSet<LonghandId>) used across the cascade for groups like reset/inherited/logical/animatable properties and for tracking which declarations changed.

nodes.name: LonghandId
nodes.summary: Generated enum with one variant per longhand in longhands.toml, including logical-property mapping (to_physical), flags tables, and shorthands() lookup; the identity of every longhand in the engine.

nodes.name: LonghandId::parse_value
nodes.summary: Generated static dispatch table mapping each LonghandId to longhands::<ident>::parse_declared, the per-longhand value parser produced by helpers.mako.rs.

nodes.name: ShorthandId
nodes.summary: Generated enum with one variant per shorthand in shorthands.toml, providing longhands() expansion, longhands_to_css serialization and flag tables.

nodes.name: ShorthandId::parse_into
nodes.summary: Generated static dispatch table mapping each ShorthandId to shorthands::<ident>::parse_into (parse_all for 'all'), the shorthand parsing/expansion entry.

nodes.name: PropertyDeclaration
nodes.summary: Generated enum of every declaration value (longhand specified values, CSS-wide keywords, WithVariables, Custom), with helpers like css_wide_keyword and per-longhand accessors; the payload stored in PropertyDeclarationBlocks.

nodes.name: parse_border
nodes.summary: Hand-written parser for the 'border' shorthand expanding into border-*-width/style/color longhands using the expanded!/try_parse_one helper macros.

nodes.name: parse_value
nodes.summary: Family of per-shorthand value parsers (margin, padding, background, grid-area, font, overflow, ...) invoked by the generated shorthand modules' parse_into to fill Longhands slots.

nodes.name: expanded (macro_rules! expanded)
nodes.summary: Macro scaffolding used by shorthand parsers to declare the expanded longhand slots and try parsing each side/value, unwrapping to initial values when absent (unwrap_or_initial!).

nodes.name: RuleCache
nodes.summary: Thread-local FxHashMap from StrongRuleNode to cached ComputedValues entries with validity conditions, used to skip cascade work for reset properties.

nodes.name: RuleCacheConditions
nodes.summary: Records dependencies that invalidate cached styles (font-size, line-height, writing-mode, color-scheme, uncacheable flag) while cascading an element.

nodes.name: RuleCache::find
nodes.summary: Looks up a cached ComputedValues for the current rule node, walking the rule tree to pick a cache key that skips animation/preshint/style-attribute levels without reset declarations.

nodes.name: RuleCache::insert_if_possible
nodes.summary: After cascading, stores the computed style keyed by the pruned rule node when conditions are cacheable and the pseudo/cascade flags allow it.

nodes.name: RuleCollector
nodes.summary: Holds per-element matching state (stylist, pseudo-element chain, style attribute, SMIL/animation declarations, MatchingContext) and builds the ApplicableDeclarationList in cascade order.

nodes.name: RuleCollector::collect_all
nodes.summary: Drives the full collection sequence: UA rules, user rules, presentational hints, :host/::slotted and shadow-tree rules, document author rules, style attribute, ::part rules from outer trees, and animation/transition declarations.

nodes.name: RuleCollector::collect_stylist_rules
nodes.summary: Fetches CascadeData for a given Origin from the Stylist and matches its normal rules maps (including element-backed pseudo targets) at the appropriate CascadeLevel.

nodes.name: RuleCollector::collect_rules_in_map_with_target
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper calling SelectorMap::get_all_matching_rules for a given rule hash target, appending matching declaration blocks with their cascade level.

nodes.name: containing_shadow_ignoring_svg_use
nodes.summary: Returns the containing shadow host while skipping <svg:use> shadow trees so those subtrees match the enclosing tree's rules.

nodes.name: RuleTree
nodes.summary: The rule tree root: a trie sharing matched-rule paths across elements, with gc()/maybe_gc() reclaiming nodes via the root free list; owned by the Stylist.

nodes.name: RuleNode
nodes.summary: A tree node holding a StyleSource (declaration block), its CascadePriority, refcount, children map and free-list pointer; implements lock-free-ish push/pop on the free list and parent unlinking on drop.

nodes.name: StrongRuleNode
nodes.summary: Refcounted handle to a RuleNode exposing parent(), style_source(), cascade_priority()/cascade_level() and ensure_child(); the path handed to the cascade as ComputedValues.rules.

nodes.name: StrongRuleNode::ensure_child
nodes.summary: Finds or creates the child node for a (CascadePriority, StyleSource) key under this node, upgrading weak children and inserting new RuleNodes under the children write lock.

nodes.name: RuleTree::swap_free_list_and_gc (gc)
nodes.summary: Steals the root free list and drops unreachable nodes whose refcounts stayed at zero, the periodic garbage collection of the rule tree.

nodes.name: CascadeLevel
nodes.summary: Packed u8 bitfield of CascadeOrigin, importance and shadow cascade order with Ord implementing the CSS cascade sort (important reverses origin order, transitions beat all).

nodes.name: CascadeOrigin
nodes.summary: Ordered enum of cascade origins (UA, User, PresHints, Author, PositionFallback, SMILOverride, Animations, Transitions) defining precedence, mapping to stylesheet Origin and lock guards.

nodes.name: ShadowCascadeOrder
nodes.summary: i8 counter tracking depth across shadow trees/slots per css-scoping shadow cascading, packed into CascadeLevel with inc/dec helpers.

nodes.name: Map
nodes.summary: Inline-optimized map storing zero/one entries directly and upgrading to a boxed FxHashMap on growth; backs rule node children lists.

nodes.name: Entry
nodes.summary: Occupied/Vacant entry API for Map used by ensure_child to insert weak child nodes.

nodes.name: RuleTree::compute_rule_node
nodes.summary: Consumes the ApplicableDeclarationList produced by rule collection and inserts it into the tree, returning the StrongRuleNode path used as cascade input.

nodes.name: RuleTree::insert_ordered_rules_with_important
nodes.summary: Inserts normal-level rules in order, then re-inserts !important author/user/UA rules in increasing importance order and appends transitions last, so selector matching can ignore importance.

nodes.name: RuleTree::update_rule_at_level
nodes.summary: Replaces the rule at a given cascade level (style attribute, animations, SMIL) on an existing path, reusing the path when the block is identical or must be rebuilt otherwise; used by restyle machinery.

nodes.name: RuleCascadeFlags
nodes.summary: Bitflags carried in cascade priority marking rules from @starting-style or @appearance-base blocks, consulted by cascade and the rule cache.

nodes.name: StyleSource
nodes.summary: Owned Arc<Locked<PropertyDeclarationBlock>> stored in rule nodes, representing a rule's declarations whether from a style rule, style attribute, animations or hints; mark_in_rule_tree flags the block immutable.

nodes.name: StyleSourceBorrow
nodes.summary: Borrowed view (ArcBorrow) used during selector matching so declaration blocks are only refcounted when actually inserted into the rule tree.

nodes.name: StyleSource::mark_in_rule_tree
nodes.summary: Relaxed-atomically marks the underlying declaration block as immutable once it becomes part of the rule tree, enabling later read_unchecked fast paths.

nodes.name: UnsafeBox
nodes.summary: ManuallyDrop-based box providing from_raw/clone/drop operations so RuleNodes can be managed outside normal Rust drop semantics for the free-list design.

nodes.name: SelectorMap
nodes.summary: Buckets selector-bearing entries by :root, id, class, local name, attribute, namespace and rare pseudo-class states so only plausible rules are matched for an element; instantiated per pseudo/origin in CascadeData.

nodes.name: SelectorMap::get_all_matching_rules
nodes.summary: Looks up every bucket relevant to the element (ids, classes, local name, rare pseudo-classes, other) and matches those selectors, appending hits to the ApplicableDeclarationList with scope/container handling.

nodes.name: SelectorMap::get_matching_rules
nodes.summary: Matches an explicit, pre-sorted rule list (e.g. ::part rules) against the element, appending matches with the given cascade level.

nodes.name: SelectorMap::insert
nodes.summary: Indexes a new entry into the appropriate buckets based on its selector's rightmost simple selectors, used while rebuilding CascadeData.

nodes.name: SelectorMap::lookup
nodes.summary: Generic lookup API running a callback over entries in the buckets applicable to an element (used for invalidation and revalidation paths).

nodes.name: PrecomputedHasher
nodes.summary: Hasher that accepts the selector's precomputed u32 hash directly, avoiding rehashing in PrecomputedHashMap/PrecomputedHashSet used throughout matching.

nodes.name: SelectorParser
nodes.summary: Carries stylesheet origin, namespaces, URL data and @supports context while parsing selectors via SelectorList::parse into the backend SelectorImpl.

nodes.name: SelectorParser::parse_author_origin_no_namespace
nodes.summary: Parses a selector string with author origin and default namespaces, used by DOM APIs like querySelector.

nodes.name: PseudoElementCascadeType
nodes.summary: Classifies pseudo-elements as Eager (cascade with the element, ::before/::after), Lazy (matched but computed on demand) or Precomputed (skip cascade, UA-only).

nodes.name: PerPseudoElementMap
nodes.summary: Sparse-array + dense-vec map keyed by pseudo-element index used to store per-pseudo styles and cascade inputs during traversal.

nodes.name: Direction
nodes.summary: Parsed value of :dir() with ltr/rtl normalization, mapping to element state bits for selector matching.

nodes.name: SharedRwLock
nodes.summary: Cloneable, non-blocking shared lock (AtomicRefCell-backed, optional read-only mode for shared memory) protecting stylesheets, style rules and declaration blocks across threads.

nodes.name: Locked<T>
nodes.summary: Wrapper associating data with its SharedRwLock; read_with/write_with enforce guard-checked access to declaration blocks and rules.

nodes.name: SharedRwLockReadGuard
nodes.summary: Proof of read access used with Locked::read_with; UA/user vs author guards (StylesheetGuards) are selected per cascade origin.

nodes.name: SharedRwLockWriteGuard
nodes.summary: Proof of write access used when parsing or mutating stylesheets and declaration blocks under the shared lock.

nodes.name: StyleAdjuster
nodes.summary: Wraps a StyleBuilder after declaration application and mutates it in place to enforce layout- and spec-required fixups before the style is finished.

nodes.name: StyleAdjuster::adjust
nodes.summary: Orchestrates all fixups: visited handling, prohibited display:contents, top layer, blockification, position/overflow, contain, writing mode, ruby, appearance, @try tactics and flag setting.

nodes.name: StyleAdjuster::blockify_if_necessary
nodes.summary: Blockifies display values required by position/absolute, inline-level out-of-flow, flex/grid children, ruby and text controls, accounting for display:contents layout parents.

nodes.name: StyleAdjuster::adjust_for_top_layer
nodes.summary: Applies the top-layer UA fixups (contained layout, forced positioning and overlay behavior) for elements in the top layer.

nodes.name: StyleAdjuster::adjust_for_text
nodes.summary: Adjusts styles for text nodes (e.g. text-transform/white-space inheritance quirks and ::first-line/::first-letter handling).

nodes.name: StyleResolverForElement
nodes.summary: Per-element resolver bundling the element, StyleContext, RuleInclusion and pseudo resolution policy; drives matching and cascading for primary and eager pseudo styles.

nodes.name: StyleResolverForElement::resolve_primary_style
nodes.summary: Matches the element (with a second visited pass when needed), then cascades via cascade_primary_style, consulting the style-sharing cache before doing real work.

nodes.name: StyleResolverForElement::resolve_style
nodes.summary: Resolves the primary style plus all eagerly-cascaded pseudo-element styles, skipping pseudos proven not to generate content.

nodes.name: StyleResolverForElement::cascade_style_and_visited
nodes.summary: Delegates to Stylist::cascade_style_and_visited with the current rule cache, then records the result into the thread-local RuleCache when conditions allow.

nodes.name: StyleResolverForElement::match_primary
nodes.summary: Builds a MatchingContext, calls Stylist::push_applicable_declarations to collect rules, and folds them into a rule node via RuleTree::compute_rule_node.

nodes.name: PrimaryStyle
nodes.summary: Resolved primary style plus a flag noting whether it was reused from another element through the rule node identity in the sharing cache.

nodes.name: DocumentStylesheetSet
nodes.summary: Per-origin collection of top-level document stylesheets with append/insert/remove and dirty tracking; the Stylist wraps it as StylistStylesheetSet.

nodes.name: DocumentStylesheetSet::flush
nodes.summary: Produces a DocumentStylesheetFlusher enumerating changed sheets and the required SheetRebuildKind (Full vs CascadeOnly) so the stylist can rebuild cascade data incrementally.

nodes.name: DocumentStylesheetFlusher
nodes.summary: Exposes per-origin flushers over the sheet collections during a stylist flush, including the UA-sheet iterator for origin sheets.

nodes.name: SheetCollectionFlusher
nodes.summary: Iterates the sheets needing work for one origin, committing entries and deciding Full vs CascadeOnly rebuilds from DataValidity.

nodes.name: DataValidity
nodes.summary: Validity states (Valid, CascadeInvalid, FullyInvalid) describing how much cascade/invalidation data must be rebuilt for an origin after sheet changes.

nodes.name: Stylist
nodes.summary: Per-document style engine holding the device, quirks mode, StylistStylesheetSet and DocumentCascadeData; rebuilds rule maps on flush and provides matching entry points (push_applicable_declarations, precomputed/lazy pseudo styles, compute_for_declarations) plus cascade_style_and_visited.

nodes.name: CascadeData
nodes.summary: Per-origin/per-tree compiled style data: SelectorMaps for normal, slotted, featureless-host and ::part rules, invalidation data, custom property registrations and keyframes, built during stylesheet flush.

nodes.name: DocumentCascadeData
nodes.summary: Per-origin set of CascadeData (UA, user, author) with borrow_for_origin and iteration helpers used whenever rules for all origins must be considered.

nodes.name: Rule
nodes.summary: A compiled style rule stored in SelectorMaps: its selector list, locked PropertyDeclarationBlock, container/scope condition ids and specificity for ordering.

nodes.name: Stylist::push_applicable_declarations
nodes.summary: Matching entry point: normalizes the pseudo-element chain, then constructs a RuleCollector with the element, style attribute, SMIL and animation declarations and runs collect_all to fill the ApplicableDeclarationList.

nodes.name: Stylist::cascade_style_and_visited
nodes.summary: Cascade entry point: resolves visited rules as needed and invokes properties::cascade with the rule node, guards, parent/layout styles, rule cache and conditions to produce Arc<ComputedValues>.

nodes.name: Stylist::flush
nodes.summary: Flushes pending stylesheet changes from the StylistStylesheetSet, rebuilding CascadeData/invalidation data per rebuild kind and returning the StylesheetInvalidationSet for restyle scope.

nodes.name: RuleInclusion
nodes.summary: Selects whether matching collects all rules or only default (UA-level) styles, used for default-document styles and pseudo probing.

nodes.name: StylistStylesheetSet
nodes.summary: The Stylist's internal DocumentStylesheetSet<StylistSheet> wrapper (declared Sync unsafely) tracking which sheets need flush.

nodes.name: DomTraversal
nodes.summary: Trait implemented by Gecko/Servo traversal drivers: process_preorder/process_postorder, postorder bubbling, pre_traverse root invalidation and element_needs_traversal decisions under TraversalFlags.

nodes.name: recalc_style_at
nodes.summary: Per-element traversal step: determines RestyleKind, calls compute_style, handles display:none subtree teardown, propagates restyle hints and enqueues children via note_children.

nodes.name: compute_style
nodes.summary: Executes the restyle kind: tries the style-sharing cache, otherwise builds a StyleResolverForElement for MatchAndCascade or recascades from stored CascadeInputs, finishing via element.finish_restyle.

nodes.name: resolve_style
nodes.summary: Manually resolves style for an element by walking unstyled ancestors, rebuilding the bloom filter and resolving each with StyleResolverForElement; used for display:none subtrees and NAC.

nodes.name: note_children
nodes.summary: Propagates restyle hints to traversal children, invalidates snapshots as needed and notes children whose subtrees require traversal, setting dirty-descendants bits.

nodes.name: TraversalFlags
nodes.summary: Bitflags controlling a traversal pass: AnimationOnly, ForCSSRuleChanges, FinalAnimationTraversal, ParallelTraversal, FlushThrottledAnimations, with for_animation_only() helper.

nodes.name: assert_traversal_flags_match
nodes.summary: Gecko-only debug assertion that each TraversalFlags bit matches the corresponding ServoTraversalFlags value in the Gecko bindings.

nodes.name: ImageDocument.css
nodes.summary: Built-in UA stylesheet applied to all ImageDocuments (standalone image-view documents, including those inside frames). It zeroes the body margin that html.css would apply, defines zoom-in/zoom-out cursors for overflowing or shrink-to-fit images via classes set from C++, sizes images embedded in object/embed, and makes img a block. Loaded as a built-in sheet (registered by GlobalStyleSheetCache) and attached by the image document code (nsImageDocument).

nodes.name: ServoBindings.toml
nodes.summary: cbindgen configuration for the Servo style-system bindings: declares which Rust types map to which Gecko C++ types (including the SERVO_LOCKED_ARC_TYPE entries from ServoLockedArcTypeList.inc), rename/prefix rules, and per-module binding generation used to produce ServoStyleConsts.h and the Gecko-ffi surface.

nodes.name: TopLevelImageDocument.css
nodes.summary: Companion UA stylesheet applied only to top-level ImageDocuments (not iframes). It paints the dark imagedoc background for overscroll, provides a light checkered-style backdrop for transparent images via chrome:// skin resources, centers the image with absolute positioning, adds a rotation transition, and applies image-orientation: from-image. Registered as a built-in sheet by GlobalStyleSheetCache and attached by nsImageDocument alongside ImageDocument.css.

nodes.name: TopLevelVideoDocument.css
nodes.summary: UA stylesheet applied to top-level VideoDocuments (standalone video player documents, not iframes). It gives the document a black background that fills the viewport, centers the video element, disables user selection and stray-click focus changes, and removes the focus outline. Registered as a built-in sheet by GlobalStyleSheetCache and attached by the video document (nsVideoDocument) code.

nodes.name: contenteditable.css
nodes.summary: Built-in UA stylesheet intended for documents with the contenteditable attribute; it is now an intentionally empty placeholder (see bug 1941134) after its rules were migrated elsewhere. It is still loaded as a built-in sheet (via GlobalStyleSheetCache) and attached by editing host code when a contenteditable element/document is set up.

nodes.name: designmode.css
nodes.summary: Built-in UA stylesheet intended for documents put into document.designMode; like contenteditable.css it is now an empty placeholder (bug 1941134). It remains registered as a built-in sheet (via GlobalStyleSheetCache) and is attached by the editor code when design mode is enabled.

nodes.name: accessiblecaret.css
nodes.summary: Built-in user-agent stylesheet loaded by GlobalStyleSheetCache at startup. Styles the accessible text-selection caret handles rendered via anonymous custom content (:host / :host(.left|.right|.normal|.hidden|.none) rules and #image/#text-overlay children). Defines touch-target padding, image-set() caret bitmaps/SVGs per -moz-platform: android media queries, z-index 2147483647, and nested CSS rules.

nodes.name: counterstyles.css
nodes.summary: Built-in user-agent stylesheet loaded by GlobalStyleSheetCache at startup. Defines the predefined @counter-style rules from CSS Counter Styles Level 3: numeric styles (decimal-leading-zero, arabic-indic, armenian, georgian, roman, and many Indic/Asian scripts), alphabetic styles (lower/upper-alpha, latin, greek, hiragana, katakana and iroha variants), fixed CJK heavenly-stem/earthly-branch, cjk-ideographic alias, plus Mozilla-specific -moz-* alias counter styles (-moz-persian, -moz-ethiopic-*, -moz-japanese-formal, etc.). These back list-style-type/counter() predefined counter names.

nodes.name: details.css
nodes.summary: Built-in user-agent stylesheet loaded by GlobalStyleSheetCache at startup. Styles the <details> element's shadow content: the unnamed slot (display:block, content-visibility:hidden, reverted when [open]) and the summary (display:list-item with disclosure-closed/disclosure-open list-style markers), duplicating the rules in html.css for the anonymous summary that cannot match html.css selectors.

nodes.name: forms.css
nodes.summary: Built-in user-agent stylesheet loaded by GlobalStyleSheetCache at startup. Defines default styles for HTML form controls in the XHTML namespace: input (all types: text/password/checkbox/radio/color/image/file/search/number/range/date-time), textarea, select (menulist, listbox, ::picker(select)/::picker-icon), button and ::file-selector-button, option/optgroup, fieldset/legend/label, progress and meter with their bar pseudo-elements, ::placeholder, ::-moz-text-control-editing-root/-preview, ::-moz-color-swatch, number spin boxes, search clear/reveal buttons, autofill styling, -moz-default-appearance widget values, and an experimental CSS Forms @appearance-base block behind the layout.css.appearance-base.enabled pref.

nodes.name: html.css
nodes.summary: Built-in user-agent stylesheet loaded by GlobalStyleSheetCache at startup; the main default style sheet for HTML documents (default namespace set to XHTML via @namespace). Defines element defaults per the WHATWG rendering section: bidi/:-moz-dir-attr rules, display:block for sectioning elements, body margin 8px, h1-h6 font sizes (plus experimental :heading pseudo-class behind a pref), preformatted elements, full table display/border/frame/rules attribute mapping, lists (ul/ol/menu/dir with disc/circle/square nesting), inline semantics (b/i/u/s/sub/sup/mark/abbr), hidden elements, q quotes, hr, images/iframe/frameset, details>summary and ::details-content, video/audio/::cue/caption-box media styles, dialog and dialog:modal with ::backdrop, popover attribute styles, marquee, ruby/rb/rt/rtc, slot { display: contents }, noscript/hidden handling, an embedded @font-face (-moz-bullet-font for list markers), and editor anonymous content (mozResizer/mozGrabber/mozTable*).

nodes.name: noframes.css
nodes.summary: Built-in user-agent stylesheet loaded by GlobalStyleSheetCache at startup; only added to the style set for documents with frames disabled. Makes noframes display:block and hides frame, frameset, and iframe with display:none !important.

nodes.name: plaintext.css
nodes.summary: Built-in user-agent stylesheet loaded by GlobalStyleSheetCache at startup; used for documents rendered as plain text (text/plain, similar to view-source styling). Sets :root color-scheme: light dark, styles pre with white-space:pre-wrap, word-wrap:break-word and -moz-control-character-visibility:visible, applies unicode-bidi:plaintext honoring dir=auto, and hides the root for zero-size viewports (workaround for zero-size object docs, bug 1548449).

nodes.name: quirk.css
nodes.summary: Built-in user-agent stylesheet loaded by GlobalStyleSheetCache at startup; applied only to documents in quirks mode. Implements legacy quirks: inside list-style-position for orphaned li elements with restoration for nested lists, padding-block-start for li > ul/ol :-moz-first-node, table font-size/weight/style/variant and line-height resets, collapsing of first/last-node block margins under body/td/th (b=97361, b=41806-era quirks), margins for floated images via img[align], border-box sizing for text inputs and textareas, and form margin-block-end.

nodes.name: scrollbars.css
nodes.summary: Built-in user-agent stylesheet loaded by GlobalStyleSheetCache at startup. Styles anonymous XUL-namespace scrollbar parts: scrollbar, thumb, scrollbarbutton, scrollcorner, and resizer. Sets -moz-default-appearance widget values per orientation, a pref-gated (layout.css.cached-scrollbar-styles.enabled) all:initial-style reset required for anonymous-content style caching, direction:ltr and block display for style-cache stability, overlay-scrollbar fade transitions via env(-moz-overlay-scrollbar-fade-duration), testing pref to hide scrollbars, and resizer cursors/flipping per dir attribute.

nodes.name: select.css
nodes.summary: Built-in user-agent stylesheet loaded by GlobalStyleSheetCache at startup. Tiny sheet for the customizable <select> shadow DOM: hides slot[name="internal-select-button"] by default and, inside the @appearance-base block (gated by layout.css.appearance-base.enabled in forms.css), switches it to display:contents and hides the label when the slot :has-slotted content.

nodes.name: ua.css
nodes.summary: Built-in user-agent stylesheet loaded by GlobalStyleSheetCache at startup; the core UA sheet applied to all documents. Defines styles for internal anonymous boxes/pseudo-elements (:: -moz-table/-moz-table-wrapper/-moz-table-cell, ruby boxes, ::marker, ::-moz-cell-content, ::-moz-block-inside-inline-wrapper, ::-moz-scrolled-content kept in sync with forms.css fieldset content, column-set/column-content/column-span-wrapper, ::-moz-viewport/-moz-canvas, print/page-sequence/printed-sheet pseudo-elements), links and focus (:any-link/:link/:visited colors, :focus-visible outline), :-moz-inert and :-moz-topmost-modal, :fullscreen, ::backdrop, :root { color: CanvasText; view-transition-name: root }, XML parsererror reporting markup, .moz-custom-content-container, CSS View Transitions UA styles (::-moz-snapshot-containing-block, ::view-transition-* with -ua-view-transition-fade-in/out and -ua-mix-blend-mode-plus-lighter @keyframes), and print-related suppression rules.

nodes.name: viewsource.css
nodes.summary: Built-in user-agent stylesheet loaded by GlobalStyleSheetCache at startup; used for view-source: documents. Sets :root color-scheme light dark on Canvas background, monospace (-moz-fixed) preformatted layout for #viewsource with pref-gated (view_source.wrap_long_lines) wrapping, generated line numbers via counter(line) in span[id]::before, and pref-gated (view_source.syntax_highlight) syntax-highlighting colors for start/end tags, comments, CDATA, doctype, PIs, entities, attributes and errors using light-dark() values.

nodes.name: selectors CHANGES.md
nodes.summary: Single-entry changelog for the selectors crate: parser.rs no longer wraps values in quotes ("...") but expects their to_css impl to already wrap them (Gecko Bug 1854809).

nodes.name: selectors Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Manifest of the selectors crate (v0.26.0, edition 2024, MPL-2.0) — CSS Selectors parsing/serialization/matching for Rust, maintained under servo/stylo and used by Stylo (servo/components/style) and Servo. Lib entry point: lib.rs. Features: bench, to_shmem. Dependencies: cssparser 0.38 (tokenization/parsing), bitflags 2, derive_more 2 (add/add_assign), hashbrown 0.17, rustc-hash 2.1.1, log 0.4, precomputed-hash 0.1, smallvec 1.0, new_debug_unreachable 1, servo_arc 0.4 (path ../servo_arc), plus optional to_shmem 0.1 (path ../to_shmem, servo_arc feature) and to_shmem_derive 0.1 (path ../to_shmem_derive).

nodes.name: selectors README.md
nodes.summary: rust-selectors: CSS Selectors library for Rust covering parsing, serialization, and matching against a generic element tree; pseudo-elements and most pseudo-classes are generic. Warns of frequent breaking changes (13 in 2016); old versions remain on crates.io under semver-compatible ranges. Points to Kuchiki's src/select.rs as a usage example for custom tree representations.

nodes.name: AnimatedPropertyIDSet.h
nodes.summary: Defines AnimatedPropertyIDSet, which pairs an nsCSSPropertyIDSet of non-custom property IDs with a set of custom property (CSS variable) names, supporting set algebra and iteration used by restyle and animation composition. Also defines InvertibleAnimatedPropertyIDSet, used to skip animated properties when composing animation/transition cascade rules.

nodes.name: AnimatedPropertyIDSet
nodes.summary: Set of animated properties combining nsCSSPropertyIDSet mIDs and a CustomNameSet of custom property atoms; provides Add/Remove/HasProperty via CSSPropertyId, Intersects/Intersect/Xor/IsSubsetOf, and a range-for Iterator yielding CSSPropertyId values including eCSSPropertyExtra_variable for custom names.

nodes.name: InvertibleAnimatedPropertyIDSet
nodes.summary: Wrapper around a pointer to an AnimatedPropertyIDSet with an inversion flag; HasProperty answers membership relative to the (possibly complemented) set so animation rules can skip animated properties at CascadeLevel::Animations/Transitions.

nodes.name: Iterator
nodes.summary: Nested input iterator over AnimatedPropertyIDSet that first walks the nsCSSPropertyIDSet::Iterator and then the custom-name set, dereferencing to a CSSPropertyId (with mCustomName set and eCSSPropertyExtra_variable id for custom entries).

nodes.name: nsCSSPropertyIDSet
nodes.summary: Bitset of nsCSSPropertyID values (included from nsCSSPropertyIDSet.h, defined elsewhere) embedded as the mIDs member of AnimatedPropertyIDSet; provides AddProperty/RemoveProperty/HasProperty/Intersects/Intersect/Xor/IsEmpty over non-custom CSS properties.

nodes.name: AnimationCollection.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the AnimationCollection template shared by CSS animations (dom::CSSAnimation) and transitions (dom::CSSTransition): destructor/Destroy cancel animations with mutation batching and optional restyle, and static Get finds the collection from an element or frame via ElementAnimationData and EffectCompositor. Explicitly instantiated for CSSAnimation and CSSTransition.

nodes.name: Destroy
nodes.summary: Marks the collection destroyed and clears the animation/transition collection pointer on the owning element's ElementAnimationData; regular style-change teardown triggers subsequent restyles, whereas direct clearing during document teardown does not.

nodes.name: Get
nodes.summary: Static lookup returning the CSSAnimation or CSSTransition collection for an element and PseudoStyleRequest by consulting the element's ElementAnimationData, returning null when there is no animation data.

nodes.name: Get
nodes.summary: Static overload resolving an nsIFrame (possibly generated content, searching the parent frame) to its animation collection via EffectCompositor::GetAnimationElementAndPseudoForFrame and the element-based Get.

nodes.name: ~AnimationCollection
nodes.summary: Destructor that cancels all contained animations from style (CancelFromStyle) inside an nsAutoAnimationMutationBatch, posting restyles only if Destroy was previously called, then unlinks itself from the manager's LinkedList.

nodes.name: AnimationCollection.h
nodes.summary: Declares AnimationCollection<AnimationType>, a LinkedListElement holding the owning element, its PseudoStyleRequest, and the array of RefPtr<AnimationType> (CSSAnimation or CSSTransition). It is the per-element/per-pseudo container of CSS animation and transition objects that drive animation events and restyles.

nodes.name: AnimationCollection
nodes.summary: Template container (element + PseudoStyleRequest + mAnimations array) linked into CommonAnimationManager's list; static Get overloads map frames/elements to collections, and mCalledDestroy distinguishes style-change teardown (restyling) from DOM teardown.

nodes.name: AnimationCommon.h
nodes.summary: Common infrastructure for CSS animations and transitions: CommonAnimationManager owns the linked list of per-element AnimationCollections and can stop animations, OwningElementRef orders animation targets across elements and pseudo-elements, and helpers convert Servo animation params into DOM TimingParams or compute phases without an effect.

nodes.name: CommonAnimationManager
nodes.summary: Template base for CSSAnimationManager/CSSTransitionManager: holds the pres context and a LinkedList of AnimationCollection, with Disconnect, StopAnimationsForElement (destroying a collection to cancel animations), and AddElementCollection/RemoveAllElementCollections bookkeeping.

nodes.name: OwningElementRef
nodes.summary: Non-owning reference to the element + PseudoStyleRequest that owns a CSS animation/transition; Compare implements composite ordering via tree position and a pseudo sorting index (backdrop, marker, before/after, checkmark, picker-icon, view-transition pseudos), and ShouldFireEvents gates animation event dispatch for native-anonymous subtrees.

nodes.name: GetAnimationPhaseWithoutEffect
nodes.summary: Template helper returning the AnimationPhase/TransitionPhase (Idle, Before, or After) to use when an animation has no target effect, based on whether current time is null or negative.

nodes.name: TimingParamsFromCSSParams
nodes.summary: Builds a TimingParams from CSS animation properties (duration, delay, iteration-count, direction, fill-mode), converting Servo style enums to DOM PlaybackDirection/FillMode via the StyleToDom overloads.

nodes.name: AttributeStyles.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements AttributeStyles: creates empty Servo declaration blocks for the link/virtual-visited/active link colors (presentational attribute data) via Servo_DeclarationBlock_* FFI, then posts a RestyleSubtree event on the root through RestyleManager so affected links restyle. Also tears down cached style-attribute MiscContainers on destruction.

nodes.name: ImplLinkColorSetter
nodes.summary: Shared implementation of the link color setters: builds a fresh empty StyleLockedDeclarationBlock, sets eCSSProperty_color via Servo_DeclarationBlock_SetColorValue, and posts RestyleHint::RestyleSubtree() on the document root through RestyleManager::PostRestyleEvent with nsChangeHint(0).

nodes.name: SetLinkColor
nodes.summary: Sets the unvisited link color declaration (from presentational attributes like body link=) and triggers restyling via ImplLinkColorSetter.

nodes.name: SetVisitedLinkColor
nodes.summary: Sets the visited link color declaration (vlink= attribute data) and triggers restyling via ImplLinkColorSetter.

nodes.name: Reset
nodes.summary: Clears the unvisited, visited, and active link declaration blocks held by this AttributeStyles.

nodes.name: AttributeStyles.h
nodes.summary: Declares AttributeStyles, the per-document holder of style data derived from presentational HTML attributes: StyleLockedDeclarationBlock refs for unvisited/visited/active link colors and a hash map caching serialized style attributes to MiscContainer (mapped attribute declarations).

nodes.name: AttributeStyles
nodes.summary: Document-attached, refcounted holder mapping presentational attribute data to declarations: link/visited/active color declaration getters, CacheStyleAttr/EvictStyleAttr/LookupStyleAttr for the serialized style attribute cache keyed to MiscContainer, and link color setters that restyle the tree.

nodes.name: BindgenUniquePtr.h
nodes.summary: Defines mozilla::BindgenUniquePtr, a subclass of std::unique_ptr with DefaultDelete that static_asserts size/alignment equality with a raw-pointer struct so rust-bindgen can replace it with a simple pointer representation in FFI bindings.

nodes.name: BindgenUniquePtr
nodes.summary: UniquePtr variant with layout identical to BindgenUniquePtr_Simple<T> (a bare T*), used as the C++ side of bindgen-generated owned-pointer FFI types.

nodes.name: BuiltinCounterStyleList.inc
nodes.summary: X-macro list of builtin counter styles (none, decimal, disc/circle/square, disclosure styles, hebrew, CJK ideographic variants, ethiopic-numeric) expanded via BUILTIN_COUNTER_STYLE(value_, atom_) by CounterStyleManager.cpp to build the builtin style table.

nodes.name: BuiltInStyleSheetList.inc
nodes.summary: X-macro list of user-agent built-in style sheets managed by GlobalStyleSheetCache (html.css, forms.css, xul.css, counterstyles.css, etc.), each with an identifier, resource URL, and BuiltInStyleSheetFlags (UA/Author/shared or unshared).

nodes.name: BuiltInStyleSheets.h
nodes.summary: Declares BuiltInStyleSheetFlags (UA, Author, NotShared, UAUnshared) and the BuiltInStyleSheet enum generated by expanding BuiltInStyleSheetList.inc, providing identifiers for user agent style sheets.

nodes.name: BuiltInStyleSheet
nodes.summary: Enum class (with a Count sentinel) enumerating the built-in UA/author style sheets from BuiltInStyleSheetList.inc, used by GlobalStyleSheetCache to fetch pre-built sheets.

nodes.name: CachedInheritingStyles.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the word-sized tagged cache of inheriting anon-box and lazily-cascaded pseudo-element ComputedStyles: Insert promotes from direct-pointer or null-direct encoding to an indirect AutoTArray of CachedStyleEntry when functional pseudo parameters are involved, and Lookup/HasEntry match pseudo type plus functional parameter.

nodes.name: Insert
nodes.summary: Inserts a (possibly null) cached ComputedStyle for a pseudo type, choosing direct pointer storage, null-direct encoding (PseudoStyleType in upper bits of mBits), or promoting to the indirect cache when a functional pseudo parameter like ::highlight(name) is present.

nodes.name: Lookup
nodes.summary: Looks up a cached inheriting style for a PseudoStyleRequest, matching pseudo type and functional parameter in the indirect cache, or the single direct entry; returns null for uncached requests and cached-null probes.

nodes.name: HasEntry
nodes.summary: Reports whether any entry (including cached null probe results) exists for the given PseudoStyleRequest, distinguishing 'not cached' from 'cached as null' for lazy pseudo probing.

nodes.name: AppendTo
nodes.summary: Appends all non-null cached styles (direct entry or indirect entries) to the given array, used to enumerate cached lazy pseudo styles.

nodes.name: CachedInheritingStyles.h
nodes.summary: Declares CachedStyleEntry (style + functional pseudo parameter + pseudo type) and CachedInheritingStyles, the per-ComputedStyle cache of anon-box/lazy pseudo styles encoded in a single tagged uintptr_t (empty, direct, null-direct, or indirect AutoTArray<CachedStyleEntry,4>), designed to minimize memory footprint.

nodes.name: CachedInheritingStyles
nodes.summary: Cache of anonymous box and lazily cascaded pseudo styles inheriting from a ComputedStyle, stored in one word with tagged low bits; supports Insert/Lookup/HasEntry, ForEachLazyPseudoEntry, AppendTo, and memory reporting.

nodes.name: CachedStyleEntry
nodes.summary: Cache entry holding a RefPtr<ComputedStyle>, an optional RefPtr<nsAtom> functional pseudo parameter (e.g. ::highlight(name)), and the PseudoStyleType; mStyle may be null for recorded probes with no matching rules.

nodes.name: ComputedStyle.cpp
nodes.summary: Core implementation for ComputedStyle: CalcStyleDifference diffs all 22 style structs (including nsStyleDisplay and visited-style structs) to accumulate an nsChangeHint for the restyle pipeline, CombineVisitedColors/GetVisitedDependentColor implement privacy-safe :visited coloring, plus anchor-position reference checks and cached lazy pseudo style access.

nodes.name: CalcStyleDifference
nodes.summary: Computes the nsChangeHint for replacing this ComputedStyle with aNewStyle by calling CalcDifference on each nsStyle struct (DO_STRUCT_DIFFERENCE macro list), handling style-if-visited differences as RepaintFrame, filtering spurious UpdateContainingBlock via ContainingBlockMayHaveChanged, and tracking equal structs in aEqualStructs for Servo's recascade optimization.

nodes.name: CombineVisitedColors
nodes.summary: Static helper combining unvisited and visited colors into a single nscolor (RGB from the selected color, alpha always from the unvisited color) with constant-time behavior independent of visitedness to avoid history leaks.

nodes.name: GetCachedLazyPseudoStyle
nodes.summary: Returns the cached lazily-cascaded pseudo-element style for a PseudoStyleRequest, skipping pseudo types that support user action states (like :hover) which cannot be shared.

nodes.name: ContainingBlockMayHaveChanged
nodes.summary: Static helper that verifies whether the frame's role as abs-pos/fixed-pos containing block really changed (positioned style, fixed CB for non-SVG text, transform-supporting, and contain:layout/paint-supporting predicates) so UpdateContainingBlock hints can be suppressed.

nodes.name: MaybeAnchorPosReferencesDiffer
nodes.summary: Broad-stroke comparison of two styles for differing CSS anchor positioning references (position-anchor, position-area, anchor-center alignment, anchor()/anchor-size() usage in insets and sizes), returning conservative true positives plus false positives.

nodes.name: ComputedStyle.h
nodes.summary: Declares ComputedStyle, the refcounted C++ handle on Servo's immutable ServoComputedData holding the nsStyle* structs; exposes per-struct accessors, computed-value flags (author-specified rules, font-metric and unit dependencies), pseudo/anon-box classification and caching, visited style access, and CalcStyleDifference used by RestyleManager.

nodes.name: ComputedStyle
nodes.summary: Represents the computed style data for an element/pseudo as a set of immutable, shared style structs (nsStyleDisplay, nsStyleFont, ...) plus CachedInheritingStyles; provides Style*() accessors, GetStyleIfVisited, flag queries, GetCachedLazyPseudoStyle/SetCachedLazyPseudoStyle, and CalcStyleDifference returning nsChangeHint.

nodes.name: ComputedStyleInlines.h
nodes.summary: Inline ComputedStyle methods: StartImageLoads triggers image loads across every style struct via the HasTriggerImageLoads trait, PointerEvents/UserSelect resolve honoring inert subtrees and root-element restrictions, and the fixed/abs-pos containing-block predicates feed CalcStyleDifference; also defines CachedInheritingStyles::ForEachLazyPseudoEntry.

nodes.name: StartImageLoads
nodes.summary: Iterates all style structs via FOR_EACH_STYLE_STRUCT, calling TriggerImageLoads on those with a TriggerImageLoads(document, oldStyle) method so URL/gradient image data starts loading after style resolution.

nodes.name: IsFixedPosContainingBlock
nodes.summary: Determines whether the style makes its frame a fixed-pos containing block, combining will-change bits, filters/backdrop filters, contain:layout/paint, and transform support against frame capabilities, excluding SVG text subtrees.

nodes.name: IsAbsPosContainingBlock
nodes.summary: Returns whether the element is a containing block for absolutely positioned descendants: fixed-pos CB conditions or positioned style (nsStyleDisplay::IsPositionedStyle) outside SVG text subtrees.

nodes.name: PointerEvents
nodes.summary: Resolves effective pointer-events: forced Auto for root element style (so the viewport remains scrollable), forced None inside inert subtrees, otherwise the computed nsStyleUI value.

nodes.name: CounterStyleManager.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the CSS counter style system: text generation algorithms for builtin systems (cyclic, fixed, symbolic, alphabetic, numeric, additive, CJK ideographic, hebrew, ethiopic), BuiltinCounterStyle/DependentBuiltinCounterStyle, @counter-style-backed CustomCounterStyle with cached descriptors and fallback/speak-as/extends resolution, and CounterStyleManager which resolves names and invalidates styles when rules change via ServoStyleSet::CounterStyleRuleForName.

nodes.name: BuiltinCounterStyle
nodes.summary: CounterStyle subclass for the immutable builtin styles listed in BuiltinCounterStyleList.inc: bullet characters for disc/circle/square/disclosure styles, spoken text fallback, per-system negative signs, ordinal ranges, and GetInitialCounterText dispatching to DecimalToText, CJKIdeographicToText, HebrewToText, EthiopicToText, etc.

nodes.name: CustomCounterStyle
nodes.summary: CounterStyle for styles created by @counter-style rules, wrapping a StyleLockedCounterStyleRule with generation-checked caching of descriptors (prefix/suffix/negative/pad/fallback/speak-as/extends); ResetCachedData/ResetDependentData support invalidation when the rule changes.

nodes.name: DependentBuiltinCounterStyle
nodes.summary: BuiltinCounterStyle variant for builtin styles whose fallback can be overridden by author @counter-style rules (IsDependentStyle true), resolving fallback through the CounterStyleManager at runtime.

nodes.name: ResolveCounterStyle
nodes.summary: Resolves a counter style atom to a CounterStyle, consulting the built table, creating CustomCounterStyle objects from the ServoStyleSet's CounterStyleRuleForName when needed, and defaulting unknown names to decimal.

nodes.name: NotifyRuleChanged
nodes.summary: Scans all managed counter styles when a @counter-style rule may have changed: queries ServoStyleSet for the current rule, removes/retires styles whose rule vanished or was replaced, resets cached data on generation bumps, and reports whether anything changed so callers can trigger restyles.

nodes.name: CleanRetiredStyles
nodes.summary: Destroys all retired (no-longer-referenced) counter styles moved out of mRetiredStyles, via DestroyCounterStyle.

nodes.name: GetCounterText
nodes.summary: CounterStyle::GetCounterText non-virtual entry point generating counter text for an ordinal: delegates to the style's range/system logic and falls back (ultimately to decimal) when the ordinal is out of range or the result is empty.

nodes.name: CounterStyleManager.h
nodes.summary: Declares the counter style object hierarchy: abstract CounterStyle (prefix/suffix/range/pad/fallback/speak-as/GetCounterText), stack-allocated AnonymousCounterStyle for symbols() and content-generated counters, and CounterStyleManager, the per-pres-context registry mapping style names to CounterStyle objects with rule-change notification and retired style tracking.

nodes.name: CounterStyle
nodes.summary: Abstract base of all counter styles keyed by a ListStyle enum; provides GetCounterText with fallback chaining, GetSpokenCounterText, IsDependentStyle (manager-dependent styles), and pure virtual descriptor queries used by list item and ::marker rendering.

nodes.name: AnonymousCounterStyle
nodes.summary: MOZ_STACK_CLASS CounterStyle for anonymous styles (CSS symbols() and content-driven counters), holding a StyleSymbolsType and a span of StyleSymbol; never a bullet, always in auto range, decimal fallback.

nodes.name: CounterStyleManager
nodes.summary: Per-pres-context owner of the counter style table (mStyles) and retired styles; ResolveCounterStyle builds styles on demand, WithCounterStyleNameOrSymbols abstracts name-vs-symbols handling, and NotifyRuleChanged/CleanRetiredStyles implement invalidation when @counter-style rules change.

nodes.name: CSS.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the DOM-exposed CSS namespace: CSS.supports() in both forms via Servo_CSSSupports/Servo_CSSSupports2, CSS.escape(), CSS.registerProperty() routed into the document's ServoStyleSet (custom property registration), the highlights registry accessor, and ~70 CSS Typed OM CSSUnitValue factory functions for every length/angle/time/frequency/resolution/flex unit.

nodes.name: RegisterProperty
nodes.summary: Implements CSS.registerProperty(): validates the global has a document, then forwards the PropertyDefinition to ServoStyleSet::RegisterProperty so the custom property becomes available to the style engine.

nodes.name: Supports
nodes.summary: Implements CSS.supports(): the property/value overload delegates to Servo_CSSSupports2, and the condition-text overload builds StyleCssSupportsParams (author origin, quirks mode, URL context from the document) and calls Servo_CSSSupports.

nodes.name: Escape
nodes.summary: Implements CSS.escape() by appending the identifier with nsStyleUtil::AppendEscapedCSSIdent.

nodes.name: GetHighlights
nodes.summary: Returns the document's HighlightRegistry for the CSS.highlights() API, erroring when the global has no associated document.

nodes.name: CSS.h
nodes.summary: Declares the mozilla::dom::CSS WebIDL interface (non-instantiable): static Supports overloads, Escape, GetHighlights, RegisterProperty, and the full CSS Typed OM set of CSSUnitValue factory statics (px/em/cqw/deg/s/hz/dpi/fr, etc.).

nodes.name: CSS
nodes.summary: Namespace-like WebIDL holder of utility CSS functions: feature support queries, identifier escaping, highlight registry access, custom property registration, and Typed OM unit value constructors.

nodes.name: CSSAppearanceBaseRule.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the DOM wrapper for the internal appearance-base group rule: cycle-collection stubs, Servo_AppearanceBaseRule_* FFI for debug listing, css text, and obtaining the child StyleLockedCssRules.

nodes.name: GetOrCreateRawRules
nodes.summary: Returns the rule's child rule list by calling Servo_AppearanceBaseRule_GetRules on the raw StyleAppearanceBaseRule.

nodes.name: CSSAppearanceBaseRule.h
nodes.summary: Declares CSSAppearanceBaseRule, a css::GroupRule subclass wrapping a RefPtr<StyleAppearanceBaseRule> with WebIDL Type()/GetCssText() and raw-rule clone support for the appearance-base internal rule.

nodes.name: CSSAppearanceBaseRule
nodes.summary: DOM representation of the Servo appearance-base rule as a GroupRule, exposing Raw()/SetRawAfterClone, GetOrCreateRawRules, SizeOfIncludingThis, and binding wrap.

nodes.name: CSSContainerRule.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the CSSContainerRule DOM wrapper around Servo's StyleContainerRule: condition text and cssText via Servo_ContainerRule_* FFI, per-condition container name/query accessors, and QueryContainerFor/QueryConditionMatchesElement which flush layout and query matching through the document's ServoStyleSet raw data.

nodes.name: QueryConditionMatchesElement
nodes.summary: Evaluates whether the container query condition at aConditionIndex matches an element: flushes pending layout notifications on the element's document, then delegates to Servo_ContainerRule_QueryConditionMatchesElement with the ServoStyleSet raw data.

nodes.name: QueryContainerFor
nodes.summary: Resolves the container element a condition's query would match for the given element via Servo_ContainerRule_QueryContainerFor.

nodes.name: GetConditions
nodes.summary: Collects the rule's CSSContainerCondition list (name + query string per condition) from the raw Servo rule for WebIDL exposure.

nodes.name: GetConditionText
nodes.summary: Returns the serialized condition text of the container rule via Servo_ContainerRule_GetConditionText.

nodes.name: CSSContainerRule.h
nodes.summary: Declares CSSContainerRule, a css::ConditionRule subclass wrapping RefPtr<StyleContainerRule>, exposing WebIDL containerName/containerQuery/conditions and container matching helpers in addition to the standard condition rule interface.

nodes.name: CSSContainerRule
nodes.summary: DOM object for @container rules: wraps the raw StyleContainerRule, supports SetRawAfterClone for stylesheet cloning, and provides query-condition and container-element queries.

nodes.name: CSSCounterStyleRule.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the CSSCounterStyleRule DOM wrapper: name and descriptor accessors that mutate the raw StyleLockedCounterStyleRule through Servo_CounterStyleRule_* FFI, with ModifyRule gating on read-only state, marking the stylesheet dirty (WillDirty) and notifying RuleChanged so CounterStyleManager invalidates dependent counter styles.

nodes.name: ModifyRule
nodes.summary: Template helper wrapping descriptor/name mutations: skips read-only rules, calls StyleSheet::WillDirty before the mutation, and issues RuleChanged(this, StyleRuleChangeKind::Generic) when it succeeds, driving counter style invalidation.

nodes.name: SetName
nodes.summary: Sets the @counter-style rule name through Servo_CounterStyleRule_SetName inside ModifyRule, so the change dirties the sheet and restyles dependent counters.

nodes.name: SetDescriptor
nodes.summary: Parses and sets a counter style descriptor (system, symbols, additive-symbols, negative, pad, range, fallback, speak-as) via Servo_CounterStyleRule_SetDescriptor within ModifyRule.

nodes.name: CSSCounterStyleRule.h
nodes.summary: Declares CSSCounterStyleRule, a css::Rule subclass wrapping RefPtr<StyleLockedCounterStyleRule>, with WebIDL name/descriptor accessors keyed by CounterStyleDescriptorId and including nsCSSProps.h for descriptor identifiers.

nodes.name: CSSCounterStyleRule
nodes.summary: DOM object for @counter-style rules exposing GetName/SetName and Get/SetDescriptor over the raw locked Servo rule, with ModifyRule-based mutation semantics and raw clone support.

nodes.name: CSSCustomMediaRule.cpp
nodes.summary: CSSOM wrapper impl for @custom-media (extension) rules over Stylo StyleCustomMediaRule; Type()=StyleCssRuleType::CustomMedia; GetQuery lazily builds a MediaList or returns a boolean; delegates serialization and debug to Servo_CustomMediaRule_* FFI.

nodes.name: CSSCustomMediaRule.h
nodes.summary: Declares mozilla::dom::CSSCustomMediaRule final : css::Rule holding RefPtr<StyleCustomMediaRule> plus lazy MediaList; exposes Raw(), SetRawAfterClone, Type(), GetCssText, GetName, GetQuery, WrapObject.

nodes.name: CSSEnabledState.h
nodes.summary: Standalone enum header defining mozilla::CSSEnabledState (ForAllContent, InUASheets, InChrome, IgnoreEnabledState) with bitwise operators via MOZ_MAKE_ENUM_CLASS_BITWISE_OPERATORS; controls whether CSS features are enabled in a given context.

nodes.name: CSSFontFaceRule.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements CSSFontFaceRule (css::Rule) and its embedded CSSFontFaceRuleDecl (nsICSSDeclaration aggregated onto the rule). Descriptor get/set via Servo_FontFaceRule_* and nsCSSProps::LookupFontDesc; setters throw NotSupportedError (bug 443978); Type()=FontFace.

nodes.name: CSSFontFaceRule.h
nodes.summary: Declares CSSFontFaceRuleDecl (nsICSSDeclaration over StyleLockedFontFaceRule, embedded in the rule via offsetof-based ContainingRule) and CSSFontFaceRule final : css::Rule with Style() accessor and SetRawAfterClone.

nodes.name: CSSFontFeatureValuesRule.cpp
nodes.summary: CSSOM wrapper impl for @font-feature-values rules over Stylo StyleFontFeatureValuesRule; Type()=FontFeatureValues; fontFamily/valueText getters via Servo_FontFeatureValuesRule_*, setters throw NS_ERROR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

nodes.name: CSSFontFeatureValuesRule.h
nodes.summary: Declares CSSFontFeatureValuesRule final : css::Rule holding RefPtr<StyleFontFeatureValuesRule>; inline ctor, Raw()/SetRawAfterClone, WebIDL font-family and value-text accessors, WrapObject.

nodes.name: CSSFontPaletteValuesRule.cpp
nodes.summary: CSSOM wrapper impl for @font-palette-values rules over Stylo StyleFontPaletteValuesRule; Type()=FontPaletteValues; name, font-family, base-palette and override-colors getters via Servo_FontPaletteValuesRule_*.

nodes.name: CSSFontPaletteValuesRule.h
nodes.summary: Declares CSSFontPaletteValuesRule final : css::Rule holding RefPtr<StyleFontPaletteValuesRule>; inline ctor, Raw()/SetRawAfterClone, WebIDL getters (name, font-family, base-palette, override-colors), WrapObject.

nodes.name: CSSImportRule.cpp
nodes.summary: CSSOM wrapper impl for @import rules over Stylo StyleLockedImportRule; adopts the child StyleSheet from Servo_ImportRule_GetSheet with referencing-rule bookkeeping, AddReferencingRule/RemoveReferencingRule; GetStyleSheetForBindings forces EnsureUniqueInner; Type()=Import.

nodes.name: CSSImportRule.h
nodes.summary: Declares CSSImportRule final : css::Rule holding RefPtr<StyleLockedImportRule> and the child StyleSheet; WebIDL href, media, styleSheet, layerName, supports accessors plus DropSheetReference and SetRawAfterClone.

nodes.name: CSSKeyframeRule.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements CSSKeyframeRule (css::Rule over StyleLockedKeyframe) plus file-local CSSKeyframeDeclaration (nsDOMCSSDeclaration) reading style via Servo_Keyframe_GetStyle; UpdateRule template wraps mutation with sheet WillDirty/RuleChanged; Type()=Keyframe.

nodes.name: CSSKeyframeRule.h
nodes.summary: Declares CSSKeyframeRule final : css::Rule holding RefPtr<StyleLockedKeyframe> and a lazily created CSSKeyframeDeclaration; keyText accessors, Style(), Raw()/SetRawAfterClone, UpdateRule helper.

nodes.name: CSSKeyframesRule.cpp

nodes.summary: Parses the requested pseudo-element, collects the desugared rule chain plus scope data and shadow hosts, and asks Servo_StyleRule_SelectorMatchesElement across candidate hosts.

nodes.name: QuerySelectorAll
nodes.summary: Runs the rule's selector list against a root node using Servo_SelectorList_QueryAll or QueryAllWithScope when scope rules are involved, filling a SimpleContentList.

nodes.name: CollectStyleRules
nodes.summary: Static helper gathering the deepest StyleLockedStyleRule and, when desugaring, ancestor style rules and CSSScopeRule scope data for selector operations.

nodes.name: CSSStyleRule
nodes.summary: Header declaration of the style rule wrapper: GroupRule subclass with selector inspection API (SelectorCount, SelectorTextAt, SelectorSpecificityAt, SelectorMatchesElement, GetScopeRootFor), GetDeclarationBlock, GetSelectorWarnings, QuerySelectorAll, StyleMap and GetOrCreateRawRules.

nodes.name: CSSStyleRuleDeclaration
nodes.summary: Declaration block view declaration; friend of CSSStyleRule and offsetof-based Rule() recovery for owner access.

nodes.name: StyleMap
nodes.summary: Lazily constructs and returns the chrome-only StylePropertyMap backed by this rule.

nodes.name: SelectorSpecificityAt
nodes.summary: Returns the 64-bit specificity of a selector index via GetSelectorDataAtIndex, with optional desugaring for nested contexts.

nodes.name: CSSSupportsRule
nodes.summary: CSSOM @supports rule wrapper around StyleSupportsRule deriving from css::ConditionRule; condition text, serialization and nested rules come from Servo_SupportsRule_* FFI.

nodes.name: GetConditionText
nodes.summary: Serializes the supports condition via Servo_SupportsRule_GetConditionText.

nodes.name: GetOrCreateRawRules
nodes.summary: Lazily fetches child StyleLockedCssRules through Servo_SupportsRule_GetRules.

nodes.name: CSSSupportsRule
nodes.summary: Final css::ConditionRule subclass wrapping RefPtr<StyleSupportsRule>, implementing GetConditionText and GetOrCreateRawRules per the CSSConditionRule interface.

nodes.name: CSSValue
nodes.summary: Abstract refcounted DOM value base for computed style, defining the CSSValue type constants and the virtual GetCssText/CssValueType contract; downcast hook AsPrimitiveValue is completed in nsROCSSPrimitiveValue.h.

nodes.name: GetCssText
nodes.summary: Pure-virtual serialization of the value into a DOM string.

nodes.name: CssValueType
nodes.summary: Pure-virtual returning one of CSS_INHERIT, CSS_PRIMITIVE_VALUE, CSS_VALUE_LIST, or CSS_CUSTOM.

nodes.name: AsPrimitiveValue
nodes.summary: Inline downcast to nsROCSSPrimitiveValue, defined in nsROCSSPrimitiveValue.h.

nodes.name: CSSViewTransitionRule
nodes.summary: CSSOM @view-transition rule wrapper around StyleViewTransitionRule; Type() is StyleCssRuleType::ViewTransition with navigation/types getters over Servo_ViewTransitionRule_* FFI.

nodes.name: GetNavigation
nodes.summary: Returns the navigation descriptor string via Servo_ViewTransitionRule_GetNavigation.

nodes.name: GetTypes
nodes.summary: Fetches view-transition type atoms with Servo_ViewTransitionRule_GetTypes and converts them to UTF-8 nsCStrings.

nodes.name: CSSViewTransitionRule
nodes.summary: Final css::Rule subclass wrapping RefPtr<StyleViewTransitionRule>, declaring navigation/types WebIDL accessors and SetRawAfterClone.

nodes.name: DeclarationBlock.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of DeclarationBlock memory reporting; defines malloc-size-of hooks and SizeofIncludingThis which measures the backing Servo StyleLockedDeclarationBlock. Everything else in the class lives inline in the header.

nodes.name: DeclarationBlock.h
nodes.summary: Header for mozilla::DeclarationBlock, the Gecko-side wrapper around a Servo locked declaration block used for CSS declaration blocks in stylesheets and style attributes. Provides mutability control, cloning, property get/set/remove, and FromCssText parsing via Servo FFI calls.

nodes.name: DocumentMatchingFunction.h
nodes.summary: Defines the DocumentMatchingFunction enum (URL, URLPrefix, Domain, RegExp, MediaDocument, PlainTextDocument) used for @-moz-document rule conditions. A trivial header shared by the CSS parser.

nodes.name: DocumentStyleRootIterator.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements DocumentStyleRootIterator: builds the list of style roots (document root element plus document-level native anonymous content, or a single element) and yields them via GetNextStyleRoot for Servo style traversals.

nodes.name: DocumentStyleRootIterator.h
nodes.summary: Declares mozilla::DocumentStyleRootIterator, a small helper that enumerates the roots of a document from the Servo style system's perspective, optionally restricted to one element.

nodes.name: ErrorReporter.h
nodes.summary: Declares mozilla::css::ErrorReporter, a stack-only helper for building and reporting CSS parser warnings to the error console, with static helpers to decide whether errors should be reported for a sheet/loader/document.

nodes.name: ErrorReporter.cpp
nodes.summary: Diagnostic reporting for the CSS style sheet parser: initializes the console service and css.properties string bundle globals, caches sanitized URI specs briefly (ShortTermURISpecCache), and logs nsIScriptError warnings attributed to the owning window.

nodes.name: FontFace.h
nodes.summary: Declares the DOM FontFace interface implementation (CSS Font Loading API), a GlobalTeardownObserver/nsWrapperCache that delegates descriptor get/set, load status, and promise handling to its FontFaceImpl. Also defines FontFaceLoadedRejectReason/Rejection.

nodes.name: FontFace.cpp
