nodes.summary: DOM-facing FontFace implementation: the JS constructor parses descriptors and buffers via FontFaceImpl, CreateForRule wraps @font-face rules, and the lazy mLoaded promise is resolved/rejected as FontFaceImpl status changes. All descriptor accessors forward to FontFaceImpl.

nodes.name: FontFaceImpl.h
nodes.summary: Declares FontFaceImpl, the thread-safe non-DOM core of a FontFace: descriptor storage in a StyleLockedFontFaceRule, source type (rule/URL/buffer), load status, and the nested gfxUserFontEntry subclass Entry that tracks owning font sets under an RWLock.

nodes.name: FontFaceImpl.cpp
nodes.summary: Core FontFace logic: descriptor parsing through Servo_FontFaceRule_* FFI, gfxUserFontAttributes extraction from @font-face rules, unicode-range character-map computation, status progression feeding owner promises, and the FontFaceBufferSource/Entry plumbing that connects FontFace to the gfx user-font machinery.

nodes.name: FontFaceSet.h
nodes.summary: Declares the DOM FontFaceSet (document.fonts), a DOMEventTargetHelper implementing the CSS Font Loading API collection methods (load/check/add/clear/entries) plus loading events and the ready promise, all backed by a FontFaceSetImpl strategy object.

nodes.name: FontFaceSet.cpp
nodes.summary: DOM FontFaceSet implementation: creates document or worker impls, mirrors the non-rule/rule FontFace records, dispatches loading/loadingdone/loadingerror events, replaces the ready promise, and delegates matching and loadability to FontFaceSetImpl subclasses.

nodes.name: FontFaceSetImpl.h
nodes.summary: Declares FontFaceSetImpl, the thread-safe gfxUserFontSet subclass underlying a FontFaceSet: manages non-rule faces, loaders, font-load permission caching, loading state machine for the ready promise, and shared @font-face entry creation. Document/worker subclasses supply threading and channel behavior.

nodes.name: FontFaceSetImpl.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements FontFaceSetImpl: font shorthand parsing for matching, FindOrCreateUserFontEntryFromFontFace building gfxFontFaceSrc lists from Servo source lists (URL/local/format hints/tech flags), console logging of font failures, sync font data loading, and the loading-started/finished state machine driving events and the ready promise.

nodes.name: FontFaceSetDocumentImpl.h
nodes.summary: Declares FontFaceSetDocumentImpl, the document-bound FontFaceSetImpl that also implements nsIDOMEventListener and nsICSSLoaderObserver; handles @font-face rule updates, font preload consumption, content-policy checks, and style flushes for the document's user font set.

nodes.name: FontFaceSetDocumentImpl.cpp
nodes.summary: Document-specific font set behavior: UpdateRules reconciles @font-face rules with existing FontFaces (migrating entries, cancelling orphaned loaders, disconnecting stale rules), StartLoad consumes font preloads or builds channels via FontLoaderUtils, and pending-load checks consider PresShell, DOMContentLoaded, and the CSS loader.

nodes.name: FontFaceSetWorkerImpl.h
nodes.summary: Declares FontFaceSetWorkerImpl, the worker-thread FontFaceSetImpl using ThreadSafeWorkerRef for lifetime, a captured ClientInfo for main-thread font channel creation, and worker-owned URLExtraData for descriptor parsing.

nodes.name: FontFaceSetWorkerImpl.cpp
nodes.summary: Worker font set implementation: initializes principals, bypass-cache/private-browsing flags, and URLExtraData on the main thread, dispatches back to the worker thread, flushes non-rule faces locally, and starts font loads through FontLoaderUtils::BuildChannel with worker load groups.

nodes.name: FontFaceSetIterator.h
nodes.summary: Declares FontFaceSetIterator, the WebIDL iterator for FontFaceSet entries()/values(), holding a FontFaceSet reference, next index, and key-and-value flag.

nodes.name: FontFaceSetIterator.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the iterator's Next(): skips non-Author-origin faces via FontFaceSet::GetFontFaceAt, and returns JS values (or [value, value] pairs) until the set is exhausted.

nodes.name: FontLoaderUtils.h
nodes.summary: Declares mozilla::FontLoaderUtils with static BuildChannel overloads that create font-load nsIChannels for document and worker contexts, plus private helpers for CORS/security flags and channel setup.

nodes.name: FontLoaderUtils.cpp
nodes.summary: Builds font load channels: computes CORS/security flags (with chrome/resource exceptions), sets font Accept headers, referrer info, no-recompression for WOFF/WOFF2, request priority, and TailForbidden class-of-service, for both document- and worker-triggered loads.

nodes.name: FontPreloader.h
nodes.summary: Declares mozilla::FontPreloader, a FetchPreloader subclass for <link rel=preload as=font> that overrides CreateChannel to build font-specific channels.

nodes.name: FontPreloader.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements FontPreloader::CreateChannel, refusing to preload when downloadable fonts are disabled and otherwise delegating to FontLoaderUtils::BuildChannel with preload content-policy type.

nodes.name: DeclarationBlock
nodes.summary: Thread-safe-refcounted wrapper around StyleLockedDeclarationBlock offering clone/EnsureMutable, property query and mutation via Servo FFI, and links to the owning AttributeStyles for style attributes.

nodes.name: FromCssText
nodes.summary: Static factory parsing a style-attribute string (UTF-8 or UTF-16) into a DeclarationBlock via Servo_ParseStyleAttribute, with URL extra data and rule-type context.

nodes.name: SizeofIncludingThis
nodes.summary: Reports memory usage of the declaration block including the Servo raw block, using dedicated malloc-size-of hooks for memory reporting.

nodes.name: DocumentMatchingFunction
nodes.summary: Enum class enumerating the match types of @-moz-document rule conditions: URL, URLPrefix, Domain, RegExp, MediaDocument, PlainTextDocument.

nodes.name: DocumentStyleRootIterator
nodes.summary: Iterates the style roots of a document (root element and document-level native anonymous content) or a single element, feeding Servo style traversals.

nodes.name: GetNextStyleRoot
nodes.summary: Returns the next style root as a dom::Element, skipping any non-element entries in the root list until exhausted.

nodes.name: ErrorReporter
nodes.summary: MOZ_STACK_CLASS error builder for CSS parsing: accumulates localized messages and flushes them to the console as CSS Parser warnings with selectors, line/column, and inner window id.

nodes.name: ShouldReportErrors
nodes.summary: Static predicate combining the layout.css.report_errors pref with docshell CSS error reporting enabled state for a sheet/loader or document.

nodes.name: ShortTermURISpecCache
nodes.summary: A Runnable caching the sanitized spec of the most recently used URI, self-clearing shortly after use to balance performance and memory in error reporting.

nodes.name: OutputError
nodes.summary: Builds an nsIScriptError from the accumulated message, sanitized file name, position, and selectors, and logs it via the console service.

nodes.name: FontFace
nodes.summary: DOM FontFace implementation wrapping a FontFaceImpl; exposes descriptor accessors, status, Load(), and a lazily created loaded promise, and observes global teardown.

nodes.name: Constructor
nodes.summary: WebIDL constructor: parses descriptors via FontFaceImpl::SetDescriptors and initializes the source from a UTF-8 string URL or ArrayBuffer(View) data, hooking into the global's FontFaceSet impl.

nodes.name: Load
nodes.summary: Creates the loaded promise if needed, triggers FontFaceImpl::Load on the underlying user font machinery, and updates owner keep-alive before returning the promise.

nodes.name: EnsurePromise
nodes.summary: Lazily creates the mLoaded promise, immediately resolving it if the font is already loaded or replaying a saved rejection otherwise.

nodes.name: FontFaceImpl
nodes.summary: Non-DOM core of FontFace: stores the @font-face rule (or synthesized descriptor rule), source type and buffer, load status, and user font entry; performs descriptor parsing via Servo FFI and status updates that notify all owning font sets.

nodes.name: FontFaceImpl::Entry
nodes.summary: gfxUserFontEntry subclass linking a user font entry back to its FontFaceImpl owners and font set under an RWLock; maps gfx load states to FontFaceLoadStatus and dispatches status changes to owning threads.

nodes.name: FontFaceBufferSource
nodes.summary: gfxFontFaceBufferSource that hands the malloc'd ArrayBuffer font data to the user font set exactly once and frees it on destruction.

nodes.name: SetDescriptors
nodes.summary: Parses all FontFaceDescriptors from the JS constructor into a fresh empty StyleLockedFontFaceRule via Servo_FontFaceRule_SetDescriptor; any failure resets everything, rejects the owner with a syntax error, and marks the face Error.

nodes.name: GetAttributesFromRule
nodes.summary: Static extractor converting a StyleLockedFontFaceRule into gfxUserFontAttributes (family, weight/width/style ranges, overrides, display, feature/variation settings, sources, unicode ranges).

nodes.name: DoLoad
nodes.summary: Marks the face Loading, creates the user font entry if needed, and kicks off the underlying gfxUserFontEntry load.

nodes.name: FontFaceSet
nodes.summary: DOM FontFaceSet (document.fonts) implementing the CSS Font Loading API over FontFaceSetImpl; keeps mRuleFaces/mNonRuleFace records, the ready promise, and dispatches loading events.

nodes.name: MaybeResolve
nodes.summary: Resolves or flags the ready promise for lazy resolution and dispatches loadingdone/loadingerror events listing the faces that finished since the last cycle.

nodes.name: UpdateRules
nodes.summary: Hands a new @font-face rule list to the FontFaceSetImpl, moving aside old rule-face records so the impl can migrate or recreate them.

nodes.name: FontFaceSetImpl
nodes.summary: Thread-safe gfxUserFontSet base for FontFaceSet: tracks non-rule faces, loaders, allowed font loads, and the loading/loaded state machine, with virtual hooks for document vs worker threading, rule updates, and channel creation.

nodes.name: FindOrCreateUserFontEntryFromFontFace
nodes.summary: Static factory translating a FontFaceImpl (buffer data or Servo source list with url/local/format()/tech() components) into gfxFontFaceSrc entries and finding or creating the gfxUserFontEntry, updating existing entries off-main-thread via a runnable.

nodes.name: CheckLoadingFinished
nodes.summary: Ends the loading state machine: waits out delayed checks and pending loads, then flips status to Loaded and notifies the DOM owner (resolving the ready promise) on the owning thread.

nodes.name: LogMessage
nodes.summary: Composes a downloadable-font diagnostic with family, style, weight, width, status, and source location, then logs it to the console service with the inner window id (skipped on workers).

nodes.name: FindMatchingFontFaces
nodes.summary: Parses a font shorthand, looks up families in the user font set, and collects FontFace owners whose entries match the style and cover any character of the given text, ordering results by set position.

nodes.name: FontFaceSetDocumentImpl
nodes.summary: Document-bound FontFaceSetImpl adding nsIDOMEventListener (DOMContentLoaded) and nsICSSLoaderObserver behavior, @font-face rule reconciliation, preload-based font loads, and content-policy font-load gating.

nodes.name: UpdateRules
nodes.summary: Rebuilds the user font set from the current @font-face rule list: detaches font entries, reuses matching old rule faces, inserts new ones, cancels orphaned loaders, disconnects stale rules, and bumps the generation when modified.

nodes.name: StartLoad
nodes.summary: Starts a font download: consumes a matching font preload when available, otherwise builds a high-priority channel via FontLoaderUtils and registers an nsFontFaceLoader with the set.

nodes.name: InsertRuleFontFace
nodes.summary: Inserts or migrates a rule-backed FontFace: compares old records with Servo_FontFaceRule_Equals, reuses entries when possible (respecting local()-rule rebuilds), and creates fresh FontFace/entries for new rules.

nodes.name: FontFaceSetWorkerImpl
nodes.summary: Worker-bound FontFaceSetImpl holding a ThreadSafeWorkerRef, captured ClientInfo, and worker URLExtraData so descriptor parsing and font channel creation work across worker and main threads.

nodes.name: Initialize
nodes.summary: Creates a StrongWorkerRef whose shutdown triggers Destroy, captures the client info, and dispatches an init runnable to read principals, docshell load flags, and build the worker URLExtraData on the main thread.

nodes.name: StartLoad
nodes.summary: Starts a worker font download by building a channel through FontLoaderUtils with the captured ClientInfo and worker load group, then wiring an nsFontFaceLoader stream loader.

nodes.name: FontFaceSetIterator
nodes.summary: Non-refcounted-DOM iterator over a FontFaceSet supporting entries() (key-and-value) and values() modes, tracking the next index into the author-origin-visible face list.

nodes.name: Next
nodes.summary: WebIDL next(): skips non-Author faces via GetFontFaceAt, converts the FontFace to a JS value, and wraps pairs in a two-element array for entries() until done.

nodes.name: FontLoaderUtils
nodes.summary: Static helper namespace for constructing font-load channels for both document and worker contexts, centralizing CORS/security flag computation and HTTP channel setup.

nodes.name: BuildChannel
nodes.summary: Overloaded channel builders (document and worker) that open font nsIChannels with triggering principals, font Accept headers, referrer info, WOFF no-recompression, priority, and TailForbidden service flags.

nodes.name: FontPreloader
nodes.summary: FetchPreloader specialization for font preloads (TYPE_INTERNAL_FONT_PRELOAD) that creates channels via FontLoaderUtils.

nodes.name: CreateChannel
nodes.summary: Overrides FetchPreloader::CreateChannel to bail out when downloadable fonts are pref-disabled and otherwise build the preload channel via FontLoaderUtils::BuildChannel.

nodes.name: GenerateCSSProperties.py
nodes.summary: Build-time codegen script that imports Servo's property metadata (servo/components/style/properties/data.py) and generates the Gecko-side CSS property tables: ServoCSSPropList.h, NonCustomCSSPropertyId.h, nsCSSPropsGenerated.inc, nsComputedDOMStyleGenerated.inc, CompositorAnimatableProperties.h, CountedUnknownProperties.h, plus WebIDL descriptor interfaces. It is the Gecko/Servo Stylo property-pipeline bridge on the build side, mapping Rust CSSPropFlags to C++ CSSPropFlags and Gecko prefs.

nodes.name: GeneratePseudoStyleTypeList.py
nodes.summary: Small codegen script that imports PseudoElementData from servo/components/style/gecko/pseudo_elements.py and emits PseudoStyleTypeList.h, a macro-based list of pseudo-element/anon-box types with PseudoStyleTypeFlags. Keeps Gecko's PseudoStyleType enum in sync with Servo's pseudo-element definitions.

nodes.name: GroupRule.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements mozilla::css::GroupRule, the internal base class for grouping CSS rules (@media, @supports, @document). Manages a lazily created ServoCSSRuleList over Stylo-owned StyleLockedCssRules, cycle collection, and InsertRule/DeleteRule delegation into the StyleSheet (InsertRuleIntoGroup/DeleteRuleFromGroup).

nodes.name: GroupRule.h
nodes.summary: Header for css::GroupRule (shared by MediaRule and DocumentRule) and css::ConditionRule (the WebIDL CSSConditionRule implementation). Declares the ServoCSSRuleList-backed child-rule API and the pure-virtual GetOrCreateRawRules hook into Stylo locked CSS rules.

nodes.name: ImageLoader.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the style-system image loader: starts imgRequestProxy loads for Stylo StyleComputedUrl values (LoadImage), tracks request-to-frame and frame-to-request maps, and handles image notifications by invalidating frames/WebRender user data, triggering reflow, and blocking/unblocking document onload. Uses a process-wide GlobalRequestTable plus a singleton GlobalImageObserver to share CSS-loaded images across loaders.

nodes.name: ImageLoader.h
nodes.summary: Header for mozilla::css::ImageLoader, which handles CSS-triggered image loads (background/border-image/list-style, etc.) on behalf of the Servo-backed style system. Declares the bidirectional request/frame hashtables, the Flags bitfield for reflow/onload behavior, and static LoadImage/NoteSharedLoad/UnloadImage over StyleComputedUrl.

nodes.name: ImportScanner.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the best-effort @import scanner used by the HTML parser to speculatively preload imports inside <style> text. Runs a character state machine that skips comments and non-import at-rules, and consults the Stylo FFI call Servo_CSSSupportsForImport to evaluate supports() import conditions before emitting a URL.

nodes.name: ImportScanner.h
nodes.summary: Header for mozilla::ImportScanner, a simple state-machine scanner for @import rules in stylesheet text consumed by the HTML parser. Declares Start/Stop/Scan and the internal State enum covering comments, at-rule names, url() and quoted values.

nodes.name: jar.mn
nodes.summary: JAR packaging manifest that installs the layout/style UA stylesheet resources (ua.css, html.css, quirk.css, forms.css, scrollbars.css, counterstyles.css, accessiblecaret assets, etc.) into toolkit.jar under res/, plus resource-directory registrations for gre-resources and content-accessible files. Build-system data only, no code.

nodes.name: LayerAnimationInfo.cpp
nodes.summary: Defines LayerAnimationInfo::sDisplayItemTypes and GetDisplayItemTypeForProperty, mapping compositor-animatable CSS properties (background-color, opacity, transform-like properties including individual transform and offset-* properties) to their nsDisplayItem DisplayItemType. Complements the CompositorAnimatableProperties.h list generated by GenerateCSSProperties.py.

nodes.name: LayerAnimationInfo.h
nodes.summary: Header for mozilla::LayerAnimationInfo, providing static lookups between compositor-animated CSS properties and display item types, plus the nsChangeHint each animated display item needs (RepaintFrame, UpdateOpacityLayer, UpdateTransformLayer). Used when animations need updating but no other change hint is generated.

nodes.name: MappedDeclarationsBuilder.cpp
nodes.summary: Out-of-line pieces of MappedDeclarationsBuilder: SetIdentAtomValue forwards to the Stylo FFI Servo_DeclarationBlock_SetIdentStringValue, and SetBackgroundImage pushes an already-resolved absolute URI (preserving document-charset query encoding) through Servo_DeclarationBlock_SetBackgroundImage. This is where attribute-mapped declarations are handed to Servo's declaration-block parsing.

nodes.name: MappedDeclarationsBuilder.h
nodes.summary: MOZ_STACK_CLASS helper that gives attribute mappers (MapAttributesIntoRule) a typed interface for building the element's presentation-attribute StyleLockedDeclarationBlock. Nearly every setter (SetKeywordValue, SetPixelValue, SetColorValue, SetFontFamily, SetAspectRatio, ...) is a thin wrapper over a Servo_DeclarationBlock_* Stylo FFI function, with EnsureDecls lazily creating the block via Servo_DeclarationBlock_CreateEmpty.

nodes.name: MediaFeatureChange.h
nodes.summary: Defines MediaFeatureChange, its MediaFeatureChangeReason bitmask (viewport, zoom, resolution, medium, size-mode, system metrics, display-mode, preference changes) and MediaFeatureChangePropagation, pairing RestyleHint and nsChangeHint with the reason a media query result changed. Consumed by ServoStyleSet/StyleSheet media-query invalidation paths.

nodes.name: MediaList.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the DOM MediaList on top of a Stylo-owned StyleLockedMediaList: text get/set, item access, append/delete medium, clone, and viewport-dependency checks all delegate to Servo_MediaList_* FFI functions. Matches() evaluates the list against the document's ServoStyleSet raw per-document data, and DoMediaChange dirties the owning StyleSheet.

nodes.name: MediaList.h
nodes.summary: Header for mozilla::dom::MediaList, the cycle-collected wrapper-cache class holding RefPtr<StyleLockedMediaList> and a weak back-pointer to its StyleSheet for dirtying. Declares the WebIDL surface (media text, length, indexed getter, AppendMedium/DeleteMedium) and Matches/IsViewportDependent used by media-query evaluation.

nodes.name: MediaQueryList.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the DOM MediaQueryList (window.matchMedia result): evaluates its immutable MediaList against the Document, tracks the mMatches vs mMatchesOnRenderingUpdate states, flushes parent-document layout when viewport-dependent, and fires MediaQueryListEvent change events when media feature values change. A LinkedListElement so the document can enumerate live lists.

nodes.name: MediaQueryList.h
nodes.summary: Header for mozilla::dom::MediaQueryList, a DOMEventTargetHelper and LinkedListElement owned by the document's mDOMMediaQueryLists list. Declares MediaFeatureValuesChanged/EvaluateOnRenderingUpdate/FireChangeEvent used by rendering-update propagation, plus the cached mViewportDependent/mMatches state.

nodes.name: moz.build
nodes.summary: Build definition for layout/style: bug-component routing, exported headers (GeckoBindings.h, ServoBindings.h, StyleSheet.h, ServoStyleSet.h, MappedDeclarationsBuilder.h, GroupRule.h, ImageLoader.h, ...), the UNIFIED_SOURCES list, and the GeneratedFile/CbindgenHeader wiring that runs GenerateCSSProperties.py and GeneratePseudoStyleTypeList.py and produces ServoStyleConsts.h from the Servo geckolib crate. Also pulls in jar.mn and typedom/test subdirectories.

nodes.name: props_and_deps
nodes.summary: Builds Servo PropertiesData for the gecko engine and collects the servo/components/style/properties source files (data.py, longhands.toml, shorthands.toml, descriptor TOMLs) as dependencies of every generated file.

nodes.name: gen_css_prop_list_header
nodes.summary: Emits ServoCSSPropList.h, expanding CSS_PROP_LONGHAND/SHORTHAND/ALIAS macros with idents, translated C++ CSSPropFlags, and Gecko pref names for every property and alias.

nodes.name: gen_webidl
nodes.summary: Generates CSSStyleDeclaration subclass WebIDL (CSSStyleProperties, CSSPageDescriptors, CSSPositionTryDescriptors) with BindingTemplate extended attributes, prefs, ChromeOnly/internal filtering, and BindingAlias spellings.

nodes.name: gen_ns_css_props
nodes.summary: Emits the #included property tables for nsCSSProps.cpp: kIDLNameTable, kIDLNameSortPositionTable, kPropertyPrefTable, shorthand subprop tables, font-face/counter-style descriptor tables, plus ordering static_asserts.

nodes.name: gen_computed_style
nodes.summary: Generates nsComputedDOMStyleGenerated.inc with the entry table of nsComputedDOMStyle getters, deciding per property whether a C++ DoGet* getter exists or Servo serialization is used.

nodes.name: cpp_flags
nodes.summary: Translates Servo/Rust property flags and enabled-in state into C++ CSSPropFlags values such as SerializedByServo, IsLogical, AffectsLayout, and Internal.

nodes.name: generate
nodes.summary: Entry point emitting PseudoStyleTypeList.h by iterating PseudoElementData::all_pseudos() and choosing the CSS_PSEUDO_ELEMENT / inheriting / non-inheriting anon-box macros with PseudoStyleTypeFlags.

nodes.name: GroupRule::CssRules
nodes.summary: Lazily constructs the ServoCSSRuleList wrapping GetOrCreateRawRules() (Stylo StyleLockedCssRules) so most group rules never allocate a child list.

nodes.name: GroupRule::InsertRule
nodes.summary: CSSOM insertRule for grouped rules: validates the index and read-only state, then delegates to StyleSheet::InsertRuleIntoGroup for Stylo-side parsing.

nodes.name: GroupRule::DeleteRule
nodes.summary: CSSOM deleteRule for grouped rules: bounds-checks and delegates to StyleSheet::DeleteRuleFromGroup, throwing IndexSizeError on bad indices.

nodes.name: GroupRule::DropSheetReference
nodes.summary: Propagates sheet-reference dropping to the child ServoCSSRuleList before clearing the rule's own sheet pointer.

nodes.name: GroupRule
nodes.summary: Abstract mozilla::css::Rule subclass shared by MediaRule and DocumentRule that owns a lazily created ServoCSSRuleList of child rules and cycle-collects it; base of ConditionRule.

nodes.name: ConditionRule
nodes.summary: GroupRule subclass implementing the WebIDL CSSConditionRule interface via the pure-virtual GetConditionText; parent of CSSMediaRule and CSSMozDocumentRule.

nodes.name: ImageLoader::LoadImage
nodes.summary: Static entry that turns a Stylo StyleComputedUrl into an imgRequestProxy via nsContentUtils::LoadImage with CORS mode derived from the StyleCorsMode, registering it in the global sImages table as non-cancelable.

nodes.name: ImageLoader::Notify
nodes.summary: Main imgINotificationObserver dispatch point for CSS images, routing SIZE_AVAILABLE, IS_ANIMATED, FRAME_COMPLETE/UPDATE, DECODE_COMPLETE, and LOAD_COMPLETE to the On* handlers.

nodes.name: InvalidateImages
nodes.summary: Helper that invalidates a frame's WebRender fallback/mask/image-provider user data, propagates repaints to -moz-element rendering observers and ancestors, and schedules paint.

nodes.name: ImageLoader
nodes.summary: Per-document mozilla::css class that loads and tracks style-system images, maintaining request-to-frame and frame-to-request hashtables and reacting to image notifications with reflow/paint updates.

nodes.name: ImportScanner::Scan
nodes.summary: Character-by-character state machine over <style> text that recognizes @import (and skips @charset/@layer) collecting URLs, stopping at the first non-at-rule token.

nodes.name: OptionalSupportsMatches
nodes.summary: Evaluates an @import supports(...) condition by calling the Stylo FFI Servo_CSSSupportsForImport, treating an empty condition as a match.

nodes.name: ImportScanner
nodes.summary: Best-effort @import scanner for the HTML parser with Start/Stop/Scan API and an internal State enum tracking comments, at-rule names, url()/quoted values, and completion.

nodes.name: LayerAnimationInfo::GetDisplayItemTypeForProperty
nodes.summary: Maps compositor-animatable property ids (background-color, opacity, transform/translate/scale/rotate/offset-*) to their DisplayItemType, returning TYPE_ZERO otherwise.

nodes.name: MappedDeclarationsBuilder::SetIdentAtomValue
nodes.summary: Sets an identifier-valued longhand on the mapped declaration block through the Stylo FFI Servo_DeclarationBlock_SetIdentStringValue.

nodes.name: MappedDeclarationsBuilder::SetBackgroundImage
nodes.summary: Converts an eURL nsAttrValue into a UTF-8 URI spec and feeds it to Servo_DeclarationBlock_SetBackgroundImage with the document's default style-attr URL data, preserving document-charset query encoding.

nodes.name: MappedDeclarationsBuilder
nodes.summary: Stack-only builder that attribute mappers use to populate an element's presentation-attribute StyleLockedDeclarationBlock; each typed setter (keyword, pixel, percent, color, font-family, aspect-ratio, counter-reset, math-depth, ...) wraps a Servo_DeclarationBlock_* FFI call.

nodes.name: MappedDeclarationsBuilder::EnsureDecls
nodes.summary: Lazily creates the backing declaration block via Servo_DeclarationBlock_CreateEmpty on first setter use.

nodes.name: MappedDeclarationsBuilder::SetKeywordValue
nodes.summary: Sets an NS_STYLE_*/Style* enum keyword on the declaration block through Servo_DeclarationBlock_SetKeywordValue, with template and IfUnset variants.

nodes.name: MediaFeatureChange
nodes.summary: Struct bundling a RestyleHint, nsChangeHint, and MediaFeatureChangeReason describing why media-query results changed; kAllChanges and a helper for prefers-color-scheme/forced-colors changes.

nodes.name: MediaList::Matches
nodes.summary: Evaluates the media list against a Document via Servo_MediaList_Matches using the ServoStyleSet's raw per-document data.

nodes.name: MediaList
nodes.summary: Cycle-collected, wrapper-cached DOM MediaList holding RefPtr<StyleLockedMediaList> and a weak StyleSheet back-pointer; all media parsing/matching is delegated to Servo_MediaList_* FFI functions.

nodes.name: MediaQueryList::MediaFeatureValuesChanged
nodes.summary: Re-evaluates mMatches against the document when media feature values change, leaving mMatchesOnRenderingUpdate stale until the next rendering update.

nodes.name: MediaQueryList
nodes.summary: DOMEventTargetHelper and document-tracked LinkedListElement implementing window.matchMedia results, caching viewport dependency and matches state and firing change events.

nodes.name: NonCustomCSSPropertyId.h.in
nodes.summary: Autoconf-style template expanded at build time into NonCustomCSSPropertyId.h, declaring the NonCustomCSSPropertyId enum of all non-custom CSS property IDs plus FontFaceDescriptorId and CounterStyleDescriptorId enums and the CountedUnknownProperty list. It is the generated enum source that nsCSSProps.h supplements with MOZ_DBG/string-value support.

nodes.name: nsAnimationManager.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the CSS animation manager: builds and updates CSSAnimation objects from computed nsStyleUIReset animation data, resolves named/scroll/view timelines, and tracks referenced animation names for style invalidation. Contains static helpers (BuildAnimation, BuildAnimations, GetTimeline) plus ServoCSSAnimationBuilder which drives Servo keyframe resolution and restyles.

nodes.name: nsAnimationManager.h
nodes.summary: Header for nsAnimationManager, a CommonAnimationManager<CSSAnimation> subclass that updates CSS animations on style changes, manages named-timeline animation maps, deferred timeline updates, and the set of maybe-referenced animation names used for invalidation.

nodes.name: nsChangeHint.h
nodes.summary: Defines the nsChangeHint bitmask enum describing what must be recomputed after a style change (repaint, reflow, frame reconstruction, overflow updates, etc.), along with bitwise operators and helpers (NS_IsHintSubset, NS_HintsNotHandledForDescendantsIn, NS_RemoveSubsumedHints) and macros classifying hints handled for descendants.

nodes.name: nsCSSPropertyIDSet.h
nodes.summary: Header-only bit-vector set of non-custom (longhand) CSS property IDs, with set algebra (Intersect, Xor, IsSubsetOf), presets for compositor-animatable/transform/motion-path/opacity properties, and a chunked Iterator for range-for enumeration.

nodes.name: nsCSSValue.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the numeric core of nsCSSValue: constructors, copy/move assignment, equality, unit conversion in GetPixelLength (via nsPresContext::CSSPixelsToAppUnits), and SetPercentValue/SetFloatValue. The rest of the old value model now lives on the Servo side.

nodes.name: nsCSSValue.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsCSSValue, the representation of simple numeric CSS property values (a float plus an nsCSSUnit), and the nsCSSUnit enum covering percent, number, font-relative, screen, and viewport units. Also forward-declares the Servo CSS URL data FFI hooks.

nodes.name: nsCSSVisitedDependentPropList.h
nodes.summary: X-macro header listing style struct member variables that can depend on :visited state (background/border/outline/column-rule colors, text colors, fill/stroke, caret color) via FOR_EACH_VISITED_DEPENDENT_STYLE_STRUCT, consumed by privacy-sensitive visited-link handling.

nodes.name: nsDOMCSSAttrDeclaration.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the DOM object for element.style: resolves inline or SMIL-override declaration blocks on the owning Element, applies SMIL/SVG animated values, and tracks property mutations for active-layer and scroll-linked-effect detection via MutationClosureFunction.

nodes.name: nsDOMCSSAttrDeclaration.h
nodes.summary: Header for nsDOMCSSAttributeDeclaration, the final nsDOMCSSDeclaration subclass backing element.style and SMIL override styles, exposing SetSMILValue/ClearSMILValue overloads for SMIL, SVG lengths, path seg lists, and transform lists.

nodes.name: nsDOMCSSDeclaration.cpp
nodes.summary: Core CSSOM plumbing shared by element.style and cssStyleRule.style: implements GetCssText/SetCssText/GetPropertyValue/SetProperty/RemoveProperty by fetching-or-creating Servo declaration blocks, parsing via Servo FFI (Servo_ParseStyleAttribute, Servo_DeclarationBlock_*), with the ModifyDeclaration template handling mutation closures and document update batching.

nodes.name: nsDOMCSSDeclaration.h
nodes.summary: Abstract base class for DOM CSSStyleDeclaration objects (element.style and cssStyleRule.style), subclassing nsICSSDeclaration. Defines the ParsingEnvironment struct, MutationClosureData, Operation enum, and pure virtuals (GetOrCreateCSSDeclaration, SetCSSDeclaration, GetParsingEnvironment) that subclasses must supply.

nodes.name: nsDOMCSSValueList.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements nsDOMCSSValueList: appending CSSValue items and serializing GetCssText with comma or space separators for computed style value lists.

nodes.name: nsDOMCSSValueList.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsDOMCSSValueList, a DOM CSSValue subclass representing a list of CSS values in computed style, tracking whether the list is comma-delimited.

nodes.name: nsFontFaceLoader.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements loading of @font-face downloadable font data: streams the font over nsIChannel, applies font-display-dependent fallback timers (LoadTimerCallback with the 75%-downloaded heuristic), records glean download metrics, and hands completed data to gfxUserFontEntry::FontDataDownloadComplete.

nodes.name: nsFontFaceLoader.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsFontFaceLoader, which loads a single @font-face src URL on behalf of a gfxUserFontEntry and FontFaceSetImpl, implementing nsIStreamLoaderObserver, nsIRequestObserver, and the nsIFontLoadCompleteCallback used when platform font initialization finishes off-main-thread.

nodes.name: nsFontFaceUtils.cpp
nodes.summary: Utilities for downloadable fonts: MarkDirtyForFontChange walks the frame subtree (following placeholders to out-of-flow frames) to find frames using a changed gfxUserFontEntry, schedules reflow via PresShell, and posts RECASCADE_SELF restyles for frames whose styles depend on font metrics (em/ex/ch units).

nodes.name: nsFontFaceUtils.h
nodes.summary: Header for the nsFontFaceUtils static helper class declaring MarkDirtyForFontChange, which marks dirty the frames affected by a downloaded font becoming available.

nodes.name: nsICSSDeclaration.cpp
nodes.summary: Non-inline bits of nsICSSDeclaration: GetDocGroup via the associated node and IsReadOnly, which consults the parent CSS rule's read-only state.

nodes.name: nsICSSDeclaration.h
nodes.summary: Internal XPCOM interface (with nsWrapperCache) for accessing style declarations using NonCustomCSSPropertyId enums instead of strings; mirrors the CSSStyleDeclaration WebIDL surface (Get/SetProperty, CssText, IndexedGetter, GetParentRule) and defines NS_DECL_NSIDOMCSSSTYLEDECLARATION_HELPER.

nodes.name: nsICSSLoaderObserver.h
nodes.summary: Internal nsISupports interface for observing CSS style sheet loads; its single StyleSheetLoaded method is invoked by the CSS Loader when a sheet completes, before associated load events fire.

nodes.name: NonCustomCSSPropertyId
nodes.summary: uint16_t enum generated from ServoCSSPropList.h giving eCSSProperty_* IDs for every non-custom property, plus eCSSPropertyExtra_variable, eCSSProperty_UNKNOWN, eCSSProperty_INVALID and the eCSSProperty_COUNT* sentinels.

nodes.name: FontFaceDescriptorId
nodes.summary: Generated enum of @font-face descriptors, which share property syntax but follow different value rules.

nodes.name: CounterStyleDescriptorId
nodes.summary: Generated enum of @counter-style descriptors, analogous to the @font-face descriptor enum.

nodes.name: nsAnimationManager::UpdateAnimations
nodes.summary: Servo entry point that updates the CSS animations of an element/pseudo-element from its ComputedStyle, stopping animations in display:none subtrees unless display-animations are enabled.

nodes.name: nsAnimationManager::UpdateNamedTimelineAnimations
nodes.summary: Re-resolves animations that reference scroll/view timelines by name when elements start or stop providing a timeline with that name, deferring unresolved updates.

nodes.name: BuildAnimation
nodes.summary: Creates a new CSSAnimation or updates the existing one matching an animation-name, resolving timing params, timelines (document/scroll/view/named), ranges, and composition, and registering named-timeline references.

nodes.name: BuildAnimations
nodes.summary: Iterates the animation-name list of nsStyleUIReset in reverse to build the new animation array, tracking referenced animation names and skipping 'none' entries.

nodes.name: GetNamedProgressTimeline
nodes.summary: Resolves a named timeline for an animation target by walking the element and its ancestors across shadow boundaries per the scroll-animations scoping algorithm, consulting TimelineManager lookups.

nodes.name: UpdateOldAnimationPropertiesWithNew
nodes.summary: Preserves object identity while updating an existing CSSAnimation's timing, keyframes, timeline, range, and play state, skipping JS-overridden properties and notifying mutation observers of relevant changes.

nodes.name: NS_HintsNotHandledForDescendantsIn
nodes.summary: Computes which hints of a change are not inherited to descendant frames, demoting NeedReflow/size-position/ancestor-intrinsic hints when the dirty reflow bit is absent.

nodes.name: NS_RemoveSubsumedHints
nodes.summary: Filters out hints already handled by an ancestor and re-adds implied reflow bits when intrinsic-size or dirty-reflow hints survive.

nodes.name: nsCSSPropertyIDSet::CompositorAnimatables
nodes.summary: Constexpr factory returning the set of all properties animatable on the compositor, sourced from the generated COMPOSITOR_ANIMATABLE_PROPERTY_LIST.

nodes.name: nsCSSValue::GetPixelLength
nodes.summary: Converts a fixed-length unit value (px, pt, in, mm, cm, q, pc) into app units via nsPresContext::CSSPixelsToAppUnits.

nodes.name: nsCSSValue::SetFloatValue
nodes.summary: Sets the value to a float with the given float-capable unit after validating the unit and resetting prior state.

nodes.name: nsDOMCSSAttributeDeclaration::GetOrCreateCSSDeclaration
nodes.summary: Returns the element's inline or SMIL-override declaration block, creating an empty one via Servo_DeclarationBlock_CreateEmpty when modifying.

nodes.name: nsDOMCSSAttributeDeclaration::SetCSSDeclaration
nodes.summary: Installs a mutated declaration block back on the element via SetInlineStyleDeclaration or SetSMILOverrideStyleDeclaration, driving attribute-change notifications.

nodes.name: nsDOMCSSAttributeDeclaration::SetSMILValue
nodes.summary: Family of overloads applying SMIL CSS values and SVG animated lengths/path/transform lists into the SMIL override declaration block through SetSMILValueHelper.

nodes.name: nsDOMCSSAttributeDeclaration::MutationClosureFunction
nodes.summary: Declaration mutation callback that flags scroll-linked positioning properties to ScrollLinkedEffectDetector, notifies ActiveLayerTracker for layer-animatable properties, and invokes InlineStyleDeclarationWillChange.

nodes.name: nsDOMCSSDeclaration::SetProperty
nodes.summary: CSSOM setProperty implementation: parses the property name into a CSSPropertyId, handles 'important', and dispatches to custom-property or longhand parsing, removing the property for empty values.

nodes.name: nsDOMCSSDeclaration::ModifyDeclaration
nodes.summary: Template driving all mutations: obtains/creates the declaration, batches document updates, ensures the block is mutable, runs a Servo FFI lambda, and commits via SetCSSDeclaration on change.

nodes.name: nsDOMCSSDeclaration::ParsePropertyValue
nodes.summary: Parses and applies a longhand property value through Servo_DeclarationBlock_SetPropertyById, treating parse failures as no-change rather than exceptions.

nodes.name: nsDOMCSSDeclaration::EnsureBlockMutable
nodes.summary: Static helper that clones an immutable Servo declaration block (Servo_DeclarationBlock_Clone) or addrefs the existing mutable one before mutation.

nodes.name: nsFontFaceLoader::OnStreamComplete
nodes.summary: Stream loader callback that cancels the fallback timer, records download metrics, validates HTTP success, and forwards the downloaded data to gfxUserFontEntry::FontDataDownloadComplete.

nodes.name: nsFontFaceLoader::LoadTimerCallback
nodes.summary: Static timer callback implementing font-display fallback timing: marks the user font LOADING_SLOWLY/LOADING_TIMED_OUT and extends the timeout when over 75% downloaded.

nodes.name: nsFontFaceLoader::Cancel
nodes.summary: Cancels the font load: notifies the user font entry, unblocks document load, deregisters from the FontFaceSet, and aborts the channel.

nodes.name: nsFontFaceUtils::MarkDirtyForFontChange
nodes.summary: Walks frame subtrees (including placeholder out-of-flows) to detect frames whose ComputedStyle or font metrics use the changed user font, scheduling reflow and posting RECASCADE_SELF restyle events where font-relative units are involved.

nodes.name: nsICSSDeclaration::IsReadOnly
nodes.summary: Returns whether the declaration is read-only by consulting the parent CSS rule's read-only state; guards all mutating CSSOM operations.

nodes.name: nsIPreloadedStyleSheet.idl
nodes.summary: IDL defining nsIPreloadedStyleSheet, an opaque scriptable interface for style sheet handles returned by nsIStyleSheetService.preloadSheet and consumable via nsIDOMWindowUtils.addSheet.

nodes.name: nsIStyleSheetService.idl
nodes.summary: Scriptable XPCOM interface for managing user, agent, and author style sheets: loadAndRegisterSheet, sheetRegistered, preloadSheet/preloadSheetAsync, and unregisterSheet take effect immediately across all documents.

nodes.name: nsROCSSPrimitiveValue.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsROCSSPrimitiveValue, a read-only mozilla::dom::CSSValue subclass representing primitive values in DOM computed style, storing a float/int32/uint32/string union plus a CSS_* type tag, and adds CSSValue::AsPrimitiveValue downcast helper.

nodes.name: nsROCSSPrimitiveValue.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements nsROCSSPrimitiveValue: serializes typed values (px, %, number, deg, s, string) into cssText via nsStyleUtil::AppendCSSNumber, provides Set* mutators, memory-reset logic, and maps internal types to legacy DOM primitive types.

nodes.name: nsStyleAutoArray.h
nodes.summary: Header-only template nsStyleAutoArray<T>, a memmovable AutoTArray-like container that always holds at least one inline element, used inside style structs for lists such as box shadows and transitions.

nodes.name: nsStyleChangeList.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsStyleChangeData (weak frame, content, nsChangeHint) and nsStyleChangeList, an AutoTArray-backed list of recomputations to perform in response to style changes, plus PopChangesForContent trimming.

nodes.name: nsStyleChangeList.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements nsStyleChangeList::AppendChange with debug assertions about hint validity (frame present, no neutral changes, reconstruct-only semantics) and merges consecutive hints for the same frame.

nodes.name: nsStyleConsts.h
nodes.summary: Large header of enum-class constants (StyleBoxAlign, StyleGeometryBox, StyleVisibility, etc.) used in ComputedStyle style structs; values mirror Servo-generated definitions and it includes mozilla/ServoStyleConsts.h.

nodes.name: nsStyleSheetService.h
nodes.summary: Declares the nsStyleSheetService singleton (nsIStyleSheetService + nsIMemoryReporter) holding per-type sheet arrays (agent/user/author), PresShell registration for change notification, and CID/contract ID definitions.

nodes.name: nsStyleSheetService.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the style sheet service: synchronously loads and registers agent/user/author sheets via css::Loader, notifies registered PresShells and replicates changes to ContentParent children, supports sync/async preloading into PreloadedStyleSheet objects, and reports memory usage.

nodes.name: nsStyleTransformMatrix.h
nodes.summary: Declares the nsStyleTransformMatrix namespace: TransformReferenceBox for lazily resolved transform reference boxes, ReadTransforms to build gfx::Matrix4x4 from StyleTransform/translate/rotate/scale/motion data, interpolate/accumulate matrix operators, and 2D position converters.

nodes.name: nsStyleTransformMatrix.cpp
nodes.summary: Converts CSS transform lists into Matrix4x4: resolves percentages against CSS or SVG reference boxes (transform-box handling, stroke-bounds cycles), dispatches per-function Process* helpers for translate/scale/skew/rotate/perspective, and delegates interpolation/accumulation of matrices to the Servo FFI (Servo_MatrixTransform_Operate).

nodes.name: nsStyleUtil.h
nodes.summary: Declares the nsStyleUtil class of static style-system helpers: selector matching comparators (DashMatchCompare, ValueIncludes, LangTagCompare), CSS string/ident serialization, color conversion, significant-child checks, overflow prediction, and CSP inline-style checks.

nodes.name: nsStyleUtil.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements style utilities: dash and language-tag matching (language tags via the oxilangtag FFI), quoted/escaped CSS string and identifier serialization, CSSOM color serialization, significant-child tests, object-fit overflow prediction, and CSP policy checks for inline styles.

nodes.name: nsTransitionManager.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsTransitionManager, a CommonAnimationManager<CSSTransition>, exposing UpdateTransitions for stylo restyles plus internal DoUpdateTransitions / ConsiderInitiatingTransition / DoCreateTransition / DoCancelTransition machinery.

nodes.name: nsTransitionManager.cpp
nodes.summary: Starts, replaces, and cancels CSS transitions during style changes: expands transition-property shorthands and 'all', consults Servo FFI (Servo_ComputedValues_ShouldTransition, Servo_ComputedValues_TransitionValueMatches, Servo_AnimationValue_Uncompute) to build start/end values and reversing-adjusted timing, integrating with the animation collections and restyle pipeline.

nodes.name: PaintWorkletGlobalScope.h
nodes.summary: Declares mozilla::dom::PaintWorkletGlobalScope, the WorkletGlobalScope subclass for the CSS Paint API, with JS global wrapping and a (currently stubbed) RegisterPaint entry point.

nodes.name: PaintWorkletGlobalScope.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements PaintWorkletGlobalScope: wraps the JS global object with its generated binding, exposes the owning PaintWorkletImpl, and provides an empty RegisterPaint stub (CSS Paint API not yet implemented here).

nodes.name: PaintWorkletImpl.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements PaintWorkletImpl, the WorkletImpl subclass backing CSS Paint API worklets: CreateWorklet builds a dom::Worklet for a window/principal (crashing in release/beta builds) and ConstructGlobalScope creates a PaintWorkletGlobalScope on the worklet thread.

nodes.name: nsROCSSPrimitiveValue::GetCssText
nodes.summary: Serializes the typed value (px, %, number, deg, s, string) into cssText via nsStyleUtil::AppendCSSNumber and nsAutoCSSString helpers.

nodes.name: nsStyleSheetService::LoadAndRegisterSheet
nodes.summary: Loads and registers an agent/user/author sheet synchronously via css::Loader and notifies PresShells and content processes.

nodes.name: nsStyleSheetService::GetInstance
nodes.summary: Returns the process-wide nsStyleSheetService singleton, creating it on first use.

nodes.name: nsStyleTransformMatrix::ReadTransforms
nodes.summary: Builds a gfx::Matrix4x4 from StyleTransform/translate/rotate/scale/motion lists, resolving percentages against the reference box and dispatching per-function Process* helpers.

nodes.name: nsStyleUtil::AppendCSSNumber
nodes.summary: Appends a float as the shortest round-trippable CSS number representation.

nodes.name: nsStyleUtil::CSPAllowsInlineStyle
nodes.summary: Checks the element's CSP for inline style permission, reporting violations to the console with the offending text sample.

nodes.name: nsTransitionManager::UpdateTransitions
nodes.summary: Servo restyle entry point that starts, replaces, or cancels CSSTransition objects by comparing before/after computed styles per transitionable property.

nodes.name: nsTransitionManager::DoCreateTransition
nodes.summary: Creates a new CSSTransition from start/end ComputedValues resolved via Servo FFI (Servo_ComputedValues_TransitionValueMatches / Servo_AnimationValue_Uncompute), wiring the transition collection and events.

nodes.name: PaintWorkletImpl.h
nodes.summary: Declares PaintWorkletImpl, the parent-process WorkletImpl subclass backing the CSS Paint API (window.paintWorklet). Creates worklet instances for a window/principal and constructs the PaintWorkletGlobalScope on the worklet thread.

nodes.name: PaintWorkletImpl
nodes.summary: Final WorkletImpl subclass for the CSS Paint API; overrides ContentPolicyType (TYPE_INTERNAL_PAINTWORKLET) and ConstructGlobalScope to build a PaintWorkletGlobalScope.

nodes.name: PostTraversalTask.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements PostTraversalTask::Run and its destructor, executing the few tasks allowed right after a Servo traversal: dispatching font loading events / replacing the FontFaceSet ready promise and continuing gfxUserFontEntry loads.

nodes.name: PostTraversalTask::Run
nodes.summary: Switches on the task type to run FontFaceSetImpl::DispatchLoadingEventAndReplaceReadyPromise or gfxUserFontEntry::ContinueLoad, releasing the strong target reference in the destructor.

nodes.name: PostTraversalTask.h
nodes.summary: Declares PostTraversalTask, a value type run immediately after a Servo traversal; replaces runnables to avoid virtual calls and allocations, and may hold raw DOM pointers that are only valid right after the traversal. Queued by ServoStyleSet during post-traversal.

nodes.name: PostTraversalTask
nodes.summary: Trivially-copyable task with static factories DispatchLoadingEventAndReplaceReadyPromise and LoadFontEntry plus a Run() method, typed by a two-value enum over a void* strong target.

nodes.name: PreferenceSheet.cpp
nodes.summary: Loads the preference-derived color sheets (chrome, content, print) used by the style system: system vs pref vs stand-in colors, high-contrast mode handling, light/dark color sets, color-scheme derivation from theme prefs, and Glean accessibility telemetry.

nodes.name: PreferenceSheet::Initialize
nodes.summary: Main-thread one-shot initializer that loads content/chrome prefs, derives the print prefs (always light scheme, stand-ins when overriding document colors), and records Glean a11y theme metrics in the parent process.

nodes.name: PreferenceSheet::Prefs::Load
nodes.summary: Resets the Prefs struct and loads accessibility-theme state, the browser.display.document_color_use policy, stand-in usage, both light and dark color sets, Windows HCM overrides, and the effective color scheme.

nodes.name: PreferenceSheet::Prefs::LoadColors
nodes.summary: Fills one light/dark Colors set from LookAndFeel stand-ins, browser.* color prefs, or system colors depending on chrome/HCM/pref-usage flags, ensuring an opaque default background.

nodes.name: PreferenceSheet::PrefsKindFor
nodes.summary: Classifies a document as Chrome (chrome docshell or chrome-rules-enabled image), Print (static document), or Content to pick the preference sheet that applies to it.

nodes.name: GetColor
nodes.summary: Static helper reading a color pref (with a .dark-suffixed variant for dark color scheme) and parsing it through ServoCSSParser::ComputeColor into an nscolor.

nodes.name: PreferenceSheet.h
nodes.summary: Declares PreferenceSheet, the static holder of prefable colors for the style system: per-kind Prefs (chrome/content/print) with light and dark color sets, color-scheme accessors, and PrefsFor/PrefsKindFor to resolve the sheet for a document.

nodes.name: PreferenceSheet
nodes.summary: Static preference color registry exposing ChromePrefs/ContentPrefs/PrintPrefs, Refresh/Initialize, ColorSchemeForChrome, PreferredColorSchemeForContent, and ShouldUseChromePrefs/MayForceColors predicates.

nodes.name: PreferenceSheet::Prefs
nodes.summary: Per-kind preference snapshot with mLightColors/mDarkColors, flags for chrome/accessibility-theme/document-colors/pref-colors/standins, a color scheme, and Load/LoadColors plus ColorsFor(ColorScheme).

nodes.name: PreloadedStyleSheet.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements preloading of chrome style sheets for nsIStyleSheetService.preloadSheet: synchronous load via css::Loader::LoadSheetSync in Preload/GetSheet, and Promise-based async loading through the StylesheetPreloadObserver.

nodes.name: PreloadedStyleSheet::GetSheet
nodes.summary: Lazily loads the sheet with css::Loader::LoadSheetSync using the system principal and returns the cached StyleSheet pointer.

nodes.name: PreloadedStyleSheet::PreloadAsync
nodes.summary: Starts an asynchronous css::Loader::LoadSheet with a StylesheetPreloadObserver that resolves or rejects the given DOM Promise when the sheet finishes loading.

nodes.name: PreloadedStyleSheet::Preload
nodes.summary: Marks the sheet as loaded and synchronously populates it by calling GetSheet(), warming the preloaded sheet for later use.

nodes.name: PreloadedStyleSheet.h
nodes.summary: Declares PreloadedStyleSheet, the cycle-collected nsIPreloadedStyleSheet object returned from nsIStyleSheetService.preloadSheet, wrapping a lazily loaded StyleSheet plus its URI and StyleOrigin.

nodes.name: PreloadedStyleSheet
nodes.summary: nsIPreloadedStyleSheet implementation holding an mSheet/mURI pair with sync Preload(), Promise-based PreloadAsync(), and the nested StylesheetPreloadObserver nsICSSLoaderObserver.

nodes.name: Mozilla_Bullet.bf
nodes.summary: BirdFont XML project source for the 'Mozilla Bullet' font (designed by Mats Palmgren, SIL Open Font License), the built-in font Gecko ships for list bullets and other built-in glyphs used by the style/rendering system.

nodes.name: RestyleManager.cpp
nodes.summary: The core of Gecko restyle orchestration: converts DOM mutations (content insert/remove, attribute and state changes) into element snapshots and restyle hints, drives the Servo traversal via DoProcessPendingRestyles, runs the C++ post-traversal turning computed-style changes into change hints, applies them to the frame tree (ProcessRestyledFrames), and manages animation generations, wrapper restyles, and :nth-of/relative-selector invalidation.

nodes.name: RestyleManager::DoProcessPendingRestyles
nodes.summary: Drives the restyle loop: calls ServoStyleSet::StyleDocument to run the Servo traversal, then walks the style roots with ProcessPostTraversal, processes change hints via ProcessRestyledFrames, and iterates while new invalidations appear.

nodes.name: RestyleManager::ProcessPostTraversal
nodes.summary: Recursive post-Servo-traversal walk over an element and its descendants, computing change hints from old/new ComputedStyle, handling change-only hint propagation, lazy frame construction, and queuing post-traversal tasks; returns whether any style changed.

nodes.name: RestyleManager::ProcessRestyledFrames
nodes.summary: Applies an nsStyleChangeList to the frame tree: reconstructs frames for ReconstructFrame hints, updates views/layers, handles repaint/geometry hints, and tracks destroyed frames to avoid double processing.

nodes.name: RestyleManager::PostRestyleEvent
nodes.summary: Public entry point for invalidation: records a restyle hint and minimal change hint for an element (or the whole document for eForAll), sets the Servo restyle root, and schedules a style flush via the refresh driver.

nodes.name: RestyleManager::AttributeChanged
nodes.summary: Handles post-change attribute mutation notifications: takes/updates the element snapshot, computes attribute-dependent restyle hints (class/id/style attrs, href, etc.), and handles :nth-of and relative-selector sibling invalidation.

nodes.name: RestyleManager::ProcessPendingRestyles
nodes.summary: Refresh-driver entry point that dispatches to DoProcessPendingRestyles, managing the mInStyleRefresh flag, animation generation increments, and highlight pseudo repaint triggers.

nodes.name: RestyleManager::AddLayerChangesForAnimation
nodes.summary: Static helper that appends change hints for compositor-driven animations (transform/opacity etc.) to the change list so layer activity stays in sync even without style changes.

nodes.name: RestyleManager::ReparentComputedStyleForFirstLine
nodes.summary: Reparents computed styles when frames move in or out of ::first-line, via the recursive DoReparentComputedStyleForFirstLine/ReparentFrameDescendants helpers.

nodes.name: RestyleManager.h
nodes.summary: Declares RestyleManager, Gecko's restyle orchestrator (post-restyle events, pending restyle processing, element snapshot tables, animation/restyle generations, post-traversal entry points) and ServoRestyleState, the stack object threading the change list and pending wrapper restyles/scroll-anchor suppressions through the post-traversal.

nodes.name: RestyleManager
nodes.summary: Per-pres-context restyle manager owning the snapshot table, restyle/animation generations, and OverflowChangedTracker; friend of ServoStyleSet and Document, exposing mutation hooks (ContentInserted/ContentWillBeRemoved/AttributeChanged/ElementStateChanged), PostRestyleEvent, and the post-traversal.

nodes.name: ServoRestyleState
nodes.summary: Stack object carrying the ServoStyleSet, nsStyleChangeList, pending wrapper-frame restyles, and pending scroll-anchor suppressions through post-traversal recursion, with handled-change-hint tracking and DEBUG owner assertions.

nodes.name: RestyleManager::AnimationsWithDestroyedFrame
nodes.summary: RAII helper alive only during restyling that records elements (including pseudo-element generated content) whose animations must be stopped because they lost their frame by the end of the restyle.

nodes.name: Rule.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the CSSOM css::Rule base class: skippable cycle collection (IsCCLeaf/IsKnownLive), careful unlinking of declaration wrappers, DropSheetReference, SetCssText no-op, read-only and incomplete-@import checks, and containing-rule state for nested parsing.

nodes.name: Rule::UnlinkDeclarationWrapper
nodes.summary: Unpreserves both the rule's and the declaration's wrappers before dropping JS objects, avoiding the double-nsWrapperCache invariant violation when a rule owns a declaration wrapper.

nodes.name: Rule::GetContainingRuleStateForParsing
nodes.summary: Walks the parent-rule chain collecting a bitmask of containing rule types and the innermost style/scope rule type, used to configure nested CSS parsing.

nodes.name: Rule.h
nodes.summary: Declares mozilla::css::Rule, the abstract base class for all CSS rule types in a style sheet and the CSSOM CSSRule base: holds non-owning sheet/parent-rule pointers, line/column, cycle-collection skippability, and WebIDL glue such as TypeForBindings and GetCssText.

nodes.name: Rule
nodes.summary: Abstract css::Rule base (nsISupports + nsWrapperCache + SupportsWeakPtr) with pure virtual Type()/GetCssText()/SizeOfIncludingThis, DropReferences helpers, IsReadOnly/IsIncompleteImportRule, and ContainingRuleState for parsing.

nodes.name: RustCell.h
nodes.summary: Defines the RustCell<T> template with the same layout as Rust's std::cell::Cell<T>, so bindgen-generated FFI structs can embed it; ServoBindings.toml maps it to the real Rust Cell and it is never passed over FFI by value.

nodes.name: RustCell
nodes.summary: Layout-compatible stand-in for std::cell::Cell<T> with Get/Set/AsPtr; exists purely so C++ structs used in FFI match Rust memory layout.

nodes.name: ServoBindings.h
nodes.summary: Declares, via BASIC_RULE_FUNCS/GROUP_RULE_FUNCS macro families, the Servo_* FFI entry points per CSS rule type (Servo_CssRules_Get<Kind>RuleAt, Servo_StyleSet_<Kind>RuleChanged, Debug/GetCssText) that cbindgen cannot see because they are macro-generated on the Rust side; complements GeckoBindings.h.

nodes.name: ServoBindingTypes.h
nodes.summary: Defines the C++/FFI ownership glue for Servo types: SERVO_ARC_TYPE RefPtrTraits routing AddRef/Release to Servo_*_AddRef/Release, SERVO_BOXED_TYPE std::default_delete routing to Servo_*_Drop, unlocked rule-type ARC instantiations, and shared forward declarations used across the style system bindings.

nodes.name: ServoBoxedTypeList.inc
nodes.summary: Preprocessor list of Servo Box<T> FFI types (PerDocumentStyleData/StyleSet, SelectorList, UseCounters, AuthorStyles, SourceSizeList, ...), expanded by ServoBindingTypes.h to generate opaque types, Servo_*_Drop declarations, and default_delete specializations.

nodes.name: ServoComputedData.h
nodes.summary: Declares ServoComputedData, the C++ mirror of Servo's computed values backing ComputedStyle: per-style-struct pointers and accessors generated over FOR_EACH_STYLE_STRUCT, plus the rule node, visited style, writing mode, pseudo type, effective zoom, and computed-value flags.

nodes.name: ServoComputedData
nodes.summary: Non-copyable struct holding one const nsStyle* per style struct with Style<Name>() accessors, the matched rule node, visited_style, writing_mode, pseudo_type, effective_zoom and flags; constructed via memcpy from a ServoComputedDataForgotten pointer.

nodes.name: ServoComputedDataForgotten
nodes.summary: Tiny wrapper carrying a raw const ServoComputedData* so Rust code can hand C++ a view of computed values without ownership, expecting the backing data to have been mem::forgotten on the Rust side.

nodes.name: ServoCSSParser.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements ServoCSSParser as thin forwarders onto the Servo_* FFI: color/image validity, color computation and color-space conversion, property parsing into locked declaration blocks, easings, view-timeline insets, transforms-to-matrix, and font shorthands, plus ParsingEnvironment construction from a Document.

nodes.name: ServoCSSParser::ComputeColor
nodes.summary: Computes an nscolor from a CSS <color> string via ComputeAbsoluteColor and StyleAbsoluteColor::ToColor, with black as currentcolor; used notably by PreferenceSheet for color prefs.

nodes.name: ServoCSSParser::ParseProperty
nodes.summary: Parses a property/value pair into a StyleLockedDeclarationBlock by forwarding to Servo_ParseProperty with the URL extra data, parsing mode, compat mode, loader, and rule type from the ParsingEnvironment.

nodes.name: ServoCSSParser::GetParsingEnvironment
nodes.summary: Builds an nsDOMCSSDeclaration ParsingEnvironment from a Document's default style-attr URL data, compatibility mode, and CSS loader (for error reporting only).

nodes.name: ServoCSSParser.h
nodes.summary: Declares ServoCSSParser, the static utility facade over Servo's parsing FFI used throughout Gecko: color validation/computation/conversion, ParseProperty into locked declaration blocks, easings, view-timeline insets, absolute length-percentages, transform-to-matrix, font shorthands for FontFaceSet matching, and URL/ParsingEnvironment helpers.

nodes.name: ServoCSSParser
nodes.summary: All-static class whose ParsingEnvironment alias is nsDOMCSSDeclaration::ParsingEnvironment; every method wraps a single Servo_* FFI call so callers never touch the bindings directly.

nodes.name: ServoElementSnapshot.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements ServoElementSnapshot capture for Servo's selector-matching/invalidation: constructor records chrome-doc and lang-attr support, AddAttrs copies attributes/id/class with change flags, AddOtherPseudoClassState probes table-border/select-list-box via GeckoBindings, and AddCustomStates clones custom element states.

nodes.name: ServoElementSnapshot::AddAttrs
nodes.summary: Records a changed attribute (deduplicating class/id changes) and, on first call, copies all element attributes into the snapshot, setting Id/MaybeClass/Attributes flags for Servo matching.

nodes.name: ServoElementSnapshot::AddOtherPseudoClassState
nodes.summary: Captures one-shot pseudo-class state (nonzero table border, select list box) via Gecko_IsTableBorderNonzero/Gecko_IsSelectListBox FFI probes.

nodes.name: ServoElementSnapshot::AddCustomStates
nodes.summary: Clones the element's custom states set into the snapshot once, marking the CustomState flag so :state() invalidation can match against it.

nodes.name: ServoElementSnapshot.h
nodes.summary: Declares ServoElementSnapshot and ServoElementSnapshotFlags: the Gecko-side capture of an element's attributes, ElementState (:hover/:active etc.), custom states, and other pseudo-class state, marshalled to Servo for selector matching.

nodes.name: ServoElementSnapshot
nodes.summary: Holds all non-tree-structural state of an element that may affect selector matching. AddState/AddAttrs/AddCustomStates/AddOtherPseudoClassState populate captured data guarded by ServoElementSnapshotFlags; GetParsedAttr and GetAttrInfoAt serve attribute matching; tracks changed attribute names, chrome-document and lang-attr support, table border and select-list-box pseudo-class state.

nodes.name: ServoElementSnapshotTable.h
nodes.summary: Declares ServoElementSnapshotTable, an nsClassHashtable from dom::Element to its ServoElementSnapshot used to carry snapshots through Servo traversals.

nodes.name: ServoElementSnapshotTable
nodes.summary: Element-keyed table of ServoElementSnapshots (nsClassHashtable<nsRefPtrHashKey<Element>, ServoElementSnapshot>) owned by the traversal machinery and consulted by FFI snapshot lookups.

nodes.name: ServoLockedArcTypeList.inc
nodes.summary: X-macro list of every Servo Arc<Locked<T>> FFI type (CssRules, DeclarationBlock, StyleRule, ImportRule, Keyframe, MediaList, PageRule, FontFaceRule, etc.) expanded by ServoStyleConstsForwards.h and mirrored in servo arc_types.rs and ServoBindings.toml.

nodes.name: ServoStyleConstsForwards.h
nodes.summary: Forward declarations and typedefs that cbindgen cannot emit itself, included from generated ServoStyleConsts.h: StyleLoader/StyleRawGeckoElement aliases, StyleLocked* struct declarations via ServoLockedArcTypeList.inc, StyleBox (Rust Box stand-in), fixed-point SERVO_FIXED_POINT_HELPERS macro, and 32-bit build detection.

nodes.name: StyleBox
nodes.summary: Non-nullable owning pointer template replacing Rust Box<T> across the FFI: takes a UniquePtr, deep-copies on copy/assign, and MOZ_DIAGNOSTIC_ASSERTs non-null on operator* / operator-> and destruction.

nodes.name: ServoStyleConstsInlines.h
nodes.summary: Hand-written inline implementations for cbindgen-generated style types: StyleOwnedSlice/StyleOwnedArray copy/destroy and StyleOwnedRect, StyleAtom refcounting and static-atom tagging, StyleAngle conversions, LengthPercentage/StyleCalcLengthPercentage and LengthOrAuto resolution to CSS pixels/appunits, StyleComputedUrl load-data/URI/CORS accessors, StyleImage resolution, StyleDisplay classification, StylePosition/StylePositionArea, font weight/style predicates, timing functions, StyleZoom, and StyleNumericType checks.

nodes.name: LengthPercentage.Resolve
nodes.summary: Resolves calc()/percentage-bearing LengthPercentage values against a basis into appunits, with template overloads for custom percentage getters and optional rounding, complementing ResolveToCSSPixels.

nodes.name: StyleComputedUrl.GetURI
nodes.summary: Returns the resolved nsIURI of a computed url() value by delegating to its StyleLoadData, part of the url accessors (CorsMode, IsLocalRef, GetImage, MutLoadData) implemented inline here.

nodes.name: ServoStyleSet.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of ServoStyleSet, the per-document Gecko wrapper around the Servo style system: stylesheet add/remove per origin, stylist updates and sheet-dirty tracking, full and animation-only traversals (StyleDocument, StyleNewSubtree), style resolution for text/placeholder/pseudo-elements/lazy cases, keyframe and animation value computation, font-face and counter-style rule queries, and a large family of relative-selector invalidation and dependency queries (MaybeInvalidate*, Has*Dependency).

nodes.name: ServoStyleSet
nodes.summary: Owns the raw Servo_StyleSet for a Document: manages stylesheets of UA/user/author origins and shadow-DOM sheets, drives style traversals with AutoPrepareTraversal and sInServoTraversal tracking, resolves ComputedStyle for elements/pseudos/declarations, computes animation values and keyframes, flushes the stylist, caches non-inheriting computed styles, and answers invalidation dependency queries for restyling.

nodes.name: AutoSetInServoTraversal
nodes.summary: MOZ_RAII guard that installs the current ServoStyleSet into the sInServoTraversal global for the duration of a traversal and, on destruction, clears it and runs RunPostTraversalTasks.

nodes.name: StyleDocument
nodes.summary: Main document restyle entry point: flushes the stylist, sets up traversal via AutoPrepareTraversal, invokes Servo_TraverseSubtree with ServoTraversalFlags, and post-processes for animation/document-state changes, returning whether restyling happened.

nodes.name: StyleNewSubtree
nodes.summary: Styles a freshly-constructed subtree: an initial animation-only pass on the root when needed followed by Servo_TraverseSubtree for the new content, handling lazy resolution constraints.

nodes.name: PreTraverse
nodes.summary: Prepares snapshots before a traversal: takes element snapshots for animation/document-state change roots and shadow roots (PreTraverseSync) so Servo can match selectors off-main-thread.

nodes.name: ResolveStyleLazily
nodes.summary: Resolves a ComputedStyle for an element outside a full traversal (getComputedStyle and friends), optionally for a pseudo-element or ::part request, via Servo_ResolveStyleLazily.

nodes.name: UpdateStylist
nodes.summary: Flushes pending stylesheet/media changes into the Servo stylist with Servo_StyleSet_FlushStyleSheets when sheets were added/removed, origins marked dirty, or media features changed; clears the corresponding dirty flags.

nodes.name: ServoTraversalStatistics.h
nodes.summary: Declares ServoTraversalStatistics, counters for elements traversed/styled/matched and styles shared/reused during a Servo traversal, mirroring style::context::PerThreadTraversalStatistics.

nodes.name: ServoTraversalStatistics
nodes.summary: Plain struct of uint32_t counters (mElementsTraversed, mElementsStyled, mElementsMatched, mStylesShared, mStylesReused) with a static sSingleton used to gather style-system telemetry.

nodes.name: ServoTypes.h
nodes.summary: Types defined to pass values through Gecko_*/Servo_* FFI: LazyComputeBehavior, ServoTraversalFlags, StyleRuleInclusion, UpdateAnimationsTasks, InheritTarget, PointerCapabilities, ServoStyleSetSizes, DeclarationBlockMutationClosure, MediumFeaturesChangedResult, and nsFontFaceRuleContainer.

nodes.name: ServoUtils.h
nodes.summary: Utilities for Servo initialization and assertions: declares InitializeServo/ShutdownServo and AssertIsMainThreadOrServoFontMetricsLocked (implemented in GeckoBindings.cpp) and defines IsInServoTraversal() branching on the sInServoTraversal global.

nodes.name: ShadowParts.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements parsing of the shadow part mapping list per css-shadow-parts: ParseSingleMapping tokenizes 'outer::inner' entries (space- and colon-delimited) and ShadowParts::Parse splits on commas to build forward and reverse atom mappings.

nodes.name: ShadowParts
nodes.summary: Value object for a parsed 'part' attribute: mMappings maps part name atoms to lists of exported names, mReverseMappings maps inner names back to outer names; Get/GetReverse serve ::part and ::slotted-style matching, Parse() builds it from a string.

nodes.name: ShadowParts.h
nodes.summary: Declares mozilla::ShadowParts with forward/reverse part-name hashtables, a PartList array type, and the static Parse entry point plus DEBUG Dump.

nodes.name: ParseSingleMapping
nodes.summary: Implements https://drafts.csswg.org/css-shadow-parts/#parsing-mapping: collects spaces and tokens around an optional U+003A colon, returning a pair of nsAtoms (outer, inner), a same-atom pair when no colon is present, or {null, null} on error.

nodes.name: ShadowParts.Parse
nodes.summary: Splits the attribute value on commas and, per the css-shadow-parts mapping-list algorithm, appends each valid mapping to mMappings and mReverseMappings, skipping error entries.

nodes.name: SharedStyleSheetCache.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the process-wide SharedStyleSheetCache: memory reporting and pref-triggered clearing in Init(), static LoadCompleted plumbing that marks failed/cancelled load trees and notifies observers, LoadCompletedInternal walking SheetLoadData lists to complete sheets and insert them into the document tree, inline-sheet cache handling, cross-process Clear via ContentParent, and idle GC scheduling for unique-inner sheets.

nodes.name: SharedStyleSheetCache
nodes.summary: Singleton SharedSubResourceCache specialization (Loader=css::Loader, Key=SheetLoadDataHashKey, Value=StyleSheet, LoadingValue=css::SheetLoadData) also implementing nsIMemoryReporter and nsIObserver; keeps per-principal inline sheet candidates, a GC timer, and static Clear/LoadCompleted entry points.

nodes.name: SharedStyleSheetCache.h
nodes.summary: Declares SharedStyleSheetCacheTraits (binding the generic cache to css::Loader/SheetLoadDataHashKey/StyleSheet/SheetLoadData) and SharedStyleSheetCache with inline-sheet storage, GC scheduling, and LoadCompleted/Clear statics.

nodes.name: SharedStyleSheetCache::LoadCompleted
nodes.summary: Static completion handler invoked when a sheet load finishes: marks the load tree failed on error (Loader::MarkLoadTreeFailed), walks mNext for per-loader cancellations, computes whether events can fire, collects datas via LoadCompletedInternal, then calls Loader::NotifyObservers for each.

nodes.name: SharedStyleSheetCache::LoadCompletedInternal
nodes.summary: Recursive walk over the SheetLoadData linked list and parent chain: stamps mSheetCompleteCalled and network metadata, inserts relevant top-level sheets into the document, marks sheets complete, posts applicable-state change events for cached sheets, decrements parents' mPendingChildren, and finally InsertIfNeeded into the cache.

nodes.name: SharedSubResourceCache
nodes.summary: CRTP template for caches sharing subresources across documents: mComplete/mPending/mLoading hash tables keyed by Traits::Key, Result/Lookup classification, CoalesceLoad list splicing with deferred-load promotion, Insert/LoadStarted/LoadCompleted/DeferLoad/Evict lifecycle, principal-refcount eviction (RegisterLoader/UnregisterLoader/EvictPrincipal), memory-pressure DoObserve, and a lazily created singleton.

nodes.name: SharedSubResourceCacheLoadingValueBase
nodes.summary: CRTP base for in-flight cache values: maintains the mNext linked list of coalesced loads (destroyed iteratively to avoid stack overflow) and declares the virtual lifecycle hooks IsLoading/IsCancelled/IsSyncLoad/GetNetworkMetadata/StartLoading/SetLoadCompleted/OnCoalescedTo/Cancel.

nodes.name: SubResourceNetworkMetadataHolder
nodes.summary: Thread-safe refcounted holder of network metadata for a cacheable subresource: optional CacheablePerformanceTimingData built from an nsITimedChannel/nsIHttpChannel and a cloned nsHttpResponseHead from HttpBaseChannel, used to add Resource Timing entries for cache hits.

nodes.name: SharedSubResourceCache::Lookup
nodes.summary: Classifies the cache state for a loader/key pair: returns a Complete result from mComplete when unexpired or already loaded by this loader, else mLoading/mPending entries, else a Miss; sync loads never consult the loading tables.

nodes.name: SharedSubResourceCache::CoalesceLoad
nodes.summary: Attaches a new LoadingValue to an existing loading/pending load's mNext list (front-inserted after the head), promoting a pending load to active via WillStartPendingLoad when the new consumer should not defer, and calling OnCoalescedTo on success.

nodes.name: SharedSubResourceCache.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements SharedSubResourceCacheUtils (Add/RemoveMemoryPressureObserver on 'memory-pressure' topics, AddPerformanceEntryForCache building PerformanceTimingData entries, ShouldClearEntry matching chrome/principal/site/URL/partition-key filters) and SubResourceNetworkMetadataHolder construction from an nsIRequest plus its size accounting.

nodes.name: SheetLoadData.h
nodes.summary: Declares css::SheetLoadData (and SheetLoadDataHolder): the per-stylesheet load descriptor deriving from PreloaderBase and SharedSubResourceCacheLoadingValueBase; holds loader/sheet/URI/parent import links, title, encoding, tainting, preload kind, nonce, fetch priority, compat mode, and a dozen bitfield state flags, with methods for pending-load start, encoding guessing, VerifySheetReadyToParse, SheetFinishedParsingAsync, and cache-value conversion.

nodes.name: SheetLoadData
nodes.summary: State machine for one stylesheet load: links mParentData/mNext lists for @import and coalesced loads, counts mPendingChildren, decides ShouldDefer/BlocksLoadEvent from alternate/media/preload state, implements the SharedSubResourceCacheLoadingValueBase lifecycle (StartLoading/SetLoadCompleted/OnCoalescedTo/Cancel), computes non-BOM encodings, and calls back into css::Loader::SheetComplete when the parse finishes.

nodes.name: StreamLoader.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements css::StreamLoader: OnStartRequest reserves capacity from Content-Length and retargets delivery to a TaskQueue; WriteSegmentFun buffers bytes with 3-byte BOM detection; OnStopRequest resolves the BOM/non-BOM encoding, validates/decodes UTF-8, annotates classifier-blocked nodes, and hands the sheet text to css::Loader::ParseSheet or completes with SheetComplete on error; also redirect handling setting minimum expiration time.

nodes.name: StreamLoader
nodes.summary: nsIThreadRetargetableStreamListener + nsIChannelEventSink + nsIInterfaceRequestor that accumulates stylesheet bytes (mBytes plus mBOMBytes for BOM sniffing) on behalf of a SheetLoadData, holding a main-thread SheetLoadDataHolder for cross-thread completion.

nodes.name: StreamLoader.h
nodes.summary: Declares css::StreamLoader wrapping a SheetLoadData reference, BOM/byte buffers, request pointer, and NIGHTLY channel-open-failure instrumentation.

nodes.name: StreamLoader::OnStopRequest
nodes.summary: Terminal stream callback (possibly triggered twice via OnDataFinished): on main thread attaches SubResourceNetworkMetadataHolder and unblocks the sheet parse promise; runs VerifySheetReadyToParse, final BOM handling, non-BOM encoding determination, UTF-8 validation/decoding, then delegates to Loader::ParseSheet, or completes via SheetComplete with classifier-blocked-node annotation on error.

nodes.name: StreamLoader::WriteSegmentFun
nodes.summary: ReadSegments callback that diverts the first three bytes into mBOMBytes (calling HandleBOM when full) and appends the remainder to mBytes with fallible allocation and OOM status tracking.

nodes.name: StyleAnimationValue.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements AnimationValue on top of the Servo_AnimationValue_* FFI: deep equality, opacity/color/currentcolor extraction, transform/translate/rotate/scale and motion-path (offset-path/distance/rotate/anchor/position) getters, GetScaleValue via ReadTransforms on the frame, serialization, interpolation and distance queries, FromString (parse via ServoCSSParser then StyleSet::ComputeAnimationValue), and FromAnimatable converting layers::Animatable IPC payloads.

nodes.name: AnimationValue
nodes.summary: Wrapper around RefPtr<StyleAnimationValue> (mServo) exposing accessors for opacity, background color, transform-family and motion-path properties, scale computation against a frame, SerializeSpecifiedValue, IsInterpolableWith/ComputeDistance, and the static factories FromString and FromAnimatable.

nodes.name: StyleAnimationValue.h
nodes.summary: Declares AnimationValue and PropertyStyleAnimationValuePair: utilities for animating computed style values across the Servo FFI, including transform/motion-path getters and interpolation helpers.
