nodes.name: AnimationValue::FromString
nodes.summary: Parses a CSS property value string for an element via ServoCSSParser::ParseProperty with the document's parsing environment (flushing style through nsComputedDOMStyle::GetComputedStyle), then computes an AnimationValue with PresShell->StyleSet()->ComputeAnimationValue.

nodes.name: AnimationValue::FromAnimatable
nodes.summary: Converts a layers::Animatable union (transform, float opacity, nscolor, rotate/scale/translate, offset-path family) into an already_AddRefed<StyleAnimationValue> via the corresponding Servo_AnimationValue_* factory, asserting percent-free transform inputs.

nodes.name: StyleColor.cpp
nodes.summary: Template specializations for cbindgen-generated StyleColor/StyleColorFunction/StyleGenericColorMix: MaybeTransparent, DependsOnCurrentColor across rgb/hsl/hwb/lab/lch/oklab/oklch/color-mix/contrast-color, ResolveColor delegating to Servo_ResolveColor for non-absolute colors, CalcColor overloads resolving against currentcolor from nscolor/absolute color/ComputedStyle/nsIFrame, and StyleAbsoluteColor color-space conversion plus ToColor with sRGB gamut mapping (binary-search MINDE or raytrace per pref) and NS_RGBA packing.

nodes.name: StyleColorInlines.h
nodes.summary: Inline functions for StyleColor (values::computed::Color): StyleAbsoluteColor::FromColor converting an nscolor to sRGB legacy components, SrgbLegacy constructor with non-finite guarding, StyleColor::FromColor/Transparent/Black/White specializations, and CalcColor/ResolveColor template declarations.

nodes.name: StyleColor::CalcColor
nodes.summary: Template specializations resolving a StyleColor to an nscolor: against an explicit foreground nscolor or StyleAbsoluteColor, against ComputedStyle's text color, or against an nsIFrame's StyleText()->mColor, all via ResolveColor().ToColor().

nodes.name: StyleAbsoluteColor::ToColor
nodes.summary: Converts an absolute color to sRGB via Servo_ConvertColorSpace, fast-path clamps when already in gamut, otherwise applies the layout.css.gamut_mapping_method pref (binary-search MINDE or raytrace via Servo_GamutMapColorUsing*), then packs components with nsStyleUtil::FloatToColorComponent into NS_RGBA.

nodes.name: StyleAbsoluteColor::FromColor
nodes.summary: Builds a legacy-sRGB StyleAbsoluteColor from an nscolor by scaling each NS_GET_R/G/B/A component to 0..1 and tagging it StyleColorFlags::IS_LEGACY_SRGB.

nodes.name: StylePreloadKind.h
nodes.summary: Declares css::StylePreloadKind, a uint8_t enum class distinguishing none, parser-speculative, <link rel=preload as=style>, Link rel=preload response-header, and early-hints stylesheet preloads, with helpers IsLinkRelPreloadOrEarlyHint and ShouldAssumeStandardsMode (header preloads assume non-quirks).

nodes.name: StylePreloadKind
nodes.summary: Enum class classifying how a stylesheet load was initiated (None, FromParser, FromLinkRelPreloadElement, FromLinkRelPreloadHeader, FromEarlyHintsHeader) so the loader can treat preloads as unobservable and guess quirks mode appropriately.

nodes.name: StyleSheetInfo.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring mozilla::StyleSheetInfo, a struct holding data common to CSSStyleSheetInner and ServoStyleSheet: CORS mode, SRI integrity metadata, origin-clean flag, child sheets, SourceMap URL, and the shared StyleStylesheetContents (Servo side).

nodes.name: StyleSheetInlines.h
nodes.summary: Out-of-line header providing the inline definition of mozilla::StyleSheet::GetParentObject, resolving the DOM parent (constructor document, document/shadow-root, owning node, or parent sheet) without forcing a Document.h dependency on StyleSheet.h includers.

nodes.name: TimelineCollection.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the mozilla::TimelineCollection template: destructor unlinks from the LinkedList, Destroy() clears the per-element/per-pseudo entry in ElementAnimationData, and static Get() looks the collection up; explicitly instantiated for dom::ScrollTimeline and dom::ViewTimeline.

nodes.name: TimelineCollection.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring mozilla::TimelineEntry (timeline ref plus cascade level) and the mozilla::TimelineCollection template, which shares implementation between ScrollTimeline and ViewTimeline: a per-element hash map from timeline name atoms to entries, linked into a LinkedList owned by the TimelineManager.

nodes.name: TimelineManager.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of mozilla::TimelineManager: creates, replaces, destroys and resolves named scroll/view progress timelines from computed nsStyleUIReset values, maintains name-to-target maps sorted in tree order, and implements timeline-scope resolution including shadow-DOM loose matching.

nodes.name: TimelineManager.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring mozilla::TimelineManager, the per-pres-context owner of scroll/view timeline collections and timeline-name maps; exposes UpdateTimelines, UpdateTimelineScopes, TimelineNameScopedByElement and named-timeline lookup used by animation-timeline resolution.

nodes.name: cleanup_computed_getters.py
nodes.summary: Developer utility script run from topsrcdir with the objdir as argument: it reads the generated nsComputedDOMStyleGenerated.inc to find which DoGet* getters are referenced, keeps those invoked by other code in nsComputedDOMStyle.cpp, and strips unused DoGet* definitions from nsComputedDOMStyle.h and .cpp.

nodes.name: CSSColor.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the CSSColor Typed OM interface (generic color() with color space, channels and alpha); most setters and channel mutation hooks throw NS_ERROR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED as the feature is still stubbed out.

nodes.name: CSSColor.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring mozilla::dom::CSSColor final, a CSSColorValue subclass implementing the CSSColor Web IDL interface (colorSpace, channels, alpha) for the CSS Typed OM color() value.

nodes.name: CSSColorValue.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the CSSColorValue Typed OM base class: constructor chaining to CSSStyleValue, IsEnabled() gated on layout.css.typedom.enabled plus layout.css.typedom.color prefs, WrapObject via the generated binding, and a Parse() static that is not yet implemented.

nodes.name: CSSColorValue.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring mozilla::dom::CSSColorValue, the CSSStyleValue subclass that is the base for all Typed OM color value wrappers (CSSColor, CSSHSL, CSSHWB, CSSLab, CSSLCH); exposes IsEnabled() feature gating and the CSSColorValue Web IDL Parse() static.

nodes.name: CSSHSL.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the CSSHSL Typed OM interface (h, s, l, alpha attributes); the constructor is stubbed and all setters throw NS_ERROR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED, with getters returning zero defaults.

nodes.name: CSSHSL.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring mozilla::dom::CSSHSL final, a CSSColorValue subclass implementing the CSSHSL Web IDL interface for the CSS Typed OM hsl()/hsla() color value.

nodes.name: CSSHWB.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the CSSHWB Typed OM interface (h, w, b, alpha attributes); constructor is stubbed and all attribute setters throw NS_ERROR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED, with getters returning zero defaults.

nodes.name: CSSHWB.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring mozilla::dom::CSSHWB final, a CSSColorValue subclass implementing the CSSHWB Web IDL interface for the CSS Typed OM hwb() color value.

nodes.name: CSSImageValue.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the CSSImageValue Typed OM interface: wraps a servo StyleImageValue (FFI-owned UniquePtr), provides Create(), serializes via Servo_ImageValue_ToCss, and defines CSSStyleValue::GetAsCSSImageValue() downcasts.

nodes.name: CSSImageValue.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring mozilla::dom::CSSImageValue final, a CSSStyleValue subclass holding a NotNull<UniquePtr<StyleImageValue>> representing <image> values in the CSS Typed OM.

nodes.name: CSSKeywordValue.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the CSSKeywordValue Typed OM interface per the CSS Typed OM spec: string constructor rejecting empty values, Create() overloads rectifying CSSKeywordish and servo StyleKeywordValue inputs, value get/set, ToCssTextWithProperty serialization, and CSSStyleValue::GetAsCSSKeywordValue() downcasts.

nodes.name: CSSKeywordValue.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring mozilla::dom::CSSKeywordValue final, a CSSStyleValue subclass wrapping a CSS keyword string (nsCString mValue) with constructor, rectifying Create() overloads, value accessors and serialization for the CSS Typed OM.

nodes.name: CSSLab.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the CSSLab Typed OM interface (l, a, b, alpha attributes); constructor is stubbed and all attribute setters throw NS_ERROR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED, with getters returning zero defaults.

nodes.name: CSSLab.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring mozilla::dom::CSSLab final, a CSSColorValue subclass implementing the CSSLab Web IDL interface for the CSS Typed OM lab() color value.

nodes.name: CSSLCH.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the CSSLCH Typed OM interface (l, c, h, alpha attributes); constructor is stubbed and all attribute setters throw NS_ERROR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED, with getters returning zero defaults.

nodes.name: CSSLCH.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring mozilla::dom::CSSLCH final, a CSSColorValue subclass implementing the CSSLCH Web IDL interface for the CSS Typed OM lch() color value.

nodes.name: mozilla::StyleSheetInfo
nodes.summary: final struct holding data shared by all StyleSheet copies backed by one inner: CORS mode, SRI integrity, origin-clean flag, child sheet array, SourceMap URL, RefPtr to StyleStylesheetContents, and the list of StyleSheet objects sharing this inner; supports CloneFor() and Add/RemoveSheet.

nodes.name: mozilla::TimelineEntry<TimelineType>
nodes.summary: Struct pairing a RefPtr to a timeline with the StyleCascadeLevel at which it was defined, stored as the map value inside a TimelineCollection.

nodes.name: mozilla::TimelineCollection<TimelineType>
nodes.summary: final template class (LinkedListElement) sharing implementation between ScrollTimeline and ViewTimeline: owns a per-element nsTHashMap from timeline-name atom to TimelineEntry, with Lookup, Extract, Swap and Destroy operations and a static Get() accessor via ElementAnimationData.

nodes.name: mozilla::TimelineManager
nodes.summary: Per-pres-context manager for named scroll/view progress timelines: keeps LinkedLists of TimelineCollections and name-keyed maps of timeline targets sorted in tree order, plus timeline-scope entries; API covers UpdateTimelines/UpdateTimelineScopes, scope queries, and lookup of named timelines for an element or subtree.

nodes.name: mozilla::dom::CSSColor
nodes.summary: final CSSColorValue subclass implementing the CSSColor Web IDL interface (generic color() with keywordish colorSpace, channel sequence and alpha); currently a stub whose setters and channel mutation hooks are not implemented.

nodes.name: mozilla::dom::CSSColorValue
nodes.summary: CSSStyleValue subclass serving as the base class of all Typed OM color value wrappers; gated by typedom color prefs via IsEnabled() and offering a not-yet-implemented Parse() static per the CSSColorValue Web IDL interface.

nodes.name: mozilla::dom::CSSHSL
nodes.summary: final CSSColorValue subclass implementing the CSSHSL Web IDL interface (h/s/l/alpha) for hsl() color values in the CSS Typed OM; currently a stub.

nodes.name: mozilla::dom::CSSHWB
nodes.summary: final CSSColorValue subclass implementing the CSSHWB Web IDL interface (h/w/b/alpha) for hwb() color values in the CSS Typed OM; currently a stub.

nodes.name: mozilla::dom::CSSImageValue
nodes.summary: final CSSStyleValue subclass (StyleValueType::ImageValue) wrapping a servo StyleImageValue in a NotNull<UniquePtr>; created from existing image values via Create() and serialized to CSS text through the Servo FFI.

nodes.name: mozilla::dom::CSSKeywordValue
nodes.summary: final CSSStyleValue subclass (StyleValueType::KeywordValue) wrapping a keyword nsCString; implements the CSSKeywordValue Web IDL interface including empty-string rejection, rectification of CSSKeywordish/StyleKeywordValue inputs, and serialization.

nodes.name: mozilla::dom::CSSLab
nodes.summary: final CSSColorValue subclass implementing the CSSLab Web IDL interface (l/a/b/alpha) for lab() color values in the CSS Typed OM; currently a stub.

nodes.name: mozilla::dom::CSSLCH
nodes.summary: final CSSColorValue subclass implementing the CSSLCH Web IDL interface (l/c/h/alpha) for lch() color values in the CSS Typed OM; currently a stub.

nodes.name: mozilla::StyleSheet::GetParentObject
nodes.summary: Inline method resolving the dom::ParentObject of a StyleSheet in priority order: constructor document, document or shadow root, owning node, then parent sheet.

nodes.name: cleanup_computed_getters
nodes.summary: Script entry point: collects DoGet* names referenced by the generated nsComputedDOMStyleGenerated.inc plus those invoked by other getters in nsComputedDOMStyle.cpp, then rewrites the header and source removing the unused getter definitions.

nodes.name: mozilla::TimelineCollection<TimelineType>::Destroy
nodes.summary: Clears this collection's slot in the element's ElementAnimationData (scroll or view variant selected at compile time), detaching it from the element before deletion.

nodes.name: mozilla::TimelineCollection<TimelineType>::Get
nodes.summary: Static accessor returning the TimelineCollection of the requested type for an element and pseudo-element request, or nullptr when the element has no animation data.

nodes.name: mozilla::TimelineManager::UpdateTimelines
nodes.summary: Entry point during styling: for scroll or view timeline type, either destroys the element's existing timelines (display:none or no computed style) or rebuilds them from the computed nsStyleUIReset via DoUpdateTimelines, returning the names of removed/changed timelines.

nodes.name: mozilla::TimelineManager::UpdateTimelineScopes
nodes.summary: Reconciles the manager's timeline-scope entries with the element's computed timeline-scope property: adds/removes scope entries and records scoped names, treating the 'all' keyword as an empty (fully permissive) name list.

nodes.name: mozilla::TimelineManager::TimelineNameScopedByElement
nodes.summary: Returns whether the given element's timeline-scope declaration makes the named timeline visible (scope covers all names or includes the given name).

nodes.name: mozilla::TimelineManager::GetNamedTimelineForThisElement
nodes.summary: Static lookup of a named timeline defined directly on an element/pseudo, checking both scroll and view collections and validating shadow-DOM scoping via ScopedNameLooselyMatches.

nodes.name: mozilla::TimelineManager::GetNamedTimelineInSubtree
nodes.summary: Resolves the named timeline for animation-timeline within a subtree: searches scroll and view name maps for the last-in-tree-order valid candidate (honoring scopes and shadow roots) and falls back to an UnresolvedTimeline when none is found.

nodes.name: mozilla::TimelineManager::DoUpdateTimelines
nodes.summary: Template workhorse behind UpdateTimelines: builds the new timeline map from computed style (reusing/patching existing timelines via TimelineBuilder), swaps it into the collection, and keeps the name-to-target map sorted by tree position using binary search insertion.

nodes.name: mozilla::dom::CSSColorValue::Parse
nodes.summary: Web IDL static for parsing a string into a CSSColorValue; currently unimplemented and throws NS_ERROR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

nodes.name: mozilla::dom::CSSImageValue::Create
nodes.summary: Static factory constructing a CSSImageValue wrapper around a servo StyleImageValue, used when exposing image values through the Typed OM.

nodes.name: mozilla::dom::CSSKeywordValue::Create
nodes.summary: Set of static factories: from a plain string, from a CSSKeywordish union (rectification returning the existing CSSKeywordValue as-is per spec), and from a servo StyleKeywordValue.

nodes.name: mozilla::dom::CSSKeywordValue::Constructor
nodes.summary: Web IDL constructor implementing the CSSKeywordValue spec steps: throws TypeError on empty strings, otherwise wraps the value in a new CSSKeywordValue.

nodes.name: CSSMathValue.h
nodes.summary: Declares CSSMathValue, the abstract Typed OM base class for calc()-style math values, derived from CSSNumericValue. Defines the MathValueType discriminator enum (Sum/Product/Negate/Invert/Min/Max/Clamp), the Operator() WebIDL attribute, per-subtype IsCSSMathXxx predicates and GetAsCSSMathXxx downcast helpers (bodies live in the subtype .cpp files), plus ToCssTextWithProperty and ToStyleMathValue conversion entry points.

nodes.name: CSSMathValue.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the CSSMathValue base: constructors forwarding NumericValueType::MathValue to CSSNumericValue, the static Create factory that dispatches on the StyleMathValue union tag to the seven concrete subclass Create functions, Operator() mapping MathValueType to the CSSMathOperator WebIDL enum, IsCSSMathXxx predicates, and ToCssTextWithProperty / ToStyleMathValue delegation via the GetAsCSSMathXxx downcasts. Also defines CSSNumericValue::GetAsCSSMathValue.

nodes.name: CSSMathSum.h
nodes.summary: Declares CSSMathSum, the Typed OM CSSMathValue subclass representing a calc() sum. Holds a RefPtr<CSSNumericArray> of operands, exposes the WebIDL Constructor and Values() attribute, cycle-collection support, ToCssTextWithProperty serialization and ToStyleMathSum conversion.

nodes.name: CSSMathSum.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements CSSMathSum: Create from StyleMathSum, WebIDL Constructor that rectifies numberish arguments, rejects an empty list, merges operand numeric types with Servo_NumericType_AddTypes (TypeError on incompatible types) and wraps operands in a CSSNumericArray; serializes as calc(a + b) folding nested CSSMathNegate operands into '- X', and converts to StyleMathSum. Also defines CSSMathValue::GetAsCSSMathSum.

nodes.name: CSSMathProduct.h
nodes.summary: Declares CSSMathProduct, the Typed OM CSSMathValue subclass representing a calc() product. Holds a RefPtr<CSSNumericArray> of factors, exposes the WebIDL Constructor and Values() attribute, cycle-collection support, ToCssTextWithProperty serialization and ToStyleMathProduct conversion.

nodes.name: CSSMathProduct.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements CSSMathProduct: Create from StyleMathProduct, WebIDL Constructor that merges factor types with Servo_NumericType_MultiplyTypes (TypeError on incompatible types), serializes as calc(a * b) folding nested CSSMathInvert operands into '/ X', and converts to StyleMathProduct. Also defines CSSMathValue::GetAsCSSMathProduct.

nodes.name: CSSMathNegate.h
nodes.summary: Declares CSSMathNegate, the Typed OM CSSMathValue subclass representing unary negation of a single CSSNumericValue. Exposes the WebIDL Constructor and Value() attribute, cycle-collection support, ToCssTextWithProperty serialization and ToStyleMathNegate conversion.

nodes.name: CSSMathNegate.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements CSSMathNegate: Create from StyleMathNegate, WebIDL Constructor that rectifies the numberish argument and copies its numeric type unchanged, serializes as calc(-X), and converts to StyleMathNegate boxing the operand. Also defines CSSMathValue::GetAsCSSMathNegate.

nodes.name: CSSMathInvert.h
nodes.summary: Declares CSSMathInvert, the Typed OM CSSMathValue subclass representing the reciprocal (1/value) of a single CSSNumericValue. Exposes the WebIDL Constructor and Value() attribute, cycle-collection support, ToCssTextWithProperty serialization and ToStyleMathInvert conversion.

nodes.name: CSSMathInvert.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements CSSMathInvert: Create from StyleMathInvert, WebIDL Constructor that rectifies the argument and inverts its numeric type with Servo_NumericType_Invert, serializes as calc(1 / X), and converts to StyleMathInvert boxing the operand. Also defines CSSMathValue::GetAsCSSMathInvert.

nodes.name: CSSMathMin.h
nodes.summary: Declares CSSMathMin, the Typed OM CSSMathValue subclass representing min() over an operand list. Holds a RefPtr<CSSNumericArray>, exposes the WebIDL Constructor and Values() attribute, cycle-collection support, ToCssTextWithProperty serialization and ToStyleMathMin conversion.

nodes.name: CSSMathMin.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements CSSMathMin: Create from StyleMathMin, WebIDL Constructor merging operand numeric types with Servo_NumericType_AddTypes (SyntaxError for empty args, TypeError for incompatible types), serializes as min(a, b) with paren-less nested operands, and converts to StyleMathMin. Also defines CSSMathValue::GetAsCSSMathMin.

nodes.name: CSSMathMax.h
nodes.summary: Declares CSSMathMax, the Typed OM CSSMathValue subclass representing max() over an operand list. Holds a RefPtr<CSSNumericArray>, exposes the WebIDL Constructor and Values() attribute, cycle-collection support, ToCssTextWithProperty serialization and ToStyleMathMax conversion.

nodes.name: CSSMathMax.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements CSSMathMax: Create from StyleMathMax, WebIDL Constructor merging operand numeric types with Servo_NumericType_AddTypes (SyntaxError for empty args, TypeError for incompatible types), serializes as max(a, b) with paren-less nested operands, and converts to StyleMathMax. Also defines CSSMathValue::GetAsCSSMathMax.

nodes.name: CSSMathClamp.h
nodes.summary: Declares CSSMathClamp, the Typed OM CSSMathValue subclass representing clamp(lower, value, upper). Holds three RefPtr<CSSNumericValue> members, exposes the WebIDL Constructor and Lower()/Value()/Upper() attributes, cycle-collection support, ToCssTextWithProperty serialization and ToStyleMathClamp conversion.

nodes.name: CSSMathClamp.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements CSSMathClamp: Create from the fixed three-element StyleMathClamp values array, WebIDL Constructor merging the three operand types with Servo_NumericType_AddTypes (TypeError on incompatible types), serializes as clamp(lower, value, upper) with paren-less nested operands, and converts to StyleMathClamp. Also defines CSSMathValue::GetAsCSSMathClamp.

nodes.name: CSSNumericValue.h
nodes.summary: Declares CSSNumericValue, the Typed OM base class (derived from CSSStyleValue) shared by CSSUnitValue and CSSMathValue. Stores the StyleNumericType and a NumericValueType discriminator, declares numberish-rectification Create factories, the WebIDL arithmetic surface (Add/Sub/Mul/Div/Min/Max/Equals), To/ToSum/Type/Parse, the nested SerializationContext helper class controlling nested/paren-less serialization, and downcast helpers GetAsCSSUnitValue/GetAsCSSMathValue.

nodes.name: CSSNumericValue.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements CSSNumericValue: numberish rectification (returning an existing CSSNumericValue or wrapping a double in CSSUnitValue) and creation from StyleNumericValue unit/math tags; WebIDL arithmetic operations still throw NotYetImplemented; To() and ToSum() convert through Servo_SumValue_Create/ToUnit(s); Type() exposes the CSSNumericType exponents and percent hint; Parse() builds values via Servo_NumericDeclaration_Parse/GetValue; dispatching serialization and ToStyleNumericValue. Also defines CSSStyleValue::GetAsCSSNumericValue.

nodes.name: CSSNumericArray.h
nodes.summary: Declares CSSNumericArray, a cycle-collected nsISupports/nsWrapperCache WebIDL array of CSSNumericValue operands, exposing Length(), the indexed getter, and the internal GetValues() accessor used by math-value serialization and conversion.

nodes.name: CSSNumericArray.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements CSSNumericArray: constructor asserting a parent, cycle-collected ISUPPORTS and wrapper-cache boilerplate, Length() and the bounds-checked IndexedGetter for the WebIDL indexed property.

nodes.name: CSSMatrixComponent.h
nodes.summary: Declares CSSMatrixComponent, the CSSTransformComponent subclass wrapping a DOMMatrix plus an is-2D flag. Exposes the WebIDL Constructor, Matrix()/SetMatrix() attributes, ToMatrix() conversion and ToCssTextWithProperty serialization.

nodes.name: CSSMatrixComponent.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements CSSMatrixComponent: Create copies all sixteen StyleMatrixComponent entries into a fresh DOMMatrix; WebIDL Constructor picks is2D from options or the source matrix; ToMatrix() projects a 2D component backed by a 3D matrix down to its a-f entries; serialization delegates to DOMMatrix::Stringify. Also defines CSSTransformComponent::GetAsCSSMatrixComponent.

nodes.name: CSSOKLab.h
nodes.summary: Declares CSSOKLab, a CSSColorValue subclass for the Typed OM oklab() color function, exposing the WebIDL Constructor and l/a/b/alpha attributes over CSSColorPercent/CSSColorNumber union types.

nodes.name: CSSOKLab.cpp
nodes.summary: Stub implementation of CSSOKLab: the Constructor only allocates the object, the l/a/b/alpha getters all return zero and the setters throw NS_ERROR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

nodes.name: CSSOKLCH.h
nodes.summary: Header for the CSS Typed OM oklch() color value. Declares CSSOKLCH, a final CSSColorValue subclass, with WebIDL constructor and l/c/h/alpha accessors typed via CSSColorPercent/CSSColorAngle.

nodes.name: CSSOKLCH.cpp
nodes.summary: Stub implementation of CSSOKLCH: the Constructor only allocates the object, the l/c/h/alpha getters all return zero and the setters throw NS_ERROR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

nodes.name: CSSMathValue
nodes.summary: Abstract Typed OM base class for calc()-style math expressions, derived from CSSNumericValue. Tagged with a MathValueType discriminator (Sum/Product/Negate/Invert/Min/Max/Clamp) which backs the Operator() WebIDL attribute, per-subtype IsCSSMathXxx predicates and GetAsCSSMathXxx static downcasts, and delegates serialization and StyleMathValue conversion to the concrete subclasses.

nodes.name: CSSMathSum
nodes.summary: Final CSSMathValue subclass representing a calc() addition chain. Owns a CSSNumericArray of operands whose numeric types must be addable (Servo_NumericType_AddTypes), exposes Values() to script, serializes as calc(a + b) folding nested negations into '- X', and converts to StyleMathSum.

nodes.name: CSSMathProduct
nodes.summary: Final CSSMathValue subclass representing a calc() multiplication chain. Owns a CSSNumericArray of factors whose numeric types are multiplied (Servo_NumericType_MultiplyTypes), exposes Values() to script, serializes as calc(a * b) folding nested inversions into '/ X', and converts to StyleMathProduct.

nodes.name: CSSMathNegate
nodes.summary: Final CSSMathValue subclass wrapping one CSSNumericValue operand with unary negation; the numeric type is copied unchanged from the operand. Serializes as calc(-X) and converts to StyleMathNegate.

nodes.name: CSSMathInvert
nodes.summary: Final CSSMathValue subclass representing the reciprocal of one CSSNumericValue operand; the numeric type is inverted via Servo_NumericType_Invert. Serializes as calc(1 / X) and converts to StyleMathInvert.

nodes.name: CSSMathMin
nodes.summary: Final CSSMathValue subclass representing min() over a CSSNumericArray of operands with addable numeric types. Serializes as min(a, b) with paren-less nested operands and converts to StyleMathMin.

nodes.name: CSSMathMax
nodes.summary: Final CSSMathValue subclass representing max() over a CSSNumericArray of operands with addable numeric types. Serializes as max(a, b) with paren-less nested operands and converts to StyleMathMax.

nodes.name: CSSMathClamp
nodes.summary: Final CSSMathValue subclass representing clamp(lower, value, upper) with three CSSNumericValue references whose numeric types must be addable. Serializes as clamp(lower, value, upper) with paren-less nested operands and converts to the fixed three-element StyleMathClamp.

nodes.name: CSSNumericValue
nodes.summary: Typed OM base class (derived from CSSStyleValue) for numeric values, common to CSSUnitValue and CSSMathValue. Holds the StyleNumericType and a NumericValueType discriminator; provides numberish rectification factories, the WebIDL arithmetic surface (Add/Sub/Mul/Div/Min/Max/Equals, currently unimplemented), unit conversion via To()/ToSum(), Type() introspection, static Parse(), nested SerializationContext, and static downcasts GetAsCSSUnitValue/GetAsCSSMathValue.

nodes.name: SerializationContext
nodes.summary: Nested value class threaded through numeric serialization. Tracks a Root/Nested/NestedParenLess kind so nested math values know whether to emit the calc( prefix and enclosing parentheses, queried via IsNested() and IsParenLess().

nodes.name: CSSNumericArray
nodes.summary: Cycle-collected WebIDL array (nsISupports + nsWrapperCache) holding a nsTArray<RefPtr<CSSNumericValue>> of math-value operands. Exposes Length() and the indexed property getter to script; GetValues() backs serialization and style conversion in the math subclasses.

nodes.name: CSSMatrixComponent
nodes.summary: Final CSSTransformComponent subclass wrapping a DOMMatrix and an is-2D flag. Constructed from DOMMatrixReadOnly plus CSSMatrixComponentOptions, exposes Matrix()/SetMatrix() to script, projects to a 2D matrix in ToMatrix() when required, and serializes via DOMMatrix::Stringify.

nodes.name: CSSOKLab
nodes.summary: Final CSSColorValue subclass for the oklab() color function with l/a/b/alpha WebIDL attributes; currently a stub whose getters return zero and setters throw NS_ERROR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

nodes.name: CSSOKLCH
nodes.summary: Final CSSColorValue subclass exposing the CSS oklch() color function to JS. WebIDL constructor takes l/c/h/alpha as CSSColorPercent/CSSColorAngle unions; accessors currently return default values (implementation pending in CSSOKLCH.cpp outside this batch).

nodes.name: Create
nodes.summary: Static factory converting a Servo StyleMathValue union into the matching DOM math object, dispatching on the tag (Sum/Product/Negate/Invert/Min/Max/Clamp) to the corresponding subclass Create function.

nodes.name: Create
nodes.summary: Overloaded static factories implementing rectify a numberish value: returning the given CSSNumericValue as-is, wrapping bare doubles in CSSUnitValue, and converting a Servo StyleNumericValue via its Unit/Math tags.

nodes.name: Parse
nodes.summary: Static CSSNumericValue.parse(): parses CSS text with Servo_NumericDeclaration_Parse, extracts the value via Servo_NumericDeclaration_GetValue, throws SyntaxError for invalid text and reuses Create for construction; includes a parent-taking overload for internal callers.

nodes.name: ToSum
nodes.summary: CSSNumericValue.toSum(): validates each requested unit with Servo_NumericType_Create, pre-checks addability via Servo_NumericType_AddTypesFromValues, converts this value to a Servo sum value (Servo_SumValue_Create/ToUnits) and wraps the resulting StyleMathSum in a CSSMathSum, throwing TypeError on failure.

nodes.name: To
nodes.summary: CSSNumericValue.to(): converts this numeric value into a CSSUnitValue expressed in the requested unit, delegating steps 1-3 to ToStyleUnitValue (unit validation plus Servo_SumValue_Create/ToUnit) and wrapping the resulting StyleUnitValue.

nodes.name: Constructor
nodes.summary: WebIDL CSSMathSum constructor: rectifies each numberish argument, throws SyntaxError when no arguments are given, merges the operand numeric types with Servo_NumericType_AddTypes (TypeError on incompatible types), then stores the operands in a CSSNumericArray.

nodes.name: CSSPerspective.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements CSSPerspective: factory Create() from StylePerspectiveComponent (numeric or keyword length), WebIDL Constructor validating a <length> numeric or the case-insensitive 'none' keyword via ConstructLength, ToMatrix() through DOMMatrix::PerspectiveSelf with a 1px floor, perspective() serialization, and GetAsCSSPerspective() downcast helpers on CSSTransformComponent.

nodes.name: CSSPerspective.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring CSSPerspective, a final CSSTransformComponent holding an OwningCSSPerspectiveValue length (CSSNumericValue or CSSKeywordValue), with WebIDL length accessors, ToMatrix(), ToCssTextWithProperty(), and a static Create() from StylePerspectiveComponent.

nodes.name: CSSRGB.cpp
nodes.summary: Stub implementation of CSSRGB: the WebIDL constructor ignores its r/g/b/alpha arguments and all getters return 0 while setters throw NS_ERROR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; only object wrapping via CSSRGB_Binding is functional.

nodes.name: CSSRGB.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring CSSRGB, a final CSSColorValue subclass representing the CSS rgb() function, with WebIDL r/g/b (CSSColorRGBComp) and alpha (CSSColorPercent) accessors; currently an unimplemented placeholder.

nodes.name: CSSRotate.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements CSSRotate: two WebIDL constructors (single <angle> producing a 2D z-axis rotate; x/y/z numbers plus <angle> producing rotate3d), Create() from StyleRotateComponent wrapping each field as CSSNumericValue, numeric-type validation on the angle and number setters, ToMatrix() via DOMMatrix::RotateAxisAngleSelf, rotate()/rotate3d() serialization, and GetAsCSSRotate() downcasts.

nodes.name: CSSRotate.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring CSSRotate, a final CSSTransformComponent with RefPtr<CSSNumericValue> slots mX/mY/mZ/mAngle, dual WebIDL constructors, x/y/z/angle accessors, ToMatrix(), ToCssTextWithProperty(), and static Create() from StyleRotateComponent.

nodes.name: CSSScale.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements CSSScale: WebIDL constructor validating x/y and optional z as <number> (z defaults to a CSSUnitValue of 1.0 and forces 2D), Create() from StyleScaleComponent, number-validated x/y/z setters, ToMatrix() via DOMMatrix::ScaleSelf, scale()/scale3d() serialization, and GetAsCSSScale() downcasts.

nodes.name: CSSScale.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring CSSScale, a final CSSTransformComponent with RefPtr<CSSNumericValue> slots mX/mY/mZ, WebIDL number accessors, ToMatrix(), ToCssTextWithProperty(), and static Create() from StyleScaleComponent.

nodes.name: CSSSkew.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements CSSSkew: WebIDL constructor and ax/ay setters requiring <angle> numeric types, Create() from StyleSkewComponent, ToMatrix() via DOMMatrix::SkewSelf, and skew() serialization.

nodes.name: CSSSkew.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring CSSSkew, a final CSSTransformComponent with RefPtr<CSSNumericValue> angle slots mAx/mAy, WebIDL accessors, ToMatrix(), ToCssTextWithProperty(), and static Create() from StyleSkewComponent.

nodes.name: CSSSkewX.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements CSSSkewX: WebIDL constructor and ax setter requiring a single <angle>, Create() from StyleSkewXComponent (an alias of StyleNumericValue), ToMatrix() via DOMMatrix::SkewXSelf, and skewX() serialization.

nodes.name: CSSSkewX.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring CSSSkewX, a final CSSTransformComponent with a single RefPtr<CSSNumericValue> mAx angle slot; aliases StyleSkewXComponent to StyleNumericValue from the style crate.

nodes.name: CSSSkewY.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements CSSSkewY: WebIDL constructor and ay setter requiring a single <angle>, Create() from StyleSkewYComponent (an alias of StyleNumericValue), ToMatrix() via DOMMatrix::SkewYSelf, and skewY() serialization.

nodes.name: CSSSkewY.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring CSSSkewY, a final CSSTransformComponent with a single RefPtr<CSSNumericValue> mAy angle slot; aliases StyleSkewYComponent to StyleNumericValue from the style crate.

nodes.name: CSSStyleValue.cpp
nodes.summary: Root of the CSS Typed OM value hierarchy implementation. Factory Create() converts a StylePropertyTypedValueList into concrete CSSStyleValue subclasses (CSSUnparsedValue, CSSKeywordValue, CSSNumericValue, CSSTransformValue, CSSImageValue) or CSSUnsupportedValue. Static Parse/ParseAll resolve the property, call the Servo_DeclarationBlock_Parse FFI to parse cssText into a DeclarationBlock, extract the typed value list, and return the resulting values; also implements Stringify and ToCssTextWithProperty dispatch over the StyleValueType tag.

nodes.name: CSSStyleValue.h
nodes.summary: Abstract base class of all Typed OM values: nsISupports + nsWrapperCache cycle-collected root holding a parent global and a StyleValueType tag. Declares static WebIDL parse()/parseAll(), the Create() factory, ParseStyleValue(), Is*/GetAs* guarded visitor accessors (implemented in each subclass .cpp), GetPropertyId(), and ToCssTextWithProperty().

nodes.name: CSSTransformComponent.cpp
nodes.summary: Base class of transform components: is2d attribute (SetIs2D is a no-op for skew/skewX/skewY/perspective), polymorphic ToMatrix() dispatching through TransformComponentType to each concrete component's ToMatrix, Stringify, ToCssTextWithProperty dispatch, and Is*/GetAs* type-guard accessors defined next to each subclass.

nodes.name: CSSTransformComponent.h
nodes.summary: Abstract base class for Typed OM transform functions (nsISupports + nsWrapperCache). Declares the TransformComponentType enum (Translate, Rotate, Scale, Skew, SkewX, SkewY, Perspective, MatrixComponent), the is2d flag, ToMatrix(), Stringify, and Is*/GetAs* visitor accessors for all eight concrete components.

nodes.name: CSSTransformValue.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements CSSTransformValue: Create() maps each StyleTransformComponent variant to a concrete CSSTransformComponent (CSSTranslate, CSSRotate, CSSScale, CSSSkew, CSSSkewX, CSSSkewY, CSSPerspective, CSSMatrixComponent); WebIDL constructor rejects an empty transform list; provides length, indexed getter (setter unimplemented), a stub ToMatrix(), space-joined serialization, and GetAsCSSTransformValue() downcasts on CSSStyleValue.

nodes.name: CSSTransformValue.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring CSSTransformValue, a final CSSStyleValue holding nsTArray<RefPtr<CSSTransformComponent>> mValues; aliases StyleTransformValue to CopyableTArray<StyleTransformComponent>. Declares the WebIDL constructor, length/is2d, ToMatrix(), indexed getter/setter, and serialization.

nodes.name: CSSTranslate.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements CSSTranslate: WebIDL constructor validating x/y as <length-percentage> and optional z as <length> (defaulting to a 0px CSSUnitValue with Length numeric type and forcing 2D), Create() from StyleTranslateComponent, validated x/y/z setters, ToMatrix() via DOMMatrix::TranslateSelf, and translate()/translate3d() serialization.

nodes.name: CSSTranslate.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring CSSTranslate, a final CSSTransformComponent with RefPtr<CSSNumericValue> slots mX/mY/mZ, WebIDL accessors, ToMatrix(), ToCssTextWithProperty(), and static Create() from StyleTranslateComponent.

nodes.name: CSSUnitValue.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements CSSUnitValue, the (value, unit) leaf of CSSNumericValue: three Create() factories (explicit StyleNumericType, plain number, StyleUnitValue), a WebIDL constructor validating the unit through the Servo_NumericType_Create FFI, value/unit accessors, property-aware ToCssTextWithProperty() that wraps out-of-range values (negative lengths, non-integers for order/z-index, font-weight bounds) in calc() and maps 'percent' to %, ToStyleUnitValue() conversion back to the style crate, GetAsCSSUnitValue() downcasts, and the MakeCSSUnitValue helper.

nodes.name: CSSUnitValue.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring CSSUnitValue, a final CSSNumericValue storing a double mValue and nsCString mUnit plus an inherited StyleNumericType; declares the three Create() factories, WebIDL constructor and accessors, ToCssTextWithProperty(), ToStyleUnitValue(), and the MakeCSSUnitValue free helper.

nodes.name: CSSPerspective
nodes.summary: Final CSSTransformComponent representing perspective(<length>|none). Stores an OwningCSSPerspectiveValue (CSSNumericValue or CSSKeywordValue); validates in the constructor per the Typed OM spec, converts to a DOMMatrix via PerspectiveSelf, and serializes as perspective().

nodes.name: CSSRGB
nodes.summary: Final CSSColorValue subclass representing the CSS rgb() function with r/g/b/alpha WebIDL accessors; a placeholder whose getters return 0 and setters throw NS_ERROR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

nodes.name: CSSRotate
nodes.summary: Final CSSTransformComponent representing rotate(angle) (2D, x=0/y=0/z=1) and rotate3d(x,y,z,angle). Keeps CSSNumericValue slots for x/y/z numbers and the angle, validates numeric types, and converts to a DOMMatrix via RotateAxisAngleSelf.

nodes.name: CSSScale
nodes.summary: Final CSSTransformComponent representing scale(x,y) and scale3d(x,y,z). Number-typed CSSNumericValue slots for x/y/z (z defaults to 1.0 in 2D), converted to a DOMMatrix via ScaleSelf.

nodes.name: CSSSkew
nodes.summary: Final CSSTransformComponent representing skew(ax, ay) with angle-typed CSSNumericValue slots mAx/mAy, converted to a DOMMatrix via SkewSelf; always 2D.

nodes.name: CSSSkewX
nodes.summary: Final CSSTransformComponent representing skewX(ax) with a single angle-typed CSSNumericValue mAx, converted to a DOMMatrix via SkewXSelf; always 2D.

nodes.name: CSSSkewY
nodes.summary: Final CSSTransformComponent representing skewY(ay) with a single angle-typed CSSNumericValue mAy, converted to a DOMMatrix via SkewYSelf; always 2D.

nodes.name: CSSStyleValue
nodes.summary: Abstract root of the Typed OM value hierarchy (nsISupports + nsWrapperCache). Tags instances with a StyleValueType (Unparsed/Keyword/Numeric/Transform/Image/Unsupported) and exposes static parse()/parseAll() which run property lookup, the Servo_DeclarationBlock_Parse FFI, and typed-value-list extraction; subclasses implement the Is*/GetAs* visitors and ToCssTextWithProperty.

nodes.name: CSSTransformComponent
nodes.summary: Abstract base class of Typed OM transform components (nsISupports + nsWrapperCache). Carries a TransformComponentType discriminant and an is2d flag (immutable for skew/skewX/skewY/perspective), with ToMatrix() and serialization dispatched on the type tag and GetAs*/Is* accessors for the eight concrete components.

nodes.name: CSSTransformValue
nodes.summary: Final CSSStyleValue subclass holding a list of CSSTransformComponent (the values slot). Created from a StyleTransformValue by mapping each StyleTransformComponent variant, rejects an empty list in its WebIDL constructor, supports indexed reads, and serializes components joined by spaces.

nodes.name: CSSTranslate
nodes.summary: Final CSSTransformComponent representing translate(x,y) and translate3d(x,y,z) with <length-percentage> x/y and <length> z (default 0px in 2D), converted to a DOMMatrix via TranslateSelf.

nodes.name: CSSUnitValue
nodes.summary: Final CSSNumericValue leaf representing a single number with a unit. Validates units via the Servo_NumericType_Create FFI at construction, serializes with property-aware range checking (wrapping out-of-range values in calc(), mapping 'percent' to %), and converts back to StyleUnitValue for the style crate.

nodes.name: CSSUnparsedValue.h
nodes.summary: Header for the CSS Typed OM CSSUnparsedValue, a CSSStyleValue subclass holding a token sequence of strings and CSSVariableReferenceValue. Declares Create() from StyleUnparsedValue, the WebIDL constructor, indexed getter/setter, and recursive serialization via ToCssTextWithProperty.

nodes.name: CSSUnparsedValue.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements CSSUnparsedValue: converts Servo StyleUnparsedValue segments into DOM tokens (creating CSSVariableReferenceValue for var() references), implements the WebIDL indexed property accessors with range checks, and serializes tokens back to css text with cycle detection over nested var() fallbacks.

nodes.name: CSSUnsupportedValue.h
nodes.summary: Header for CSSUnsupportedValue, the Typed OM representation of a reify-failure value per the css-typed-om spec. Keeps the originating CSSPropertyId plus a DeclarationBlock so the raw value can still be serialized for its own property but cannot be moved to another property.

nodes.name: CSSUnsupportedValue.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements CSSUnsupportedValue: wraps a StyleUnsupportedValue's StyleLockedDeclarationBlock into a DeclarationBlock, serializes the property value via GetPropertyValueById, and adds GetAsCSSUnsupportedValue/GetPropertyId downcast helpers on CSSStyleValue.

nodes.name: CSSVariableReferenceValue.h
nodes.summary: Header for the Typed OM CSSVariableReferenceValue, representing a var() reference with a custom property name and an optional CSSUnparsedValue fallback. Declares Create() from StyleVariableReferenceValue plus WebIDL constructor and variable/fallback accessors.

nodes.name: CSSVariableReferenceValue.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements CSSVariableReferenceValue: Create() builds the fallback CSSUnparsedValue from the Servo struct when present, and the WebIDL Constructor/SetVariable reject names that are not custom properties using nsCSSProps::LookupProperty.

nodes.name: moz.build
nodes.summary: Build definition for the CSS Typed OM module: exports all CSS*Value and StylePropertyMap headers under mozilla/dom, lists the unified sources compiled into the xul library, and assigns the bug component for CSS Parsing and Computation.

nodes.name: StylePropertyMap.h
nodes.summary: Header for StylePropertyMap, the mutable Typed OM property map over an element's inline style or a CSSStyleRule's declarations. Declares the WebIDL set/append/delete/clear operations and memory reporting on top of StylePropertyMapReadOnly.

nodes.name: StylePropertyMap.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the writable StylePropertyMap operations. Set() parses a CSSStyleValue (or parses a string via CSSStyleValue::ParseStyleValue with URLExtraData), serializes it to css text, and writes through DeclarationTraits specializations into nsDOMCSSDeclaration for inline style or style rules; also implements Declarations::Set/Clear/Delete for the Inline and Rule kinds.

nodes.name: StylePropertyMapReadOnly.h
nodes.summary: Header for the read-only Typed OM StylePropertyMapReadOnly base class, exposing get/getAll/has/size and list iteration. Its nested Declarations class is a tagged union over inline style, computed style, and style-rule declaration sources.

nodes.name: StylePropertyMapReadOnly.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements StylePropertyMapReadOnly: DeclarationTraits specializations per declaration source dispatch to Servo FFI (Servo_DeclarationBlock_GetPropertyTypedValueList/HasProperty/Count/GetAt) and to nsComputedDOMStyle for computed style, then reify results through CSSStyleValue::Create. Also resolves URLExtraData per source (document default, style attribute, or stylesheet).

nodes.name: TypedOMUtils.h
nodes.summary: Shared helpers for the Typed OM: defines CSSNUMERIC_BASE_TYPE_COUNT and the CSSNUMERIC_TYPE_FIELDS member-pointer table used for generic CSSNumericType manipulation, and declares ToCSSKeywordish for extracting the keyword branch of a CSSPerspectiveValue.

nodes.name: TypedOMUtils.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements ToCSSKeywordish, converting a pre-checked CSSPerspectiveValue union into a CSSKeywordish (UTF8 string or CSSKeywordValue). Static_asserts keep the Servo StyleNumericBaseType discriminants aligned with the WebIDL CSSNumericBaseType enum.

nodes.name: URLExtraData.h
nodes.summary: Thread-safe container bundling base URI, referrer info, and principal used to resolve url() values during CSS parsing, shared with the Servo selectors/style code via Stylo. Provides dummy and per-built-in-stylesheet shared instances and a cached ChromeRulesEnabled flag computed from the referrer.

nodes.name: URLExtraData.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements URLExtraData lifecycle: Init() creates the dummy and dummy-chrome instances backed by a NullPrincipal URI, Shutdown() releases them, and ChromeRulesEnabled() allows chrome, resource, and non-content-accessible about schemes.

nodes.name: attr.rs
nodes.summary: Attribute selector support for the selectors crate: AttrSelectorWithOptionalNamespace and namespace constraints, parsed attribute operations, and the six AttrSelectorOperator matchers (=, ~=, |=, ^=, *=, $=) with CaseSensitivity evaluation used by matching.rs when testing element attributes.

nodes.name: bloom.rs
nodes.summary: Counting and non-counting Bloom filters tuned as ancestor filters for selector matching. CountingBloomFilter is parameterized over a BloomStorage strategy (8-bit counters in BloomStorageU8 for the production BloomFilter alias, 1-bit BloomStorageBool), probing two 12-bit slots of a 24-bit hash.

nodes.name: builder.rs
nodes.summary: SelectorBuilder assembles Component streams from the parser into an Arc-ed SelectorData in matching order: compound selectors right-to-left, simple selectors left-to-right, reversing each compound on combinator push. Also computes the packed 10-bit-per-kind Specificity, SelectorFlags (pseudo/slotted/part/parent/host/scope), and the max-specificity rules for :is/:not/:where/:nth-of-type/:has arguments.

nodes.name: CSSUnparsedValue
nodes.summary: Final CSSStyleValue subclass for values that could not be parsed into typed values, holding a Sequence of OwningCSSUnparsedSegment tokens (UTF8 strings or CSSVariableReferenceValue). Supports WebIDL construction, indexed access, and serialization back to css text including nested var() fallbacks.

nodes.name: CSSUnparsedValue::Create
nodes.summary: Factory that converts a Servo StyleUnparsedValue (CopyableTArray of StyleUnparsedSegment) into DOM tokens, wrapping var() segments via CSSVariableReferenceValue::Create and plain strings as UTF8String segments.

nodes.name: CSSUnparsedValue::Constructor
nodes.summary: WebIDL constructor creating a CSSUnparsedValue from a sequence of string or CSSVariableReferenceValue members, per the css-typed-om-1 spec.

nodes.name: CSSUnparsedValue::ToCssTextWithPropertyInternal
nodes.summary: Recursive serializer appending each token to css text, expanding var() references with their fallback and guarding against infinite recursion with a hash set of visited CSSUnparsedValue pointers. Returns false on cycles, in which case the caller serializes nothing (w3c/css-houdini-drafts#1158).

nodes.name: CSSUnsupportedValue
nodes.summary: Typed OM CSSStyleValue for a reify-failure value: pairs the property it came from (CSSPropertyId) with the raw DeclarationBlock so the value serializes only for that property. Implements the spec's rule that unsupported values cannot be transferred to other properties.

nodes.name: CSSUnsupportedValue::Create
nodes.summary: Consumes a StyleUnsupportedValue's StyleLockedDeclarationBlock into a RefPtr<DeclarationBlock> and constructs the CSSUnsupportedValue bound to the given property id.

nodes.name: CSSUnsupportedValue::ToCssTextWithProperty
nodes.summary: Asserts the requested property matches the stored one and appends the raw property value obtained from the declaration block via GetPropertyValueById.

nodes.name: CSSVariableReferenceValue
nodes.summary: Cycle-collected nsWrapperCache object representing a var() reference in the Typed OM: a custom property name plus an optional CSSUnparsedValue fallback. Used as a token type inside CSSUnparsedValue.

nodes.name: CSSVariableReferenceValue::Create
nodes.summary: Factory from a Servo StyleVariableReferenceValue that builds the CSSUnparsedValue fallback only when the has_fallback flag is set.

nodes.name: CSSVariableReferenceValue::Constructor
nodes.summary: WebIDL constructor that throws a TypeError unless the variable name resolves to eCSSPropertyExtra_variable via nsCSSProps::LookupProperty, enforcing that only custom property names are accepted.

nodes.name: StylePropertyMap
nodes.summary: Mutable StylePropertyMapReadOnly subclass constructed either from an nsStyledElement (inline style) or a CSSStyleRule, adding the WebIDL set/append/delete/clear mutation operations.

nodes.name: StylePropertyMap::Set
nodes.summary: Replaces the value of a property: parses the property id, accepts exactly one CSSStyleValue or a string parsed through CSSStyleValue::ParseStyleValue with the declarations' URLExtraData, rejects values bound to a different property, serializes to css text, and writes via Declarations::Set.

nodes.name: StylePropertyMap::Delete
nodes.summary: Removes a property after validating it via CSSPropertyId::Parse, delegating to Declarations::Delete which dispatches on inline style or style rule.

nodes.name: StylePropertyMapReadOnly::Declarations::Set
nodes.summary: Kind-dispatching write path: inline styles go through DeclarationTraits<MutableInlineStyleDeclarations> and the element's nsDOMCSSDeclaration::SetPropertyTypedValue, rules through the rule's Style() declaration, while computed maps throw NS_ERROR_UNEXPECTED.

nodes.name: StylePropertyMapReadOnly::Declarations::Delete
nodes.summary: Kind-dispatching removal of a property via the DeclarationTraits Delete specializations, rejecting the computed kind.

nodes.name: StylePropertyMapReadOnly
nodes.summary: Read-only Typed OM property map base over inline style, computed style, or a CSSStyleRule. Exposes WebIDL get/getAll/has/size plus iterable key/value index accessors, holding the parent object and the nested Declarations union.

nodes.name: StylePropertyMapReadOnly::Declarations
nodes.summary: Tagged union (Kind::Inline/Computed/Rule) over a raw pointer to nsStyledElement, Element, or CSSStyleRule. Provides GetAll/Has/Size/GetKeyAt plus mutation entry points and Unlink for cycle collection, dispatching to the right declaration source.

nodes.name: StylePropertyMapReadOnly::Get
nodes.summary: WebIDL get(): parses the property name and returns the first reified CSSStyleValue from GetAll, or undefined when the list is empty.

nodes.name: StylePropertyMapReadOnly::GetAll
nodes.summary: WebIDL getAll(): fetches the StylePropertyTypedValueList from Declarations::GetAll and reifies each entry into CSSStyleValue objects through CSSStyleValue::Create.

nodes.name: StylePropertyMapReadOnly::Declarations::GetAll
nodes.summary: Dispatches on the declaration kind: inline and rule sources call DeclarationBlockGetAll on their StyleLockedDeclarationBlock, computed style goes through nsComputedDOMStyle::GetComputedStyle and ComputedStyle::GetPropertyTypedValueList.

nodes.name: DeclarationBlockGetAll
nodes.summary: Static helper wrapping Servo_DeclarationBlock_GetPropertyTypedValueList for a locked declaration block, returning an empty list for a null block and throwing a TypeError when the property id is invalid.

nodes.name: ToCSSKeywordish
nodes.summary: Extracts the CSSKeywordish branch from a flattened CSSPerspectiveValue union, copying the UTF8 string or referencing the CSSKeywordValue; diagnostic-asserts the caller pre-checked the union variants.

nodes.name: URLExtraData
nodes.summary: Thread-safe refcounted trio of base URI, referrer info, and principal for resolving url() values in style sheets and style attributes, handed to the Servo parser through Stylo. Computes a cached ChromeRulesEnabled flag and offers Dummy/DummyChrome plus shared per-built-in-sheet instances.

nodes.name: URLExtraData::Init
nodes.summary: Creates the process-wide dummy instances from a NullPrincipal URI and empty ReferrerInfo, with sDummyChrome forcing mChromeRulesEnabled to true; called during startup before any style parsing.

nodes.name: URLExtraData::ChromeRulesEnabled
nodes.summary: Static predicate deciding whether chrome-authoritative URLs may load from this context: true for chrome and resource schemes and for about URIs that are not content-accessible.

nodes.name: AttrSelectorWithOptionalNamespace
nodes.summary: Parsed attribute selector component carrying an optional NamespaceConstraint, the local name plus its lowercased form, and the ParsedAttrSelectorOperation to apply. The namespace() accessor erases the prefix, returning only the URL for matching.

nodes.name: NamespaceConstraint
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing Any ('*|') and Specific namespace matching for attribute selectors, where an empty URL means no namespace.

nodes.name: ParsedAttrSelectorOperation
nodes.summary: Parse-time representation of an attribute test: Exists, or WithValue pairing an AttrSelectorOperator with the resolved ParsedCaseSensitivity and the attribute value.

nodes.name: AttrSelectorOperation
nodes.summary: Match-time counterpart of ParsedAttrSelectorOperation with a resolved CaseSensitivity; its eval_str applies the operator against an element's attribute value.

nodes.name: AttrSelectorOperator
nodes.summary: The six CSS attribute operators (=, ~=, |=, ^=, *=, $=) with CSSOM serialization via ToCss and byte-level eval_str implementing prefix/suffix/substring/whitespace-separated-includes/dash-match semantics under a CaseSensitivity.

nodes.name: ParsedCaseSensitivity
nodes.summary: Case sensitivity as computed at parse time: explicit 's'/'i' flags, or the document-language default including the HTML element-in-HTML-document case-insensitivity special case.

nodes.name: CaseSensitivity
nodes.summary: Resolved binary case sensitivity used during matching, providing eq for byte-slice comparison (ASCII case folding) and a case-insensitive substring search used by the *= operator.

nodes.name: AttrSelectorOperation::eval_str
nodes.summary: Entry point for evaluating an attribute operation against an element attribute value: true for Exists, otherwise delegates to the AttrSelectorOperator's eval_str.

nodes.name: AttrSelectorOperator::eval_str
nodes.summary: Implements each operator over byte slices: Equal, Prefix, Suffix, Substring, Includes (whitespace-separated word match using SELECTOR_WHITESPACE), and DashMatch (value or value followed by '-'), all honoring the CaseSensitivity.

nodes.name: CaseSensitivity::eq
nodes.summary: Byte-slice equality that is exact for CaseSensitive and ASCII-case-insensitive otherwise, the comparison primitive for all attribute operators.

nodes.name: CaseSensitivity::contains
nodes.summary: Substring search supporting ASCII case-insensitive matching via a first-byte scan followed by eq_ignore_ascii_case on the remainder, backing the *= substring operator.

nodes.name: CountingBloomFilter
nodes.summary: Generic two-hash-function counting Bloom filter used as the ancestor filter during selector matching, parameterized over BloomStorage for counter width. Supports insert/remove of 32-bit hashes, might_contain_hash fast rejection, clear, and a debug-only is_zeroed check.

nodes.name: BloomStorage
nodes.summary: Storage trait abstracting slot read/adjust and zeroed checks, with default slot-index helpers that split a hash into two 12-bit indices (hash1/hash2) over the 2^12 entry array.

nodes.name: BloomStorageU8
nodes.summary: 8-bit saturating-counter storage backing the production BloomFilter alias; increments and decrements per slot with a 0xff saturation guard so removals never corrupt the filter.

nodes.name: BloomStorageBool
nodes.summary: 1-bit-per-slot non-counting storage (one byte per eight slots) for use cases that never remove; asserts against decrementing a bit that was never set.

nodes.name: CountingBloomFilter::insert_hash
nodes.summary: Increments both storage slots selected by the hash's two 12-bit halves; called when pushing ancestor names onto the filter during tree traversal.

nodes.name: CountingBloomFilter::remove_hash
nodes.summary: Decrements both slots for a hash when popping an ancestor, keeping the counting filter exact for balanced insert/remove traversal.

nodes.name: CountingBloomFilter::might_contain_hash
nodes.summary: Fast conservative membership test returning false only when at least one slot is empty, letting selector matching skip subtrees whose ancestors cannot match descendant selectors.

nodes.name: SelectorBuilder
nodes.summary: Stack-allocated helper that accumulates Components inline in a SmallVec as the parser encounters them left-to-right, reversing each compound on combinator push so the final Arc-ed SelectorData is stored right-to-left in matching order with simple selectors ordered cheapest-first.

nodes.name: SelectorBuilder::push_simple_selector
nodes.summary: Appends a non-combinator Component to the current compound selector; also the Push implementation hook used by the parser's sink.

nodes.name: SelectorBuilder::push_combinator
nodes.summary: Reverses the just-finished compound selector in place, pushes Component::Combinator, and records the start of the next compound so compounds end up right-to-left in the final selector.

nodes.name: SelectorBuilder::build
nodes.summary: Consumes the builder: computes SpecificityAndFlags over the accumulated components and forwards to build_with_specificity_and_flags to produce the heap-allocated SelectorData.

nodes.name: SelectorBuilder::build_with_specificity_and_flags
nodes.summary: Builds the final SelectorData with servo_arc::Arc::from_header_and_iter, prepending an implicit & (ParentSelector) or :scope component for relative parsing when the flags allow, and skipping the reversal entirely for combinator-free selectors.

nodes.name: SelectorFlags
nodes.summary: Bitflags recorded on a selector: HAS_PSEUDO, HAS_SLOTTED, HAS_PART, HAS_PARENT, HAS_HOST, and HAS_SCOPE, used by the style system to pick fast paths and to enforce nesting invariants via forbidden_for_nesting.

nodes.name: SpecificityAndFlags
nodes.summary: Packed u32 specificity (three 10-bit counters for id/class-like/element) plus SelectorFlags, stored in the selector header for O(1) cascade comparison.

nodes.name: Specificity
nodes.summary: Additive/ord-deriving struct counting id, class-like, and element selectors during computation, converting to and from the packed u32 representation with 10-bit clamping.

nodes.name: specificity_and_flags
nodes.summary: Walks a Component iter assigning specificity per component kind and OR-ing in flags, implementing the spec rules that :is()/:not()/:has()/:nth-child(an+b of S) take the most-specific argument, :where() contributes only flags, and ::slotted()/::host() absorb their argument's specificity. Recurses into selector and relative-selector lists for nested lists.

nodes.name: selector_list_specificity_and_flags
nodes.summary: Returns the maximum specificity and union of flags across a selector list, recomputing specificity from raw components when a nesting parent forbids reusing cached flags (e.g. pseudo-elements inside :is()).

nodes.name: relative_selector_list_specificity_and_flags
nodes.summary: Adapter mapping a RelativeSelector list (:has arguments) to selector_list_specificity_and_flags over each relative selector's inner selector.

nodes.name: style_derive/lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root of the style_derive proc-macro crate. Registers ten derive macros (Animate, ComputeSquaredDistance, ToAnimatedValue, Parse, ToAnimatedZero, ToComputedValue, ToResolvedValue, ToCss, SpecifiedValueInfo, ToTyped) that generate trait impls for Stylo property value types, dispatching each to its implementation module.

nodes.name: style_derive Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Manifest for the style_derive proc-macro crate (derive crate for the Stylo CSS engine). Declares proc-macro=true lib target at lib.rs and dependencies on syn 2, quote, proc-macro2, darling 0.20, and synstructure 0.13.

nodes.name: style_derive/to_css.rs
nodes.summary: Implementation of derive(ToCss): generates style_traits::ToCss impls for CSS value types, including bitflag serialization (single/mixed flags, overlapping bits), css function/keyword/comma handling, skip/skip_if field conditions, SequenceWriter separators, and optional Debug impls routed through CSS serialization.

nodes.name: style_derive/animate.rs
nodes.summary: Implementation of derive(Animate): generates crate::values::animated::Animate impls that interpolate field-by-field only when both values share the same enum discriminant; supports animation error/constant, no_bound, and field_bound attributes.

nodes.name: style_derive/cg.rs
nodes.summary: Shared code-generation helpers for every style_derive derive: where-clause manipulation (add_predicate, propagate_clauses_to_output_type), synstructure binding patterns (ref_pattern, value), fmap_match/fmap2_match variant mapping, trait output type construction, generic type-parameter rewriting (map_type_params), darling attribute parsing, and CamelCase to kebab-case/scream-case conversion.

nodes.name: style_derive/compute_squared_distance.rs
nodes.summary: Implementation of derive(ComputeSquaredDistance): generates crate::values::distance::ComputeSquaredDistance impls summing per-field squared distances, reusing the animation attributes (error/constant/no_bound) and honoring distance field_bound.

nodes.name: style_derive/parse.rs
nodes.summary: Implementation of derive(Parse): generates crate::parser::Parse impls matching keyword variants via cssparser match_ignore_ascii_case (with aliases and conditions), trying data-carrying variants in order, and parsing bitflags with duplicate rejection; keyword-only enums also get inherent parse/from_ident helpers.

nodes.name: style_derive/specified_value_info.rs
nodes.summary: Implementation of derive(SpecifiedValueInfo): generates style_traits::SpecifiedValueInfo impls exposing the SUPPORTED_TYPES bitmask and collect_completion_keywords used by devtools autocompletion, gathering keywords from css, parse aliases, and value_info attributes.

nodes.name: style_derive/to_animated_value.rs
nodes.summary: Implementation of derive(ToAnimatedValue): a thin instantiation of to_computed_value::derive_to_value parameterized with the animated trait paths and move bindings, generating to_animated_value/from_animated_value field conversions.

nodes.name: style_derive/to_animated_zero.rs
nodes.summary: Implementation of derive(ToAnimatedZero): generates crate::values::animated::ToAnimatedZero impls mapping each variant to its zero-equivalent for interpolation; error variants return Err and constant fields are cloned unchanged.

nodes.name: style_derive/to_computed_value.rs
nodes.summary: Implementation of derive(ToComputedValue) plus the generic derive_to_value engine shared by the ToComputedValue/ToAnimatedValue/ToResolvedValue derives: propagates existing where clauses onto trait output types, adds trait bounds for type parameters and fields, and builds to_/from_ match bodies for both generic and non-generic types.

nodes.name: style_derive/to_resolved_value.rs
nodes.summary: Implementation of derive(ToResolvedValue): instantiates derive_to_value for crate::values::resolved::ToResolvedValue with move bindings, generating to_resolved_value/from_resolved_value conversions honoring resolve field_bound/no_field_bound.

nodes.name: style_derive/to_typed.rs
nodes.summary: Implementation of derive(ToTyped) for CSS Typed OM: all-unit enums delegate to ToCss and wrap the result in TypedValue::Keyword; mixed enums and structs build match arms reifying unit variants as keywords and delegating fielded variants via to_typed (or Err for skip/todo); bitflags reify to a single keyword with overlapping-bit tracking; ToTyped bounds are added only where recursion actually happens.

nodes.name: selectors/lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root of the selectors crate: declares the attr/bloom/builder/context/kleene_value/matching/nth_index_cache/parser/relative_selector/sink/tree/visitor modules and publicly re-exports NthIndexCache, Parser, SelectorImpl, SelectorList, Element, and OpaqueElement; also defines the FxHashMap alias.

nodes.name: selectors/context.rs
nodes.summary: Matching context and modes for selector matching: MatchingContext carries matching mode, bloom filter, scope/shadow-host elements, nesting level, negation, visited-handling mode, featureless flag, invalidation/revalidation flags, and SelectorCaches; also defines MatchingMode, VisitedHandlingMode, QuirksMode, NeedsSelectorFlags, and MatchingForInvalidation.

nodes.name: selectors/kleene_value.rs
nodes.summary: KleeneValue, a three-valued (False/True/Unknown) logic type based on Kleene logic, with Not/BitAnd/BitOr operators and any/any_false iterator helpers; used by selector matching to propagate unknown results during invalidation comparisons.

nodes.name: selectors/matching.rs
nodes.summary: Core selector matching engine: matches selector lists and complex selectors right-to-left against elements with bloom-filter fast rejection, backtracking across combinators, nth-index caching, has() relative-selector traversal with caches/filters, shadow-DOM (host/part/slotted) handling, quirks-mode and visited handling, Kleene unknown propagation, and ElementSelectorFlags for invalidation.

nodes.name: selectors/nth_index_cache.rs
nodes.summary: Caches speeding up nth-child-like selectors: NthIndexCache selects between nth/nth-last/nth-of-type/nth-last-of-type maps and NthIndexOfSelectorsCaches keyed by the selector list's stable ThinArc pointer; NthIndexCacheInner maps OpaqueElement to sibling index.

nodes.name: selectors/parser.rs
nodes.summary: Selector parser and data model: SelectorImpl/Parser/PseudoElement/NonTSPseudoClass traits, Selector/SelectorList/Component/Combinator types with specificity and flags in a ThinArc header, nth (An+B, of-selector-list) data, relative selectors for has(), AncestorHashes for bloom filtering, ToCss serialization of selectors, the recursive-descent selector grammar, and a forgiving-parsing invalid-selector representation.

nodes.name: selectors/relative_selector/mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for relative selector (has()) support; re-exports the cache and filter submodules.

nodes.name: selectors/relative_selector/cache.rs
nodes.summary: RelativeSelectorCache: an FxHashMap keyed by (OpaqueElement anchor, SelectorKey) storing Matched/NotMatched results of has() evaluations, reused across repeated matches on the same anchor (e.g. non-subject has() and querySelectorAll patterns).

nodes.name: selectors/relative_selector/filter.rs
nodes.summary: RelativeSelectorFilterMap: a lazily-built map of Bloom filters over an element's children or descendant subtree used to fast-reject has() matches; sibling-direction hints reuse the parent's filter, and construction is deferred until the second lookup.

nodes.name: selectors/sink.rs
nodes.summary: The Push trait abstracting a push() method over Vec, SmallVec, and presence-only sinks, used by the selector builder to stay container-agnostic.

nodes.name: selectors/tree.rs
nodes.summary: The Element trait and OpaqueElement identity type that decouple the selectors crate from any specific DOM: traversal, local-name/namespace/class/id/attribute checks, pseudo-class and pseudo-element matching, selector-flag application, slot/part/shadow-host hooks, nth-child suppression, and element-unique hash contribution for bloom filters.

nodes.name: selectors/visitor.rs
nodes.summary: The SelectorVisitor trait for traversing selector components (attributes, simple selectors, nested and relative selector lists, complex selectors with their combinator) and SelectorListKind bitflags tracking not/is/where/nth-of/has nesting context, used by invalidation and analysis code.

nodes.name: derive_animate
nodes.summary: Proc-macro entry for derive(Animate) (attributes animate, animation); parses the token stream and delegates to animate::derive.

nodes.name: derive_compute_squared_distance
nodes.summary: Proc-macro entry for derive(ComputeSquaredDistance) (attributes animation, distance); delegates to compute_squared_distance::derive.

nodes.name: derive_to_animated_value
nodes.summary: Proc-macro entry for derive(ToAnimatedValue); delegates to to_animated_value::derive.

nodes.name: derive_parse
nodes.summary: Proc-macro entry for derive(Parse) (attributes css, parse); delegates to parse::derive.

nodes.name: derive_to_animated_zero
nodes.summary: Proc-macro entry for derive(ToAnimatedZero) (attributes animation, zero); delegates to to_animated_zero::derive.

nodes.name: derive_to_computed_value
nodes.summary: Proc-macro entry for derive(ToComputedValue) (attribute compute); delegates to to_computed_value::derive.

nodes.name: derive_to_resolved_value
nodes.summary: Proc-macro entry for derive(ToResolvedValue) (attribute resolve); delegates to to_resolved_value::derive.

nodes.name: derive_to_css
nodes.summary: Proc-macro entry for derive(ToCss) (attribute css); delegates to to_css::derive.

nodes.name: derive_specified_value_info
nodes.summary: Proc-macro entry for derive(SpecifiedValueInfo) (attributes css, parse, value_info); delegates to specified_value_info::derive.

nodes.name: derive_to_typed
nodes.summary: Proc-macro entry for derive(ToTyped) (attributes css, typed); delegates to to_typed::derive.

nodes.name: derive (to_css)
nodes.summary: Builds the style_traits::ToCss impl: adds ToCss bounds for type parameters, dispatches bitflag structs to derive_bitflags, otherwise generates a match over variants via synstructure, and optionally appends a Debug impl delegating to CSS serialization.

nodes.name: derive_bitflags (to_css)
nodes.summary: Emits ToCss for bitflags structs: early-return for standalone single flags, space-separated mixed flags, and correct serialization when bits overlap (e.g. contain: size).

nodes.name: derive_variant_arm (to_css)
nodes.summary: Generates one to_css match arm per variant: keyword output for unit variants, css keyword overrides, css function wrapping with parentheses, comma or space separators, and skip handling.

nodes.name: derive_variant_fields_expr (to_css)
nodes.summary: Builds the serialization expression for a variant's fields: filters skipped fields, applies field_bound where predicates, handles the single-field shortcut with skip_if/contextual_skip_if, and wraps multi-field output in a SequenceWriter with the variant's separator.

nodes.name: derive_single_field_expr (to_css)
nodes.summary: Generates serialization for one field: iterable loops with if_empty placeholder, represents_keyword booleans emitting their kebab-case name, writer.item calls, and skip_if/contextual_skip_if guards.

nodes.name: CssBitflagAttrs
nodes.summary: Darling attributes for css bitflags: single and mixed comma-separated flag lists (mapped to SCREAM_CASE Rust idents), optional validate_mixed function, and the overlapping_bits marker.

nodes.name: CssInputAttrs
nodes.summary: Type-level css attributes for the ToCss derive: derive_debug, function, comma, and bitflags; function/comma are also accepted for structs since struct definitions double as variants.

nodes.name: CssVariantAttrs
nodes.summary: Variant-level css attributes: function override, keyword, comma separator selection, skip, derive_debug, and nested bitflags metadata.

nodes.name: CssFieldAttrs
nodes.summary: Field-level css attributes: skip, skip_if, contextual_skip_if, iterable, if_empty, represents_keyword, and field_bound.

nodes.name: derive (animate)
nodes.summary: Generates the crate::values::animated::Animate impl: requires equal discriminants, adds Animate bounds to each type parameter unless excluded by no_bound, folds variant arms, and appends a debug_unreachable catchall when multiple variants exist.

nodes.name: derive_variant_arm (animate)
nodes.summary: Builds one (this, other) match arm: animation error variants return Err, constant fields must be equal and are cloned, other fields are interpolated via Animate::animate with optional field_bound predicates.

nodes.name: AnimationInputAttrs
nodes.summary: Type-level animation attributes: the no_bound list of type parameters that should not receive trait bounds.

nodes.name: AnimationVariantAttrs
nodes.summary: Variant-level animation attributes: error (animation between this variant and others fails) and no_bound.

nodes.name: AnimationFieldAttrs
nodes.summary: Field-level animation attributes: constant (fields must be equal and are reused verbatim) and field_bound.

nodes.name: propagate_clauses_to_output_type
nodes.summary: Rewrites existing where predicates on the input's type parameters so they also hold for the trait's output type, e.g. T: Zero becomes (<T as ToComputedValue>::ComputedValue): Zero; must run before adding other bounds.

nodes.name: add_predicate
nodes.summary: Appends a where-clause predicate to the optionally-present where clause, creating an empty clause when needed.

nodes.name: fmap_match
nodes.summary: Maps every field binding of every variant through the callback and assembles the computations into a match body with move-into-mapped bindings; single-callback form of fmap2_match.

nodes.name: fmap2_match
nodes.summary: Like fmap_match but also runs a per-mapped-binding post-processing callback that can emit additional statements after the mapping.

nodes.name: fmap_trait_output
nodes.summary: Constructs the Self type path with each generic argument replaced by (<T as Trait>::Output) (lifetimes and consts passed through), representing the mapped output type of the input.

nodes.name: map_type_params
nodes.summary: Recursively rewrites a syn Type, replacing occurrences of the given type parameters (and Self) with the callback's result while rebuilding slices, arrays, tuples, paths, paren/group types, and associated type bindings.

nodes.name: parse_input_attrs
nodes.summary: Parses type-level darling attributes into A: FromDeriveInput, panicking with a contextual message on failure.

nodes.name: parse_field_attrs
nodes.summary: Parses field-level darling attributes into A: FromField, panicking with a contextual message on failure.

nodes.name: parse_variant_attrs_from_ast
nodes.summary: Reconstructs a syn Variant from a synstructure VariantAst and parses its darling attributes into A: FromVariant.

nodes.name: ref_pattern
nodes.summary: Builds a variant pattern binding all fields by reference, renaming bindings with the given prefix (e.g. this_foo) and returning the pattern plus bindings.

nodes.name: value
nodes.summary: Builds a variant pattern binding all fields by move with prefixed identifiers, returning the pattern plus bindings for constructing result values.

nodes.name: to_css_identifier
nodes.summary: Converts a CamelCase Rust identifier to a kebab-case CSS identifier (FooBar to foo-bar), trimming trailing underscores and prefixing a dash for Moz/Webkit/Servo vendor-prefixed segments.

nodes.name: to_scream_case
nodes.summary: Converts a kebab-case CSS name to SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE, used to derive bitflag Rust identifiers from CSS flag names.

nodes.name: derive (compute_squared_distance)
nodes.summary: Generates the crate::values::distance::ComputeSquaredDistance impl: discriminant equality check, ComputeSquaredDistance bounds per type parameter (minus no_bound), variant-arm fold, and debug_unreachable catchall.

nodes.name: derive_variant_arm (compute_squared_distance)
nodes.summary: Builds the per-variant arm summing compute_squared_distance over field pairs; error variants and constant (animation) fields that mismatch return Err, empty variants contribute a zero distance.

nodes.name: DistanceFieldAttrs
nodes.summary: Field-level distance attributes: field_bound to add an explicit ComputeSquaredDistance bound for the field type.

nodes.name: derive (parse)
nodes.summary: Generates the crate::parser::Parse impl: unit variants become match_ignore_ascii_case keyword arms with aliases and conditions, data-carrying variants are tried in order via try_parse (the last variant without keywords uses ?), bitflags variants use parse_bitflags; pure keyword enums additionally get inherent parse/from_ident methods.

nodes.name: parse_bitflags
nodes.summary: Emits the loop that parses space-separated bitflags: single flags return immediately, mixed flags accumulate with duplicate rejection, an optional validate_mixed function guards the result, and trailing garbage leaves input unconsumed for shorthand parsing.

nodes.name: parse_non_keyword_variant
nodes.summary: Emits parsing for one data-carrying variant: supports parse_fn overrides, condition gating, field_bound predicates against crate::parser::Parse, bitflags delegation, and try_parse versus direct (last-variant) forms.

nodes.name: ParseVariantAttrs
nodes.summary: Variant-level parse attributes: aliases (extra accepted keywords), condition (context predicate), and parse_fn (custom parse function path).

nodes.name: ParseFieldAttrs
nodes.summary: Field-level parse attributes: field_bound adds a crate::parser::Parse bound for the field type.

nodes.name: derive (specified_value_info)
