nodes.summary: Generates the style_traits::SpecifiedValueInfo impl: computes SUPPORTED_TYPES by OR-ing field type bits plus an optional value_info ty, and collect_completion_keywords from variant keywords, aliases, other_values, and function-named wrappers.

nodes.name: derive_struct_fields
nodes.summary: Collects supported types and completion values from a variant's or struct's fields, honoring other_values, represents_keyword, if_empty, and skip attributes; returns whether the fields were non-unit.

nodes.name: ValueInfoInputAttrs
nodes.summary: Type-level value_info attributes: ty (extra CssType contributed to SUPPORTED_TYPES) and other_values (extra completion keywords).

nodes.name: ValueInfoVariantAttrs
nodes.summary: Variant-level value_info attributes: starts_with_keyword, skip, and other_values.

nodes.name: ValueInfoFieldAttrs
nodes.summary: Field-level value_info attributes: skip and other_values.

nodes.name: derive (to_animated_value)
nodes.summary: Instantiates derive_to_value for crate::values::animated::ToAnimatedValue with the AnimatedValue output type, move bindings, and per-field bounds derived from animation attributes, emitting to_animated_value/from_animated_value bodies.

nodes.name: derive (to_animated_zero)
nodes.summary: Generates the crate::values::animated::ToAnimatedZero impl mapping each variant to its zero value: error variants yield Err, constant fields are cloned, others convert via ToAnimatedZero::to_animated_zero, with no_bound-aware bounds.

nodes.name: derive_to_value
nodes.summary: Generic engine behind the ToComputedValue/ToAnimatedValue/ToResolvedValue derives: propagates where clauses to the trait's output type, adds trait bounds for type parameters and fields (mapping field types through the output type), and builds to_/from_ match bodies differently for non-generic (clone/move) and generic (fmap_match) types.

nodes.name: derive (to_computed_value)
nodes.summary: Instantiates derive_to_value for crate::values::computed::ToComputedValue with the ComputedValue output type, ref bindings, and compute field_bound/no_field_bound handling, emitting to_computed_value/from_computed_value bodies.

nodes.name: ToValueAttrs
nodes.summary: Normalized per-field settings handed to derive_to_value: field_bound (add explicit bound) and no_field_bound (rely on the derived impl's correctness for clone/move).

nodes.name: ComputedValueAttrs
nodes.summary: Field-level compute attributes: field_bound and no_field_bound.

nodes.name: derive (to_resolved_value)
nodes.summary: Instantiates derive_to_value for crate::values::resolved::ToResolvedValue with the ResolvedValue output type and move bindings, honoring resolve field_bound/no_field_bound field attributes.

nodes.name: ResolvedValueAttrs
nodes.summary: Field-level resolve attributes: field_bound and no_field_bound.

nodes.name: derive (to_typed)
nodes.summary: Generates the crate::typed_om::ToTyped impl: bitflags go to derive_bitflags; all-unit enums optimize by serializing via ToCss into a TypedValue::Keyword; mixed enums and structs build match arms, adding T: ToTyped bounds only where field recursion actually happens; skip_derive_fields/todo_derive_fields turn unsupported variants into Err.

nodes.name: derive_bitflags (to_typed)
nodes.summary: Reifies bitflags into at most one TypedValue::Keyword: standalone single flags return directly, mixed flags reject multi-keyword results with Err, and overlapping_bits tracking lets subsuming keywords like contain: size reify correctly.

nodes.name: derive_variant_arm (to_typed)
nodes.summary: Builds one to_typed match arm: css/typed skip and todo variants return Err; unit variants push TypedValue::Keyword using the css keyword or the kebab-case identifier; fielded variants delegate to derive_variant_fields_expr unless field recursion is disabled.

nodes.name: derive_variant_fields_expr (to_typed)
nodes.summary: Reifies the variant's usable fields into dest: single non-iterable fields get a direct to_typed call; multiple fields append their output and, unless comma plus no_multiple_values allow it, truncate and return Err when more than one value was produced.

nodes.name: derive_single_field_expr (to_typed)
nodes.summary: Per-field reification: iterable fields add ToTyped bounds on their element types (via field_generic_arguments) with if_empty keyword emission, represents_keyword booleans push their keyword when true, plain fields get T: ToTyped bounds; typed skip_if/contextual_skip_if annotations override the css ones.

nodes.name: field_generic_arguments
nodes.summary: Extracts generic type arguments from an iterable field's container type (Vec<T>/OwnedSlice<T>, and SmallVec<[T; N]> via array unwrapping) so ToTyped bounds land on item types instead of the container.

nodes.name: TypedInputAttrs
nodes.summary: Type-level typed attributes: skip_derive_fields and todo_derive_fields disable field recursion (todo marks it for revisiting), and no_multiple_values forbids reifying to multiple TypedValues.

nodes.name: TypedVariantAttrs
nodes.summary: Variant-level typed attributes: skip_derive_fields, todo_derive_fields, and no_multiple_values (duplicated from the type level because structs act as variants), plus skip and todo.

nodes.name: TypedFieldAttrs
nodes.summary: Field-level typed attributes: skip_if (per-field predicate) and contextual_skip_if (predicate over all sibling fields); these override the equivalent css annotations.

nodes.name: FxHashMap
nodes.summary: Type alias for hashbrown::HashMap using the rustc_hash Fx build hasher; the map type used by the nth-index and relative-selector caches.

nodes.name: MatchingMode
nodes.summary: Selector matching mode: Normal matches everything; ForStatelessPseudoElement ignores stateless pseudo-element selectors in the rightmost compound (used when matching selectors like ::before:hover).

nodes.name: VisitedHandlingMode
nodes.summary: Controls :visited/:link matching: all links unvisited, all links both visited and unvisited (conservative invalidation), or relevant-link visited with other links unvisited; provides matches_visited/matches_unvisited helpers.

nodes.name: QuirksMode
nodes.summary: Document quirks mode (Quirks, LimitedQuirks, NoQuirks) per the WHATWG quirks spec; determines class/id case sensitivity via classes_and_ids_case_sensitivity.

nodes.name: SelectorCaches
nodes.summary: Bundle of caches that speed up expensive selector matches: the NthIndexCache, the RelativeSelectorCache, and the RelativeSelectorFilterMap, threaded through MatchingContext.

nodes.name: MatchingContext
nodes.summary: Per-match state shared across selectors for an element: matching mode, bloom filter, scope/shadow-host/current-host elements, featureless flag, nesting level, negation marker, pseudo-element matching hook, extra impl data, relative-selector anchor, quirks mode, selector-flag and invalidation/revalidation needs, plus scoped helpers (nest, nest_for_negation, nest_for_relative_selector, nest_for_scope, with_visited_handling_mode, with_featureless, for_invalidation_comparison).

nodes.name: KleeneValue
nodes.summary: Trilean value (False/True/Unknown) with Kleene logic: Not/BitAnd/BitOr operators, to_bool with an unknown fallback, and any/any_false iterator folds that short-circuit on a definite result and return a specified value when empty.

nodes.name: ElementSelectorFlags
nodes.summary: Bitflags recorded on elements or their parents during matching to drive restyle invalidation: slow selectors for nth/nth-of/edge-child/empty, relative-selector anchoring and search-direction markers, and MAY_HAVE_TREE_COUNTING_FUNCTION for sibling-index()/sibling-count(); for_self/for_parent split applicability.

nodes.name: SelectorMatchingResult
nodes.summary: Internal result of compound/complex matching: Matched, restart-from-closest-later-sibling, restart-from-closest-descendant, NotMatchedGlobally, and Unknown; convertible to KleeneValue for invalidation comparisons.

nodes.name: matches_selector_list
nodes.summary: Returns whether any selector in the list matches the element, with a manually inlined any() to keep querySelector fast paths inlinable.

nodes.name: selector_may_match
nodes.summary: Bloom-filter fast rejection: checks the selector's packed ancestor hashes against the filter, synthesizing the fourth hash from the high bytes of the first three; extremely hot path.

nodes.name: matches_selector
nodes.summary: Matches one selector from a right-hand offset with optional AncestorHashes for bloom rejection; wraps matches_selector_kleene and coerces Unknown to true outside invalidation comparisons.

nodes.name: matches_selector_kleene
nodes.summary: Same as matches_selector but returns the KleeneValue as-is, preserving Unknown for before/after invalidation comparisons.

nodes.name: matches_compound_selector_from
nodes.summary: Matches one compound selector starting at a parse-order offset (used by invalidation code), locating the compound bounds and matching its simple selectors left-to-right; returns the next combinator offset or NotMatched/FullyMatched.

nodes.name: matches_complex_selector
nodes.summary: Entry point for complex-selector matching: consumes the rightmost pseudo-element in ForStatelessPseudoElement mode, then delegates to matches_complex_selector_internal and converts the result to KleeneValue.

nodes.name: matches_complex_selector_internal
nodes.summary: The matching backtracking loop: matches the current compound, then walks candidates for the combinator (parent/previous sibling/shadow host/slot/part origin), handling sibling selector flags, visited-handling resets at links, featureless elements, per-combinator restart semantics, and Unknown propagation.

nodes.name: matches_relative_selector
nodes.summary: Evaluates one has() relative selector by traversing descendants (or siblings/subtrees per the match hint), applying RELATIVE_SELECTOR_SEARCH_DIRECTION selector flags to visited elements for later invalidation.

nodes.name: match_relative_selectors
nodes.summary: Orchestrates has() matching for an element: rejects nested relative selectors, short-circuits during invalidation (returning Unknown as needed), nests the context with the element as anchor, and consults the relative-selector cache and bloom-filter map before full traversal, caching results afterwards.

nodes.name: SubjectOrPseudoElement
nodes.summary: Whether the compound currently being matched is the subject (or its pseudo-element) versus an ancestor compound; affects quirks-mode hover/active handling and selector-flag placement.

nodes.name: matches_compound_selector
nodes.summary: Matches one compound selector: early-rejects featureless elements whose compound can never match a host, captures quirks-mode data, and folds simple selectors with KleeneValue::any_false.

nodes.name: matches_simple_selector
nodes.summary: Dispatch on a single Component: id/class/local-name/attribute checks, namespaces, root/empty/scope/parent-selector/host/part/slotted, nth and nth-of with caching, is/where/not nested lists, has() relative selectors, pseudo-classes with the quirks-mode hover/active quirk, and invalid components.

nodes.name: matches_generic_nth_child
nodes.summary: Implements the nth-child/nth-of-type/only-*/first-*/last-* family: applies HAS_SLOW_SELECTOR flags, filters by the of-selector-list, shortcuts simple edge children, returns Unknown during invalidation comparisons, and otherwise consults/updates the nth-index cache before testing An+B.

nodes.name: nth_child_index
nodes.summary: Computes an element's sibling index honoring of-type and of-selector-list filters, walking in the requested direction and opportunistically reusing cached indices of already-computed siblings (walking left first when counting from the end).

nodes.name: compound_matches_featureless_host
nodes.summary: Analyzes whether a compound can match a featureless shadow host: only host, scope, pseudo-elements, and logical pseudo-classes qualify; returns Only/Yes/Never so callers can fast-reject or downgrade.

nodes.name: NthIndexCache
nodes.summary: Cache bundle for nth-index-like selectors with separate inner maps for nth/nth-last, nth-of-type/nth-last-of-type, and per-selector-list maps for nth-child(.. of S); get() picks the right cache from is_of_type/is_from_end and the selector list.

nodes.name: NthIndexCacheInner
nodes.summary: Concrete per-pseudo-class cache: an FxHashMap from OpaqueElement to the computed sibling index, with lookup/insert/is_empty helpers.

nodes.name: PseudoElement (trait)
nodes.summary: Trait implemented per engine for pseudo-elements: state pseudo-class acceptance, validity after ::slotted and ::before/::after, element-backed parsing, before/after classification, specificity contribution, and pseudo-element-tree membership.

nodes.name: NonTSPseudoClass (trait)
nodes.summary: Trait for non-tree-structural pseudo-classes: is_active_or_hover (used by the quirks-mode hover/active quirk), is_user_action_state, and an optional visitor hook.

nodes.name: SelectorImpl (trait)
nodes.summary: The associated-type trait parameterizing the whole selectors crate for an embedding: identifier/local-name/attr-value/namespace types (with PrecomputedHash bounds), borrowed variants, ExtraMatchingData, NonTSPseudoClass, and PseudoElement types, plus should_collect_attr_hash for bloom filtering.

nodes.name: Parser (trait)
nodes.summary: Embedder hook trait controlling selector parsing: feature toggles (::slotted, ::part, nth-child of, :is/:where, :has, parent selector, :host, forgiving selectors), pseudo-class/pseudo-element parse callbacks (including CSS2.1 single-colon pseudos), and namespace resolution.

nodes.name: SelectorList
nodes.summary: A tagged pointer holding either one inline Selector or a ThinArc of many: parse entry points (strict, parse_disallow_pseudo, parse_forgiving with invalid-selector recovery), slice/len accessors, scope lists, parent-selector replacement, and memory-reporting hooks.

nodes.name: Selector
nodes.summary: A stored selector: ThinArc of Components with a SpecificityAndFlags header; provides match-order and parse-order iteration (SelectorIter), combinators at either end, pseudo-element/part accessors, universality and featureless-host checks, parent-selector replacement for nesting, invalid-selector construction, and CSSOM-rule serialization that undoes internal compound inversion.

nodes.name: SelectorIter
nodes.summary: Iterator over one compound's simple selectors in matching order; stops at combinators, exposing next_sequence() to fetch the pending combinator, plus skip_until_ancestor and matches_for_stateless_pseudo_element helpers.

nodes.name: Component
nodes.summary: Enum packing simple selectors and combinators for cache performance: local name, id, class, attribute variants, namespaces, root/empty/scope/parent-selector/nth/nth-of, non-TS pseudo-classes, slotted/part/host/is/where/not/has, Invalid, PseudoElement, Combinator, and RelativeSelectorAnchor; also carries visit(), as_combinator(), and stateless-pseudo matching logic.

nodes.name: Combinator
nodes.summary: Child/Descendant/NextSibling/LaterSibling plus the internal PseudoElement, SlotAssignment, and Part combinators, with is_pseudo_element/is_sibling/is_ancestor predicates and CSS serialization (to_css_relative for leading relative combinators).

nodes.name: AncestorHashes
nodes.summary: Precomputed ancestor hashes for bloom-filter fast rejection: three packed u32s with the fourth hash split into their high bytes, assembled by collect_ancestor_hashes and decoded by fourth_hash().

nodes.name: NthSelectorData
nodes.summary: Data for Selectors-3 nth pseudo-classes: the NthType (child/last/only and of-type variants), whether functional, and the AnPlusB coefficients, with const constructors for first/last/only and is_simple_edge detection.

nodes.name: NthOfSelectorData
nodes.summary: Selectors-4 nth-child(An+B of S) data: the NthSelectorData header plus the selector list in a ThinArc; used for both matching and nth-of dependency tracking.

nodes.name: RelativeSelectorMatchHint
nodes.summary: Enumerates where a has() match can be contained (subtree, direct children, next sibling, next-sibling subtree, later siblings, sibling subtrees), derived from the relative combinator and inner combinator composition to constrain matching traversal.

nodes.name: RelativeSelector
nodes.summary: Storage for one relative selector: the computed match hint plus the inner selector guaranteed to start with RelativeSelectorAnchor and the relative combinator in parse order.

nodes.name: collect_selector_hashes
nodes.summary: Collects up to four element-identifying hashes (lowercase local names, namespaces, ids/classes outside quirks mode, whitelisted attributes) from a component iterator for bloom filters, recursing into single-selector is/where and bailing when the list would OR.

nodes.name: collect_ancestor_hashes
nodes.summary: Walks the subject compound (including single-selector is/where nesting) until an ancestor combinator is reached, then feeds the ancestor iteration to collect_selector_hashes.

nodes.name: parse_selector
nodes.summary: Parses one complex selector into a SelectorBuilder: handles relative-selector modes (ForHas anchoring, ForNesting/ForScope implicit prefixes), repeated compound parsing with combinator detection, and post-pseudo-element state termination.

nodes.name: parse_compound_selector
nodes.summary: Parses one compound selector: the type selector followed by simple selectors, inserting an implicit default-namespace universal when needed and updating parsing state as pseudo-elements/part/slotted are consumed.

nodes.name: parse_one_simple_selector
nodes.summary: Parses a single simple selector token: id hash, class, parent selector, attribute blocks, and the colon machinery distinguishing pseudo-classes from pseudo-elements, including ::part/::slotted, functional pseudo-elements, and CSS2 single-colon names.

nodes.name: parse_attribute_selector
nodes.summary: Parses attribute selectors: qualified names with optional namespaces, existence or operator matching (=, ~=, |=, ^=, *=, $=), value parsing, and i/s case-sensitivity flags including the HTML ascii-case-insensitive attribute list.

nodes.name: parse_has
nodes.summary: Parses the has() pseudo-class into a relative selector list: rejects nesting and pseudo-elements, parses with ParseRelative::ForHas so leading combinators anchor on the subject.

nodes.name: parse_functional_pseudo_class
nodes.summary: Dispatches functional pseudo-classes: nth-child/nth-of-type/nth-last-*, is/where (forgiving), has, host, not, embedder is-aliases, then falls back to the embedder's non-tree-structural functional pseudo-class hook.

nodes.name: parse_nth_pseudo_class
nodes.summary: Parses An+B coefficients via cssparser::parse_nth and, when the parser enables nth-child of and the type allows it, the trailing 'of <selector-list>' clause into an NthOf component.

nodes.name: namespace_empty_string
nodes.summary: Returns the default (empty) NamespaceUrl for an impl, used for no-namespace comparisons and attribute selectors without a namespace.

nodes.name: RelativeSelectorCachedMatch
nodes.summary: Matched/NotMatched enum caching the outcome of one has() evaluation for an anchor element, with a matched() accessor.

nodes.name: RelativeSelectorCache
nodes.summary: FxHashMap keyed by (OpaqueElement anchor, SelectorKey) storing RelativeSelectorCachedMatch results, add()/lookup() APIs; avoids re-traversing the same subtree for repeated has() matches on the same anchor.

nodes.name: RelativeSelectorFilterMap
nodes.summary: Map of (element, TraversalKind) to lazily-built Bloom filter entries (two-lookups-before-construction) used to fast-reject has() matches; sibling-direction hints build the filter over the parent's children/subtree so multiple siblings share one filter.

nodes.name: fast_reject (filter.rs)
nodes.summary: Collects selector hashes from the relative selector's rightmost compound (via collect_selector_hashes) and reports definite rejection when any hash is missing from the subtree bloom filter.

nodes.name: add_to_filter
nodes.summary: Recursively adds element-unique hashes of an element's children (and descendants for Descendant traversal) into a BloomFilter, aborting when insertion fails.

nodes.name: Push (trait)
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting push() over Vec, SmallVec, and presence-only byte-tweaking sinks, letting selector-building code stay container-agnostic.

nodes.name: OpaqueElement
nodes.summary: Type-erased NonNull identity of an element for pointer-identity comparisons and cache keys; Send+Sync since the original reference is never recoverable; new()/from_ptr()/to_ptr() constructors.

nodes.name: Element (trait)
nodes.summary: DOM abstraction required by the matcher: parent/sibling/child traversal, shadow-host and slot relations, local-name/namespace/class/id/attribute checks, pseudo-class and pseudo-element matching, apply_selector_flags, is_root/is_empty/is_link, custom state and part handling, ignores_nth_child_selectors, and add_element_unique_hashes for bloom filters.

nodes.name: SelectorVisitor (trait)
nodes.summary: Visitor over selector structure with hooks for attribute selectors, simple selectors, relative selector lists, nested selector lists (default recurses), and complex selectors (receiving the combinator to the right); returning false terminates traversal.

nodes.name: SelectorListKind
nodes.summary: Bitflags describing which construct a nested selector list belongs to (NEGATION, IS, WHERE, NTH_OF, HAS), with from_component construction and in_* predicates plus relevant_to_nth_of_dependencies for invalidation dependency tracking.

nodes.name: arc_slice.rs
nodes.summary: Defines ArcSlice<T>, a thin atomically reference-counted slice over servo_arc::ThinArc with a u64 canary header, FFI forget/leak helpers, and serde/malloc_size_of/ToShmem support. Shared Stylo data structure used for refcounted value lists across the Rust/C++ boundary.

nodes.name: style_traits Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for the style_traits crate ('Types used by the Stylo CSS engine'); declares servo/gecko features and dependencies on cssparser, selectors, servo_arc, malloc_size_of, to_shmem and (optional) nsstring/url.

nodes.name: dom.rs
nodes.summary: Defines OpaqueNode, an opaque, comparable handle to a DOM node, letting layout/style reference nodes without dereferencing DOM data.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root of style_traits, the shared types crate used by both Servo and Gecko (Stylo). Defines ParseError (cssparser::ParseError<StyleParseErrorKind>), the StyleParseErrorKind error enums, the ParsingMode bitflags that select parse modes (unitless lengths, numeric ranges, computationally independent values, media queries), pixel units, and re-exports the ToCss serialization family.

nodes.name: owned_array.rs
nodes.summary: Defines OwnedArray<T, N>, a cbindgen-friendly #[repr(C)] replacement for Box<[T; N]> held as a single thin pointer, plus malloc_size_of/to_shmem impls; used to break cbindgen circular references with one allocation and statically checked length.

nodes.name: owned_slice.rs
nodes.summary: Defines OwnedSlice<T>, a cbindgen-friendly #[repr(C)] replacement for Box<[T]> storing a NonNull pointer and length, with serde, hashing, iteration, malloc_size_of and to_shmem support; the base storage of OwnedStr.

nodes.name: owned_str.rs
nodes.summary: Defines OwnedStr, a defined-layout (#[repr(C)]) replacement for Box<str> built over OwnedSlice<u8>, with conversions to/from String and Box<str> for FFI.

nodes.name: specified_value_info.rs
nodes.summary: Value information for devtools: the derivable SpecifiedValueInfo trait (SUPPORTED_TYPES + collect_completion_keywords) with blanket impls for primitives and common containers, plus the CssType constants matching InspectorPropertyType in InspectorUtils.webidl.

nodes.name: values.rs
nodes.summary: Helper types and traits for CSS values shared between cssparser-based parsing and Stylo: the derivable ToCss trait, CssWriter/SequenceWriter serialization helpers, CssString/CssStringWriter aliases (nsCString under gecko), Separator/OneOrMoreSeparated for comma/space lists, and specified::AllowedNumericType range rules used together with ParsingMode.

nodes.name: bezier.rs
nodes.summary: Parametric unit cubic Bezier curve used for CSS transition/animation timing functions (based on WebKit's UnitBezier.h); solves with Newton's method and a bisection fallback, extrapolating via tangents outside [0,1].

nodes.name: build_gecko.rs
nodes.summary: Gecko-only build script logic: drives bindgen to generate structs.rs from layout/style/ServoBindings.toml (headers, allowlists, opaque types, fixups, cbindgen type mappings), tracks recursively included headers for cargo:rerun-if-changed, and regenerates pseudo-element data via regen_pseudo_elements.py.

nodes.name: build.rs
nodes.summary: Build script for the style crate: requires exactly one of the servo/gecko features, locates a Python 3 interpreter (PYTHON3 or PATH), runs properties/build.py to generate CSS property code, and under gecko invokes build_gecko::generate for bindgen bindings.

nodes.name: style Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for the style crate ('The Stylo CSS engine'); declares the build.rs script, gecko/servo feature sets, and dependencies including style_traits, selectors, servo_arc, cssparser, style_derive, rayon and gecko-profiler.

nodes.name: color_function.rs
nodes.summary: Defines ColorFunction<OriginColor>, the parsed output of rgb()/hsl()/hwb()/lab()/lch()/oklab()/oklch()/color()/alpha() including relative-color origin. Computes to ComputedColor (collapsing to absolute when the origin is absolute), maps origin colors, resolves to AbsoluteColor with legacy-srgb clamping, and serializes including 'from <color>' syntax.

nodes.name: component.rs
nodes.summary: Defines ColorComponent<ValueType> (none, value, channel keyword, calc(), omitted alpha) and the ColorComponentType constructor trait; parses single color components with calc()/channel-keyword support via ParserContext, computes them against an origin color, and resolves them to floats.

nodes.name: convert.rs
nodes.summary: CSS Color 4 conversion algorithms: hue normalization, HSL/RGB/HWB conversions, polar/orthogonal transforms, D50/D65 white point handling, and the ColorSpaceConversion trait with per-space impls (srgb, display-p3, a98-rgb, prophoto, rec2020, xyz-d50/d65, lab/lch/oklab/oklch) converting through XYZ with euclid 3D transforms.

nodes.name: gamut.rs
nodes.summary: CSS Color 4 gamut mapping: AbsoluteColor::gamut_map_binary_search implements the binary-search-with-local-MINDE algorithm over Oklch chroma, with in-gamut/clipping helpers and the deltaE OK color-difference function.

nodes.name: raytrace.rs
nodes.summary: Ray-trace gamut mapping (CSS Color 4 section 13.2.5): casts rays through linear-light RGB space from an achromatic anchor to find the gamut boundary intersection; documents spec ambiguities and the f32 precision adjustment for the direction threshold.

nodes.name: mix.rs
nodes.summary: Color mixing/interpolation for color-mix(): HueInterpolationMethod and ColorInterpolationMethod parse/serialize, mix_many left-to-right fold with weight normalization, premultiplied component interpolation, hue adjustment methods, and carry-forward of 'none' (powerless) components between color spaces.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Color support module of the style crate: ColorComponents, the ColorSpace enum covering all CSS Color 4 spaces, ColorFlags bitflags (none-component and legacy-srgb markers), and AbsoluteColor with to_color_space() conversion through convert.rs, channel-keyword lookup for relative colors, and legacy-syntax helpers.

nodes.name: parsing.rs
nodes.summary: CSS color parsing: ChannelKeyword bitflags for relative-color channel keywords, parse_color_with/parse_color_keyword/parse_color_function dispatching rgb/hsl/hwb/lab/lch/oklab/oklch/color/alpha with legacy vs modern syntax detection, and the NumberOrPercentageComponent/NumberOrAngleComponent component types.

nodes.name: to_css.rs
nodes.summary: Serialization of colors to CSS: legacy rgb()/rgba(), modern lab()/lch()/oklab()/oklch()/color() with none/calc(infinity) handling via ModernComponent, ToCss impls for the number/percentage/angle component types, and write_author_preferred_value for author-facing output.

nodes.name: ArcSlice<T>
nodes.summary: Thin atomically-reference-counted slice wrapping servo_arc::ThinArc<u64, T> with a canary header; supports from_iter/from_iter_leaked construction, FFI forget()/leaked_empty_ptr(), uniqueness checks, serde, hashing and malloc_size_of.

nodes.name: ForgottenArcSlicePtr<T>
nodes.summary: Typed raw pointer (NonNull<T>) to an ArcSlice's inner allocation, produced by ArcSlice::forget() to send the slice over FFI without running its destructor.

nodes.name: OpaqueNode
nodes.summary: Opaque usize handle to a DOM node where only equality/hash/comparison are safe, enforcing that layout and graphics never dereference DOM data.

nodes.name: ParseError
nodes.summary: Type alias ParseError = cssparser::ParseError<StyleParseErrorKind>: the error type for all CSS parsing routines across Stylo, pairing cssparser basic errors with engine-specific error kinds.

nodes.name: StyleParseErrorKind
nodes.summary: Enum of Stylo-specific CSS parse errors: declaration-value-block token errors, media query errors, @property syntax/inherits descriptor errors, rule placement errors (@import/@namespace/@charset), selector errors (wrapping selectors::SelectorParseErrorKind), and unknown/experimental/invalid property errors.

nodes.name: PropertySyntaxParseError
nodes.summary: Error variants for parsing a @property rule's syntax descriptor per css-properties-values-api: missing/empty syntax, missing pipes, invalid component names, unclosed or unknown data type names, unexpected EOF.

nodes.name: PropertyInheritsParseError
nodes.summary: Error variants for parsing a @property rule's inherits descriptor: missing descriptor or a value that is not true/false.

nodes.name: ParsingMode
nodes.summary: Bitflags describing the value parsing mode shared by Stylo's ParserContext and its consumers: DEFAULT, ALLOW_UNITLESS_LENGTH (SVG), ALLOW_ALL_NUMERIC_VALUES (SVG range clamping), DISALLOW_COMPUTATIONALLY_DEPENDENT (@property/Typed OM), DISALLOW_UNITLESS_ZERO_LENGTH and MEDIA_QUERY_CONDITION; queried via helpers like allows_unitless_lengths() and allows_all_numeric_values().

nodes.name: PinchZoomFactor
nodes.summary: Newtype over f32 representing a mobile style pinch zoom factor, with new()/get() accessors.

nodes.name: ToCss
nodes.summary: Central CSS serialization trait of Stylo: writes a value in CSS syntax to a CssWriter; derivable with #[derive(ToCss)] and attributes such as #[css(function)], #[css(comma)], #[css(iterable)], #[css(represents_keyword)] and bitflags rules. Implemented for strings (quoted via serialize_string), Option, Box, Arc, Vec (via OneOrMoreSeparated), Au and numeric/cssparser token types; the shared serialization contract between the Servo and Gecko builds.

nodes.name: CssWriter
nodes.summary: fmt::Write adapter that tracks a lazily-consumed prefix so SequenceWriter can insert separators (', '/space) only between items that actually produced output.

nodes.name: SequenceWriter
nodes.summary: Serializes sequences of CSS values separated by a given string; item()/raw_item()/write_item() write the separator only before subsequent non-empty output, so Option fields that print nothing are handled transparently.

nodes.name: Separator
nodes.summary: Trait satisfied by separator marker types (Comma, Space, CommaWithSpace) providing separator() and parse() over cssparser::Parser for parsing comma/space separated value lists into Vecs.

nodes.name: OneOrMoreSeparated
nodes.summary: Marker trait associating a Separator with an element type so Vec<T> automatically implements ToCss with the right delimiter (e.g. cssparser::UnicodeRange uses Comma).

nodes.name: specified::AllowedNumericType
nodes.summary: Enum restricting numeric values (All, NonNegative, AtLeastOne, ZeroToOne); is_ok() consults ParsingMode (ALLOW_ALL_NUMERIC_VALUES bypasses the restriction) and clamp() enforces the range, the shared numeric range policy of specified value parsing.

nodes.name: SpecifiedValueInfo
nodes.summary: Derivable trait exposing supported CssType bits (SUPPORTED_TYPES) and value completion keywords (collect_completion_keywords) for devtools; traversal honors css()/value_info() helper attributes, with blanket impls for primitives, Box, [T], Option, OwnedSlice, Vec, ThinVec, Arc, ArcSlice, Range and tuples.

nodes.name: CssType
nodes.summary: Namespace of u8 constants (COLOR, GRADIENT, TIMING_FUNCTION) describing the value types a property supports, matching InspectorPropertyType in InspectorUtils.webidl.

nodes.name: OwnedSlice<T>
nodes.summary: #[repr(C)] cbindgen-friendly Box<[T]> replacement (NonNull<T> + len) with into_vec/into_box/from_slice conversions, IntoIterator, FromIterator, serde, hashing, malloc_size_of and to_shmem support.

nodes.name: OwnedArray<T, N>
nodes.summary: #[repr(C)] cbindgen-friendly Box<[T; N]> replacement: a single thin pointer with the length in the type; cheaper than N boxed values and statically length-checked, useful for enum variant payloads crossing FFI.

nodes.name: OwnedStr
nodes.summary: #[repr(C)] defined-layout Box<str> replacement over OwnedSlice<u8>, deref-ing (unsafely) to str with conversions to/from String and Box<str> for FFI; also has SpecifiedValueInfo and quoted-string ToCss impls.

nodes.name: Bezier
nodes.summary: Unit cubic Bezier timing function holding polynomial coefficients (ax..cy) derived from control points x1/y1/x2/y2; solves via Newton iteration with bisection fallback, based on WebKit UnitBezier.h.

nodes.name: Bezier::calculate_bezier_output
nodes.summary: Public entry point mapping a progress value through the Bezier: short-circuits linear curves and the 0/1 edges, extrapolates via tangents for progress outside [0,1], otherwise solves the curve with the given epsilon.

nodes.name: build_gecko::generate
nodes.summary: Entry point of Gecko binding generation: creates OUT_DIR/gecko, installs optional build logging (STYLO_BUILD_LOG/STYLO_BUILD_FILTER), generates structs and pseudo elements, and emits cargo:rerun-if-changed for every consumed header.

nodes.name: generate_structs
nodes.summary: Configures a bindgen Builder from ServoBindings.toml (headers, raw lines, hidden types, fixups, allowlisted functions/vars/types, bitfield/rusty enums, cbindgen-types mappings, mapped-generic-types), applies regex fixups, and writes structs.rs only when its dependencies changed.

nodes.name: build::main
nodes.summary: Build script entry: panics unless exactly one of the gecko/servo features is enabled, prints the OUT_DIR, generates CSS property code via properties/build.py, and runs Gecko binding generation under the gecko feature.

nodes.name: generate_properties
nodes.summary: Walks the properties/ directory registering cargo:rerun-if-changed for mako/rs/py/zip/toml sources and invokes properties/build.py with the selected engine (gecko/servo) to generate property code.

nodes.name: ColorComponents
nodes.summary: Triple of f32 color components (excluding alpha) with map()/to_array() and Add/Sub/Mul/Div operators; the value type exchanged by all color conversion math in convert.rs and gamut mapping.

nodes.name: ColorSpace
nodes.summary: Enum of CSS Color 4 color spaces (srgb, hsl, hwb, lab, lch, oklab, oklch, srgb-linear, display-p3(+linear), a98-rgb, prophoto-rgb, rec2020, xyz-d50, xyz-d65 with 'xyz' alias); derived Parse/ToCss plus helpers is_polar(), is_rectangular(), is_rgb_or_xyz_like(), hue_index() and get_linear_color_space().

nodes.name: ColorFlags
nodes.summary: Bitflags carried on colors marking which components are 'none' (C0/C1/C2_IS_NONE, ALPHA_IS_NONE) and whether the color is written in legacy sRGB syntax (IS_LEGACY_SRGB); used by conversion, mixing and serialization.

nodes.name: AbsoluteColor
nodes.summary: Concrete fully-resolved color: ColorComponents + alpha + ColorSpace + ColorFlags. Constructors (new, srgb_legacy, from_nscolor) clamp per-space ranges and record none components; to_color_space() converts via convert.rs (with fast direct conversions between related spaces), get_component_by_channel_keyword() serves relative colors, PartialEq compares across spaces via Oklab, and constants TRANSPARENT_BLACK/BLACK/WHITE are provided.

nodes.name: ComponentDetails
nodes.summary: Helper holding (value, is_none) for a color component, with From impls for f32, u8 (0..255 scaled), Option<f32> and ColorComponent<f32>, consumed by AbsoluteColor::new to set the *_IS_NONE flags.

nodes.name: ColorFunction<OriginColor>
nodes.summary: Generic enum of parsed color function outputs (Rgb, Hsl, Hwb, Lab, Lch, Oklab, Oklch, Color, Alpha), each carrying an Optional origin color for relative color syntax. to_computed_color() computes to ComputedColor (collapsing to absolute when the origin is absolute), map_origin_color() re-types the origin, to_absolute_color() resolves components with per-function reference ranges and legacy-srgb clamping, resolve_to_absolute() substitutes currentcolor, and ToCss serializes including the 'from <color>' prefix and '/ alpha'.

nodes.name: ColorComponent<ValueType>
nodes.summary: Generic single color component: None, Value(ValueType), ChannelKeyword, Calc(Box<CalcNode>) or AlphaOmitted. parse() accepts none/channel keywords/calc()/tokens under ParserContext, to_computed_value() substitutes channel keywords from an absolute origin color (relative alpha defaults to the origin alpha per css-color-5) and folds calc trees, resolve() yields the final float, and ToCss serializes each form.

nodes.name: ColorComponentType
nodes.summary: Constructor trait for ColorComponent value types (NumberOrPercentageComponent, NumberOrAngleComponent, f32): from_value, is_valid_type against typed-OM NumericType, try_from_token for cssparser tokens and try_from_leaf for resolved calc leaves.

nodes.name: normalize_hue
nodes.summary: Normalizes a hue angle into [0, 360); used by HSL/HWB/LCH/OKLCH conversions and interpolation.

nodes.name: hsl_to_rgb
nodes.summary: CSS Color 4 HSL to RGB conversion; missing components are normalized to 0.

nodes.name: rgb_to_hsl
nodes.summary: CSS Color 4 RGB to HSL conversion returning hue plus saturation/lightness percentages via rgb_to_hue_min_max.

nodes.name: hwb_to_rgb
nodes.summary: CSS Color 4 HWB to RGB conversion, degenerating to gray when whiteness + blackness >= 1, otherwise scaling an HSL-derived RGB by 1 - w - b.

nodes.name: rgb_to_hwb
nodes.summary: CSS Color 4 RGB to HWB conversion: hue from rgb_to_hue_min_max, whiteness = min, blackness = 1 - max.

nodes.name: orthogonal_to_polar
nodes.summary: Converts rectangular (lab/oklab) components to cylindrical polar (lch/oklch); near-zero a/b or chroma make the hue powerless and it is reported as NaN (missing).

nodes.name: polar_to_orthogonal
nodes.summary: Converts polar (lch/oklch) components to rectangular (lab/oklab); a missing (NaN) hue yields an achromatic color.

nodes.name: to_xyz
nodes.summary: Generic conversion of components from a ColorSpaceConversion space to XYZ: to_linear_light then to_xyz, returning the components together with the space's WhitePoint for later adaptation.

nodes.name: from_xyz
nodes.summary: Generic conversion from XYZ at a given WhitePoint to a ColorSpaceConversion space: white point adaptation (D50 <-> D65 via the xyz matrices), from_xyz, then gamma encoding.

nodes.name: ColorSpaceConversion
nodes.summary: Per-color-space conversion algebra: WHITE_POINT, to_linear_light, to_xyz, from_xyz, to_gamma_encoded; implemented for Srgb, Hsl, Hwb, SrgbLinear, DisplayP3(+Linear), A98Rgb, ProphotoRgb, Rec2020, XyzD50/XyzD65, Lab, Lch, Oklab and Oklch so all spaces convert through XYZ per CSS Color 4.

nodes.name: WhitePoint
nodes.summary: Enum of reference whites D50/D65 with their XYZ tristimulus values, used by convert_white_point to adapt between white points.

nodes.name: Srgb
nodes.summary: sRGB color space conversion: piecewise gamma transfer functions (0.04045/12.92 knee) and TO_XYZ/FROM_XYZ matrices; its transfer and matrices are reused by Hsl, Hwb and SrgbLinear.

nodes.name: Hsl
nodes.summary: HSL conversion implementing ColorSpaceConversion by going through Srgb via hsl_to_rgb / rgb_to_hsl.

nodes.name: Hwb
nodes.summary: HWB conversion implementing ColorSpaceConversion by going through Srgb via hwb_to_rgb / rgb_to_hwb.

nodes.name: SrgbLinear
nodes.summary: Linear-light sRGB: identity transfer functions while reusing Srgb's XYZ matrices.

nodes.name: DisplayP3
nodes.summary: Display-P3 color space: sRGB-like transfer functions with its own TO_XYZ/FROM_XYZ matrices (D65).

nodes.name: DisplayP3Linear
nodes.summary: Linear Display-P3: identity transfers reusing DisplayP3's XYZ matrices.

nodes.name: A98Rgb
nodes.summary: Adobe RGB (a98-rgb) color space with 2.19921875 gamma and its own XYZ matrices (D65).

nodes.name: ProphotoRgb
nodes.summary: ProPhoto RGB color space with the D50 white point, 1/1.8 power transfer with a 1/512 linear toe, and its own XYZ matrices.

nodes.name: Rec2020
nodes.summary: Rec.2020 color space with ALPHA/BETA transfer constants (0.45 power law) and its own XYZ matrices (D65).

nodes.name: XyzD50
nodes.summary: Identity ColorSpaceConversion for XYZ coordinates at the D50 white reference.

nodes.name: XyzD65
nodes.summary: Identity ColorSpaceConversion for XYZ coordinates at the D65 white reference.

nodes.name: Lab
nodes.summary: CIELAB color space: KAPPA/EPSILON constants with hand-written to_xyz/from_xyz conversions against the D50 white point instead of matrices.

nodes.name: Lch
nodes.summary: CIELCh color space converting to/from XYZ via Lab and the polar/orthogonal transforms with a lightness-range epsilon.

nodes.name: Oklab
nodes.summary: Oklab color space: XYZ<->LMS<->Oklab matrices with cube/cube-root non-linearity in the LMS space (D65).

nodes.name: Oklch
nodes.summary: Oklch color space converting to/from XYZ via Oklab and the polar/orthogonal transforms.

nodes.name: AbsoluteColor::gamut_map_binary_search
nodes.summary: CSS Color 4 section 13.2.1 binary search gamut mapping: bypasses limitless spaces and achromatic extremes, then binary-searches the Oklch chroma while comparing the deltaE OK of the clipped color against a JND of 0.02 until the epsilon convergence.

nodes.name: delta_eok
nodes.summary: Computes deltaE OK (root sum of squares of Oklab component differences after converting both colors to Oklab), the difference metric of gamut mapping.

nodes.name: AbsoluteColor::gamut_map_raytrace
nodes.summary: CSS Color 4 section 13.2.5 ray-trace gamut mapping: converts to the linear form of the destination space, handles limitless spaces and achromatic extremes, then performs up to four ray casts from an achromatic anchor to find the gamut boundary before clipping.

nodes.name: AbsoluteColor::cast_ray
nodes.summary: Slab-method ray/AABB intersection of the segment from start to end against the [0,1]^3 RGB gamut cube, using a 1e-6 direction threshold adjusted for f32 (the spec assumes f64); returns the intersection components or None.

nodes.name: HueInterpolationMethod
nodes.summary: Enum of hue interpolation methods from CSS Color 4 (shorter, longer, increasing, decreasing, specified), with derived Parse and ToCss.

nodes.name: ColorInterpolationMethod
nodes.summary: Color-space plus hue-method pair ('in <space> [<method> hue]') for color-mix(): parses via ColorSpace/HueInterpolationMethod, defaults to Oklab/shorter, falls back to srgb when both endpoints are legacy syntax (best_interpolation_between), and serializes omitting the default hue method.

nodes.name: ColorMixItem
nodes.summary: A color together with its weight contributing to a color-mix() result; items are collected into a ColorMixItemList smallvec.

nodes.name: mix_many
nodes.summary: Folds N weighted colors into one in the interpolation space: normalizes weights per css-color-5 percent normalization (scaling alpha when the sum is below 1), interpolates premultiplied components left-to-right, rounds the resulting alpha, and finalizes to modern or legacy syntax according to ColorMixFlags.

nodes.name: interpolate_premultiplied
nodes.summary: Core premultiplied interpolation of the 4 components honoring per-component none outcomes (mix/use-left/use-right/none), carrying ALPHA_IS_NONE and C*_IS_NONE flags into the result, and applying hue interpolation at the hue index (including the 'longer' full-cycle case for equal endpoints).

nodes.name: ChannelKeyword
nodes.summary: Bitflags of relative-color channel keywords (alpha, a, b, c, g, h, l, r, s, w, x, y, z) with per-syntax sets rgb()/hsl()/hwb()/lab()/lch()/xyz(), from_ident parsing over match_ignore_ascii_case, derived Parse, and ToCss.

nodes.name: parse_color_with
nodes.summary: Main entry point for parsing a <color> under a ParserContext: hash colors, named/currentcolor/transparent keywords, or nested color functions, eagerly resolving to an absolute SpecifiedColor when no origin color is present.

nodes.name: parse_color_keyword
nodes.summary: Parses CSS named color keywords (case-insensitively) plus transparent and currentcolor into a legacy sRGB SpecifiedColor using cssparser's parse_named_color.

nodes.name: parse_color_function
nodes.summary: Dispatches the nested argument block of rgb()/rgba(), hsl()/hsla(), hwb(), lab(), lch(), oklab(), oklch(), color() and alpha() (the last behind the layout.css.alpha-color-function.enabled pref), first parsing the optional 'from <color>' origin and detecting legacy comma syntax.

nodes.name: NumberOrPercentageComponent
nodes.summary: Component value that is either a <number> or a <percentage> normalized to 0..1; to_number() scales by a percentage basis and the ColorComponentType impl accepts Number/Percentage calc types.

nodes.name: NumberOrAngleComponent
nodes.summary: Component value that is either a <number> or an <angle> canonicalized to degrees; accepts dimension tokens via NoCalcAngle::parse_dimension and Angle calc leaves.

nodes.name: ModernComponent
nodes.summary: Private wrapper over &Option<f32> that serializes a modern color component as none, calc(NaN), calc(-infinity)/calc(infinity), or the number itself.

nodes.name: AbsoluteColor::to_css
nodes.summary: Serializes an AbsoluteColor: legacy rgb()/rgba() for legacy-srgb flags, converting hsl/hwb into srgb, lab()/lch()/oklab()/oklch() with none/calc(NaN)/infinity handling through ModernComponent, and color() for predefined spaces with debug assertions about which spaces allow which syntax.

nodes.name: AbsoluteColor::write_author_preferred_value
nodes.summary: Writes a devtools/author-friendly serialization of the color (rounded percentages, degrees, none components) per color space; explicitly not spec-canonical but tuned for how authors enter color values.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Implementation of the @counter-style at-rule for Stylo: parses <counter-style> values (name, none, symbols()), defines CounterStyleRule with its descriptors and a generation counter for change detection, and all descriptor value types (System, Symbols, AdditiveSymbols, Pad, Fallback, CounterRanges, SpeakAs).

nodes.name: SymbolsType
nodes.summary: Enum for the <symbols-type> of symbols(): cyclic, numeric, alphabetic, symbolic, fixed; defaults to symbolic when not specified.

nodes.name: CounterStyle
nodes.summary: Specified <counter-style> value: None, Name(CustomIdent), Symbols { ty, symbols } for symbols(), or String(AtomString) for space-efficient list-style-type strings; provides disc()/decimal() constructors and is_bullet() for the bullet list-style names.

nodes.name: CounterStyle::parse
nodes.summary: Parses a counter style honoring CounterStyleParsingFlags (ALLOW_NONE / ALLOW_STRING for list-style-type); validates that alphabetic/numeric symbols() have >= 2 symbols and rejects identifiers inside symbols().

nodes.name: CounterStyleRule
nodes.summary: Parsed @counter-style rule holding its name, Descriptors, a Wrapping<u32> generation bumped on every descriptor change (used by CSSCounterStyleRule to detect modifications), and source location; set_descriptor() re-validates system/symbols invariants.

nodes.name: CounterStyleRule::set_descriptor
nodes.summary: Setter backing the CSSCounterStyleRule WebIDL interface: special-cases system/symbols with check_system/check_symbols (e.g. no symbols for extends, >= 2 for alphabetic/numeric), rejects additive-symbols on extends, and bumps generation when a descriptor actually changes.

nodes.name: parse_counter_style_body
nodes.summary: Parses the { } block of an @counter-style rule via DescriptorParser/RuleBodyParser, logging unsupported descriptor errors, then enforces spec validity checks (missing symbols, not-enough-symbols, missing additive-symbols, extends with symbols/additive-symbols).

nodes.name: parse_counter_style_name_definition
nodes.summary: Parses the prelude of an @counter-style rule, rejecting the reserved builtin names (decimal, disc, circle, square, disclosure-open, disclosure-closed) as definition names.

nodes.name: System
nodes.summary: The counter-style system descriptor: cyclic, numeric, alphabetic, symbolic, additive, fixed <integer>?, or extends <counter-style-name>, with Parse/ToCss implementations.

nodes.name: Symbol
nodes.summary: A counter style <symbol>: either a <string> (OwnedStr) or <custom-ident>; identifiers are disallowed inside symbols() per is_allowed_in_symbols().

nodes.name: Symbols
nodes.summary: ArcSlice<Symbol> list for the symbols descriptor / symbols() function; requires at least one symbol when parsed.

nodes.name: AdditiveSymbols
nodes.summary: Comma-separated OwnedSlice<AdditiveTuple> for the additive-symbols descriptor; weights must resolve (no unresolved calc) and be strictly decreasing.

nodes.name: AdditiveTuple
nodes.summary: An <integer> weight paired with a <symbol> for the additive-symbols descriptor.

nodes.name: Negative
nodes.summary: The negative descriptor: one required and one optional <symbol> wrapped around negative counter values.

nodes.name: CounterRange
nodes.summary: A single range for the range descriptor, with start/end CounterBounds (integer or infinite).

nodes.name: CounterRanges
nodes.summary: Comma-separated list of CounterRanges serializing as 'auto' when empty; parsing rejects integer pairs where start > end or either bound is an unresolvable calc.

nodes.name: CounterBound
nodes.summary: A bound in a counter-style range: an <integer> (possibly calc, resolved at parse time) or infinite.

nodes.name: Pad
nodes.summary: The pad descriptor: a non-negative <integer> minimum length plus a <symbol>; rejects unresolvable calc minimum lengths.

nodes.name: Fallback
nodes.summary: The fallback descriptor: a <counter-style-name> used when the counter style cannot render a value.

nodes.name: SpeakAs
nodes.summary: The speak-as descriptor: auto, bullets, numbers, words, or another <counter-style-name>; spell-out is parsed but explicitly unsupported (bug 1024178).

nodes.name: predefined.rs
nodes.summary: Data-only file with a single predefined! invocation listing every predefined counter style name (decimal, disc, cjk-decimal, ethiopic-numeric, ...); include!'d by counter_style/mod.rs to build the case-insensitive name map and completion keywords.

nodes.name: update_predefined.py
nodes.summary: Generator script that scrapes https://drafts.csswg.org/css-counter-styles/ for names tagged data-dfn-for=<counter-style-name>/<counter-style> and regenerates predefined.rs from the upstream spec.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Fetches the css-counter-styles spec page, regex-extracts the predefined style names, and writes the predefined! macro invocation to predefined.rs next to the script.

nodes.name: custom_properties_map.rs
nodes.summary: CustomPropertiesMap: an Arc<Inner> persistent map of an element's custom properties with cheap copy-on-write; Inner chains to a parent (ancestor limit of 4) storing an IndexMap (OwnMap) of Name -> Option<ComputedRegisteredValue> where None marks removals, plus an order-sensitive PartialEq tuned for style invalidation.

nodes.name: CustomPropertiesMap
nodes.summary: Public handle wrapping Arc<Inner>; insert/remove go through do_insert which mutates in place when uniquely owned, makes a copy via Arc::make_mut for small maps, or extends the parent chain when above 8 own properties and under the ancestor limit.

nodes.name: Inner
nodes.summary: Persistent node of the map: own IndexMap keyed by PrecomputedHasher, optional parent Arc<Inner>, deduplicated length, and ancestor count; get() walks the parent chain and PartialEq compares entries in order for fast custom-property change detection (bug 1926423).

nodes.name: Iter
nodes.summary: Iterator walking the Inner chain from newest to oldest, skipping entries shadowed by an already-visited descendant so each property is yielded once with its effective value.

nodes.name: CustomPropertiesMap::do_insert
nodes.summary: Core copy-on-write insertion (also backs remove via None value): in-place when Arc is unique, no-op when the value is unchanged, Arc::make_mut copy below the small-map threshold, otherwise clones the current node as parent and inserts into a fresh chain link.

nodes.name: custom_properties.rs
nodes.summary: The var()/env()/attr() substitution engine for custom properties: VariableValue parsing that records substitution-function references and unit dependencies, CssEnvironment for env() (safe-area insets, GTK CSD look-and-feel, hairline, link parameters), computed-value resolution for registered properties, cycle detection, attr() tainting per css-values-5, and Typed OM reification; calls into Gecko FFI for color-scheme and look-and-feel env variables.

nodes.name: CssEnvironment
nodes.summary: Stateless resolver for env() variables: standard safe-area-inset-* always available, chrome-only variables (-moz-gtk-csd-*, -moz-content-preferred-color-scheme, scrollbar-inline-size, hairline) gated on chrome-ruled url data, plus document link-parameters; Gecko paths go through Gecko_GetLookAndFeelInt and Gecko_MediaFeatures_PrefersColorScheme.

nodes.name: CssEnvironment::get
nodes.summary: Looks up an env() name among ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLES and (for chrome-enabled documents) CHROME_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLES, dispatching to the variable's evaluator fn(Device, &UrlExtraData); also resolves --* link parameters from the device.

nodes.name: get_content_preferred_color_scheme
nodes.summary: Gecko evaluator for the -moz-content-preferred-color-scheme env variable: calls Gecko_MediaFeatures_PrefersColorScheme(document, use_content=true) via FFI and maps the result to a light/dark ident VariableValue.

nodes.name: VariableValue
nodes.summary: A custom property value: raw CSS string plus stylesheet UrlExtraData, first/last token serialization types for correct re-serialization, References to var()/env()/attr() and unit dependencies, and explicitly_attr_tainted; equality is CSS-text equality; parse() preserves the token stream and auto-closes unbalanced constructs.

nodes.name: References
nodes.summary: List of SubstitutionFunctionReference entries in source order plus ReferenceFlags summarizing var/env/attr/unit dependencies (including nested fallback flags) used for dependency tracking and cycle handling.

nodes.name: ReferenceFlags
nodes.summary: Bitflags over value dependencies: font/line-height units (root and non-root), color-scheme, attr, env, var; from_unit() maps em/ex/ch/... and rem/rlh/... units to flags, and for_each_non_custom() yields SingleNonCustomReference items for cascade dependency registration.

nodes.name: SingleNonCustomReference
nodes.summary: A non-custom dependency participating in cycle resolution: FontUnits, LhUnits, or ColorScheme; to_prioritary_id() maps these to FontSize/LineHeight/ColorScheme prioritary property ids.

nodes.name: NonCustomReferenceMap
nodes.summary: Small fixed-size array map keyed by SingleNonCustomReference, used to associate non-custom dependencies with values.

nodes.name: SubstitutionFunctionKind
nodes.summary: Which substitution function a reference came from: Var, Env, or Attr; from_ident() recognizes the CSS function names during value parsing.

nodes.name: SubstitutionFunctionReference
nodes.summary: One recorded var()/env()/attr() occurrence: the referenced Name, byte start/end in the value CSS, optional VariableFallback (with nested references), attr()-specific AttributeData, neighboring token types, and the substitution kind.

nodes.name: VariableFallback
nodes.summary: Fallback of a substitution function: NonZeroUsize start offset (end implied by the reference), token types, and its own nested References.

nodes.name: AttributeData
nodes.summary: attr()-call specifics: AttributeType (invalid/none/raw-string/type(<syntax>)/unit) and the ParsedNamespace for namespaced attribute lookups.

nodes.name: AttrTaintedRange
nodes.summary: Byte range [start, end) within a CSS string that is tainted by attr(), used for the css-values-5 <url> security rule.

nodes.name: AttrTaint
nodes.summary: SmallVec of AttrTaintedRanges accumulated during substitution; should_disallow_urls_in_range() invalidates <url> values overlapping tainted regions, and whole-value tainting propagates through nested substitutions.

nodes.name: ComputedCustomProperties
nodes.summary: repr(C) pair of CustomPropertiesMaps splitting inherited and non-inherited custom properties; insert/remove/get dispatch by registration.inherits() and property_at() exposes a unified index for CSSOM iteration.

nodes.name: ComputedSubstitutionFunctions
nodes.summary: repr(C) wrapper holding the applicable custom properties plus an OwnMap of applicable DOM attributes consumed by attr(); insert_var/insert_attr/get_var/get_attr are the API used by the cascade while applying substitution functions.

nodes.name: Substitution
nodes.summary: Private intermediate result of substituting a chunk: borrowed-or-owned css string, first/last token types, and whether the result is attr()-tainted; into_value() computes a registered value or wraps a universal one.

nodes.name: SubstitutionResult
nodes.summary: Public result of substitute(): the resolved CSS string (Cow) plus the AttrTaint ranges discovered during substitution.

nodes.name: parse_name
nodes.summary: Validates a custom property name per css-variables: must start with '--' and have more than just the prefix; returns the name without it.

nodes.name: compute_variable_value
nodes.summary: Computes a registered custom property's specified VariableValue against its PropertyDescriptors: universal (('*') syntax) values pass through, otherwise the CSS text is computed via compute_value().

nodes.name: parse_declaration_value
nodes.summary: css-syntax <declaration-value> parser that stops at '!' or ';' and delegates to parse_declaration_value_block, tracking first/last serialization token types and missing closing characters.

nodes.name: parse_attr_type
nodes.summary: Parses an <attr-type>: type(<syntax>) via SyntaxDescriptor, raw-string, a unit keyword, or '%' for percentage; unknown input yields AttributeType::None so substitution falls back gracefully.

nodes.name: get_attr_value_for_cycle_resolution
nodes.summary: Fetches an attribute value through the AttributeTracker for cycle detection during attr() substitution, parsing it into a universal ComputedRegisteredValue; rejects unknown namespaces.

nodes.name: handle_invalid_at_computed_value_time
nodes.summary: Implements invalid at computed-value time for registered custom properties: keeps the inherited value on non-root inherited properties, computes the registration's initial value otherwise, or removes the property entirely (making it the guaranteed-invalid state).

nodes.name: substitute_references_if_needed_and_apply
nodes.summary: Entry point while applying a var()/attr()-carrying declaration: fast-path for reference-free universal values, otherwise runs substitute_internal, handles CSS-wide keywords in the result (inherit/initial/unset/revert semantics), and inserts the resolved value or falls back to invalid-at-computed-value-time handling.

nodes.name: substitute
nodes.summary: Public API replacing var()/env()/attr() in a VariableValue, returning the resulting CSS string and accumulated attr taint; Err means invalid at computed-value time.

nodes.name: substitute_internal
nodes.summary: Driver for substitution over a whole VariableValue, delegating to do_substitute_chunk with the value's references and taint sink.

nodes.name: do_substitute_chunk
nodes.summary: Substitutes references within css[start..end]: copies literal spans between references with correct token separators, short-circuits whole-value single references, and stitches substituted results while tracking attr taint and the 2MB value-size cap enforced by VariableValue::push.

nodes.name: substitute_one_reference
nodes.summary: Resolves a single reference: var() reads the substitution map (recursively resolving still-universal values with a 'seen' cycle guard), env() consults CssEnvironment, attr() applies the <attr-type> (unit append, type() parse via SpecifiedRegisteredValue::parse, or raw string) against the attribute tracker, falling back to the recorded fallback chunk on failure.

nodes.name: compute_value
nodes.summary: Parses CSS text as a SpecifiedRegisteredValue and computes it against the registration's syntax, allowing computationally-dependent values and carrying attr taint; used for registered custom properties and initial values.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Platform-independent Device: the media-query evaluation context holding default ComputedValues, the root element's style, atomically-cached root font-size/line-height and root font metrics (rex/rcap/rch/ric), usage flags (used_viewport_size etc.) for restyle invalidation, the CssEnvironment, the body-text-color quirk state, and a platform-specific ExtraDeviceData; in Gecko it wraps the pres context.

nodes.name: Device
nodes.summary: Struct against which media queries evaluate and viewport/root-relative units resolve; stores root style and font metrics as relaxed atomics (safe because root styling is exclusive), tracks used_* flags so Gecko can invalidate on changes, and delegates to gecko.rs/servo.rs impls for FFI-backed queries.

nodes.name: Device::update_root_font_metrics
nodes.summary: Queries font metrics for the cached root style (with NEEDS_CH/NEEDS_IC), unzooms each metric by the root's effective zoom, stores them in the atomics, and returns whether any metric changed since the previous restyle.

nodes.name: Device::root_font_size
nodes.summary: Returns the cached root font size for rem resolution, recording used_root_font_size so the embedder knows to restyle if it changes.

nodes.name: gecko.rs
nodes.summary: Gecko backend for Device: holds a raw *const structs::Document (ExtraDeviceData), walks to nsPresContext for viewport size, DPR, text zoom, print preview, media emulation, and system colors, and forwards font metrics, line-height, look-and-feel and safe-area queries to GeckoBindings FFI; also declares Device as Send+Sync.

nodes.name: ExtraDeviceData
nodes.summary: Gecko-only Device payload: a raw pointer to the nsIDocument (sound because the document owns the style set, which owns the Device), exposing document() and pres_context() accessors used by all FFI-backed queries.

nodes.name: Device::new
nodes.summary: Constructs the Device from a document pointer: fetches Gecko_GetPrefSheetPrefs for the initial body text color, builds default ComputedValues via ComputedValues::default_values(document), and seeds all root metric atomics with the medium font defaults.

nodes.name: Device::calc_line_height
nodes.summary: Delegates line-height computation (including the 'normal' keyword and used value for an element) to Gecko_CalcLineHeight, passing the pres context, writing-mode verticality, font style struct, and optional GeckoElement.

nodes.name: Device::query_font_metrics
nodes.summary: Fetches a native FontMetrics struct via Gecko_GetFontMetrics from the pres context and adapts it into style::FontMetrics, treating negative ch/cap/ic values as unavailable and zero script scale factors as None.

nodes.name: Device::pres_context
nodes.summary: Walks document -> mPresShell -> mPresContext raw pointer; nearly every Gecko Device query starts here and degrades to defaults (screen media, 1.0 DPR, zero insets) when the pres context is gone.

nodes.name: Device::media_type
nodes.summary: Returns the medium for media queries, honoring Gecko's mMediaEmulationData.mMedium emulation override, otherwise the pres context's mMedium, re-wrapped as an Atom without cloning.

nodes.name: Device::au_viewport_size_for_viewport_unit_resolution
nodes.summary: Viewport size for unit resolution per ViewportVariant: paginated documents use the page size minus default margins; Small/Large/Dynamic adjust mVisibleArea by the dynamic toolbar heights and set the used_viewport_size / used_dynamic_viewport_size flags.

nodes.name: Device::device_pixel_ratio
nodes.summary: Computes CSS-pixel to device-pixel scale from AU_PER_PX and the pres context's mCurAppUnitsPerDevPixel, preferring mMediaEmulationData.mDPPX when emulating; device_pixel_ratio_ignoring_full_zoom() uses the device context's at-unit-full-zoom value instead.

nodes.name: Device::system_nscolor
nodes.summary: Resolves a SystemColor to an nscolor for the given ColorSchemeFlags via Gecko_ComputeSystemColor; backs default_background_color/default_color (Canvas/Canvastext under normal scheme) used for forced-colors.

nodes.name: Device::safe_area_insets
nodes.summary: Returns the env(safe-area-inset-*) values as a SideOffsets2D by calling Gecko_GetSafeAreaInsets with four out-params.

nodes.name: Device::base_size_for_generic
nodes.summary: Asks Gecko_GetBaseSize for the default font size of a generic font family for a language atom, used for keyword font-size resolution.

nodes.name: Device::scrollbar_inline_size
nodes.summary: Returns the scrollbar thickness in CSS pixels via Gecko_GetScrollbarInlineSize from the pres context (0.0 fallback without one); also backs the scrollbar-inline-size env() variable.

nodes.name: servo.rs
nodes.summary: Servo backend for Device: ExtraDeviceData carries media type, viewport/device size, DPR, quirks mode, color scheme, pointer capabilities, and a boxed FontMetricsProvider trait object; system colors are a hardcoded srgb table (dark/light), and queries that Gecko answers via FFI degrade to constant defaults.

nodes.name: FontMetricsProvider
nodes.summary: Trait the Servo embedder implements to answer query_font_metrics and base_size_for_generic for the Device, the dependency-inversion counterpart of Gecko's direct FFI calls.

nodes.name: ExtraDeviceData
nodes.summary: Servo-only Device payload: MediaType, viewport and device Size2D, device pixel ratio Scale, QuirksMode, PrefersColorScheme, primary/all PointerCapabilities, and Box<dyn FontMetricsProvider>, with setters that require the caller to refresh the Stylist.

nodes.name: Device::new
nodes.summary: Constructs the Servo Device from embedder-supplied media type, sizes, DPR, font metrics provider, default computed values, color scheme, and pointer capabilities; seeds root metric atomics identically to the Gecko constructor.

nodes.name: Device::query_font_metrics
nodes.summary: Records font-metric usage then forwards to the boxed FontMetricsProvider trait object; the Servo analog of Gecko_GetFontMetrics.

nodes.name: Device::system_color
nodes.summary: Hardcoded CSS Color 4 system-color tables for dark and light schemes (with deprecated aliases mapped to Canvas/CanvasText/ButtonFace/ButtonBorder), selected by is_dark_color_scheme which combines supported scheme flags with the preferred color scheme.

nodes.name: driver.rs
nodes.summary: Style traversal driver: traverse_dom() seeds a breadth-first work queue from the traversal root, sets up ScopedTLS thread-local contexts, and hands off to parallel::style_trees through a rayon in-place scope once the DOM is wide enough (work-unit size from the layout.css.stylo-work-unit-size pref); aggregates per-thread statistics and reports them to the ServoTraversalStatistics singleton on Gecko.

nodes.name: traverse_dom
nodes.summary: Generic DOM style traversal entry point over TElement/DomTraversal: creates the ScopedTLS before SendNode borrows (comment explains the TLS double-borrow hazard with Servo_StyleSet_GetBaseComputedValuesForElement), runs sequential-then-parallel processing, and returns the traversal root element.

nodes.name: report_statistics
nodes.summary: Gecko-only aggregation into the ServoTraversalStatistics singleton (elements traversed/styled/matched, styles shared/reused), asserting main-thread via Gecko_IsMainThread; the servo build unreachables.

nodes.name: with_pool_in_place_scope
nodes.summary: Runs the traversal closure inside a rayon in_place_scope_fifo when parallel work units are enabled, keeping the main thread as thread index 0 on Gecko, else executes sequentially.

nodes.name: font_face.rs
nodes.summary: The @font-face at-rule: FontFaceRule with shared Descriptors, the src descriptor's Source/SourceList (url with format()/tech(), local()), FontFaceSourceTechFlags bitflags, FontDisplay, and weight/width/style ranges with repr(C) computed counterparts (ComputedFontWeightRange etc.) so Gecko's font code can read them directly; parse_font_face_block drives DescriptorParser.

nodes.name: FontFaceRule
nodes.summary: Parsed @font-face rule holding Descriptors and source location; serializes via ToCssWithGuard and is shared behind the style stylesheet lock.

nodes.name: Source
nodes.summary: A single @font-face src entry: Url(UrlSource) or Local(FamilyName).

nodes.name: SourceList
nodes.summary: Comma-separated Vec<Source> for the src descriptor; custom Parse impl skips invalid components (consuming to the next comma) and fails only when nothing valid remains.

nodes.name: Source::parse
nodes.summary: Parses local(...) or url with optional format() (keyword or string) and optional tech() flag list, the latter gated by the layout.css.font-tech.enabled pref (gecko-only default true).

nodes.name: UrlSource
nodes.summary: A url() font source with SpecifiedUrl, optional FontFaceSourceFormat hint, and FontFaceSourceTechFlags; serializes as url format(...) tech(...).

nodes.name: FontFaceSourceFormat
nodes.summary: format() hint: a known FontFaceSourceFormatKeyword or an arbitrary string.

nodes.name: FontFaceSourceFormatKeyword
nodes.summary: Known src format keywords (collection, embedded-opentype family, opentype, svg, truetype, woff, woff2) plus internal None/Unknown variants not exposed to CSS.

nodes.name: FontFaceSourceTechFlags
nodes.summary: u16 bitflags for tech() requirements: opentype/AAT/graphite features, COLRv0/v1, SVG, sbix/CBDT color glyphs, variations, palettes, incremental download; with parse_one() and ToCss.

nodes.name: FontFaceSourceListComponent
nodes.summary: Gecko-only repr(u8) POD view of a src component (raw CssUrl pointer, addrefed nsAtom for local(), format keyword/string view, tech flags) handed across the FFI; all pointers non-owned and utf8 strings.

nodes.name: FontDisplay
nodes.summary: The font-display descriptor: auto, block, swap, fallback, optional.

nodes.name: FontWeightRange
nodes.summary: font-weight descriptor range of AbsoluteFontWeight bounds; compute() sorts and resolves to ComputedFontWeightRange, returning None on unresolvable calc bounds.

nodes.name: ComputedFontWeightRange
nodes.summary: repr(C) computed weight range (FontWeight pair) readable by Gecko because cbindgen cannot express specified Number.

nodes.name: FontWidthRange
nodes.summary: font-width (font-stretch) descriptor range; compute() resolves keyword/percentage bounds into the repr(C) ComputedFontWidthRange, rejecting unresolvable calc and system values.

nodes.name: ComputedFontWidthRange
nodes.summary: repr(C) computed width range (FontWidth pair) shared with Gecko's font matching code.

nodes.name: FontStyleRange
nodes.summary: font-style descriptor range: Italic or Oblique(angle, angle); parse distinguishes 'normal' from 'oblique 0deg' so a following angle is rejected after normal, and compute() sorts angles into ComputedFontStyleRange.

nodes.name: ComputedFontStyleRange
nodes.summary: repr(C) computed style range (FontStyle pair with oblique angles in degrees as 8.8 fixed point) consumed by Gecko.

nodes.name: parse_font_face_block
nodes.summary: Parses the { } block of @font-face through DescriptorParser/RuleBodyParser, logging UnsupportedFontFaceDescriptor errors, and returns the (possibly partial) FontFaceRule.

nodes.name: font_metrics.rs
nodes.summary: FontMetrics struct exposing what the style system needs for metric-dependent CSS units (ex/ch/cap/ic, ascent, MathML script scale factors), with spec-mandated fallbacks (0.5em ex, 0.5em-or-1em ch depending on upright writing mode, ascent for cap, 1em ic) and FontMetricsOrientation for vertical-metric selection.

nodes.name: FontMetrics
nodes.summary: Optional x_height/zero_advance_measure/cap_height/ic_width plus always-present ascent and MathML script_percent_scale_down values; *_or_default() methods implement the css-values fallbacks against a reference font size.

nodes.name: FontMetrics::x_height_or_default
nodes.summary: Returns x-height or 0.5em of the used (not computed) font size per the css-values ex unit fallback.

nodes.name: FontMetrics::zero_advance_measure_or_default
nodes.summary: Returns the ch advance or its fallback: 0.5em normally, a full em when typeset upright in vertical writing modes.

nodes.name: FontMetricsOrientation
nodes.summary: Selector for which metrics to retrieve: prefer horizontal or vertical for the context's writing mode, or force horizontal.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: string_cache replacement backed by Gecko nsAtom: Atom is a NonZeroUsize handle that is either a dynamic nsAtom pointer or a gGkAtoms static index tagged with the low bit; WeakAtom reads hash/length/UTF-16 storage directly from nsStaticAtom/nsDynamicAtom layouts; refcounting and atomization go through Gecko_AddRefAtom/Gecko_ReleaseAtom/Gecko_Atomize/Gecko_Atomize16 FFI, and the atom! macro indexes the generated static_atoms table.

nodes.name: Atom
nodes.summary: repr(C) NonZeroUsize atom handle: odd value = shifted static index into gGkAtoms (no refcount), even = strong dynamic nsAtom pointer; Clone/Drop addref/release only dynamic atoms, from_raw/from_addrefed/into_addrefed manage ownership across the FFI boundary, and hashing uses the atom's precomputed hash.

nodes.name: WeakAtom
nodes.summary: Borrowed view over a raw nsAtom: as_slice() computes the UTF-16 storage pointer from static string offsets or dynamic string buffers; provides is_static/is_ascii_lowercase/len, to_ascii_lowercase (borrowing when already lowercase), eq_ignore_ascii_case with a pointer-equality fast path, and with_str for stack-decoded UTF-8 access.

nodes.name: atom!
nodes.summary: Compile-time macro producing an Atom from a literal via static_atom_index! and from_index_unchecked against the objdir-generated xpcom/ds/static_atoms.rs table; the ubiquitous atom!("foo") used across Stylo.

nodes.name: Atom::from_raw
nodes.summary: Takes ownership of a raw nsAtom pointer, bumping the refcount via Gecko_AddRefAtom only for dynamic atoms.

nodes.name: Atom::into_addrefed
nodes.summary: Forgets the Rust handle and returns the nsAtom pointer with its reference, the standard way to hand atoms to C++.

nodes.name: WeakAtom::with_str
nodes.summary: Runs a callback with the atom's UTF-8 string, decoding in place on a 64-byte stack buffer when the UTF-16 length is <= 16 chars, else via a lossy owned String; deliberately awkward API to discourage slow string use.

nodes.name: WeakAtom::to_ascii_lowercase
nodes.summary: ASCII-case-folds the atom, returning a borrowed Cow when mIsAsciiLowercase is already set, otherwise lowercasing a stack or heap UTF-16 buffer and re-atomizing.

nodes.name: WeakAtom::eq_ignore_ascii_case
nodes.summary: ASCII-case-insensitive atom comparison: pointer equality fast path, then a static-only shortcut when both atoms are known lowercase (equality is impossible), else a slow code-unit comparison.

nodes.name: namespace.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the style crate's Namespace types on top of gecko_string_cache atoms: Namespace is a repr(transparent) wrapper around a strong Atom with PrecomputedHash support, derefs to WeakNamespace (a WeakAtom wrapper) for borrowed map lookups, plus the ns!() macro for cheap static namespace construction; underpins @namespace handling and namespace-qualified selector matching in the Stylo style engine.

nodes.name: Namespace
nodes.summary: A Gecko CSS namespace URL represented as a transparent wrapper around a strong Atom: implements PrecomputedHash by delegating to the atom, converts from &str, displays via the atom, and derefs to WeakNamespace so borrowed namespace comparisons in selector matching avoid refcount traffic.

nodes.name: WeakNamespace
nodes.summary: Borrowed view of a namespace wrapping a WeakAtom: unsafe::new reinterprets a *mut nsAtom as &WeakNamespace, clone() re-anchors it into a strong Namespace, and Namespace: Borrow<WeakNamespace> lets interning maps look up namespaces without owning references.

nodes.name: ns!
nodes.summary: Exported macro that builds a crate::string_cache::Namespace: ns!() yields the empty namespace via atom!("") and ns!(ident) yields Namespace(atom!(ident)), giving zero-cost static namespace literals used across selector parsing and matching.

nodes.name: document_state.rs
nodes.summary: An invalidation processor for document-wide state changes (e.g. :-moz-window-inactive, print state): on a DocumentState change it iterates every applicable CascadeData's invalidation map document_state_selectors and pushes full-selector self invalidations for the whole document, reusing the TreeStyleInvalidator machinery and delegating restyle side effects to the state_and_attributes helpers.

nodes.name: InvalidationMatchingData
nodes.summary: Struct stored in the matching context's extra data during document-state invalidation, carrying the DocumentState bits that changed so selector matching inside the invalidation pass knows which document-state conditions always match.

nodes.name: DocumentStateInvalidationProcessor
nodes.summary: InvalidationProcessor for changed document state: collect_invalidations walks every CascadeData (rules: Iterator<Item = &CascadeData>) and pushes an Invalidation for each DocumentStateDependency whose state intersects the changed bits, using a visited-tolerant MatchingContext; check_outer_dependency is unreachable (parent-less dependencies only) and invalidated_self/sibling/descendants callbacks delegate to state_and_attributes free functions.

nodes.name: element_wrapper.rs
nodes.summary: Enables selector matching against the pre-restyle state of an element: the ElementSnapshot trait abstracts snapshot data (state, attributes, classes, parts, custom states, lang), Snapshots wraps a SnapshotMap with a one-entry lookup cache, and ElementWrapper implements the selectors crate's Element trait for SelectorImpl so restyle-hint computation can match selectors twice (old vs. new state) and diff the results.

nodes.name: ElementSnapshot
