nodes.summary: Trait over the past state of an element: state(), has_attrs(), id_attr(), has_class(), is_part()/imported_part(), each_class(), has_custom_state(s)/each_custom_state() and lang_attr(); implemented by Gecko's ServoElementSnapshot so ElementWrapper can answer selector matching using stale (pre-change) data.

nodes.name: Snapshots
nodes.summary: A borrowed SnapshotMap plus a Cell-cached (OpaqueElement, Snapshot) of the last lookup, shared by all ElementWrappers of one invalidation pass; exploits the common pattern of consecutive lookups on the same element while matching a compound selector.

nodes.name: ElementWrapper
nodes.summary: Copyable (element, snapshots) pair implementing selectors::Element for SelectorImpl: resolves :link/:visited via visited_handling, matches :lang/:paused/:playing/:heading/custom states and state-flag pseudo-classes against the snapshot when present, answers id/class/attr/part queries from snapshot attributes with live-element fallback, and wraps parents, siblings, shadow hosts, slots and originating elements so traversal keeps using the old-state view; also computes state_changes() as snapshot XOR current state.

nodes.name: invalidation_map.rs
nodes.summary: Builds the per-cascade-data InvalidationMap used for state/attribute invalidations: defines Dependency (selector + offset + chained next for :is/:where/@scope) with its Normal/Relative/Scope invalidation kinds, keyed dependency maps (class, id, element state, document state, other attributes, custom states, tree-structural states), the AdditionalRelativeSelectorInvalidationMap for :has(), and the SelectorDependencyCollector/RelativeSelectorDependencyCollector visitors that note every state- or attribute-sensitive compound selector.

nodes.name: Dependency
nodes.summary: Core unit of style dependence: a Selector plus the offset of the compound it guards, an optional ThinArc-chained next dependency for selector chains and nested :is/:where/@scope lists (with cached, refcounted entries), and a DependencyInvalidationKind describing which direction a change may invalidate; implements SelectorMapEntry, knows when its right combinator is next-sibling, and can create full-selector dummy dependencies for document-state invalidation.

nodes.name: StateDependency
nodes.summary: A Dependency plus the exact ElementState bits it depends on; the SelectorMap entry type of state_affecting_selectors so a given element-state change finds precisely the selectors affected by it.

nodes.name: DocumentStateDependency
nodes.summary: A full-selector Dependency plus the DocumentState bits it depends on; stored in a flat Vec because a document-state change invalidates the entire document, so per-compound offsets are unnecessary.

nodes.name: InvalidationMap
nodes.summary: Per-cascade-data dependency store keyed for cheap invalidation lookups: class_to_selector and id_to_selector (MaybeCaseInsensitiveHashMap of Dependency vectors), state_affecting_selectors (SelectorMap<StateDependency>), document_state_selectors (Vec<DocumentStateDependency>), other_attribute_affecting_selectors by local name, and custom_state_affecting_selectors; provides len/clear/shrink_if_needed for stylist rebuilds.

nodes.name: AdditionalRelativeSelectorInvalidationMap
nodes.summary: Extra dependency data needed only when :has() is used: relative-selector dependencies keyed by tree-structural pseudo-class state, type/local name, or '*' catch-all, plus `used` and needs_ancestors_traversal flags that tell the restyle machinery whether DOM mutations require upward (ancestor/sibling-of-ancestor) traversal.

nodes.name: TSStateForInvalidation
nodes.summary: Bitflags recording which tree-structural pseudo-classes a relative-selector compound depends on (:empty, :nth, :first-child/:last-child edges), with may_be_optimized() identifying unobservable invalidations that can be skipped during DOM-mutation handling.

nodes.name: TSStateDependency
nodes.summary: A Dependency plus its TSStateForInvalidation bits; the SelectorMap entry type of ts_state_to_selector used to invalidate relative-selector anchors on tree-structural pseudo-class-relevant mutations.

nodes.name: SelectorDependencyCollector
nodes.summary: SelectorVisitor walking a complex selector compound by compound: tracks PerCompoundState offsets, a stack of NextDependencyEntry for nested :is/:where lists, and @scope state; adds a Dependency per id/class/attribute/pseudo-class/document-state-sensitive compound into the normal, relative-selector, or additional relative-selector maps via the generic Collector trait, handling allocation errors non-fatally.

nodes.name: RelativeSelectorDependencyCollector
nodes.summary: SelectorVisitor for the inner selectors of :has(): skips the relative anchor compound, maps RelativeSelectorMatchHint (via RelativeSelectorCombinatorCount) to RelativeDependencyInvalidationKind, records type/ts-state/'*' fallback dependencies when a compound lacks unique identifying info, and preserves added_entry across nested selector lists so any DOM manipulation invalidates correctly.

nodes.name: DependencyInvalidationKind
nodes.summary: Enum family classifying what a dependency may affect: DependencyInvalidationKind (FullSelector, Normal, Relative, Scope), NormalDependencyInvalidationKind (Element, ElementAndDescendants, Descendants, Siblings, SlottedElements, Parts, derived from the combinator left of the compound), RelativeDependencyInvalidationKind (Parent, Ancestors, PrevSibling, EarlierSibling and ancestor variants) and ScopeDependencyInvalidationKind (ExplicitScope, ImplicitScope, ScopeEnd).

nodes.name: note_selector_for_invalidation
nodes.summary: Entry point called by the stylist when adding selectors to cascade data: creates a full-selector Dependency, runs the SelectorDependencyCollector over the selector to populate the invalidation, relative-selector and additional relative-selector maps, appends a DocumentStateDependency when the selector touches document state, and returns any @scope dependencies that must be forced at the subject.

nodes.name: invalidator.rs
nodes.summary: Core driver of element style invalidation: defines the InvalidationProcessor strategy trait, the Invalidation unit (dependency + host + scope + offset), DescendantInvalidationLists (DOM, ::slotted, ::part), SiblingTraversalMap for mutation-severed sibling relations, and TreeStyleInvalidator which collects invalidations for an element and walks descendants, siblings, NAC, slotted children and shadow-tree parts matching dependency compounds, plus @scope helpers (NegationScopeVisitor, any_next_has_scope_in_negation, note_scope_dependency_force_at_subject).

nodes.name: InvalidationProcessor
nodes.summary: Strategy trait consumed by TreeStyleInvalidator: exposes the MatchingContext and SiblingTraversalMap, collects self/descendant/sibling invalidations for the starting element, decides whether to descend (should_process_descendants) and receives outcome callbacks (invalidated_self/sibling/descendants, invalidated_highlight_pseudo, check_outer_dependency for :is/:where narrowing, found_relative_selector_invalidation); implemented by the state/attribute, document-state and relative-selector processors.

nodes.name: TreeStyleInvalidator
nodes.summary: Generic engine parameterized by element and processor: invalidate() collects invalidations then recursively processes DOM descendant, pseudo-element/NAC, ::slotted and ::part invalidation lists plus rightward sibling invalidations, matching each Invalidation's dependency compound from its offset (via matches_compound_selector_from, with stack-limit checks and fully-matched short-circuits) and summarizing effects in an InvalidationResult.

nodes.name: Invalidation
nodes.summary: A pending invalidation: borrowed Dependency, rightmost shadow host and @scope element (OpaqueElement), a parse-order offset of the next compound to match, and flags matched_by_any_previous / always_effective_for_next_descendant used to suppress redundant pushes; constructors new/new_subject_invalidation/new_always_effective_for_next_descendant, with kind() classifying the required traversal (sibling vs. DOM/slotted/part descendant).

nodes.name: SiblingTraversalMap
nodes.summary: One-element map recovering sibling relations severed by DOM mutation during :has() invalidation: next_sibling_for/prev_sibling_for return the recorded siblings for the affected element and delegate to the DOM otherwise, letting invalidation traversal cross a removed element's former position.

nodes.name: DescendantInvalidationLists
nodes.summary: Buckets of pending descendant invalidations: dom_descendants (children and pseudo-elements), slotted_descendants (::slotted children) and parts (::part targets), each an InvalidationVector, with is_empty() gating whether descendant traversal runs at all.

nodes.name: InvalidationResult
nodes.summary: Outcome of an invalidation pass over one element: invalidated_self, invalidated_descendants and invalidated_siblings booleans queried via has_* accessors by the restyle traversal to schedule subsequent work.

nodes.name: any_next_has_scope_in_negation
nodes.summary: Uses NegationScopeVisitor (a SelectorVisitor tracking whether it is inside a negation list) to report whether any chained next dependency contains a :scope component inside :not() (e.g. :not(:scope)), which forces scope invalidations to be pushed unconditionally to descendants.

nodes.name: note_scope_dependency_force_at_subject
nodes.summary: Builds invalidations for @scope dependencies: follows the dependency chain, recursing through normal next dependencies while forcing add-once a non-subject compound has been traversed, and otherwise emits over-invalidating subject invalidations (new_subject_invalidation) so scope-rule changes restyle correctly without costly ancestor walks.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for element style invalidation in Stylo: declares the document_state, element_wrapper, invalidation_map, invalidator, relative_selector, restyle_hints and state_and_attributes submodules that together implement restyle propagation due to state, attribute, DOM-mutation and document-state changes.

nodes.name: relative_selector.rs
nodes.summary: Invalidation of element styles for relative selectors (:has()). Implements the dependency collector that gathers relative selector dependencies from the stylist's relative invalidation maps, optimization logic that prunes invalidations by running selector matches on siblings, and inner/outer invalidation processors that walk ancestors and earlier siblings to find and restyle relative selector anchors.

nodes.name: DomMutationOperation
nodes.summary: Enum of the kind of DOM mutation (Insert, Append, Remove, SideEffectPrevSibling, SideEffectNextSibling) a relative selector invalidation is carried out in; its accept() filter decides which dependencies are relevant for the operation.

nodes.name: OptimizationContext
nodes.summary: Context (sibling traversal map, quirks mode, mutation operation) used to try to optimize away relative dependencies, e.g. when a sibling can stand in for the mutating element.

nodes.name: RelativeSelectorInvalidator
nodes.summary: Overall invalidator for relative selector invalidations: gathers dependencies for an element (with snapshots or after DOM mutation) and drives upward/earlier-sibling invalidation to restyle :has() anchors.

nodes.name: AlreadyInvalidatedEntry
nodes.summary: Bookkeeping entry for invalidations emitted right away, tracking element, shadow host, dependency chain, and the leftmost collapse offset so duplicate relative dependencies can be merged.

nodes.name: RelativeSelectorDependencyCollector
nodes.summary: Collects relative selector dependencies for an element (and optionally its subtree) from id/class/state/attribute/TS-state maps, collapsing identical dependencies and applying optimization to skip unnecessary work.

nodes.name: RelativeSelectorOuterInvalidationProcessor
nodes.summary: InvalidationProcessor that blindly invalidates everything outside of a relative selector when the tree has mutated (snapshots unusable), checking whether a candidate anchor actually matches the selector part left of :has().

nodes.name: RelativeSelectorInnerInvalidationProcessor
nodes.summary: InvalidationProcessor for selectors inside a relative selector; walks outward through Normal dependencies and records relative selector invalidations found during tree-style invalidation, using snapshots when available.

nodes.name: invalidation_can_collapse
nodes.summary: Detects identical relative dependencies occurring at different compounds of the same selector (e.g. :has(.item .item)) so their invalidations can be collapsed into one.

nodes.name: RelativeSelectorInvalidator.invalidate_relative_selectors_for_this
nodes.summary: Gathers relative selector dependencies for the triggering element across all cascade data (with scope) via a caller-provided gather callback, then runs the invalidation if anything was collected.

nodes.name: RelativeSelectorInvalidator.invalidate_relative_selectors_for_dom_mutation
nodes.summary: Gathers relative selector dependencies for an element (and optionally its subtree) after a DOM mutation, applying selector flags and TS-state optimizations, then invalidates from the collected dependencies.

nodes.name: RelativeSelectorDependencyCollector.collect_all_dependencies_for_element
nodes.summary: Walks the id/class/custom-state/attribute/state and additional relative selector maps for one element, filtering by DomMutationOperation and TS-state optimizations, and adds matching dependencies.

nodes.name: RelativeSelectorInvalidator.invalidate_upwards
nodes.summary: Core of relative invalidation: travels ancestor and/or earlier-sibling directions per RelativeDependencyInvalidationKind, restricted to elements whose relative selector search direction flags allow it, to reach potential anchors.

nodes.name: RelativeSelectorInvalidator.handle_anchor
nodes.summary: Handles a potential relative selector anchor: checks ANCHORS_RELATIVE_SELECTOR flags, runs the outer dependency through RelativeSelectorOuterInvalidationProcessor with a TreeStyleInvalidator, and invokes the invalidated callback.

nodes.name: restyle_hints.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the RestyleHint bitflags, an optimization to avoid unnecessarily re-matching selectors during restyle traversals: RESTYLE_SELF/DESCENDANTS, RECASCADE_*, animation cascade replacements (CSS animations/transitions/SMIL), style-attribute and style-query related hints, plus propagation logic to children.

nodes.name: RestyleHint
nodes.summary: bitflags! type (u16) describing what restyle work an element needs: selector rematch of self/pseudos/descendants, recascades, animation-only cascade level replacements, style attribute, and style-query/font/writing-mode dependency hints.

nodes.name: RestyleHint.restyle_subtree
nodes.summary: Builds a hint (RESTYLE_SELF | RESTYLE_DESCENDANTS) indicating the element and all descendants must be fully restyled.

nodes.name: RestyleHint.propagate
nodes.summary: Propagates this restyle hint to child elements, clearing self bits and computing the child-appropriate hint; during animation-only traversals it only removes animation hints and propagates nothing.

nodes.name: RestyleHint.for_animations
nodes.summary: Returns the union of the animation cascade replacement hints (RESTYLE_SMIL | RESTYLE_CSS_ANIMATIONS | RESTYLE_CSS_TRANSITIONS).

nodes.name: state_and_attributes.rs
nodes.summary: Invalidation processor for style changes due to element state and attribute changes: compares snapshots against current elements via check_dependency, scans the invalidation map for id/class/state/attribute dependencies, and emits descendant/sibling invalidations and restyle hints.

nodes.name: StateAndAttrInvalidationProcessor
nodes.summary: InvalidationProcessor driven by the TreeStyleInvalidator for state/attribute changes; builds a Collector from the element's snapshot diff (classes, id, custom states, attributes, state changes) and processes the document and shadow invalidation maps.

nodes.name: Collector
nodes.summary: Internal collector that scans an InvalidationMap for dependencies affected by removed/added ids, classes, custom states, changed attributes and state changes; checks each dependency against snapshot vs current element and records invalidations.

nodes.name: check_dependency
nodes.summary: Checks a dependency against an element and its snapshot wrapper (matching now vs then with matches_selector_kleene) to see whether the dependency's match result changed, handling scope nesting and unknown Kleene values.

nodes.name: should_process_descendants
nodes.summary: Returns whether descendants of an element should be processed for style invalidation (skips display:none subtrees and subtrees already hinted RESTYLE_DESCENDANTS).

nodes.name: propagate_dirty_bit_up_to
nodes.summary: Propagates the dirty-descendants bit from a child up the traversal-parent chain to the given ancestor, accounting for flattened-tree boundaries in shadow DOM.

nodes.name: invalidated_self
nodes.summary: Inserts RestyleHint::RESTYLE_SELF into the element's ElementData hint after its style is invalidated.

nodes.name: invalidated_sibling
nodes.summary: Sets RESTYLE_SELF on a sibling and propagates the dirty-descendants bit to the common parent when traversal parents differ.

nodes.name: push_invalidation
nodes.summary: Routes an Invalidation into the right list (dom_descendants, slotted_descendants, parts, or sibling invalidations) based on its DependencyInvalidationKind, reporting whether the element itself is invalidated.

nodes.name: dependency_may_be_relevant
nodes.summary: Shared helper returning whether a dependency could still cause more invalidation than already done, depending on kind (Element, SlottedElements, Parts, Descendants, Siblings, Scope).

nodes.name: media_queries.rs
nodes.summary: Invalidation support for media-query-affected rules: MediaListKey (address-based key for media lists), ToMediaListKey trait, EffectiveMediaQueryResults cache of which media lists matched last evaluation, and PotentiallyEffectiveMediaRules iteration condition.

nodes.name: MediaListKey
nodes.summary: Opaque usize key identifying a media list by its stable address, used to cache media query evaluation results across style flushes.

nodes.name: ToMediaListKey
nodes.summary: Trait implemented by items that can hold a MediaList (StylesheetContents, ImportRule, MediaRule), defaulting to using the item's address as key.

nodes.name: EffectiveMediaQueryResults
nodes.summary: Holds the set of MediaListKeys that evaluated as effective during the last media query evaluation pass, used to detect media-query-driven invalidations.

nodes.name: PotentiallyEffectiveMediaRules
nodes.summary: NestedRuleIterationCondition that allows all @media and @import rules regardless of effectiveness (for invalidation analysis) while delegating @document and @supports to EffectiveRules.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for style invalidation code, exposing the element, media_queries, stylesheets, and viewport_units invalidation submodules.

nodes.name: stylesheets.rs
nodes.summary: Invalidations due to stylesheet changes: StylesheetInvalidationSet collects id/class/local-name invalidations (element or subtree scope) from effective rules, tracks a CascadeDataDifference, decides full-tree invalidation for unanalyzable rules, and applies the invalidations to the DOM tree; also handles @position-try fallback invalidation.

nodes.name: RuleChangeKind
nodes.summary: Enum of what changed for a rule: Generic, Insertion, Removal, StyleRuleDeclarations, or PositionTryDeclarations; generic changes force more aggressive invalidation.

nodes.name: StylesheetInvalidationSet
nodes.summary: Set of invalidations caused by stylesheet changes, stored in a SimpleBucketsMap of id/class/local-name to InvalidationKind (None/Element/Scope), with a style_fully_invalid fast path and an incremental CascadeDataDifference.

nodes.name: StylesheetInvalidationSet.collect_invalidations_for
nodes.summary: Analyzes a stylesheet's effective rules and collects invalidations ahead of a style flush, stopping early once the tree is marked fully invalid.

nodes.name: StylesheetInvalidationSet.process_style
nodes.summary: Applies the invalidation set to a DOM subtree: inserts restyle_subtree hints when fully invalid, otherwise walks the tree matching elements (and snapshots) against collected ids/classes/local names.

nodes.name: StylesheetInvalidationSet.collect_invalidations
nodes.summary: Scans a selector for its outermost id/class/local-name left of an ancestor combinator, preferring subtree-scope invalidations and higher-specificity keys; bails to invalidate_fully when the selector can't be handled.

nodes.name: StylesheetInvalidationSet.rule_changed
nodes.summary: Entry point when a CSS rule mutates: handles @position-try declaration changes via the cascade data difference, collects invalidations for the rule and its effective children, and honors generic changes conservatively.

nodes.name: StylesheetInvalidationSet.collect_invalidations_for_rule
nodes.summary: Per-rule invalidation collection: style rules scan their selectors; keyframes, scope, layer statements, custom-media and unsupported rules mark the tree fully invalid; media/import/supports etc. are handled via rule iteration.

nodes.name: invalidate_position_try
nodes.summary: Recursively invalidates absolutely positioned elements whose position-try fallback names match the changed set, invoking callbacks for self invalidation and invalidated descendants.

nodes.name: viewport_units.rs
nodes.summary: Invalidates style of all elements depending on viewport units (svh/lvh/dvh etc.): walks the tree inserting RESTYLE_SELF for query-dependent usage or RECASCADE_SELF for declaration-dependent usage, and maintains dirty-descendants bits.

nodes.name: invalidate
nodes.summary: Public entry point that starts the recursive viewport-unit invalidation at the given root element and reports whether anything was invalidated.

nodes.name: invalidate_recursively
nodes.summary: Recursive helper consulting ElementData's ViewportUnitUsage to insert RESTYLE_SELF (FromQuery) or RECASCADE_SELF (FromDeclaration), skipping already-invalid subtrees and setting dirty-descendants when children changed.

nodes.name: logical_geometry.rs
nodes.summary: Flow-relative geometry: WritingMode bitflags derived from writing-mode/direction/text-orientation style structs, plus LogicalSize/LogicalPoint/LogicalMargin/LogicalRect and logical/physical axis/side/corner enums for converting between physical and flow-relative space.

nodes.name: WritingMode
nodes.summary: bitflags! (u8) representing the resolved writing mode (VERTICAL, INLINE_REVERSED, VERTICAL_LR, LINE_INVERTED, RTL, VERTICAL_SIDEWAYS, TEXT_SIDEWAYS, UPRIGHT) with constructors from InheritedBox style structs and conversion helpers to/from physical coordinates.

nodes.name: WritingModeProperty
nodes.summary: Parsed writing-mode property values (horizontal-tb, vertical-rl, vertical-lr, and gecko-only sideways-rl/sideways-lr) with SVG legacy aliases.

nodes.name: BlockFlowDirection
nodes.summary: Enum of block flow directions (TopToBottom, RightToLeft, LeftToRight) derived from a WritingMode.

nodes.name: InlineBaseDirection
nodes.summary: Enum of inline base directions (LeftToRight, RightToLeft) derived from a WritingMode.

nodes.name: LogicalSize
nodes.summary: Flow-relative size (inline and block extents) generic over the coordinate value, with conversion to/from physical Size2D given a WritingMode.

nodes.name: LogicalPoint
nodes.summary: Flow-relative point (inline-start/block-start offsets) with conversions to physical Point2D requiring a containing LogicalSize/WritingMode.

nodes.name: LogicalMargin
nodes.summary: Flow-relative edge offsets (block-start/end, inline-start/end) convertible from physical SideOffsets2D per WritingMode, supporting arithmetic and deflating/inflating rects.

nodes.name: LogicalRect
nodes.summary: Flow-relative rectangle (start offsets plus inline/block sizes) with conversions to/from physical Rect and support for LogicalMargin add/sub and geometric predicates.

nodes.name: LogicalAxis
nodes.summary: Enum of logical axes (Inline, Block) that can be resolved to a physical axis given a WritingMode.

nodes.name: LogicalSide
nodes.summary: Enum of logical sides (InlineStart, InlineEnd, BlockStart, BlockEnd) with WritingMode-based resolution to physical sides.

nodes.name: LogicalCorner
nodes.summary: Enum of logical corners (StartStart, StartEnd, EndStart, EndEnd) with WritingMode-based resolution to physical corners.

nodes.name: macros.rs
nodes.summary: Macro helpers for the style crate: trivial_to_computed_value, try_match_ident_ignore_ascii_case for keyword parsing, gecko/servo local_name!/ns! shims, and a size_of_test! compile-time size assertion.

nodes.name: trivial_to_computed_value
nodes.summary: Macro implementing ToComputedValue for types whose computed value is themselves (identity conversion).

nodes.name: try_match_ident_ignore_ascii_case
nodes.summary: Macro that parses an identifier and matches it ASCII-case-insensitively against keyword arms, returning an UnexpectedIdent selector parse error otherwise.

nodes.name: size_of_test
nodes.summary: Macro asserting at compile time (on 64-bit targets) that a type has the expected byte size.

nodes.name: media_list.rs
nodes.summary: MediaList: parses a comma-separated media query list per the Media Queries spec (invalid queries become 'not all'), evaluates it against a Device with custom-media support, reports viewport dependency, and implements CSSOM appendMedium/deleteMedium.

nodes.name: MediaList
nodes.summary: A list of MediaQuery values implementing parsing, evaluation (empty list matches; Kleene OR across queries with qualifier negation), viewport-dependency checks, and CSSOM medium append/delete.

nodes.name: MediaList.parse
nodes.summary: Parses a media query list under ParsingMode::MEDIA_QUERY_CONDITION, logging contextual errors and substituting never-matching queries for invalid entries per spec error handling.

nodes.name: MediaList.evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluates the whole media list against a Device, creating a computed::Context for media query evaluation and treating unknown results as false.

nodes.name: MediaList.matches
nodes.summary: Kleene-value match of each query's media type and condition against a pre-existing context, applying the 'not' qualifier; an empty list matches.

nodes.name: MediaList.append_medium
nodes.summary: CSSOM appendMedium: parses the medium string and appends it after removing duplicates, returning false on parse failure; matches Gecko/Edge behavior.

nodes.name: MediaList.delete_medium
nodes.summary: CSSOM deleteMedium: parses the medium string and removes all equal queries, returning whether anything was removed.

nodes.name: media_query.rs
nodes.summary: MediaQuery per the Media Queries spec: qualifier (only/not), media type (all or concrete custom-ident), and an optional QueryCondition; includes parsing, CSS serialization, never-matching construction, and viewport-dependency detection.

nodes.name: Qualifier
nodes.summary: Enum of media query qualifiers: Only (hide from legacy UAs) and Not (negation).

nodes.name: MediaType
nodes.summary: Concrete media type as a CustomIdent, with screen/print constructors and parsing that rejects reserved keywords (not/or/and/only/layer) and lowercases per CSSOM serialization.

nodes.name: MediaQuery
nodes.summary: A single media query: optional Qualifier, MediaQueryType, and optional QueryCondition; supports parsing, ToCss serialization (including the 'all'/' and ' rules), and viewport-dependency via cumulative feature flags.

nodes.name: MediaQueryType
nodes.summary: Enum All or Concrete(MediaType) with parsing of the 'all' keyword and matching against a device MediaType.

nodes.name: MediaQuery.parse
nodes.summary: Parses an optional qualifier and explicit media type, then either a bare QueryCondition (FeatureType::Media) or an 'and'-joined condition, per the media query grammar.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for media queries, re-exporting MediaList, MediaQuery, MediaQueryType, MediaType, and Qualifier from its media_list and media_query submodules.

nodes.name: parallel.rs
nodes.summary: Parallel DOM traversal for styling built on Rayon: distributes SendNode work chunks across a ScopeFifo thread pool, keeps a local work queue per thread, tracks DOM depth, and defines stack size and safety-margin constants.

nodes.name: style_trees
nodes.summary: Processes discovered nodes breadth-wise with pre/postorder traversal callbacks, spawning excess discovered children to other threads when above work_unit_max while keeping the configured local queue size.

nodes.name: distribute_work
nodes.summary: Splits an iterator of SendNodes into VecDeque chunks of work_unit_max and hands each to distribute_one_chunk on the thread pool.

nodes.name: distribute_one_chunk
nodes.summary: Spawns one fifo-scoped Rayon job that ensures a thread-local style context, builds a StyleContext, and recurses into style_trees for the chunk.

nodes.name: piecewise_linear.rs
nodes.summary: Piecewise linear function support for CSS linear() easing: entry/function representations with spec-compliant at() evaluation (asymptote extension outside the domain), plus a builder that resolves deferred x positions by even distribution.

nodes.name: PiecewiseLinearFunctionEntry
nodes.summary: A single (x, y) point of a piecewise linear function, serializable as 'y x%'.

nodes.name: PiecewiseLinearFunction
nodes.summary: An ArcSlice of entries representing a piecewise linear function with spec-compliant output computation for linear easing, including identity, constant, and extrapolation cases.

nodes.name: PiecewiseLinearFunctionBuilder
nodes.summary: Builder accumulating entries with optional x values, enforcing monotonic x and assigning deferred x values evenly between defined neighbors on build().

nodes.name: PiecewiseLinearFunction.at
nodes.summary: Computes the y output for input x per css-easing-2: y=x when empty, constant when single entry, and slope extension from the first/last asymptote outside the defined domain.

nodes.name: PiecewiseLinearFunctionBuilder.build
nodes.summary: Resolves entries whose x was left undefined by evenly dividing the gap between the surrounding defined x values, then produces the final PiecewiseLinearFunction.

nodes.name: prefs.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the crate::pref! macro to read static preference values, allowing gecko/servo-specific overrides for preferences that exist in only one embedding.

nodes.name: pref
nodes.summary: Exported macro reading a static preference via static_prefs::pref!, with optional 'gecko =' or 'servo =' literal overrides depending on the build feature.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for CSS Properties and Values (css-properties-values-api): registry, @property rule, syntax string parsing, and registered custom property values.

nodes.name: registry.rs
nodes.summary: Registered custom property storage: PropertyRegistration (validated name/descriptors/url data/source location) and ScriptRegistry, the window's registered property set keyed by Atom with no-override register().

nodes.name: PropertyRegistration
nodes.summary: A computed, already-validated custom property registration holding the PropertyRuleName, Descriptors, the UrlExtraData used for its initial value, and source location.

nodes.name: ScriptRegistry
nodes.summary: The script-side registry of custom properties (window's RegisteredPropertySet slot), a PrecomputedHashMap from Atom to PropertyRegistration with get/register accessors.

nodes.name: rule.rs
nodes.summary: The @property at-rule: parses the descriptor block into a PropertyRegistration (requiring syntax and inherits descriptors and a valid initial value), computes/validates initial values, serializes CSSPropertyRule, and defines PropertyRuleName/Inherits/InitialValue types.

nodes.name: parse_property_block
nodes.summary: Parses a @property rule body via DescriptorParser, reporting per-descriptor errors and enforcing that syntax and inherits are present and the initial value validates, yielding a PropertyRegistration.

nodes.name: PropertyRegistrationError
nodes.summary: Errors for property registration: NoInitialValue, InvalidInitialValue, InitialValueNotComputationallyIndependent.

nodes.name: PropertyRuleName
nodes.summary: Wrapper around CustomPropertyName that serializes with the leading '--' prefix for @property and registration APIs.

nodes.name: Inherits
nodes.summary: Parsed value of the @property inherits descriptor (true/false) with ASCII-case-insensitive parsing and a dedicated parse error kind.

nodes.name: ascii.rs
nodes.summary: Small helper that trims leading/trailing ASCII whitespace from a syntax string, used in the 'consume a syntax definition' algorithm.

nodes.name: trim_ascii_whitespace
nodes.summary: Byte-level trim of ASCII whitespace from both ends of a &str, returning the trimmed subslice (or an empty slice).

nodes.name: data_type.rs
nodes.summary: Syntax component data types for @property: the DataType enum of supported <type> names with parsing/serialization/pre-multiplication, and DependentDataTypes bitflags tracking length/color dependence for computed-value invalidation.

nodes.name: DataType
nodes.summary: Supported syntax data type names (<length>, <number>, <color>, <transform-list>, <string>, ...) with from_str parsing, ToCss, unpremultiply (transform-list to transform-function+), and dependent-type classification.

nodes.name: DependentDataTypes
nodes.summary: bitflags (LENGTH, COLOR) marking which external properties (font-size etc., color-scheme) a registered property's values may depend on.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Parsing and serialization of the @property syntax string per css-properties-values-api: Descriptor (components + specified string, universal '*'), multipliers (+ and #), syntax components of data type or ident names, and both cssparser-based and hand-rolled parsers.

nodes.name: Descriptor
nodes.summary: A parsed syntax definition: Vec<Component> plus the optionally preserved specified string; universal when empty; parses from CSS parser or string, computes dependent types, and serializes back to CSS.

nodes.name: Multiplier
nodes.summary: Space ('+') or Comma ('#') list multiplier for a syntax component.

nodes.name: Component
nodes.summary: A syntax component: ComponentName (DataType or Ident) with optional Multiplier, supporting un-premultiplication of pre-multiplied names like <transform-list>.

nodes.name: ComponentName
nodes.summary: Either a DataType name or a CustomIdent literal name in a syntax definition, with pre-multiplied name handling.

nodes.name: value.rs
nodes.summary: Specified and computed values for registered custom properties: generic component enums over CSS types, ComponentList with multipliers, Value with url data for uncomputing, syntax-driven parsing/computation, attr() taint propagation, and CustomAnimatedValue bridging declarations and animations.

nodes.name: GenericValueComponent
nodes.summary: Generic enum of value components (Length, Number, Percentage, LengthPercentage, Color, Image, Url, Integer, Angle, Time, Resolution, TransformFunction, TransformList, CustomIdent, String) parameterized over specified/computed types, with animation and serialization support.

nodes.name: ComponentList
nodes.summary: A list of value components plus its Multiplier, animatable component-wise when multipliers agree, serialized space- or comma-separated.

nodes.name: Value
nodes.summary: A registered custom property value (ValueInner) plus the URL data needed to uncompute it and an attr()-taint flag; supports animation, equality ignoring metadata, and conversion to variable values.

nodes.name: ValueInner
nodes.summary: Inner representation: a single Component, a universal-syntax Arc<ComputedPropertyValue>, or a ComponentList for multiplied syntax components.

nodes.name: CustomAnimatedValue
nodes.summary: Animated value of a custom property (name plus optional ComputedValue); converts from computed contexts or declarations via the stylist's property registration handling initial/inherit/unset keywords.

nodes.name: AllowComputationallyDependent
nodes.summary: Flag selecting ParsingMode for value parsing: only computationally independent values (No) or also dependent ones like 3em/var() (Yes), per css-properties-values-api computationally-independent rules.

nodes.name: SpecifiedValue.compute
nodes.summary: Parses a registered custom property value against its syntax descriptor and converts it to the computed value in the given context.

nodes.name: SpecifiedValue.parse
nodes.summary: Validates input against a syntax Descriptor: universal syntax parses as an untyped variable value; otherwise a hand-rolled Parser matches each component (with multipliers) into a Component/ValueInner result.

nodes.name: ComputedValue.to_declared_value
nodes.summary: Uncomputes a registered value back into a CustomDeclarationValue for the cascade, re-tainting universal values whose wrapper was attr()-tainted to avoid laundering attribute-derived URLs.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module hub for code shared between media queries and container queries. Declares the condition, feature, feature_expression, and values submodules and re-exports QueryCondition, FeatureFlags, FeatureType, QueryFeatureExpression, and QueryStyleRange.

nodes.name: condition.rs
nodes.summary: Query conditions per mediaqueries-4/css-contain-3: QueryCondition tree (Feature, Custom media reference, Not/Operation/InParens, Style, -moz-pref, GeneralEnclosed) plus StyleQuery/StyleFeature for style container queries against custom properties. Parsing via the shared OperationParser grammar and Kleene 3-valued matching (KleeneValue) so <general-enclosed> yields Unknown instead of failure.

nodes.name: feature.rs
nodes.summary: Query feature plumbing: Evaluator enum describing the value kind each feature parses/evaluates (length, integer, float, bool-integer, ratio, resolution, enumerated keywords), FeatureFlags bitflags (chrome/UA only, -webkit- prefix, container axis requirements, viewport-dependent, style), QueryFeatureDescription, and the keyword_evaluator!/feature! helper macros.

nodes.name: feature_expression.rs
nodes.summary: Parsing/evaluation of feature expressions like (foo: bar) and (width >= 400px): QueryFeatureExpression with Empty/Single/LegacyRange/Range kinds (legacy min-/max- syntax and modern mq-range-context), FeatureType selecting the MEDIA_FEATURES/CONTAINER_FEATURES tables, QueryExpressionValue unions, and QueryStyleRange for style() ranges including custom-property resolution with cycle protection.

nodes.name: values.rs
nodes.summary: Feature value enums shared between media and container features: Orientation (portrait/landscape, square counts as portrait) and PrefersColorScheme (light/dark).

nodes.name: Operator
nodes.summary: Binary And/Or boolean operator combining conditions; serializes as 'and'/'or'. Distinct from the range-comparison Operator in feature_expression.rs.

nodes.name: OperationParser
nodes.summary: Trait for parsing conditions chained with AND/OR or prefixed with NOT (mediaqueries-5 <media-condition> grammar). Implemented by both QueryCondition and StyleQuery; parse_internal drives the loop, leaves implement parse_in_parens/new_not/new_operation.

nodes.name: OperationParser::parse_internal
nodes.summary: Parses 'not <cond>' or '<cond> (and|or <cond>)*', rejecting 'or' when AllowOr::No (legacy media syntax). Collects operands by delegating each to the impl's parse_in_parens and builds the tree via new_operation/new_not.

nodes.name: try_parse_block
nodes.summary: Speculatively parses a nested block; on error, reports the contextual CSS error (so it is not silently swallowed by a <general-enclosed> fallback) and returns None so callers can fall back.

nodes.name: StyleQuery
nodes.summary: css-conditional-5 <style-query> tree used by style() container queries: Not / Operation / InParens / Feature(StyleFeature) / GeneralEnclosed. Matching evaluates against inherited custom properties and always marks the element DEPENDS_ON_CONTAINER_STYLE_QUERY.

nodes.name: StyleQuery::parse
nodes.summary: Parses a style query: tries StyleFeature ('--foo: bar') first, otherwise parses a full condition (AllowOr::Yes) and wraps it in InParens.

nodes.name: StyleQuery::parse_in_parens
nodes.summary: OperationParser impl for StyleQuery (container features only). Accepts a parenthesized style query or falls back to '<ident>: <any-value>' captured verbatim as GeneralEnclosed, which evaluates to false but keeps the query valid.

nodes.name: StyleQuery::matches
nodes.summary: Evaluates the style-query tree with Kleene logic: Not negates, Operation folds via KleeneValue::any_false (and) / any (or), GeneralEnclosed is Unknown; flags ComputedValueFlags::DEPENDS_ON_CONTAINER_STYLE_QUERY on the builder.

nodes.name: StyleQuery::enabled
nodes.summary: Style queries parse only when the layout.css.style-queries.enabled pref is on and the feature type is Container.

nodes.name: StyleFeature
nodes.summary: css-conditional-5 <style-feature>: either Plain (custom property name with optional value, StyleFeaturePlain) or Range (a QueryStyleRange comparison).

nodes.name: StyleFeature::matches
nodes.summary: Dispatches matching to StyleFeaturePlain::matches for plain custom-property features or QueryStyleRange::evaluate for range features.

nodes.name: StyleFeaturePlain
nodes.summary: A style feature of a custom property name plus an optional value: either a CSS-wide keyword (StyleFeatureValue::Keyword) or a parsed custom_properties::SpecifiedValue held in an Arc.

nodes.name: StyleFeaturePlain::parse
nodes.summary: Parses '--name', optionally ': value' where the value is a CSS-wide keyword or a custom property value (parsed with namespace prefixes and url data); '!important' after the value is allowed and ignored.

nodes.name: StyleFeaturePlain::matches
nodes.summary: Compares the query value against the inherited custom property for the registration from the Stylist. With var() references in the query value it substitutes first (substitute_and_compare); otherwise computes the variable value directly. No container context means guaranteed-false; handles unset/initial/inherit keywords and treats revert/revert-layer/revert-rule as false.

nodes.name: StyleFeaturePlain::substitute_and_compare
nodes.summary: Builds ComputedSubstitutionFunctions from inherited custom properties, runs custom_properties::substitute (tracking attr taint), then re-parses/computes the resulting CSS via SpecifiedRegisteredValue::compute (AllowComputationallyDependent) and compares with the current registered value; substitution failure means 'is none' semantics.

nodes.name: MozPrefFeature
nodes.summary: Chrome-only -moz-pref(<name>[, <value>]) media feature; the value is a MozPrefFeatureValue (none/bool/integer/string, no calc).

nodes.name: MozPrefFeature::matches
nodes.summary: gecko: computes the stored value and evaluates the pref through the Gecko_EvalMozPrefFeature FFI binding; servo: returns KleeneValue::Unknown.

nodes.name: QueryCondition
nodes.summary: The main query condition tree shared by media and container queries: Feature(QueryFeatureExpression), Custom(custom media reference), Not, Operation(Box<[QueryCondition]>, And/Or), InParens, Style(StyleQuery), MozPref, and GeneralEnclosed which keeps the source text, UrlExtraData, and FeatureFlags for later var()-substitution re-parse.

nodes.name: QueryCondition::parse
nodes.summary: Public entry point: parses a single condition allowing 'or' via OperationParser::parse_internal.

nodes.name: QueryCondition::parse_disallow_or
nodes.summary: Legacy syntax variant used by media queries that only allows 'and'-joined conditions.

nodes.name: QueryCondition::parse_in_parens
nodes.summary: OperationParser impl: parses '('<condition>')', style(...) (behind pref), -moz-pref(...), or falls back to capturing the block/function source as GeneralEnclosed (recording STYLE flags when style() failed to parse).

nodes.name: QueryCondition::matches
nodes.summary: Kleene 3-valued evaluation of the condition tree against the computed::Context: dispatches per variant to CustomMediaEvaluator, QueryFeatureExpression::matches, StyleQuery::matches, or MozPrefFeature::matches; and/or fold via KleeneValue::any_false/any; matches_general re-evaluates GeneralEnclosed after substitution.

nodes.name: QueryCondition::matches_general
nodes.summary: For a GeneralEnclosed condition inside a container query: parses the captured CSS text as a custom property value, substitutes var()/attr() references with ComputedSubstitutionFunctions, re-parses the substituted CSS as a QueryCondition (author origin, Container rule type) and evaluates it; returns Unknown whenever substitution or re-parse fails or the result is still GeneralEnclosed.

nodes.name: QueryCondition::cumulative_flags
nodes.summary: Walks the tree with visit() and unions FeatureFlags: STYLE from style() conditions, per-feature flags from Feature expressions, and stored flags from GeneralEnclosed; used for container query requirements.

nodes.name: Evaluator
nodes.summary: Per-feature evaluator enum that also determines the parsed value kind: Length, OptionalLength, Integer, Float, BoolInteger, NumberRatio, OptionalNumberRatio, Resolution, and Enumerated { parser, serializer, evaluator } for keyword features.

nodes.name: keyword_evaluator!
nodes.summary: Macro that builds an Evaluator::Enumerated from a keyword enum: __parse (Parse + discriminant cast), __serialize (FromPrimitive + ToCss), __evaluate ( KleeneValue::from(actual_evaluator)); asserts keyword features do not accept ranges.

nodes.name: FeatureFlags
nodes.summary: u8 bitflags altering parsing/evaluation: CHROME_AND_UA_ONLY, WEBKIT_PREFIX, CONTAINER_REQUIRES_{INLINE,BLOCK,WIDTH,HEIGHT}_AXIS, VIEWPORT_DEPENDENT, STYLE; helpers parsing_requirements(), all_container_axes(), container_axes().

nodes.name: QueryFeatureDescription
nodes.summary: Static descriptor of a query feature: lowercase name Atom, allows_ranges (min-/max- and range support), the Evaluator, and FeatureFlags; instances are constructed by the feature! macro in the MEDIA_FEATURES/CONTAINER_FEATURES tables.

nodes.name: FeatureType
nodes.summary: Media or Container discriminator; features() returns the static table (gecko/servo MEDIA_FEATURES or container_rule CONTAINER_FEATURES) and find_feature locates a feature by Atom name.

nodes.name: Operator
nodes.summary: Range comparison operators =, <, <=, >, >=: parse enforces no whitespace between </> and =, evaluate maps an Ordering to bool, and is_compatible_with validates multi-range operator pairs.

nodes.name: QueryFeatureExpressionKind
nodes.summary: The four expression forms: Empty (bare feature), Single value, LegacyRange (min-*:/max-*: value), and Range { left, right } for mq-range-context; evaluate() compares a context value against the parsed values with partial_cmp per operator.

nodes.name: QueryFeatureExpressionKind::evaluate
nodes.summary: Generic range evaluation: Empty is true for a non-zero context value; Single compares equality; LegacyRange accepts equal/min-greater/max-less; Range evaluates both sides (left operand compared reversed) short-circuiting on failure.

nodes.name: QueryFeatureExpression
nodes.summary: A (feature: value) expression: FeatureType + feature_index into the static table + QueryFeatureExpressionKind. Handles legacy min-/max- syntax, -webkit- prefixes, pref-gated features, and modern multi-range syntax; matches() runs the feature's Evaluator getter and compares via the kind.

nodes.name: QueryFeatureExpression::parse_feature_name
nodes.summary: Parses an optionally -webkit-/min-/max- prefixed feature ident, lowercases and looks it up in the feature table, and validates pref-gating (disabled_by_pref), parsing requirements (chrome/UA-only, webkit prefix) and range support; returns the feature index and optional LegacyRange.

nodes.name: QueryFeatureExpression::parse_in_parenthesis_block
nodes.summary: Main parse entry once the parenthesis is consumed: parse the feature name then a colon or operator to distinguish Empty, Single, LegacyRange, and Range forms; falls back to parse_multi_range_syntax when no leading feature name parses.

nodes.name: QueryFeatureExpression::parse_multi_range_syntax
nodes.summary: Parses '(value <op> name [<op> value])': scans forward to locate the bare feature name, resets the input, then parses left value + operator, re-checks the feature name, and optionally a compatible right operator/value (left_op.is_compatible_with).

nodes.name: QueryFeatureExpression::matches
nodes.summary: Dispatches on the feature's Evaluator: calls the feature getter with the computed::Context, converts the parsed QueryExpressionValue (expect! ensures kind/evaluator agreement), and compares via kind.evaluate; Optional* evaluators return KleeneValue::Unknown when the context value is absent; Enumerated delegates to the feature's evaluator fn.

nodes.name: QueryExpressionValue
nodes.summary: Value found or expected in an expression: Length, Integer, Float, BoolInteger, NumberRatio, Resolution, Enumerated(KeywordDiscriminant), plus style-range-only Keyword (CSS-wide), Percentage, Angle, Time, Custom (dashed ident) and Function (var()/attr()/env() stored as a CustomVariableValue for later substitution).

nodes.name: QueryExpressionValue::parse
nodes.summary: Parses the value according to the feature's Evaluator kind (Length/Integer/Number/Ratio/Resolution, BoolInteger restricted to 0/1, or Enumerated via the feature's keyword parser).

nodes.name: QueryExpressionValue::parse_for_style_range
nodes.summary: Tries number, percentage, length, angle, time, resolution, then a dashed-ident custom property name or a substitution function (var/attr/env classified by SubstitutionFunctionKind) whose text is stored as a CustomVariableValue.

nodes.name: QueryStyleRange
nodes.summary: css-conditional-5 <style-range> for style() container queries: StyleRange2 (value1 op1 value2) or StyleRange3 (chained v1 op1 v2 op2 v3), evaluated against computed values.

nodes.name: QueryStyleRange::parse
nodes.summary: Parses value <op> value and, when a compatible second operator follows, a third value into StyleRange3; otherwise produces StyleRange2.

nodes.name: QueryStyleRange::evaluate
nodes.summary: Resolves each side via resolve_value and compares with compare_values, applying op1 (and op2 with the chained middle value for StyleRange3); unresolved sides yield false via Option semantics, converted to KleeneValue.

nodes.name: QueryStyleRange::resolve_value
nodes.summary: Resolves a QueryExpressionValue to a computed Component: Custom looks up the registered custom property in inherited_custom_properties (Component value directly; Universal re-parsed via resolve_universal with a visited-set cycle guard; List unsupported); Function substitutes via custom_properties::substitute then resolves; typed values convert with to_computed_value; CSS-wide keywords do not resolve.

nodes.name: QueryStyleRange::resolve_universal
nodes.summary: For universal-syntax custom property values: re-parses the current CSS text with parse_for_style_range (fresh author-origin ParserContext) and recurses into resolve_value; the shared visited_set of custom property names protects against infinite mutual recursion.

nodes.name: QueryStyleRange::compare_values
nodes.summary: partial_cmp across matching Component kinds (length, number, resolution via dppx, percentage, angle, time); a zero number is comparable against a length (treated as zero length), any other mixing yields None.

nodes.name: Orientation
nodes.summary: Portrait/Landscape enum shared by the orientation media and container features; eval treats a square viewport as portrait per spec.

nodes.name: Orientation::eval
nodes.summary: Evaluates an orientation query from a Size2D<Au> getter: no query value means true; landscape iff width > height, otherwise portrait.

nodes.name: PrefersColorScheme
nodes.summary: Light/Dark keyword values for the prefers-color-scheme media feature, shared between backends.

nodes.name: scoped_tls.rs
nodes.summary: Stack-scoped thread-local storage for rayon thread pools: a fixed array of per-thread slots alive for the 'scope lifetime, cleared by the owning thread after restyling.

nodes.name: ScopedTLS
nodes.summary: ScopedTLS<'scope, T: Send>: STYLO_MAX_THREADS RefCell<Option<T>> slots indexed by rayon thread index; unsafely Sync because no more than one worker thread can access a given slot. Used to build thread-local style contexts that are reset after each restyle.

nodes.name: ScopedTLS::ensure
nodes.summary: Initializes the current thread's slot with the callback if empty and returns a RefMut to T; inlined so the initializing memmove stays fast without placing the whole large T in the stack frame.

nodes.name: animation.rs
nodes.summary: Servo's CSS transitions and animations engine: keyframe computation, animation state machines, transition starting/reversing per the CSS specs, and per-document animation sets. Compiled (but not executed) on Gecko builds.

nodes.name: PropertyAnimation
nodes.summary: A single animatable property's transition: from/to AnimationValues, timing function and duration; computes the interpolated value at a progress ratio, falling back to discrete interpolation.

nodes.name: AnimationState
nodes.summary: Lifecycle state of an animation or transition: Pending, Running, Paused(progress), Finished or Canceled; decides whether the owning animation needs to be ticked.

nodes.name: KeyframesIterationState
nodes.summary: Tracks the current iteration of a keyframes animation: Infinite(current) or Finite(current, max).

nodes.name: IntermediateComputedKeyframe
nodes.summary: Temporary structure collapsing declarations from keyframe steps sharing a start_percentage into one entry, filtering !important, non-animatable properties and display, and resolving each step's style through the rule tree at the Animations cascade level.

nodes.name: ComputedKeyframe
nodes.summary: A computed keyframe of a CSS animation: timing function, start percentage, and per-property AnimationValue or offsets referencing the preceding/following keyframes that declare the property (avoiding quadratic scans).

nodes.name: Animation
nodes.summary: A CSS animation: name, computed keyframe steps, timing state (started_at/duration/delay/fill mode), iteration and direction state; ticks iterations, computes property values at a time, cancels against new styles and merges state from re-submitted animations.

nodes.name: Transition
nodes.summary: A CSS transition: start time, delay, PropertyAnimation, reversing-adjusted start value and reversing shortening factor implementing the css-transitions reversing-of-transitions algorithm.

nodes.name: ElementAnimationSet
nodes.summary: Per-element animation state: lists of Animations and Transitions plus a dirty flag; cancels/starts animations and transitions on style changes, applies active values into ComputedValues, and produces AnimationValueMaps at a given time.

nodes.name: AnimationSetKey
nodes.summary: Key identifying an animation set in the document: opaque node plus optional pseudo-element.

nodes.name: DocumentAnimationSet
nodes.summary: Document-wide map of AnimationSetKey to ElementAnimationSet behind a shared RwLock; reports active animations/transitions and returns animation or transition declarations as locked PropertyDeclarationBlocks.

nodes.name: start_transitions_if_applicable
nodes.summary: Collects transition-properties for the new style (reversed so later entries win), maps to physical properties, and starts each applicable transition; returns the set of transitioning properties.

nodes.name: maybe_start_animations
nodes.summary: Starts CSS animations for each animation-name: looks up keyframes via the stylist, determines animating physical properties, generates ComputedKeyframes, and either updates an existing same-name animation or pushes a new one.

nodes.name: attr.rs
nodes.summary: Parsed representations of DOM attributes for Servo: AttrValue variants with lazy serialization, HTML parsing algorithms for integers, doubles, legacy colors and dimensions, and inline style declaration attributes.

nodes.name: AttrValue
nodes.summary: A parsed attribute value: eagerly or lazily serialized strings, atoms, token lists, unsigned/signed ints, doubles, colors, length percentages, dimensions, resolved URLs, shadow part mappings, or an inline PropertyDeclarationBlock fast path for element.style; derefs to the serialized string.

nodes.name: LengthOrPercentageOrAuto
nodes.summary: Simple Auto/Percentage/Length value used for parsed dimension attributes.

nodes.name: AttrIdentifier
nodes.summary: Uniquely identifies an element attribute: local name, name, namespace and optional prefix.

nodes.name: parse_legacy_color
nodes.summary: Implements the HTML 'rules for parsing a legacy colour value' (keyword lookup, #rgb, hex-stuffing, truncation and stripping steps) returning an AbsoluteColor or Err.

nodes.name: parse_length
nodes.summary: Implements the HTML 'rules for parsing dimension values' into a LengthOrPercentageOrAuto (digits, optional percent or single decimal point).

nodes.name: parse_double
nodes.summary: Parses a floating-point number per the HTML rules: sign, integer part, fraction and exponent.

nodes.name: encoding_support.rs
nodes.summary: Parses stylesheets from raw bytes rather than &str: wires cssparser's stylesheet_encoding up to encoding_rs and adds Stylesheet::from_bytes.

nodes.name: decode_stylesheet_bytes
nodes.summary: Determines the fallback encoding from the protocol label, environment encoding and in-band sniffing (BOM/@charset) via cssparser's stylesheet_encoding, then decodes the bytes to a string.

nodes.name: Stylesheet::from_bytes
nodes.summary: Parses a stylesheet from network bytes: decodes them and forwards the resulting string to Stylesheet::from_str.

nodes.name: media_features.rs
nodes.summary: Servo's media feature list and evaluators: viewport size, device size/DPR, orientation, pointer/hover capabilities, aspect ratio, resolution, scan, and prefers-color-scheme.

nodes.name: MEDIA_FEATURES
nodes.summary: Static table of the 15 media features Servo supports (width, height, orientation, pointer, any-pointer, hover, any-hover, aspect-ratio, device-width/height, scan, resolution, device-pixel-ratio, -moz-device-pixel-ratio, prefers-color-scheme) with range support, evaluator functions and feature flags.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the Servo-specific bits of the style system (animations, attributes, encoding support, media features, restyle damage, selector parser, shadow parts); compiled out on Gecko builds.

nodes.name: restyle_damage.rs
nodes.summary: Servo's restyle damage: hints telling layout which phases (repaint, stacking context, overflow, relayout) to rerun after incremental style changes, computed by diffing old and new ComputedValues.

nodes.name: ServoRestyleDamage
nodes.summary: u16 bitflags of layout phases to run (REPAINT, REBUILD_STACKING_CONTEXT, RECALCULATE_OVERFLOW, RELAYOUT, with the rest as an embedder extension point); computes StyleDifference between styles and provides a fully saturated 'reconstruct' damage.

nodes.name: compute_damage
nodes.summary: Derives damage from property diffs with short-circuiting: augmented rebuild-box implies RELAYOUT, else recalculate-overflow, augmented stacking-context rebuild, then repaint.

nodes.name: ServoRestyleDamage::compute_style_difference
nodes.summary: Computes StyleDifference (damage plus StyleChange) between old and new ComputedValues: pointer-equality fast path, element-specific layout damage, and custom-property changes forcing repaint and reset_only classification.

nodes.name: selector_parser.rs
nodes.summary: Servo's selector parser implementation: pseudo-elements, non-tree-structural pseudo-classes, the SelectorImpl binding, element snapshots for restyles, and :lang() extended filtering.

nodes.name: PseudoElement
nodes.summary: Servo's pseudo-element enum: eager (::before/::after/::selection/::first-letter), lazy (::marker, ::backdrop, ::placeholder, slider and UA-shadow pseudos, ::details-content) and precomputed Servo anonymous-box/table pseudos; classifies cascade type, property restrictions and element-backed behavior.

nodes.name: NonTSPseudoClass
nodes.summary: Servo's non-tree-structural pseudo-classes (:active, :hover, :checked, :lang(), :state(), -moz-meter variants, :-servo-nonzero-border, etc.), each mapped to ElementState flags for matching and invalidation.

nodes.name: SelectorImpl
nodes.summary: Servo's selectors::SelectorImpl binding: Atom identifiers, LocalName/Namespace types, AtomString attribute values, PseudoElement and NonTSPseudoClass, plus ExtraMatchingData for invalidation and container queries.

nodes.name: SnapshotMap
nodes.summary: Map from OpaqueNode to ServoElementSnapshot used to match selectors against pre-mutation element state during Servo restyles.

nodes.name: ServoElementSnapshot
nodes.summary: Servo's element snapshot: stored ElementState, attribute list and changed-attribute flags; implements the selectors ElementSnapshot trait (id/class/part/lang matching, attr_matches) for invalidated selector matching.

nodes.name: extended_filtering
nodes.summary: RFC 4647 extended language-range filtering for :lang() matching, including wildcard subtags and the single-character exception.

nodes.name: shadow_parts.rs
nodes.summary: Parsing and storage of the exportparts attribute per css-shadow-parts: part mappings between shadow tree part names.

nodes.name: ShadowParts
nodes.summary: Parsed exportparts value: a list of (from, to) Atom mappings; iterates exported parts for a name and looks up the imported part for a name.

nodes.name: parse_part_mapping
nodes.summary: Implements the css-shadow-parts 'parse a part mapping' algorithm: optional 'token : token' form defaulting the second token to the first.

nodes.name: parse_mapping_list
nodes.summary: Implements 'parse a comma-separated list of part mappings', skipping whitespace-only and invalid entries.

nodes.name: checks.rs
nodes.summary: Eligibility checks for the style sharing cache: quick tests deciding whether two elements can share the same style (parents, style attribute, pres hints, class/parts, revalidation selectors, attr() references, tree counting, scopes, id rules).

nodes.name: parents_allow_sharing
nodes.summary: Whether target and candidate parents are compatible for sharing: equal parent style identity, same parent element, or both parents marked safe for cousin sharing.

nodes.name: have_same_style_attribute
nodes.summary: Whether the two elements have the same inline style attribute: pointer-identity fast path, then guarded value comparison.

nodes.name: have_same_presentational_hints
nodes.summary: Whether the target and candidate have identical presentational-hint StyleSources.

nodes.name: have_same_class
nodes.summary: Whether the class attribute lists match; lists are hash-sorted so 'foo bar' and 'bar foo' are equal.

nodes.name: have_same_parts
nodes.summary: Whether the shadow part attribute lists match.

nodes.name: revalidate
nodes.summary: Whether the target and candidate match the same set of revalidation selectors: compares the bit vectors of revalidation match results from the stylist.

nodes.name: have_same_referenced_attrs
nodes.summary: Whether the elements agree on all attributes referenced by attr() functions in the candidate's primary and pseudo styles.

nodes.name: have_shareable_tree_counting_functions
nodes.summary: Whether the candidate's use of sibling-index()/sibling-count() permits sharing with the target (never for sibling-index; same parent required for sibling-count).

nodes.name: revalidate_scope
nodes.summary: Whether the two elements have identical @scope activation revalidation results.

nodes.name: may_match_different_id_rules
nodes.summary: Whether either element's id may have rules in the stylist, which blocks style sharing.

nodes.name: shadow_root_style_data_equals
nodes.summary: Whether the cascade data of two optional shadow roots is pointer-equal, used to allow sharing only across equal shadow styling contexts.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: The style sharing cache: per-DOM-depth LRU caches of candidate elements kept in leaked thread-local storage, letting similar elements reuse computed styles without rerunning selector matching; includes the full candidate testing chain and rule-node-based style reuse.

nodes.name: StyleSharingCache
nodes.summary: Public cache of SHARING_MAX_LEVELS (8) per-depth LRU candidate caches, type-erased to usize-sized entries and persisted across traversals via a leaked thread-local; shares styles, inserts candidates, and reuses styles by rule node.

nodes.name: StyleSharingCandidate
nodes.summary: A cache entry: element plus lazily computed ValidationData and a flag for having considered nontrivial scoped styles; element style is immutable once cached in TLS.

nodes.name: StyleSharingTarget
nodes.summary: An element being tested against the style sharing cache; computes validation data (setting selector flags as needed) and attempts share_style_if_possible.

nodes.name: ValidationData
nodes.summary: Lazily computed, cacheable data reused while testing sharing: class list, part list, presentational hints, parent style identity, and revalidation match results.

nodes.name: SharingCacheBase
nodes.summary: Generic LRU cache base over uluru LRUCache with SHARING_CACHE_SIZE entries and a recorded DOM depth; cleared when the depth changes.

nodes.name: RevalidationResult
nodes.summary: Result of revalidation selector matching: one bit per matched selector plus the style-relevant attributes, ensuring both elements looked at the same buckets before comparing bits.

nodes.name: ScopeRevalidationResult
nodes.summary: Bit vector of matched @scope activations produced by scope revalidation.

nodes.name: OpaqueComputedValues
nodes.summary: Opaque non-null pointer wrapper comparing ComputedValues identity for parent-style equality checks; Send/Sync for use in cached validation data.

nodes.name: SHARING_CACHE_SIZE
nodes.summary: Maximum entries (32) of a style sharing candidate LRU cache, tuned by measured style sharing and performance on real pages.

nodes.name: StyleSharingTarget::share_style_if_possible
nodes.summary: Entry point that tries to share the target's style with a cached candidate using the thread-local sharing cache, bloom filter and selector caches from the style context.

nodes.name: StyleSharingCache::insert_if_possible
nodes.summary: Inserts a freshly styled element into its DOM-depth cache unless it lacks a parent, does not match user/content rules, has running animations or SMIL overrides; clears the depth cache when the depth changes.

nodes.name: StyleSharingCache::test_candidate
nodes.summary: The full candidate eligibility chain: parent sharing, local name/namespace, element state, link-ness, containing/shadow root style data, assigned slot, implemented pseudo-element, animations/SMIL, id rules, style attribute, class, pres hints, parts, attr() references, tree-counting functions, revalidation selectors and scope revalidation; on success returns the candidate's shared styles.

nodes.name: StyleSharingCache::lookup_by_rules
nodes.summary: Attempts to reuse a candidate's primary style purely by matching rule node, visited rules and inherited style, with guards for attr() references, tree counting, name/namespace, container units and style queries, and link visitedness.

nodes.name: simple_buckets_map.rs
nodes.summary: A small map for filtering selectors by easily discernible features (class, id, local name), built on the selector map's hash map types.

nodes.name: SimpleBucketsMap
nodes.summary: Generic bucket map with MaybeCaseInsensitiveHashMaps for classes and ids plus a PrecomputedHashMap for local names; supports clear, shrink_if_needed and is_empty.

nodes.name: str.rs
nodes.summary: String utilities for attributes and number parsing: HTML whitespace handling, splitting, checked ASCII number/fraction/exponent reading, joining and case-insensitive comparisons.

nodes.name: HTML_SPACE_CHARACTERS
nodes.summary: The HTML 'space characters' (U+0020, U+0009, U+000A, U+000C, U+000D) per the WHATWG HTML spec.

nodes.name: split_html_space_chars
nodes.summary: Splits a string on HTML whitespace, filtering out empty pieces.

nodes.name: split_commas
nodes.summary: Splits a string on commas, filtering out empty pieces.

nodes.name: read_numbers
nodes.summary: Reads ASCII digits into an i64 with checked multiply/add, returning the value and digit count.

nodes.name: read_fraction
nodes.summary: Reads a decimal fraction ('.ddd'), accumulating each digit into the value with a growing divisor.

nodes.name: read_exponent
nodes.summary: Reads an optional e/E exponent with sign from a char iterator.

nodes.name: str_join
nodes.summary: Joins an iterator of strings with a delimiter.

nodes.name: string_as_ascii_lowercase
nodes.summary: Returns an ASCII-lowercased Cow of the input, borrowing when already lowercase.

nodes.name: appearance_base_rule.rs
nodes.summary: The @appearance-base at-rule used for appearance-dependent styles in UA stylesheets: nested rules plus source location, with CSS serialization and deep cloning under the shared lock.

nodes.name: AppearanceBaseRule
nodes.summary: An @appearance-base rule: Arc-locked nested CssRules and SourceLocation; implements ToCssWithGuard and DeepCloneWithLock, plus Gecko heap sizing.

nodes.name: container_rule.rs
nodes.summary: The @container rule: condition parsing, container lookup by container-type axes and names, query evaluation with size lookups, attribute (attr()) dependency tracking for invalidation, and the lazy container size query machinery used by cq units.

nodes.name: ContainerRule
nodes.summary: An @container rule: parsed ContainerConditions, Arc-locked nested CssRules and SourceLocation; supports ToCssWithGuard and DeepCloneWithLock.

nodes.name: ContainerConditions
nodes.summary: Comma-separated ArcSlice of ContainerConditions for a container rule.

nodes.name: ContainerCondition
nodes.summary: One container query condition: optional ContainerName, QueryCondition, cumulative FeatureFlags describing required container axes, and the set of attr()-referenced attribute names; performs container lookup and full condition evaluation with invalidation flag bookkeeping.

nodes.name: ContainerInfo
nodes.summary: Sizing, writing-mode and inherited-style information of the located container used while evaluating a container query.

nodes.name: ContainerLookupResult
nodes.summary: Result of a successful container query lookup: the container element, its ContainerInfo and its Arc<ComputedValues>.

nodes.name: ContainerAttributeDependencyKind
nodes.summary: Whether a container uses attr() references and whether it is named or unnamed; named containers using attr() require stronger descendant invalidation for style container queries.

nodes.name: ContainerSizeQuery
nodes.summary: Lazy container size lookup: either a deferred closure or the cached evaluated result; used as the sizing context for container-query lengths and cq units, short-circuiting when no ancestor has a size container type.

nodes.name: ContainerSizeQueryResult
nodes.summary: The hypothetical containment boundary as optional physical width/height; resolves logical axes against the querying element's writing mode, merges partial results from multiple size containers, and falls back to the viewport.

nodes.name: CONTAINER_FEATURES
nodes.summary: The six container query features (width, height, inline-size, block-size, aspect-ratio, orientation) with their required container axes and optional-length/ratio evaluators.

nodes.name: traverse_container
nodes.summary: Generic upward traversal from an element (optionally starting with the originating element's style for pseudo-elements), running an evaluator on each ancestor until it returns Done or StopTraversal.

nodes.name: ContainerCondition::find_container
nodes.summary: Walks traversal ancestors to find the nearest element whose container-type axes cover the condition's flags and whose container-name list contains all requested names, returning its info and style.

nodes.name: ContainerCondition::matches
nodes.summary: Evaluates the container query: finds the container, sets up a ContainerSizeQuery and evaluation Context, evaluates the QueryCondition (or name-only presence), and records ComputedValueFlags for style/viewport/font-dependent container queries and sibling-counting functions on the container.

nodes.name: counter_style_rule.rs
nodes.summary: Thin re-export of the @counter-style rule definition from crate::counter_style for the stylesheets module tree.

nodes.name: document_rule.rs
nodes.summary: The prefixed @-moz-document rule (CSS Conditional 3): URL matching functions, condition parsing with Gecko-only allowances, and evaluation delegated to Gecko_DocumentRule_UseForPresentation.

nodes.name: DocumentRule
nodes.summary: A @-moz-document rule: parsed DocumentCondition, Arc-locked nested CssRules and SourceLocation; supports serialization, deep cloning and Gecko heap sizing.

nodes.name: DocumentCondition
nodes.summary: Comma-separated list of DocumentMatchingFunctions, true if any matches; on Gecko only allowed in chrome rules or as a single empty url-prefix() for compatibility.

nodes.name: DocumentMatchingFunction
nodes.summary: URL matching functions for @-moz-document: url(), url-prefix(), domain(), regexp(), media-document() and plain-text-document(); parsing and Gecko-backed evaluation.

nodes.name: MediaDocumentKind
nodes.summary: Kind of media document matched by media-document(): All, Image or Video.

nodes.name: font_face_rule.rs
nodes.summary: Thin Stylo stylesheet-module shim for the @font-face rule; it only re-exports crate::font_face::FontFaceRule as the stylesheets::FontFaceRule used by the CssRule enum. The actual parsing and descriptor storage lives in components/style/font_face.rs.

nodes.name: font_feature_values_rule.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the @font-feature-values at-rule (CSS Fonts): value containers (SingleValue/PairValues/VectorValues), the FontFeatureValuesRule with per-feature-type blocks (@swash, @styleset, ...), its nested parsers, and conversion to Gecko's gfxFontFeatureValueSet.

nodes.name: font_palette_values_rule.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the @font-palette-values at-rule (CSS Fonts 4): FontPaletteValuesRule with font-family/base-palette/override-colors descriptors, its declaration parser, and conversion to Gecko's FontPaletteValueSet.

nodes.name: import_rule.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the @import at-rule: ImportRule holding the URL, an ImportSheet (loaded/pending/refused stylesheet), optional supports() condition and layer() target, plus parsing of the layer/supports header for the import preloader.

nodes.name: keyframes_rule.rs
nodes.summary: Implements @keyframes (CSS Animations): KeyframesRule with named keyframes, selector parsing (from/to/percentage and scroll-driven timeline-range selectors), Keyframe declaration blocks, computed KeyframesAnimation steps, and the keyframe list parser used by rule_parser.

nodes.name: layer_rule.rs
nodes.summary: Implements @layer (CSS Cascade 5): LayerName (dot-separated names), block-form LayerBlockRule with nested rules, statement-form LayerStatementRule, and the packed LayerOrder used for cascade layer sorting.

nodes.name: loader.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the StylesheetLoader trait, the abstraction used by the style system to trigger network requests for @import rules while parsing, returning the constructed ImportRule.

nodes.name: margin_rule.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the page margin at-rules from CSS Paged Media (@top-left, @bottom-center, ...): MarginRuleType enum generated by macro with name matching, and MarginRule wrapping a PropertyDeclarationBlock.

nodes.name: media_rule.rs
nodes.summary: Implements @media and the experimental @custom-media (Media Queries 5): MediaRule with MediaList and nested rules, CustomMediaCondition/CustomMediaRule storage, the CustomMediaMap, and CustomMediaEvaluator with cycle detection.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for stylesheets and CSS rules: declares all rule modules, defines the CssRule enum (Stylo counterpart of Gecko's CSSOM rule wrappers), CssRuleType/CssRuleTypes, CssRuleRef, RulesMutateError, CorsMode, UrlExtraData, rule serialization helpers and deep-clone plumbing.

nodes.name: namespace_rule.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the @namespace at-rule: NamespaceRule storing an optional prefix and the namespace URL, with CSSOM serialization.

nodes.name: nested_declarations_rule.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the nested declarations rule from CSS Nesting (bare declarations inside a style rule): NestedDeclarationsRule wrapping a PropertyDeclarationBlock, with deep clone, serialization and heap measurement.

nodes.name: origin.rs
nodes.summary: Defines CSS cascade origins: the Origin enum (UserAgent/User/Author), the OriginSet bitflags (equivalent to Gecko OriginFlags), OriginSetIterator, and the PerOrigin<T> container with its iterators used to store per-origin style data.

nodes.name: page_rule.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the @page rule (CSS Paged Media): PageSelector with name and :first/:blank/:left/:right pseudo-classes, PagePseudoClassFlags, page-selector specificity computation, and PageRule holding selectors, declarations and nested (margin) rules.

nodes.name: position_try_rule.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the @position-try rule for CSS Anchor Positioning: PositionTryRule with a dashed-ident name and a PropertyDeclarationBlock, with deep clone and serialization.

nodes.name: property_rule.rs
nodes.summary: Thin shim for the @property rule; re-exports crate::properties_and_values::registry::PropertyRegistration as stylesheets::PropertyRule, which is the variant stored in the CssRule enum.

nodes.name: rule_list.rs
nodes.summary: Implements CssRules, the list of CSS rules: spec-compliant removeRule/insertRule support (parse_rule_for_insert with InsertRuleContext), block serialization used by all grouping rules, deep clone and heap measurement.

nodes.name: rule_parser.rs
nodes.summary: The stylesheet rule parser: TopLevelRuleParser with its State machine (Start/EarlyLayers/Imports/Namespaces/Body), AtRuleType/AtRulePrelude dispatch for every supported at-rule, the repr(transparent) NestedRuleParser handling nesting and declarations, InsertRuleContext for CSSOM insertRule, and VendorPrefix.

nodes.name: rules_iterator.rs
nodes.summary: Provides RulesIterator, a stack-based iterator that recursively walks rule lists (including into @import), gated by the NestedRuleIterationCondition trait with EffectiveRules (media/supports/document/import evaluated) and AllRules filters.

nodes.name: scope_rule.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the @scope rule (CSS Cascade 6): ScopeRule with ScopeBounds (scope-start/scope-end selector lists), parsing, implicit scope roots for shadow trees and user stylesheets, scope-root candidate collection with proximity, scope-end checking, and the ScopeSubjectMap fast-reject index.

nodes.name: starting_style_rule.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the @starting-style rule (CSS Transitions 2 before-change style): StartingStyleRule holding nested CssRules, with deep clone, serialization and heap measurement.
