nodes.name: style_rule.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the ordinary style rule: StyleRule with a selector list, locked PropertyDeclarationBlock and optional nested rules for CSS nesting, plus deep clone, heap measurement and CSSOM serialization shared with page rules.

nodes.name: stylesheet.rs
nodes.summary: Stylesheet representation: StylesheetContents (rules, origin, url data, namespaces, quirks mode, use counters; maps to Gecko StyleSheetInner), the Servo Stylesheet, the StylesheetInDocument trait implemented for GeckoStyleSheet-backed users, DocumentStyleSheet, and CSS sanitization (SanitizationKind/SanitizationData, AllowImportRules).

nodes.name: supports_rule.rs
nodes.summary: Implements @supports (CSS Conditional): SupportsRule with nested rules, the recursive SupportsCondition AST (not/and/or, declarations, selector(), at-rule(), font-format()/font-tech(), named-feature()), its parser and evaluator.

nodes.name: view_transition_rule.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the @view-transition rule (CSS View Transitions 2): ViewTransitionRule holding parsed descriptors (navigation/types) via the shared DescriptorParser, the NavigationType enum, and a TransitionTypes re-export.

nodes.name: FontFaceRule
nodes.summary: Stylo representation of an @font-face rule; re-exported from crate::font_face where it is defined and parsed. Rust-side counterpart of Gecko's CSSFontFaceRule CSSOM wrapper.

nodes.name: FFVDeclaration
nodes.summary: A single @font-feature-values block declaration of the form <ident>: <integer>+, generic over the value container type (SingleValue, PairValues or VectorValues).

nodes.name: SingleValue
nodes.summary: Font-feature-values declaration value holding exactly one unsigned integer (e.g. @swash, @stylistic blocks); converts to a one-element Gecko ThinVec<u32>.

nodes.name: PairValues
nodes.summary: Font-feature-values declaration value holding one or two unsigned integers (used by @character-variant); converts to a Gecko ThinVec<u32>.

nodes.name: VectorValues
nodes.summary: Font-feature-values declaration value holding a list of unsigned integers (used by @styleset); converts to a Gecko ThinVec<u32>.

nodes.name: FontFeatureValuesRule
nodes.summary: The @font-feature-values rule: a font family list plus one Vec<FFVDeclaration<T>> per feature-type block (swash, stylistic, ornaments, annotation, character-variant, styleset), generated via the font_feature_values_blocks! macro; can populate Gecko's gfxFontFeatureValueSet. Counterpart of Gecko's CSSFontFeatureValuesRule.

nodes.name: FontFeatureValuesBlockType
nodes.summary: Enum keeping the block type (@swash, @styleset, @character-variant, ...) inside an @font-feature-values rule; supports from_name matching used by the rule parser.

nodes.name: parse_family_name_list
nodes.summary: Parses a comma-separated list of FamilyName values; shared by the @font-feature-values and @font-palette-values rule preludes.

nodes.name: FontPaletteOverrideColor
nodes.summary: A single override-colors entry of an @font-palette-values rule: a non-negative palette index plus an absolute specified color, validated at parse time to be resolvable without context.

nodes.name: FontPaletteBase
nodes.summary: The base-palette descriptor value of an @font-palette-values rule: light, dark, or a resolved non-negative integer index.

nodes.name: FontPaletteValuesRule
nodes.summary: The @font-palette-values rule: dashed-ident palette name, font family list, base palette and override colors; to_gecko_palette_value_set populates Gecko's FontPaletteValueSet. Counterpart of Gecko's CSSFontPaletteValuesRule.

nodes.name: ImportSheet
nodes.summary: The stylesheet held by an @import rule: a real sheet (GeckoStyleSheet or Arc<Stylesheet>), Pending (off-main-thread parse, sheet not yet attached), or Refused (supports condition false).

nodes.name: ImportLayer
nodes.summary: The cascade layer targeted by an @import rule: none, anonymous (layer), or named (layer(name)) with a LayerName.

nodes.name: ImportSupportsCondition
nodes.summary: The supports(<condition>) part of an @import rule, caching whether the condition evaluated as enabled at parse time.

nodes.name: ImportRule
nodes.summary: The @import rule: target CssUrl, held ImportSheet, optional supports condition and layer, plus source location. parse_layer_and_supports parses the layer()/supports() header for the import preloader. Rust-side counterpart of Gecko's CSSImportRule.

nodes.name: KeyframesRule
nodes.summary: The @keyframes rule: animation KeyframesName, the list of locked Keyframes, and the vendor prefix it was written with; find_rule implements CSSKeyframesRule.findRule. Rust-side counterpart of Gecko's CSSKeyframesRule.

nodes.name: KeyframePercentage
nodes.summary: A keyframe offset as a number in [0,1]; parses from/to idents as 0/1 and validates percentage ranges, with ordering support for step sorting.

nodes.name: KeyframeSelector
nodes.summary: A single <keyframe-selector>: from | to | <percentage [0,100]>, optionally extended with a timeline-range name plus percentage for scroll-driven animations behind a pref.

nodes.name: KeyframeSelectors
nodes.summary: A comma-separated list of KeyframeSelector values, the prelude of a keyframe rule.

nodes.name: Keyframe
nodes.summary: A single keyframe inside @keyframes: its selector list and a locked PropertyDeclarationBlock (!important declarations are ignored at use time); parse() builds one from CSS text for CSSOM keyframe manipulation.

nodes.name: KeyframesStep
nodes.summary: One step of a computed keyframes animation: its start offset selector, declarations or a synthesized ComputedValues step, and flags for declared animation-timing-function / animation-composition.

nodes.name: KeyframesAnimation
nodes.summary: The animation steps computed from a KeyframesRule's keyframes: percentage-only steps sorted by offset plus an order-preserving vector for timeline-range-name steps; empty when no animatable properties exist.

nodes.name: KeyframeListParser
nodes.summary: cssparser RuleBodyParser adapter that parses the bodies of individual keyframes (selector prelude plus declaration block) inside an @keyframes rule.

nodes.name: parse_keyframe_list
nodes.summary: Parses the full body of an @keyframes rule into a Vec<Arc<Locked<Keyframe>>>, skipping and reporting invalid keyframes.

nodes.name: KeyframeOffset
nodes.summary: The keyframe offset for Web Animations CSSOM input: a double number, a percentage (incl. calc()), or a full KeyframeSelector with timeline-range name; range validation is deferred per spec.

nodes.name: LayerOrder
nodes.summary: A u16 cascade-layer order packed alongside CascadeLevel into 32 bits; special values for the root and style-attribute layers.

nodes.name: LayerName
nodes.summary: A <layer-name> as a small vector of AtomIdent components (foo.bar); supports parsing and synthesized unique names for anonymous layers.

nodes.name: LayerBlockRule
nodes.summary: The block form @layer <name>? { ... } with an optional name and nested locked CssRules. Counterpart of Gecko's CSSLayerBlockRule.

nodes.name: LayerStatementRule
nodes.summary: The statement form @layer <name>, <name>, ...; declares the ordering of multiple layers without a body. Counterpart of Gecko's CSSLayerStatementRule.

nodes.name: StylesheetLoader
nodes.summary: Trait abstraction to trigger the network request after parsing an @import rule; request_stylesheet receives url, media list, supports condition and layer and returns the constructed locked ImportRule.

nodes.name: MarginRuleType
nodes.summary: Enum of the 16 CSS Paged Media margin at-rule names (@top-left-corner ... @right-bottom), macro-generated with shared static name strings and from_name matching.

nodes.name: MarginRule
nodes.summary: A page margin at-rule (@top-left etc.) nested inside @page: its MarginRuleType plus a locked PropertyDeclarationBlock. Counterpart of Gecko's CSSMarginRule.

nodes.name: MediaRule
nodes.summary: The @media rule: a locked MediaList plus nested locked CssRules. Rust-side counterpart of Gecko's CSSMediaRule.

nodes.name: CustomMediaCondition
nodes.summary: The condition attached to a @custom-media rule: constant true, constant false, or a locked MediaList.

nodes.name: CustomMediaRule
nodes.summary: The @custom-media rule (Media Queries 5): a dashed-ident name bound to a CustomMediaCondition.

nodes.name: CustomMediaEvaluator
nodes.summary: Evaluates custom media queries against a CustomMediaMap during media matching, tracking the queries currently being evaluated to detect cycles (which evaluate to false).

nodes.name: CssRule
nodes.summary: The central enum of every CSS rule kind Stylo supports (Style, Import, Media, FontFace, Keyframes, Layer, Scope, StartingStyle, ...); provides rule_type(), children(), parse() implementing CSSOM insert-a-css-rule, deep clone and serialization. Rust-side counterpart of the Gecko CSSOM rule wrapper family.

nodes.name: CssRuleType
nodes.summary: Enum of CSSOM rule types with their numeric values (Style=1, Import=3, ..., ViewTransition=27), mirroring dom::CSSRule types; used for parser nesting contexts and parse-relative decisions.

nodes.name: CssRuleTypes
nodes.summary: Bitfield set of CssRuleType values with predefined sets like IMPORTANT_FORBIDDEN (PositionTry, Keyframe) and WITHOUT_ELEMENT_CONTEXT, used for parser nesting contexts.

nodes.name: CssRuleRef
nodes.summary: A #[repr(C)] borrowed-reference mirror of CssRule, allowing C++-friendly access to rule variants without cloning Arcs.

nodes.name: RulesMutateError
nodes.summary: Error enum for CSSOM rule list mutation: Syntax, IndexSize, HierarchyRequest, InvalidState; maps to DOMException names for insertRule/deleteRule.

nodes.name: CorsMode
nodes.summary: The CORS mode used for a CSS load: None or Anonymous, applied when creating CssUrl values for loads such as @import.

nodes.name: UrlExtraData
nodes.summary: Extra data needed to resolve URL values: on Gecko a packed usize holding either a strong pointer to a structs::URLExtraData or an index into the shared UA-sheet array; on Servo an Arc<url::Url>.

nodes.name: NamespaceRule
nodes.summary: The @namespace rule: optional Prefix and the Namespace URL, with CSSOM serialization. Rust-side counterpart of Gecko's CSSNamespaceRule.

nodes.name: NestedDeclarationsRule
nodes.summary: A CSS Nesting nested declarations rule (bare declarations in a nested context), wrapping a locked PropertyDeclarationBlock; created by the rule parser's flush_declarations and by insertRule fallback.

nodes.name: Origin
nodes.summary: The CSS cascade origin of a style rule: UserAgent, User, or Author, ordered for iteration and convertible to OriginSet bits.

nodes.name: OriginSet
nodes.summary: A bitflags set of cascade origins, equivalent to Gecko's OriginFlags, with iteration over the contained origins.

nodes.name: PerOrigin
nodes.summary: Generic container storing one T per cascade origin, with accessors and forward/reverse/mutable iterators; the iteration order matters for @font-face, @counter-style and @keyframes lookups.

nodes.name: PerOriginIter
nodes.summary: Iterator over PerOrigin<T> yielding (&T, Origin), in author-to-user-agent or reverse order; PerOriginIterMut is its unsafe mutable sibling.

nodes.name: PagePseudoClass
nodes.summary: The @page selector pseudo-classes :first, :blank, :left and :right, macro-generated with parsing and string conversion.

nodes.name: PagePseudoClassFlags
nodes.summary: Bitflags mirror of PagePseudoClass used to query whether a page rule applies to a given page context.

nodes.name: PageSelector
nodes.summary: A single @page selector: an optional page name plus pseudo-classes; implements matching and the spec's g/h/f specificity computation.

nodes.name: PageSelectors
nodes.summary: The comma-separated list of PageSelector values forming the prelude of an @page rule.

nodes.name: PageRule
nodes.summary: The @page rule: page selectors, a declaration block, and nested rules (margin at-rules when enabled); match_specificity computes per-page specificity. Rust-side counterpart of Gecko's CSSPageRule.

nodes.name: PositionTryRule
nodes.summary: The @position-try rule for CSS Anchor Positioning fallback positions: a dashed-ident name and a locked PropertyDeclarationBlock (!important forbidden). Counterpart of Gecko's CSSPositionTryRule.

nodes.name: PropertyRule
nodes.summary: Alias of properties_and_values::registry::PropertyRegistration, the parsed @property rule stored in CssRule::Property; immutable and shared on clone. Counterpart of Gecko's CSSPropertyRule.

nodes.name: CssRules
nodes.summary: A list of CSS rules (Vec<CssRule>) shared via Arc<Locked<...>>: implements cssom remove-a-css-rule and insert-a-css-rule parsing, block serialization for all grouping rules, and deep clone.

nodes.name: InsertRuleContext
nodes.summary: Information needed for CSSOM insertRule: the target rule list slice, insertion index, ancestor CssRuleTypes, and the parse-relative rule type; max_rule_state_at_index derives the allowed parser state.

nodes.name: TopLevelRuleParser
nodes.summary: The cssparser AtRuleParser/QualifiedRuleParser for top-level stylesheet rules: tracks parser State, DOM hierarchy errors, insert-rule context, import allowance, declaration parser state for nesting, and collects the parsed Vec<CssRule>.

nodes.name: State
nodes.summary: The ordered parser state machine for a stylesheet: Start, EarlyLayers, Imports, Namespaces, Body; transitions are validated for insertRule correctness.

nodes.name: VendorPrefix
nodes.summary: Recognized vendor prefixes for rules like @keyframes: -moz and -webkit.

nodes.name: AtRuleType
nodes.summary: Dispatch enum mapping at-rule names (with pref/feature gating) to their parse behavior; from_name and is_supported drive which at-rules are accepted, including margin rules and font-feature-values blocks.

nodes.name: AtRulePrelude
nodes.summary: A parsed at-rule prelude carrying its data (media list, supports condition, keyframes name, page selectors, import url/layer/supports, container conditions, ...), consumed by parse_block to construct the corresponding CssRule variant.

nodes.name: NestedRuleParser
nodes.summary: A repr(transparent) deref wrapper over TopLevelRuleParser implementing nested rule parsing: at-rule allowance inside style/page rules (CSS Nesting), nested rule list construction, declaration flushing into style or nested-declarations rules, and selector error reporting.

nodes.name: RulesIterator
nodes.summary: Stack-based depth-first iterator over a rule list that descends into grouping rules and @import sheets, using NestedRuleIterationCondition to decide effectiveness and supporting skipping of children.

nodes.name: NestedRuleIterationCondition
nodes.summary: Trait deciding whether the nested rules of @import/@media/@-moz-document/@supports rules are processed during iteration.

nodes.name: EffectiveRules
nodes.summary: NestedRuleIterationCondition that only descends into rules effective for the current device (evaluating media, supports enabledness, document conditions and import media).

nodes.name: AllRules
nodes.summary: NestedRuleIterationCondition that processes every rule regardless of conditions, used e.g. for effective_children traversal of ineffective ancestors.

nodes.name: EffectiveRulesIterator
nodes.summary: Type alias of RulesIterator parameterized on EffectiveRules; recurses into @import rules and provides effective_children construction.

nodes.name: ScopeRule
nodes.summary: The @scope rule: ScopeBounds plus nested locked CssRules. Rust-side counterpart of Gecko's CSSScopeRule.

nodes.name: ScopeBounds
nodes.summary: The optional scope-start and scope-end selector lists of an @scope rule, with parsing rules such as @scope {} being valid and @scope to {} not.

nodes.name: ImplicitScopeRoot
nodes.summary: Describes an implicit scope root (from shadow DOM hosts, constructed stylesheets, user stylesheets, or the document element) and resolves it to an ImplicitScopeTarget.

nodes.name: ScopeTarget
nodes.summary: What defines a scope root: either a selector list matched against candidate elements (with fast-reject via ScopeSubjectMap) or an implicit scope target.

nodes.name: ScopeRootCandidate
nodes.summary: A candidate scope root: its opaque element plus the ancestor-hop ScopeProximity from the element under consideration, used for proximity-sorted scope resolution.

nodes.name: ScopeSubjectMap
nodes.summary: Index of ids/classes/local-names appearing in scope-start selector subjects, enabling cheap early rejection of elements that cannot be scope roots before full selector matching.

nodes.name: collect_scope_roots
nodes.summary: Walks ancestors (optionally crossing into the shadow host) collecting every element matching the scope target as a ScopeRootCandidate with its proximity, up to an optional ceiling element.

nodes.name: element_is_outside_of_scope
nodes.summary: Given the scope-end selector, checks whether any ancestor up to the scope root matches it, handling the :host edge case for shadow trees.

nodes.name: scope_selector_list_is_trivial
nodes.summary: Determines whether a scope bound selector list is trivial (no sibling relations, :nth/:has, or ID components), which allows style-sharing optimizations.

nodes.name: StartingStyleRule
nodes.summary: The @starting-style rule defining before-change style for transitions: a locked list of nested CssRules. Counterpart of Gecko's CSSStartingStyleRule.

nodes.name: StyleRule
nodes.summary: An ordinary style rule: SelectorList, locked PropertyDeclarationBlock, and optional nested CssRules when CSS nesting applies. Counterpart of Gecko's CSSStyleRule.

nodes.name: Namespaces
nodes.summary: The set of namespaces applying to a stylesheet: an optional default namespace plus a prefix-to-namespace map populated by @namespace rules.

nodes.name: StylesheetContents
nodes.summary: The parsed contents of a stylesheet (Gecko StyleSheetInner equivalent): locked rule list, origin, url data, namespaces, quirks mode, source map/source URL and use counters; offers rule iteration, effective-rule iteration and deep clone.

nodes.name: Stylesheet
nodes.summary: The Servo representation of a stylesheet: locked StylesheetContents, its SharedRwLock, an associated MediaList, and CSSOM disabled state; from_str parses CSS text into it.

nodes.name: StylesheetInDocument
nodes.summary: Trait representing a stylesheet attached to a document (implemented by Servo's Stylesheet/DocumentStyleSheet and Gecko's GeckoStyleSheet): enabled state, media, contents, device effectiveness, and implicit scope root.

nodes.name: DocumentStyleSheet
nodes.summary: A pointer-comparable Arc<Stylesheet> wrapper suitable for use in a StylesheetSet, delegating StylesheetInDocument to the inner sheet.

nodes.name: SanitizationKind
nodes.summary: The level of sanitization applied when parsing untrusted CSS: None, Standard (only @font-face, style and @namespace rules), or NoConditionalRules; allows() recursively filters rules and drives sanitized output.

nodes.name: AllowImportRules
nodes.summary: Whether @import rules are allowed to be parsed for a given stylesheet parse (Yes/No), threaded through parsing and insertRule.

nodes.name: SanitizationData
nodes.summary: Accumulates the sanitized CSS output string for a given SanitizationKind during parsing; take() returns the sanitized text.

nodes.name: SupportsRule
nodes.summary: The @supports rule: parsed SupportsCondition, nested locked CssRules, and the cached enabled result of evaluating the condition. Counterpart of Gecko's CSSSupportsRule.

nodes.name: SupportsCondition
nodes.summary: Recursive @supports condition AST: not/and/or combinators, parenthesized conditions, declarations, selector(), at-rule(), font-format()/font-tech(), named-feature(), and FutureSyntax for unrecognized grammar; includes parser and evaluator (also for @import supports()).

nodes.name: RawSelector
nodes.summary: A possibly-invalid selector captured from a selector() supports condition; eval() re-parses it with a for_supports_rule SelectorParser to test support.

nodes.name: Declaration
nodes.summary: A possibly-invalid property declaration captured from a @supports condition; eval() tests whether the property parses in the Style rule context.

nodes.name: AtRuleKeyword
nodes.summary: An @keyword operand of the at-rule() supports function (css-conditional-5); eval() delegates to AtRuleType::is_supported.

nodes.name: NamedFeature
nodes.summary: Named features testable via named-feature() in @supports (css-conditional-5): anchor-positioning transform following (pref-gated) and single-axis scroll containers (not implemented).

nodes.name: parse_condition_or_declaration
nodes.summary: Parses a supports_condition or a plain declaration, as required inside @supports parens and @import supports() functions.

nodes.name: ViewTransitionRule
nodes.summary: The @view-transition rule: parsed Descriptors (navigation, types) via the shared view-transition DescriptorParser; immutable and cheap to deep-clone. Counterpart of Gecko's CSSViewTransitionRule.

nodes.name: NavigationType
nodes.summary: The navigation descriptor value of @view-transition: none (default) or auto (perform the cross-document transition when conditions are met).

nodes.name: thread_state.rs
nodes.summary: Thread-state assertions for the Stylo style engine: a thread-local ThreadState bitflags (SCRIPT/LAYOUT/IN_WORKER/IN_GC) with initialize/get/enter/exit helpers used to dynamically assert what kind of thread is running and in which phase during style parsing and traversal.

nodes.name: ThreadState
nodes.summary: Bitflags describing the current thread kind and phase (SCRIPT, LAYOUT, IN_WORKER, IN_GC) with is_script/is_layout/is_worker queries for dynamic assertions across the style system.

nodes.name: initialize
nodes.summary: Initializes the thread-local ThreadState, panicking if the thread was already initialized to a different state.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Returns the current thread's ThreadState (default value if the thread state was never initialized).

nodes.name: enter
nodes.summary: Enters a temporary thread state (e.g. IN_GC), panicking when re-entering an already-active flag.

nodes.name: exit
nodes.summary: Leaves a temporary thread state previously registered via enter(), clearing the given flags.

nodes.name: typed_om/mod.rs
nodes.summary: CSS Typed OM (css-typed-om-1) core in Stylo: property-agnostic value representations (TypedValue, NumericValue, the MathValue family, transform components, image and unparsed values) plus the derivable ToTyped trait that reifies computed values into CSSStyleValue-shaped data for the DOM.

nodes.name: ToTyped
nodes.summary: Derivable trait reifying computed CSS values into property-agnostic TypedValue(s); the Typed OM analogue of ToCss, with to_typed_value/to_numeric_value/to_typed_value_list entry points and derive attributes for bitflags, skips, and multi-value variants.

nodes.name: TypedValue
nodes.summary: Enum over property-agnostic Typed OM values: Unparsed, Keyword, Numeric, Transform, and Image; the internal counterpart of the CSSStyleValue subclasses exposed to script.

nodes.name: NumericValue
nodes.summary: Enum over UnitValue and MathValue corresponding to CSSNumericValue and its subclasses, with Zero/One impls and numeric_type() accessors used by reification and sum-value computation.

nodes.name: MathValue
nodes.summary: Enum for the CSSMathValue subclasses (Sum/Product/Negate/Invert/Min/Max/Clamp), each variant carrying its NumericType computed from its operands via NumericType algebra.

nodes.name: UnitValue
nodes.summary: CSSUnitValue counterpart: an f32 value plus a textual unit string and the NumericType derived from that unit.

nodes.name: KeywordValue
nodes.summary: CSSKeywordValue counterpart wrapping a CssString keyword so keywords can be carried independently of any property.

nodes.name: ImageValue
nodes.summary: CSSImageValue counterpart over SpecifiedUrl or ComputedUrl, keeping relative URLs resolvable against the originating stylesheet.

nodes.name: TransformComponent
nodes.summary: CSSTransformComponent counterpart: Translate/Rotate/Scale/Skew/SkewX/SkewY/Perspective/Matrix variants, each storing NumericValue components and an is_2d flag.

nodes.name: numeric_declaration.rs
nodes.summary: Numeric declaration for CSSNumericValue.parse(): parses a number/dimension token or a calc() expression into a NumericDeclaration (NoCalcNumeric or CalcNode), validating calc results against allowed numeric types.

nodes.name: NumericDeclaration
nodes.summary: Parsed result of the Typed OM numeric parse algorithm: either a NoCalcNumeric (length/angle/time/number/percentage) or a CalcNode calc() expression, with a derived ToTyped reification.

nodes.name: numeric_type.rs
nodes.summary: NumericType/NumericBaseType implementing the Typed OM numeric-typing algorithm: a fixed-size exponent vector over base types with a percent hint, add/multiply/invert type algebra, and <length>/<angle>/... grammar matching, partially exported to Gecko via Servo_NumericType_* FFI.

nodes.name: NumericBaseType
nodes.summary: The seven CSSNumericValue base types (Length, Angle, Time, Frequency, Resolution, Flex, Percent) that index NumericType's exponent vector.

nodes.name: NumericType
nodes.summary: Numeric typing per css-typed-om-1: exponent array plus percent hint with derived non-zero counters for O(1) compatibility checks; implements add/multiply/invert and grammar matching, also mapped to CalcType for calc() validation.

nodes.name: add_two_types
nodes.summary: Implements the spec's 'add two types' algorithm, reconciling percent hints (including the provisional-hint loop) and returning failure for incompatible types.

nodes.name: multiply_two_types
nodes.summary: Implements the spec's 'multiply two types' algorithm by adding exponents after percent-hint reconciliation, returning failure on conflicting hints.

nodes.name: numeric.rs
nodes.summary: NoCalcNumeric: a Typed OM numeric value without calc() (length/angle/time/number/percentage) exposing unitless_value, unit, canonical_unit, unit conversion, and parse_unit_value used by CSSNumericValue sum-value and unit-conversion paths.

nodes.name: NoCalcNumeric
nodes.summary: Enum over non-calc numeric values (NoCalcLength/NoCalcAngle/NoCalcTime/NoCalcNumber/NoCalcPercentage) with unit conversion helpers and parse_unit_value for validating (value, unit) pairs.

nodes.name: sum_value.rs
nodes.summary: SumValue: implements the spec's create-a-sum-value algorithm over NumericValue (unit, sum, product, negate, invert, min, max, clamp) using unit-map algebra, plus conversion to UnitValue/MathSum backing CSSNumericValue.to()/toSum().

nodes.name: SumValue
nodes.summary: Result of create-a-sum-value: a list of (value, unit map) items obtained by recursively reducing a NumericValue math expression, convertible back to a UnitValue or MathSum in requested units.

nodes.name: try_from_numeric_value
nodes.summary: Recursively converts a NumericValue into a SumValue per spec steps: canonicalizing units, folding sums, expanding products via unit-map multiplication, negating/inverting, and comparing min/max/clamp operands with equal unit maps.

nodes.name: to_unit
nodes.summary: Step 3 of CSSNumericValue.to: converts a single-item SumValue into a UnitValue expressed in the requested unit via NoCalcNumeric conversion.

nodes.name: url/mod.rs
nodes.summary: Shared CSS url() handling for Stylo: cfg-selects the Gecko or Servo CssUrl/SpecifiedUrl/ComputedUrl definitions and implements Parse for CssUrl, CORS-mode-aware parsing, and attr()-tainting checks per css-values-5 URL security.

nodes.name: parse_with_cors_mode
nodes.summary: Parses a url() token into a CssUrl, recording the token span and delegating to parse_from_string with the requested CORS mode.

nodes.name: parse_from_string
nodes.summary: Parses a URL string while enforcing attr()-tainting constraints (rejecting URLs inside attr()-substituted ranges) before constructing the CssUrl.

nodes.name: url/gecko.rs
nodes.summary: Gecko backend for CSS url() values in Stylo: CssUrl/CssUrlData keep the unresolved serialization plus UrlExtraData and CORS mode, lazily share C++-mutable LoadData through a global table, classify NonLocalUriDependency for use counters, and convert to ComputedUrl via Gecko FFI.

nodes.name: CssUrl
nodes.summary: Gecko CSS url() value: an Arc-shared CssUrlData preserving the unresolved serialization for equality, shmem sharing, and ToCss, recording use-counter URI dependencies at parse time.

nodes.name: CssUrlData
nodes.summary: Per-URL data shared between CssUrls: the serialization string, UrlExtraData for later resolution, CORS mode, and the lazily created LoadDataSource mutable from C++.

nodes.name: LoadData
nodes.summary: C++-owned image load state (resolved imgRequestProxy and nsIURI plus LoadDataFlags), Send/Sync for the style engine's usage and released through Gecko_LoadData_Drop.

nodes.name: LoadDataSource
nodes.summary: Owned or lazily interned LoadData; lazy instances are stored in the global LOAD_DATA_TABLE keyed by address so shared-memory stylesheets can share load state, cleared on shutdown().

nodes.name: NonLocalUriDependency
nodes.summary: Classifies how a URL may depend on the base URI (No/Absolute/Path/Full) via scan(), feeding CustomUseCounter recording for telemetry about stylesheet portability.

nodes.name: url/servo.rs
nodes.summary: Servo backend for CSS url() values: eagerly resolves CssUrl against the stylesheet base URL with rust-url at parse time, distinguishing Valid/Invalid ComputedUrl variants for computed-value conversion and serialization.

nodes.name: CssUrl
nodes.summary: Servo CSS url() value storing the original serialization and eagerly resolved Arc<Url>, with is_invalid based on resolution failure and for_cascade for computed-image insertion.

nodes.name: ComputedUrl
nodes.summary: Computed url() for Servo: Valid(resolved Url) or Invalid(original string) fallback, convertible back to a specified CssUrl for the cascade.

nodes.name: use_counters/mod.rs
nodes.summary: CSS property use counters for Stylo: atomic bitset counters (NonCustomPropertyUseCounters, CountedUnknownPropertyUseCounters, CustomUseCounters) recorded during stylesheet parsing and merged for off-main-thread parsing, stored per document.

nodes.name: UseCounters
nodes.summary: Per-document use-counter aggregate combining non-custom property, counted-unknown-property, and custom counters, with merge() used when parsing stylesheets off the main thread.

nodes.name: NonCustomPropertyUseCounters
nodes.summary: Atomic bitset with one bit per non-custom CSS property, providing record/recorded/merge via the use_counters_methods! macro.

nodes.name: CountedUnknownPropertyUseCounters
nodes.summary: Atomic bitset tracking usage of recognized-but-unimplemented CSS properties (CountedUnknownProperty) for telemetry.

nodes.name: CustomUseCounters
nodes.summary: Atomic bitset for CustomUseCounter flags such as non-local URI dependencies, recorded while parsing url() values.

nodes.name: CustomUseCounter
nodes.summary: Custom counter flags: HasNonLocalUriDependency, MaybeHasPathBaseUriDependency, and MaybeHasFullBaseUriDependency.

nodes.name: animated/mod.rs
nodes.summary: Animated values core for the Stylo style engine: the Animate/ToAnimatedValue/ToAnimatedZero traits, the Procedure enum (Interpolate/Add/Accumulate) with weights, numeric and container impls, and compare_property_priority ordering used for Web Animations computed keyframes.

nodes.name: Animate
nodes.summary: Derivable trait animating a value towards another under a Procedure; derived impls match both values and animate field-wise, supporting #[animation(constant)] and #[animation(error)] annotations.

nodes.name: Procedure
nodes.summary: Web Animations procedure enum: Interpolate{progress}, Add, and Accumulate{count}, with weights() yielding the (from, to) weight pair for animations that ignore the procedure kind.

nodes.name: ToAnimatedValue
nodes.summary: Conversion between computed values and intermediate animation representations (notably colors as floats), with blanket impls for Option/Vec/ThinVec/Box/slices/SmallVec and trivial impls for non-interpolated types.

nodes.name: ToAnimatedZero
nodes.summary: Returns the additive zero of a value (used for SMIL by-animations and zero-filled list animation), implemented for numeric primitives and common containers.

nodes.name: Context
nodes.summary: Context for converting a computed value into an animated value, carrying the ComputedValues the value comes from.

nodes.name: compare_property_priority
nodes.summary: Sorts PropertyIds per Web Animations computed-keyframe ordering: custom, then physical longhands, logical longhands, and shorthands (by component count, then IDL name).

nodes.name: animate_multiplicative_factor
nodes.summary: Animates two multiplicative factors by shifting them around 1.0 before interpolation, then shifting back.

nodes.name: animated/color.rs
nodes.summary: Animation impls for colors in Stylo: Animate for AbsoluteColor via color-mix with best interpolation method, animated Color (GenericColor<Percentage>) animated as sRGB mix items, plus squared-distance and animated-zero support.

nodes.name: Color
nodes.summary: Animated <color> value (GenericColor<Percentage>): interpolated by constructing a color-mix with per-side weights and compared via resolve_to_absolute squared distance.

nodes.name: animated/effects.rs
nodes.summary: Animated type aliases for CSS filter effects: AnimatedSimpleShadow for drop-shadow() and AnimatedFilter instantiated over animated angle/number/length/color generics (with ComputedUrl only on Gecko).

nodes.name: AnimatedFilter
nodes.summary: Animated value for a single filter function list entry: GenericFilter over animated Angle, Number, Length, AnimatedSimpleShadow, and (Gecko) ComputedUrl.

nodes.name: AnimatedSimpleShadow
nodes.summary: Animated drop-shadow() value: GenericSimpleShadow over animated Color and lengths.

nodes.name: animated/font.rs
nodes.summary: Animation impls for font-related types: Animate/ComputeSquaredDistance/ToAnimatedZero for FontVariationSettings using by-computed-value list animation over the sorted, de-duplicated axis settings.

nodes.name: animated/grid.rs
nodes.summary: Animation impls for grid types: interpolation for TrackSize/TrackRepeat/TrackList with discrete fallback per csswg resolutions (auto-fit/fill and line names not interpolable), plus unimplemented distance/zero for GridTemplateComponent.

nodes.name: discrete
nodes.summary: Discrete animation fallback: swaps at progress 0.5 under Interpolate and yields the to-value for Add/Accumulate to match the composite_endpoint behavior of other browsers.

nodes.name: animated/lists.rs
nodes.summary: List animation strategies from Web Animations: by_computed_value (element-wise, equal lengths), with_zero (shadow/filter semantics interpolating missing entries against their animated zero, concatenating on Add), and repeatable_list (cycling both lists to their LCM).

nodes.name: by_computed_value::animate
nodes.summary: Animates equal-length lists element-wise into any FromIterator collection, failing on length mismatch.

nodes.name: with_zero::animate
nodes.summary: Animates shadow/filter-style lists, pairing missing entries with the other side's animated zero; Procedure::Add concatenates both lists instead.

nodes.name: repeatable_list::animate
nodes.summary: Animates lists of different lengths by cycling both to their least common multiple, failing when either list is empty.

nodes.name: animated/svg.rs
nodes.summary: Animation impls for SVG types: Animate/ComputeSquaredDistance for SVGStrokeDashArray using repeatable-list interpolation and rejecting Add/Accumulate as non-additive.

nodes.name: animated/text.rs
nodes.summary: Animation impls for text-related types: TextDecorationInset resolves text-decoration inset auto into animatable start/end LengthPercentage values with an is_auto flag, with Animate/distance/zero support.

nodes.name: TextDecorationInset
nodes.summary: Animated text-decoration inset value: start/end LengthPercentage pair plus is_auto, animating component-wise unless both sides are auto.

nodes.name: animated/transform.rs
nodes.summary: Transform interpolation for the Stylo style engine: 2D/3D matrix decomposition (MatrixDecomposed2D/3D, Quaternion) with recomposition, and Animate for computed Transform/TransformOperation doing matched-prefix interpolation, identity fill for uneven lists, and InterpolateMatrix/AccumulateMatrix fallback for mismatched transform functions.

nodes.name: InnerMatrix2D
nodes.summary: 2x2 linear part of a decomposed 2D matrix, animated component-wise with multiplicative handling for the scale-diagonal entries.

nodes.name: MatrixDecomposed2D
nodes.summary: Decomposed 2D matrix (translate/scale/angle/InnerMatrix2D) with animate() handling flipped axes and shortest-way rotation per css-transforms, and From<Matrix3D> decomposition/recomposition.

nodes.name: MatrixDecomposed3D
nodes.summary: Decomposed 3D matrix (translate, scale, skew, perspective, quaternion rotation) enabling per-component interpolation and distance computation for matrix3d() animations.

nodes.name: Quaternion
nodes.summary: Quaternion (x, y, z, w) with dot-product-based interpolation for 3D rotation, negating to the matching hemisphere before slerp-style interpolation.

nodes.name: computed/align.rs
nodes.summary: Computed values for CSS Box Alignment in Stylo: re-exports specified ContentDistribution/ItemPlacement/SelfAlignment and defines ComputedJustifyItems carrying both specified and computed values so the legacy keyword can be resolved in StyleAdjuster without breaking style sharing.

nodes.name: ComputedJustifyItems
nodes.summary: Computed justify-items value storing the specified (possibly legacy) value alongside the computed one; ToComputedValue assumes normal for bare legacy and defers the inheritance special case to StyleAdjuster.

nodes.name: computed/angle.rs
nodes.summary: Computed Angle value for Stylo: stored in degrees with radian/degree conversion, Zero/Neg/AddAssign and derived Animate, ComputeSquaredDistance using the SVG angle-distance formula, and ToTyped reification into a Typed OM deg UnitValue.

nodes.name: Angle
nodes.summary: Computed angle in degrees with from_radians/from_degrees constructors, radians()/radians64() accessors, derived animation support, and ToTyped producing a NumericValue with the angle numeric type.

nodes.name: computed/animation.rs
nodes.summary: Computed values for animation/transition properties in Stylo: AnimationDuration, AnimationIterationCount (number or infinite), AnimationTimeline, ViewTimelineInset, and animation-range start/end aliases over generic animation value types.

nodes.name: AnimationIterationCount
nodes.summary: Computed animation-iteration-count: an f32 where INFINITY represents infinite, with ToCss/ToTyped emitting the 'infinite' keyword accordingly.

nodes.name: AnimationDuration
nodes.summary: Computed animation-duration over Time with an Auto variant, exposing seconds() used by the animation machinery.

nodes.name: background.rs
nodes.summary: Computed values for the CSS background property group (background-size etc.); computed types derive from specified via ToComputedValue.

nodes.name: BackgroundSize
nodes.summary: Computed value of background-size, generic over NonNegativeLengthPercentage.

nodes.name: basic_shape.rs
nodes.summary: Computed values for clip-path, shape-outside and shape() basic shapes; reuses specified svg_path parsing (PathCommand, CoordPair) and generic shape definitions.

nodes.name: BasicShape
nodes.summary: Computed generic basic shape (inset rect, circle, ellipse, path/shape) used by clip-path and shape-outside.

nodes.name: ClipPath
nodes.summary: Computed clip-path value: none, basic shape, path/shape function or url.

nodes.name: ShapeOutside
nodes.summary: Computed shape-outside value combining a basic shape and an image.

nodes.name: ShapeCommand
nodes.summary: Computed command of the CSS shape() function, generic over Angle/Position/LengthPercentage.

nodes.name: PathOrShapeFunction
nodes.summary: Computed either an SVG path() or a shape() function, sharing SVGPathPosition parsing from specified::svg_path.

nodes.name: border.rs
nodes.summary: Computed values for the border/border-image/border-radius property group; widths resolve to device pixels (Au) at computed-value time.

nodes.name: BorderSideWidth
nodes.summary: Computed border-*-width, an absolute Au length after resolving thin/medium/thick keywords.

nodes.name: BorderRadius
nodes.summary: Computed border-radius, generic over NonNegativeLengthPercentage.

nodes.name: BorderImageSlice
nodes.summary: Computed border-image-slice value over NonNegativeNumberOrPercentage with fill keyword.

nodes.name: BorderImageWidth
nodes.summary: Computed border-image-width as a rect of side widths (number, percentage or auto).

nodes.name: BorderSpacing
nodes.summary: Computed border-spacing pair of NonNegativeLength values (table layout).

nodes.name: box.rs
nodes.summary: Computed values for the box layout property group (display-side properties like overflow, resize, zoom, line-clamp, perspective); keywords are mirrored from specified::box_.

nodes.name: Resize
nodes.summary: Computed enum for the resize property (none/both/horizontal/vertical).

nodes.name: Zoom
nodes.summary: Computed value of the zoom property, a normalized f32 factor with clamping and serialization.

nodes.name: BaselineShift
nodes.summary: Computed baseline-shift value generic over LengthPercentage.

nodes.name: ContainIntrinsicSize
nodes.summary: Computed contain-intrinsic-size value generic over NonNegativeLength (with none/last-remembered variants).

nodes.name: Perspective
nodes.summary: Computed perspective value generic over NonNegativeLength (none or length).

nodes.name: LineClamp
nodes.summary: Computed line-clamp value generic over positive integers (max lines and block-ellipsis).

nodes.name: calc.rs
nodes.summary: Computed leaf nodes for calc() math expressions across length/angle/time/percentage/number/resolution units; simplification lives in specified/calc with ComputedLeaf feeding CalcNode.

nodes.name: ComputedLeaf
nodes.summary: Computed leaf value of a calc() node: resolved Length, Angle, Percentage, Number, Resolution or Time.

nodes.name: CalcPercentageLeaf
nodes.summary: Specialized calc leaf for percentage-only expressions, generic over Percentage.

nodes.name: color.rs
nodes.summary: Computed values for the color property group (color, caret-color, color-mix); resolves specified colors (system colors, currentcolor) into AbsoluteColor at computed-value time.

nodes.name: Color
nodes.summary: Computed color, GenericColor<Percentage>, resolving currentcolor and system colors to AbsoluteColor.

nodes.name: ColorMix
nodes.summary: Computed color-mix() result, GenericColorMix<Color, Percentage> after interpolation normalization.

nodes.name: ColorPropertyValue
nodes.summary: Alias of AbsoluteColor used as the final computed color value handed to layout.

nodes.name: column.rs
nodes.summary: Computed values for the CSS multicol property group (column-count); thin alias module over the generic column count.

nodes.name: ColumnCount
nodes.summary: Computed column-count: auto or a positive integer.

nodes.name: corner_shape.rs
nodes.summary: Computed values for the corner-shape property (superellipse/round/square/bevel/scoop/notch); mirrors the specified keywords with a computed rect helper.

nodes.name: CornerShape
nodes.summary: Computed corner-shape value with parameters (e.g. superellipse k values) per corner.

nodes.name: CornerShapeRect
nodes.summary: Computed rect describing corner shaping for all four corners.

nodes.name: counters.rs
nodes.summary: Computed values for counter-increment/reset/set and the content property; count values resolve to i32 with calc() already evaluated.

nodes.name: CounterIncrement
nodes.summary: Computed counter-increment list of (name, i32 delta) pairs.

nodes.name: CounterReset
nodes.summary: Computed counter-reset list of (name, i32 initial value) pairs.

nodes.name: CounterSet
nodes.summary: Computed counter-set list of (name, i32 value) pairs.

nodes.name: Content
nodes.summary: Computed content property value, generic over the computed Image for url()/image-set items.

nodes.name: ContentItem
nodes.summary: Single computed content item: string, counter(), counters(), attr(), url image or quotes.

nodes.name: easing.rs
nodes.summary: Computed timing functions for the transition/animation property group; converts specified keywords/steps to piecewise-linear functions plus integer/number parameters.

nodes.name: ComputedTimingFunction
nodes.summary: Computed easing::TimingFunction<Integer, Number, PiecewiseLinearFunction> used by animations and transitions.

nodes.name: TimingFunction
nodes.summary: Alias of ComputedTimingFunction for transition-timing-function/animation-timing-function.

nodes.name: effects.rs
nodes.summary: Computed values for the filter and box-shadow effect property group; lengths resolve at computed-value time and urls are kept (or dropped in the servo variant).

nodes.name: BoxShadow
nodes.summary: Computed box-shadow item generic over Color and resolved lengths.

nodes.name: Filter
nodes.summary: Computed filter list (blur, brightness, url() in gecko config) generic over Angle/Number/Length.

nodes.name: SimpleShadow
nodes.summary: Computed drop-shadow() parameter set: color plus offsets and blur radius.

nodes.name: flex.rs
nodes.summary: Computed values for the flexbox item properties (flex-basis); thin alias over the generic flex basis using computed Size.

nodes.name: FlexBasis
nodes.summary: Computed flex-basis: content keyword or a Size value.

nodes.name: font.rs
nodes.summary: Computed values for the font property group (font-family/size/weight/style/width/variant, line-height, font-feature/variation-settings, math-depth); the largest computed values module, with fixed-point storage for weight/style/width and parsing for SingleFontFamily reused by specified.

nodes.name: FontWeight
nodes.summary: Computed font-weight stored as fixed-point (u16 with FONT_WEIGHT_FRACTION_BITS), in the 1..1000 range.

nodes.name: FontSize
nodes.summary: Computed font-size in application units plus font-size-adjust info, computed against FontBaseSize from specified::length.

nodes.name: FontFamily
nodes.summary: Computed font-family: list of single families sharing a FontFamilyList refcounted vector.

nodes.name: SingleFontFamily
nodes.summary: One computed family: a named family or generic keyword; implements Parse (parse entry shared with specified values).

nodes.name: SingleFontFamily::parse
nodes.summary: Parse impl for a single font family token (ident or quoted string), reused when parsing font-family lists.

nodes.name: GenericFontFamily
nodes.summary: Computed generic families (serif, sans-serif, system-ui, math, etc.) with font-name mapping support.

nodes.name: FontStyle
nodes.summary: Computed font-style (normal/italic/oblique angle) stored as fixed-point i16.

nodes.name: FontWidth
nodes.summary: Computed font-width (stretch) stored as fixed-point u16 percentage.

nodes.name: LineHeight
nodes.summary: Computed line-height: normal, number, or non-negative length.

nodes.name: FontVariationSettings
nodes.summary: Computed font-variation-settings list of 4-char tags with float values.

nodes.name: image.rs
nodes.summary: Computed values for the image property group (background-image, content images, gradients, image-set, cross-fade); mirrors specified::image generics with computed Color/Percentage/Resolution and specified gradient parsing.

nodes.name: Image
nodes.summary: Computed image value: url, gradient, image-set, cross-fade, element or paint-worklet.

nodes.name: Gradient
nodes.summary: Computed gradient (linear/radial/conic) generic over computed items; structure comes from specified parsing.

nodes.name: LineDirection
nodes.summary: Computed direction of a linear-gradient: angle or position-derived line.

nodes.name: ImageSet
nodes.summary: Computed image-set() with resolution candidates (1x/dppx).

nodes.name: CrossFade
nodes.summary: Computed cross-fade() of two images with a percentage mix weight.

nodes.name: length_percentage.rs
nodes.summary: Core computed LengthPercentage type: a tagged union (tag + f32 or CalcLengthPercentage) shared by nearly every length-accepting property; resolves calc() against FontBaseSize/LineHeightBase and handles anchor-pos() resolution.

nodes.name: LengthPercentage
nodes.summary: Computed length-percentage: NumericUnion tagged value (length, percentage, or calc) with resolution against reference font sizes.

nodes.name: LengthPercentageTag
nodes.summary: Discriminant bits packing length/percentage/calc variants (and anch flags) into the union tag.

nodes.name: CalcLengthPercentage
nodes.summary: Computed calc() node that still needs resolution (clamped lengths, percentages, anchor sides).

nodes.name: Unpacked
nodes.summary: View of a LengthPercentage as Length, Percentage, or Calc for fast matching.

nodes.name: NonNegativeLengthPercentage
nodes.summary: Non-negative wrapper of computed LengthPercentage.

nodes.name: length.rs
nodes.summary: Core computed absolute length types (CSSPixelLength) and derived aliases for size/margin/width properties (Size, MaxSize, Margin, LengthOrAuto); conversion entry is ToComputedValue with font-relative resolution.

nodes.name: CSSPixelLength
nodes.summary: Absolute computed length in CSS pixels (newtype over f32) used by layout.

nodes.name: Length
nodes.summary: Alias of CSSPixelLength; the resolved computed length value.

nodes.name: Size
nodes.summary: Computed width/height value generic over NonNegativeLengthPercentage (with auto).

nodes.name: Margin
nodes.summary: Computed margin value: auto or LengthPercentage.

nodes.name: LengthOrAuto
nodes.summary: Computed value that is either an absolute length or auto.

nodes.name: list.rs
nodes.summary: Computed values for the list property group (list-style-type, quotes); re-exports the specified ListStyleType/Quotes and defines the quotes initial value.

nodes.name: Quotes
nodes.summary: Computed quotes value (auto or pairs), re-exported from specified with get_initial_value here.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Hub of the computed values module: the ToComputedValue Context (style/quirks/device, font metrics, zoom), iterators, and shared aliases (Number, Integer, Opacity, NumberOrPercentage, AngleOrPercentage, grid tracks, ClipRect).

nodes.name: Context
nodes.summary: Cascader context used by all ToComputedValue impls: builder, style, cached system fonts, metrics, and for_non_inherited_property entry.

nodes.name: ComputedVecIter
nodes.summary: Iterator that computes items of a specified value list on demand against the Context.

nodes.name: AngleOrPercentage
nodes.summary: Computed angle-or-percentage union used by gradient stop positions.

nodes.name: NumberOrPercentage
nodes.summary: Computed number-or-percentage union (e.g. opacity stops, border-image slices).

nodes.name: Number
nodes.summary: Computed number alias (CSSFloat) shared across property groups.

nodes.name: Integer
nodes.summary: Computed integer alias (CSSInteger/i32).

nodes.name: Opacity
nodes.summary: Computed opacity alias clamped to 0..1 via ZeroToOneNumber.

nodes.name: motion.rs
nodes.summary: Computed values for the CSS motion path property group (offset-path, offset-position, offset-rotate); built on generic motion definitions with computed basic shapes and positions.

nodes.name: OffsetRotate
nodes.summary: Computed offset-rotate: auto/auto keyword flag plus a fixed angle.

nodes.name: OffsetPath
nodes.summary: Computed offset-path: none or an OffsetPathFunction (ray/basic shape/url).

nodes.name: RayFunction
nodes.summary: Computed ray() function of a motion path: angle, size and contain flag with a Position.

nodes.name: outline.rs
nodes.summary: Computed values for the outline property group; thin module re-exporting specified OutlineStyle (computed == specified).

nodes.name: OutlineStyle
nodes.summary: Computed outline-style (auto or border style), re-exported from specified.

nodes.name: page.rs
nodes.summary: Computed values for paged media (page name and the size property); PageSize resolves specified keywords/lengths to orientation + concrete dimensions.

nodes.name: PageSize
nodes.summary: Computed size property value: paper names, orientation keywords or explicit sizes.

nodes.name: param.rs
nodes.summary: Computed values for CSS link-parameters (param()); specified == computed, so this module just re-exports specified LinkParameters.

nodes.name: LinkParameters
nodes.summary: param() values of a link-parameters declaration, re-exported unchanged from specified.

nodes.name: percentage.rs
nodes.summary: Core computed Percentage type and ToPercentage helper; percentages are stored as f32 and converted from specified via ToComputedValue.

nodes.name: Percentage
nodes.summary: Computed percentage newtype over CSSFloat, with 0%/100% constructors.

nodes.name: NonNegativePercentage
nodes.summary: Non-negative wrapper of computed Percentage.

nodes.name: position.rs
nodes.summary: Computed values for the position property group (object-position, anchor positioning, inset, z-index, aspect-ratio); Position resolves to LengthPercentage pairs and anchor() keeps percentage-based sides.

nodes.name: Position
nodes.summary: Computed <position> as horizontal/vertical LengthPercentage components.

nodes.name: HorizontalPosition
nodes.summary: Computed horizontal component of a position (LengthPercentage alias).

nodes.name: AnchorSide
nodes.summary: Computed anchor-positioning side (percentage or keyword).

nodes.name: AnchorFunction
nodes.summary: Computed anchor() function resolving to percentages of the anchor element's insets.

nodes.name: Inset
nodes.summary: Computed inset property value generic over Percentage/LengthPercentage (with anchor() support).

nodes.name: ZIndex
nodes.summary: Computed z-index: auto or an integer.

nodes.name: AspectRatio
nodes.summary: Computed aspect-ratio: auto flag plus a ratio.

nodes.name: ratio.rs
nodes.summary: Computed values for the <ratio> type used by aspect-ratio; thin alias of the generic ratio over NonNegativeNumber.

nodes.name: Ratio
nodes.summary: Computed <ratio> = GenericRatio<NonNegativeNumber> (width/height numbers).

nodes.name: rect.rs

nodes.name: resolution.rs

nodes.name: svg.rs

nodes.name: SVGLength
nodes.summary: Computed <length-percentage> for SVG geometry properties like stroke-dashoffset. Alias of GenericSVGLength<LengthPercentage>.

nodes.name: SVGOpacity

nodes.name: table.rs

nodes.name: text.rs
nodes.summary: Computed values for the CSS text properties group (text-align, text-indent, letter-spacing, word-spacing, text-emphasis, hyphenate-limit-chars, initial-letter, text-decoration length/inset). nodes.name: InitialLetter
nodes.summary: Computed initial-letter value (number + integer) over GenericInitialLetter. Parsed by specified::InitialLetter::parse.

nodes.name: TextAlign

nodes.name: TextIndent

nodes.name: LetterSpacing
nodes.summary: Computed letter-spacing as GenericLetterSpacing<LengthPercentage>; supports normal keyword and calc. Parsed by the specified letter-spacing parse.

nodes.name: WordSpacing
nodes.summary: Computed word-spacing, simply a LengthPercentage (normal computes to zero). Parsed in values/specified/text.rs.

nodes.name: TextEmphasisStyle
nodes.summary: Computed text-emphasis-style (keyword set or string). Parsed by specified::TextEmphasisStyle::parse.

nodes.name: time.rs
nodes.summary: Computed <time> value serving the animation/transition property group. Parsing (s/ms units and calc) is in values/specified/time.rs; computed Time stores seconds.

nodes.name: Time
nodes.summary: Computed <time> holding a CSSFloat in seconds; supports calc resolution. Parsed by specified::Time::parse.

nodes.name: transform.rs

nodes.name: tree_counting.rs
nodes.summary: Computed result type for tree-counting functions serving the sibling-index()/sibling-count() property group. Parsing is in values/specified/tree_counting.rs.

nodes.name: TreeCountingResult
nodes.summary: Result of resolving sibling-index/sibling-count functions to an integer during computation. Parsed by specified tree-counting parse code.

nodes.name: ui.rs
nodes.summary: Computed values for the UI properties group (cursor, scrollbar-color) as aliases over generics::ui. Parsing entries are specified::Cursor::parse / ScrollbarColor::parse in values/specified/ui.rs.

nodes.name: Cursor
nodes.summary: Computed cursor value (keyword list plus optional cursor images) over GenericCursor<CursorImage>. Parsed by specified::Cursor::parse.

nodes.name: CursorImage
nodes.summary: Computed cursor image with hotspot over GenericCursorImage<Image, Number>. Parsed as part of cursor values.

nodes.name: ScrollbarColor
nodes.summary: Computed scrollbar-color (two colors or auto) over GenericScrollbarColor<Color>. Parsed by specified::ScrollbarColor::parse.

nodes.summary: Optional computed url (url | none) over GenericUrlOrNone<ComputedUrl>; used by mask, list-style-image and similar properties.

nodes.name: animation.rs

nodes.summary: Generic animation-duration list supporting the auto keyword (for view-transition durations). Parsed via specified::AnimationDuration.

nodes.name: GenericViewFunction
nodes.summary: Generic view() timeline function with optional axis and inset. Parsed by the specified view() function parser.

nodes.name: GenericAnimationTimeline
nodes.summary: Generic animation-timeline value (auto, none, scroll(), view(), named timeline). Parsed by specified::AnimationTimeline::parse.

nodes.name: GenericViewTimelineInset

nodes.name: GenericAnimationRangeValue

nodes.name: GenericAnimationRangeEnd
nodes.summary: Generic animation-range-end wrapper over GenericAnimationRangeValue. Parsed as part of the animation-range shorthand.

nodes.name: background.rs
nodes.summary: Generic values for the background property group (background-size cover/contain/length pair). Parsing entry is specified::BackgroundSize::parse in values/specified/background.rs.

nodes.name: GenericBackgroundSize
nodes.summary: Generic background-size (explicit, cover or contain). Parsed by specified::BackgroundSize::parse.

nodes.name: basic_shape.rs

nodes.summary: Geometry box combined with a basic shape for clip-path/shape-outside. Parsed by the specified basic-shape parsers.

nodes.summary: Generic clip-path value: none, url, basic shape or geometry box. Parsed by specified::ClipPath::parse.

nodes.name: GenericShapeOutside
nodes.summary: Generic shape-outside value (none, image url, or basic shape plus box). Parsed by specified::ShapeOutside::parse.

nodes.summary: Enum of basic shape functions (inset, circle, ellipse, polygon, path, shape). Central parse dispatch lives in specified/basic_shape.rs.

nodes.name: Ellipse

nodes.name: GenericPolygon
nodes.summary: polygon() basic shape with fill rule and coordinate list. Parsed within BasicShape parsing.

nodes.name: FillRule
nodes.summary: nonzero | evenodd fill rule keyword shared by polygon and path/shape functions.

nodes.name: Path

nodes.name: GenericShapeCommand
nodes.summary: Individual command of the shape() function (move/line/curve/arc/close). Parsed as part of shape().

nodes.name: border.rs

nodes.name: GenericBorderImageSideWidth
nodes.summary: Generic border-image width for one side (auto, length-percentage or number). Parsed by border-image-width parsing.

nodes.name: GenericBorderImageSlice
nodes.summary: Generic border-image-slice (four offsets plus fill keyword). Parsed by specified::BorderImageSlice::parse.

nodes.name: GenericBorderCornerRadius
nodes.summary: Generic single corner radius (two length-percentages). Used by border-radius shorthand parsing.

nodes.name: GenericBorderRadius
nodes.summary: Generic four-corner border-radius with slash-separated horizontal/vertical radii. Parsed by specified::BorderRadius::parse.

nodes.name: GenericBorderSpacing
nodes.summary: Generic border-spacing pair for table layout. Parsed by specified border-spacing parsing.

nodes.name: GenericCornerShapeRect
nodes.summary: Generic corner-shape value geometry (superellipse parameter or length pair). Parsed by corner-shape parsing.

nodes.name: box.rs
nodes.summary: Generic values for the box model / layout property group: baseline-shift, contain-intrinsic-size, block-ellipsis, max-lines, line-clamp, perspective, overflow-clip-margin, scrollbar-inset, position property enum. nodes.name: GenericBaselineShift
nodes.summary: Generic baseline-shift (baseline, sub, super, length-percentage). Parsed by specified::BaselineShift::parse.

nodes.name: GenericContainIntrinsicSize
nodes.summary: Generic contain-intrinsic-size (none, length with or without last-remembered keyword). Parsed by specified parsing.

nodes.name: BlockEllipsis
nodes.summary: block-ellipsis value (none, auto or string) for fragmentation. Parsed by specified::BlockEllipsis::parse.

nodes.name: GenericMaxLines
nodes.summary: Generic max-lines (none or integer) for line-clamp block carving. Parsed by specified::MaxLines::parse.

nodes.name: GenericLineClamp
nodes.summary: Generic line-clamp combining max-lines, block-ellipsis and continue behavior. Parsed by specified::LineClamp::parse.

nodes.name: GenericPerspective
nodes.summary: Generic perspective (none or non-negative length) for the transform group. Parsed by specified::Perspective::parse.

nodes.name: PositionProperty
nodes.summary: Static/relative/absolute/fixed/sticky position keywords with trait-based gating (anchor positioning). Parsed by specified::Position::parse.

nodes.name: GenericOverflowClipMargin
nodes.summary: Generic overflow-clip-margin (content-box plus outset length). Parsed by specified::OverflowClipMargin::parse.

nodes.name: GenericScrollbarInset
nodes.summary: Generic scrollbar inset pair used by scrollbar-gutter-related layout values. Parsed in specified/box.rs.

nodes.name: ModRemOp
nodes.summary: mod/rem operation marker inside calc nodes.

nodes.name: RoundingStrategy

nodes.name: GenericAnchorFunctionFallback
nodes.summary: Fallback argument of anchor()/anchor-size() functions. Parsed as part of anchor function parsing.

nodes.name: SimplificationResult
nodes.summary: Result of calc simplification: either a simplified leaf value or an unsimplifiable node.

nodes.name: color.rs
nodes.summary: Generic color values serving all color-accepting property groups: color-mix(), light-dark(), ColorOrAuto/CaretColor. Parsing entries are specified::Color::parse in values/specified/color.rs; this file defines the generic wrapper layer.

nodes.name: GenericCaretColor
nodes.summary: Generic caret-color (auto or color). Parsed by specified::CaretColor::parse.

nodes.name: GenericLightDark
nodes.summary: Generic light-dark() function holding two values. Parsed by the specified light-dark parser.

nodes.name: column.rs
nodes.summary: Generic values for the multicol property group (column-count). Parsing entry is specified::ColumnCount::parse in values/specified/column.rs.

nodes.name: GenericColumnCount
nodes.summary: Generic column-count (auto or positive integer). Parsed by specified::ColumnCount::parse.

nodes.name: counters.rs

nodes.name: GenericCounterIncrement
nodes.summary: Generic counter-increment list. Parsed by specified::CounterIncrement::parse.

nodes.name: GenericCounterSet
nodes.summary: Generic counter-set list. Parsed by specified::CounterSet::parse.

nodes.name: GenericCounterReset
nodes.summary: Generic counter-reset list. Parsed by specified::CounterReset::parse.

nodes.name: GenericContent
nodes.summary: Generic content property value (normal/none/contents or item list). Parsed by specified::Content::parse.

nodes.name: GenericContentItem
nodes.summary: Single content list item (string, counter(), counters(), url, attr(), quote, open/close). Parsed as part of content.

nodes.name: easing.rs
nodes.summary: Generic easing values for the animation/transition property group (timing functions: linear stops, steps, cubic-bezier, keywords). Parsing entry is specified::TimingFunction::parse in values/specified/easing.rs.

nodes.name: TimingFunction
nodes.summary: Generic timing function (keyword, steps(), cubic-bezier() or linear() stops). Parsed by specified::TimingFunction::parse.

nodes.name: TimingKeyword
nodes.summary: ease/ease-in/ease-out/ease-in-out/linear keywords.

nodes.name: StepPosition
nodes.summary: steps() position keywords (jump-*/start/end).

nodes.name: BeforeFlag
nodes.summary: Web Animations before-flag used when evaluating steps() at interval boundaries.

nodes.name: effects.rs
nodes.summary: Generic values for the filter/box-shadow/text-shadow property group. Parsing entries are specified::BoxShadow::parse, Filter::parse and SimpleShadow parsing in values/specified/effects.rs.

nodes.name: GenericBoxShadow
nodes.summary: Generic box-shadow (offsets, blur, spread, color, inset). Parsed by specified::BoxShadow::parse.

nodes.name: GenericFilter
nodes.summary: Generic filter list (blur, brightness, contrast, grayscale, drop-shadow, hue-rotate, invert, opacity, saturate, sepia, url). Parsed by specified::Filter::parse.

nodes.name: GenericSimpleShadow
nodes.summary: Generic simple shadow shared by text-shadow and drop-shadow(). Parsed by the specified shadow parser.

nodes.name: flex.rs
nodes.summary: Generic values for the flexbox property group (flex-basis). Parsing entry is specified::FlexBasis::parse in values/specified/flex.rs.

nodes.name: GenericFlexBasis
nodes.summary: Generic flex-basis (content keyword or size). Parsed by specified::FlexBasis::parse.

nodes.name: font.rs
nodes.summary: Generic values for the font property group: font-feature-settings, font-variation-settings, font-style, font-size-adjust, line-height and font tags. Parsing entries are the specified::Font*::parse implementations in values/specified/font.rs.

nodes.name: GenericFontSizeAdjust
nodes.summary: Generic font-size-adjust (none, number, or metric + factor). Parsed by specified::FontSizeAdjust::parse.

nodes.name: GenericLineHeight
nodes.summary: Generic line-height (normal, number, length). Parsed by specified::LineHeight::parse.

nodes.name: grid.rs
nodes.summary: Generic values for the CSS grid property group (grid-template-*, line names, track sizing, repeat(), flex units). Parsing entries are specified::GridTemplateComponent::parse and track parsing in values/specified/grid.rs.

nodes.name: GenericGridLine
nodes.summary: Generic <grid-line> (integer index, line name, span keyword). Parsed by specified::GridLine::parse.

nodes.name: Flex
nodes.summary: The <flex> fr unit value. Parsed by the track breadth parser.

nodes.name: GenericTrackBreadth
nodes.summary: Generic track breadth (min-content, max-content, auto, breadth, flex). Parsed as part of track-list parsing.

nodes.name: GenericTrackSize
nodes.summary: Generic track size with min/max constraints (minmax(), fit-content()). Parsed by specified::TrackSize::parse.

nodes.name: RepeatCount
nodes.summary: repeat() count (integer, auto-fill, auto-fit). Parsed within repeat() parsing.

nodes.name: GenericTrackRepeat
nodes.summary: Generic repeat() entry (count plus track sizes and line names). Parsed by specified::TrackRepeat::parse.

nodes.name: GenericTrackList
nodes.summary: Generic track list (line names plus track/template components). Parsed by specified::TrackList::parse.

nodes.name: GenericGridTemplateComponent
nodes.summary: Component of grid-template-areas/rows/columns (single track or repeated tracks). Parsed by specified::GridTemplateComponent::parse.
