nodes.summary: Specified CSS <position> combining horizontal and vertical position components with quirky three-value parsing.

nodes.name: PositionComponent
nodes.summary: One component of a <position>: center, a length-percentage, or a side keyword with optional offset.

nodes.name: HorizontalPosition
nodes.summary: Specified horizontal position component with left/right keywords.

nodes.name: ratio.rs
nodes.summary: Specified <ratio> values serving the aspect-ratio property.

nodes.name: Ratio
nodes.summary: Specified <ratio> value as a pair of non-negative numbers with an implicit denominator of 1.

nodes.name: rect.rs
nodes.summary: Specified values for CSS border rectangles: defines NonNegativeLengthOrNumberRect, a 4-sided <length-or-number> rect serving border-image-outset/slice-style properties, plus its Typed OM reification via ToTyped.

nodes.name: NonNegativeLengthOrNumberRect
nodes.summary: Type alias for Rect<NonNegativeLengthOrNumber>; parses the four sides of border-image outset-like values. Its ToTyped impl only reifies when all sides are equal.

nodes.name: resolution.rs
nodes.summary: Specified values for the <resolution> type (dppx/dpi/dpcm/x), serving media queries and the image-resolution/resolution property group. Parse entry: Resolution::parse_dimension and NoCalcResolution::parse_dimension.

nodes.name: ResolutionUnit
nodes.summary: Enum of resolution units (dppx, dpi, dpcm, x) with from_str/as_str conversion; dppx is the canonical unit.

nodes.name: NoCalcResolution
nodes.summary: A plain (non-calc) resolution value with unit conversions to dppx/dpi; parsed via parse_dimension.

nodes.name: Resolution
nodes.summary: Specified Resolution backed by NumericUnion so it can hold either an inline NoCalcResolution or a boxed calc() expression; parse entry is Resolution::parse_dimension.

nodes.name: Resolution::parse_dimension
nodes.summary: Entry point for parsing a numeric dimension with a resolution unit into a specified Resolution, used by the CSS parser for resolution-valued properties and media features.

nodes.name: source_size_list.rs
nodes.summary: Specified values for the HTML sizes attribute on img/source (source-size-list). Parse entry: SourceSizeList::parse; evaluation via SourceSizeList::evaluate resolves a media-condition-selected <length> to Au for the image loader.

nodes.name: SourceSize
nodes.summary: One entry of a sizes attribute: an optional media condition paired with a specified length value.

nodes.name: SourceSizeList
nodes.summary: List of SourceSize entries parsed from a sizes attribute; parse() is the entry point and evaluate() picks the first matching condition's length for the current device.

nodes.name: SourceSizeList::evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluates the source size list against a Device and QuirksMode, returning the effective image source width in AppUnits.

nodes.name: SourceSizeList::parse
nodes.summary: Parses the comma-separated source size list grammar of the HTML sizes attribute.

nodes.name: svg_path.rs
nodes.summary: Specified values for SVG path data, serving the d property and clip-path path(). Parse entry: SVGPathData::parse (plus parse_bytes for the SMIL/attribute path); stores a parsed list of PathCommands.

nodes.name: AllowEmpty
nodes.summary: Flag enum controlling whether an empty path string is accepted when parsing SVG path data (d allows empty, path() does not).

nodes.name: SVGPathData
nodes.summary: Parsed SVG path data as a vector of PathCommand; parse() is the CSS entry point, normalize() converts to absolute commands, and to_css serializes back to a quoted string.

nodes.name: SVGPathData::parse
nodes.summary: Parses SVG path data source syntax (M/m, L/l, C/c, arcs, etc.) into PathCommand lists, honoring the AllowEmpty flag.

nodes.name: svg.rs
nodes.summary: Specified values for SVG property group: paint-order, -moz-context-properties, the d property, and vector-effect. Parse entries are each type's Parse impl, gated by is_context_value_enabled for -moz-context-properties.

nodes.name: is_context_value_enabled
nodes.summary: Checks static prefs to decide whether context-value / -moz-context-properties support is enabled.

nodes.name: PaintOrder
nodes.summary: Keyword enum (normal / fill / stroke / markers) for the SVG paint-order property.

nodes.name: SVGPaintOrder
nodes.summary: Bitfield-combined specified value of paint-order; parses and orders fill/stroke/markers via order_at().

nodes.name: ContextPropertyBits
nodes.summary: Bitflag set tracking which properties (-moz-context-properties: fill, stroke, fill-opacity, stroke-opacity) are exposed to SVG context painting.

nodes.name: MozContextProperties
nodes.summary: Specified value of the -moz-context-properties property, a comma-separated custom-property name list stored with ContextPropertyBits.

nodes.name: DProperty
nodes.summary: Specified value of the SVG d property: either none or an SVGPathData.

nodes.name: VectorEffect
nodes.summary: Bitfield specified value of the SVG vector-effect property (none / non-scaling-stroke / non-scaling-size / fixed-position).

nodes.name: table.rs
nodes.summary: Specified values for table-related properties; currently holds the CaptionSide keyword enum serving the caption-side property.

nodes.name: CaptionSide
nodes.summary: Keyword enum (top/bottom plus logical and *-out-of-flow variants) parsed for the caption-side property.

nodes.name: text.rs
nodes.summary: Specified values for the text/typography property group: letter-spacing, word-spacing, text-overflow, text-decoration, text-transform, text-align, text-emphasis, word-break, line-break, overflow-wrap, ruby-position, text-autospace, text-box-edge/trim, and more. Parse entry is each type's Parse impl, wired through specified/mod.rs.

nodes.name: Spacing
nodes.summary: Generic spacing value (normal, <length>, or <percentage>) shared by letter-spacing and word-spacing parsing.

nodes.name: LetterSpacing
nodes.summary: Specified value of the letter-spacing property wrapping Spacing.

nodes.name: WordSpacing
nodes.summary: Specified value of the word-spacing property wrapping Spacing.

nodes.name: HyphenateCharacter
nodes.summary: Specified value of the hyphenate-character property: auto or a <string>, validated to a single grapheme.

nodes.name: TextOverflowSide
nodes.summary: One side of text-overflow: clip, ellipsis, or a <string>.

nodes.name: TextOverflow
nodes.summary: Two-sided specified value of the text-overflow property; get_initial_value() provides the clip/clip default.

nodes.name: TextDecorationLine
nodes.summary: Bitfield specified value of the text-decoration-line property (underline, overline, line-through, blink, spelling/grammar errors).

nodes.name: TextTransformCase
nodes.summary: Casing keyword (uppercase, lowercase, capitalize, full-width, full-size-kana) of text-transform.

nodes.name: TextTransform
nodes.summary: Bitfield specified value of the text-transform property combining none with case keywords; case() exposes the casing component.

nodes.name: TextAlignLast
nodes.summary: Specified value of the text-align-last property: auto or a TextAlignKeyword.

nodes.name: TextAlignKeyword
nodes.summary: Alignment keywords (start, end, left, right, center, justify) shared by text-align and text-align-last.

nodes.name: TextAlign
nodes.summary: Specified value of the text-align property: start/end (MozAlign), center, or a TextAlignKeyword per the box-alignment spec.

nodes.name: TextEmphasisStyle
nodes.summary: Specified value of text-emphasis-style: none, a fill/shape keyword pair, or a <string>.

nodes.name: TextEmphasisFillMode
nodes.summary: Filled/open fill keyword of text-emphasis-style.

nodes.name: TextEmphasisShapeKeyword
nodes.summary: Shape keyword (dot, circle, double-circle, triangle, sesame) of text-emphasis-style.

nodes.name: TextEmphasisPosition
nodes.summary: Bitfield specified value of the text-emphasis-position property encoding horizontal and vertical position keywords.

nodes.name: WordBreak
nodes.summary: Keyword enum parsed for the word-break property (normal, break-all, keep-all, break-word).

nodes.name: TextJustify
nodes.summary: Keyword enum parsed for the text-justify property (auto, none, inter-word, inter-character).

nodes.name: MozControlCharacterVisibility
nodes.summary: Keyword enum for the -moz-control-character-visibility property (visible/hidden).

nodes.name: LineBreak
nodes.summary: Keyword enum parsed for the line-break property (auto, loose, normal, strict, anywhere).

nodes.name: OverflowWrap
nodes.summary: Keyword enum parsed for the overflow-wrap property (normal, break-word, anywhere) including legacy word-wrap aliases.

nodes.name: TextDecorationSkipInk
nodes.summary: Specified value of text-decoration-skip-ink: auto, none, or -moz-none for compat.

nodes.name: TextUnderlinePosition
nodes.summary: Bitfield specified value of the text-underline-position property (auto, from-font, under, left/right).

nodes.name: RubyPosition
nodes.summary: Keyword enum parsed for the ruby-position property (over, under, alternate).

nodes.name: TextAutospace
nodes.summary: Bitfield specified value of the text-autospace property (normal, no-autospace, ideograph-alpha/numeric).

nodes.name: TextEdgeKeyword
nodes.summary: Keyword or <percentage> edge value shared by text-edge and text-box-edge parsing (text, cap, ex, ideographic, etc.).

nodes.name: TextEdge
nodes.summary: Over/under edge pair used by the text-edge (and half-leading-related) parsing.

nodes.name: TextBoxEdge
nodes.summary: Specified value of the text-box-edge property: auto or a first/last TextEdgeKeyword pair.

nodes.name: TextBoxTrim
nodes.summary: Bitfield specified value of the text-box-trim property (none, trim-both, trim-start, trim-end).

nodes.name: time.rs
nodes.summary: Specified values for the <time> type (s/ms), serving the transition/animation property group. Parse entries: Time::parse_dimension for dimensions, Time::parse_non_negative for non-negative contexts, plus calc() support via NumericUnion.

nodes.name: TimeUnit
nodes.summary: Enum of time units (s, ms) with from_str/as_str; seconds is the canonical unit.

nodes.name: NoCalcTime
nodes.summary: A plain (non-calc) time value with unit conversion helpers (seconds(), to()) and parse_dimension entry.

nodes.name: Time
nodes.summary: Specified Time backed by NumericUnion holding either a NoCalcTime or boxed calc(); parse_non_negative handles durations like transition-duration.

nodes.name: Time::parse_dimension
nodes.summary: Entry point converting a numeric value plus s/ms unit into a specified Time.

nodes.name: Time::parse_non_negative
nodes.summary: Parses a non-negative <time>, including calc() expressions clamped to zero, for duration-like properties.

nodes.name: transform.rs
nodes.summary: Specified values for the transform property group (transform-box, transform-origin components, scale factors); the full transform list itself lives in generics with shared parsing. Parse entries are the per-type Parse impls re-exported by specified/mod.rs.

nodes.name: TransformBox
nodes.summary: Keyword enum for the transform-box property (content-box, border-box, fill-box, stroke-box, view-box); initial_value() returns view-box.

nodes.name: AllowUnitlessPerspective
nodes.summary: Flag enum deciding whether the unitless zero in perspective() is accepted (needed for the transform property but not transform lists elsewhere).

nodes.name: OriginComponent
nodes.summary: Generic component of transform-origin / perspective-origin: a keyword (Center, Left/Right/Top/Bottom via Length, Side keyword), LengthPercentage, or calc.

nodes.name: ScaleFactor
nodes.summary: Wrapper over NumberOrPercentage used as the scale factor component in transform scale functions.

nodes.name: tree_counting.rs
nodes.summary: Specified values for the tree-counting functions (sibling-index()/sibling-count()) used in the counter-style/sibling positioning of the CSS trees counting spec. Parse entry: TreeCountingFunction's Parse impl; to_computed_value resolves it via the computed Context.

nodes.name: TreeCountingFunction
nodes.summary: Enum of sibling-index()/sibling-count() function calls; to_computed_value consults the computed Context (EagerSpatialTreeCounting) to produce the u32 result.

nodes.name: TreeCountingFunction::to_computed_value
nodes.summary: Resolves the tree-counting function to a u32 using per-element sibling data carried on the computed Context.

nodes.name: ui.rs
nodes.summary: Specified values for the UI property group: user-select, cursor (CursorKind), -moz-theme, pointer-events, inert, and user-focus, plus BoolInteger. Parse entries are each enum's Parse impl exposed through specified/mod.rs.

nodes.name: BoolInteger
nodes.summary: Integer-valued bool (0/1) used by UI properties that accept only 0 or 1, e.g. -moz-user-input enabled variants.

nodes.name: UserSelect
nodes.summary: Keyword enum parsed for the user-select property (auto, text, none, contain, all, element).

nodes.name: CursorKind
nodes.summary: All standard and Mozilla-extended cursor keywords parsed for the cursor property's <cursor-kind> component.

nodes.name: MozTheme
nodes.summary: Keyword enum for the -moz-theme internal property.

nodes.name: PointerEvents
nodes.summary: Keyword enum parsed for the pointer-events property (auto, none, and SVG values like visiblePainted).

nodes.name: Inert
nodes.summary: Keyword enum parsed for the inert property (none/inherit/auto).

nodes.name: UserFocus
nodes.summary: Keyword enum parsed for the -moz-user-focus property.

nodes.name: url.rs
nodes.summary: Specified values for CSS url(): re-exports crate::url::SpecifiedUrl and defines UrlOrNone = GenericUrlOrNone<SpecifiedUrl> serving all <url> | none property values.

nodes.name: UrlOrNone
nodes.summary: Type alias for Specified <url> | <none>, used by properties like list-style-image, mask, and shape rendering.

nodes.name: tagged_numeric.rs
nodes.summary: Infrastructure module providing NumericUnion, a niche-optimized tagged union storing small numeric values inline or boxing calc() expressions. It backs specified/computed Time and Resolution; parsing of the numeric forms happens in the users' parse_dimension entries.

nodes.name: NumericUnion
nodes.summary: Tagged union of an inline (tag, numeric) pair or a boxed variant B (e.g. calc()); constructed via inline()/boxed() and inspected with unpack()/extract().

nodes.name: BoxedVariant
nodes.summary: Wrapper variants (non-64-bit and 64-bit platform cases) that fit a Box<B> into the union's storage.

nodes.name: TagVariant
nodes.summary: Marker describing the tagged variant layout used by the union implementation.

nodes.name: InlineVariant
nodes.summary: Marker describing the inline (tag, value) variant layout for Copy numerics.

nodes.name: Unpacked
nodes.summary: Borrowed view enum (Inline or Boxed) returned by NumericUnion::unpack().

nodes.name: Extracted
nodes.summary: Owned view enum (Inline or Box(Box<B>)) returned by NumericUnion::extract().

nodes.name: UnpackedMut
nodes.summary: Mutable borrowed view enum returned by NumericUnion::unpack_mut().

nodes.name: input-number-ref.html

nodes.name: input-number.html

nodes.name: input-ref.html

nodes.summary: Inline focus handler: setTimeout(0)-removes the reftest-wait class from <html> after the autofocus select receives focus.

nodes.name: textarea-create document

nodes.name: script-main

nodes.name: onfocus-handler-1
nodes.summary: Focus handler of the second (first autofocus) textarea; schedules removal of the reftest-wait class from documentElement via setTimeout(..., 0) once focus is received.

nodes.name: onfocus-handler-2

nodes.name: textarea-load.html

nodes.name: textarea-load document
nodes.summary: HTML document (class reftest-wait) linking style.css, defining focusHandler in a head script, and declaring three <textarea> elements inline, two with autofocus and onfocus attributes.

nodes.name: focusHandler
nodes.summary: Global handler invoked from the autofocus textareas' onfocus attributes; schedules removal of the reftest-wait class from documentElement via setTimeout(..., 0).

nodes.name: onfocus-1

nodes.name: onfocus-2
nodes.summary: Inline onfocus attribute of the third (second autofocus) textarea; delegates to focusHandler if it receives focus.

nodes.name: textarea-ref.html

nodes.name: textarea-ref document

nodes.name: nsAttrValue.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of nsAttrValue, the space-efficient typed storage for attribute values: parses strings into enums, integers, colors, doubles, atom lists and CSS declarations (ParseStyleAttribute), and implements equality, string conversion and memory reporting.

nodes.name: nsAttrValue.h
nodes.summary: Header for nsAttrValue: a tagged-pointer value object representing an attribute's type and data (atom, integer, color, enum, CSS DeclarationBlock, atom array with a bloom filter for CSS class matching), plus MiscContainer for rare types.

nodes.name: nsContentUtils.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the nsContentUtils static-helper class: element creation per the DOM spec (NewXULOrHTMLElement) with custom-element upgrade reactions, trusted event dispatch, origin/security checks, content policy, QName parsing, image loading and fingerprinting-resistance helpers.

nodes.name: nsContentUtils.h
nodes.summary: Declaration of nsContentUtils, the central static utility class for DOM/content code: hundreds of helpers for node relationships, principals, event dispatch, parsing, custom elements and preferences-cached state; included by nearly every DOM file.

nodes.name: nsNameSpaceManager.cpp
nodes.summary: Runtime manager mapping namespace URIs to int32 namespace IDs: registers the built-in namespaces (None, XMLNS, XML, XHTML, XLink, XSLT, MathML, RDF, XUL, SVG), honors mathml.disabled/svg.disabled prefs, and hosts NS_NewElement which dispatches element construction by namespace.

nodes.name: nsNameSpaceManager.h
nodes.summary: Declaration of the nsNameSpaceManager singleton: URI-to-ID hash tables plus an ordered ID-to-atom array, registration/lookup APIs, HasElementCreator, and pref-driven MathML/SVG disabled flags.

nodes.name: nsStyledElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements id/class/style-attribute styling support shared by HTML/SVG/MathML elements: CSP-checked parsing of the style attribute into a DeclarationBlock, installing inline style declarations via SetAttrAndNotify, style reparse on demand, and autofocus handling in BindToTree.

nodes.name: nsStyledElement.h
nodes.summary: Declaration of nsStyledElement, common base for elements styled via id/class/style; overrides ParseAttribute for the style attribute, exposes Style() and AttributeStyleMap(), and declares inline-style declaration hooks.

nodes.name: ConstraintValidation.cpp
nodes.summary: Core of the HTML constraint validation API: GetValidationMessage dispatch over validity states, CheckValidity delegated to nsIConstraintValidation, and SetCustomValidity with platform line-break normalization.

nodes.name: ConstraintValidation.h
nodes.summary: Declaration of the mozilla::dom::ConstraintValidation mixin (inherits nsIConstraintValidation) providing the CheckValidity/GetValidationMessage/SetCustomValidity WebIDL methods and the custom validity string.

nodes.name: CustomStateSet.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the CustomStateSet setlike for custom element states: Add/Delete/Clear maintain nsAtom states on the target HTMLElement and notify the PresShell (CustomStatesWillChange/CustomStateChanged) so ::state pseudo-class styling invalidates.

nodes.name: CustomStateSet.h
nodes.summary: Declaration of CustomStateSet, a cycle-collected nsWrapperCache setlike (Add/Delete/Clear) bound to an HTMLElement target for the custom states WebIDL interface.

nodes.name: EditContext.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the EditContext API: manages the associated editable element and its anonymous text content, tracks the focused edit context, and coordinates IME composition and text updates via TextUpdateEvent, TextFormatUpdateEvent and CharacterBoundsUpdateEvent together with HTMLEditor and IMEStateManager.

nodes.name: nsAttrValue
nodes.summary: Typed variant holding an attribute value: inline strings (up to 12 chars), atoms, integers, colors, enums, doubles, CSS DeclarationBlocks, SVG values, or a MiscContainer; central to attribute comparison, parsing and style mapping pipelines.

nodes.name: nsContentUtils
nodes.summary: Static utility class aggregating DOM-content helpers: init/shutdown lifecycle, element creation and custom element upgrades, security and same-origin checks, trusted event dispatch, name parsing, and fingerprinting resistance.

nodes.name: nsNameSpaceManager
nodes.summary: Process-wide singleton mapping namespace URI atoms to runtime int32 IDs, with pref-controlled disabled MathML/SVG namespaces and lookup helpers used by NodeInfo creation.

nodes.name: nsStyledElement
nodes.summary: Base class (derived from Element) for elements styled via id/class/style; parses the style attribute into a CSS declaration and exposes Style() and AttributeStyleMap().

nodes.name: ConstraintValidation
nodes.summary: Mixin implementing the constraint validation API on form-associated elements via nsIConstraintValidation; stores the custom validity message and routes validity-state messages.

nodes.name: CustomStateSet
nodes.summary: WebIDL setlike exposing a custom element's custom states; holds a strong reference to its HTMLElement target and invalidates ::state styling through the PresShell.

nodes.name: nsContentUtils::NewXULOrHTMLElement
nodes.summary: Implementation of DOM spec 'create an element' for XHTML/XUL: detects custom-element names or is= values, looks up the CustomElementDefinition (optionally in a scoped registry), runs the synchronous custom constructor or enqueues upgrade reactions, and otherwise creates the element via the HTMLElementFactory/XUL element creators.

nodes.name: nsContentUtils::Init
nodes.summary: One-time global initialization: caches services, registers preference callbacks, and builds the event tables, modifier strings and other static state used across the DOM.

nodes.name: nsContentUtils::DispatchTrustedEvent
nodes.summary: Dispatches a chrome-trusted event with given name/bubble/cancelable flags on a target, used for DOMContentLoaded, visibilitychange and other internal events.

nodes.name: nsContentUtils::IsSafeToRunScript
nodes.summary: Returns true when no modal dialog or script blocker is active; the guard behind MOZ_CAN_RUN_SCRIPT entry points.

nodes.name: nsContentUtils::GetContentPolicy
nodes.summary: Caches and returns the nsIContentPolicy service used for should-load/should-process checks.

nodes.name: nsAttrValue::ParseStyleAttribute
nodes.summary: Parses a style attribute string into a Servo DeclarationBlock stored as eCSSDeclaration in the nsAttrValue, recording the scripted principal for CSP accounting.

nodes.name: nsAttrValue::ParseColor
nodes.summary: Parses a color string (hex, named, or system color) into an nscolor stored inside the value.

nodes.name: nsAttrValue::ParseEnumValue
nodes.summary: Matches the attribute string against an EnumTable and stores the resulting enum index for fast equality checks and value getters.

nodes.name: NS_NewElement
nodes.summary: Namespace-dispatching element factory: routes XHTML/XUL to NS_NewHTMLElement/NS_NewXULElement, MathML/SVG (rewriting into disabled namespaces per prefs) to their creators, otherwise the generic XMLElement; applies scoped custom element registries for non-XHTML/XUL results.

nodes.name: nsNameSpaceManager::GetInstance
nodes.summary: Returns the process-wide singleton, constructing and initializing it on first use and registering it with ClearOnShutdown.

nodes.name: nsNameSpaceManager::GetNameSpaceID
nodes.summary: Maps a namespace URI (string or atom) to its ID, returning the disabled MathML/SVG IDs per prefs when not in a chrome document.

nodes.name: nsStyledElement::ParseStyleAttribute
nodes.summary: CSP-checks the style value via nsStyleUtil::CSPAllowsInlineStyle, then parses it through nsAttrValue::ParseStyleAttribute (honoring the header-declared content style type), falling back to the raw string.

nodes.name: nsStyledElement::SetInlineStyleDeclaration
nodes.summary: Wraps a StyleLockedDeclarationBlock into an nsAttrValue and installs it as the style attribute via Element::SetAttrAndNotify inside a document update batch.

nodes.name: nsStyledElement::ReparseStyleAttribute
nodes.summary: Re-parses the style attribute when its stored value is still a plain string (first style access or binding), swapping in the parsed declaration with SetAndSwapAttr without mutation notifications.

nodes.name: ConstraintValidation::GetValidationMessage
nodes.summary: Computes the validation message by walking validity-state flags in priority order (custom error, too long/short, value missing, type mismatch, pattern, range, step, bad input) and delegating each to the element's per-state handler.

nodes.name: ConstraintValidation::CheckValidity
nodes.summary: WebIDL CheckValidity: QIs to nsIContent and delegates to nsIConstraintValidation::CheckValidity, which fires invalid events when validation fails.

nodes.name: ConstraintValidation::SetCustomValidity
nodes.summary: Stores the custom validity message with platform line breaks normalized by nsContentUtils::PlatformToDOMLineBreaks and toggles VALIDITY_STATE_CUSTOM_ERROR.

nodes.name: CustomStateSet::Add
nodes.summary: Setlike Add: atomizes the state string, ignores duplicates, appends to the target element's custom states, and notifies the PresShell (CustomStatesWillChange/CustomStateChanged) to invalidate ::state styling.

nodes.name: CustomStateSet::Delete
nodes.summary: Setlike Delete via the generated setlike helpers, then removes the state atom from the element's state array with PresShell invalidation.

nodes.name: CustomStateSet::Clear
nodes.summary: Setlike Clear: drains the element's custom-state array, notifying the PresShell for each removed state so dependent styling invalidates.

nodes.name: EditContext::Constructor
nodes.summary: WebIDL constructor: validates the global object, builds the EditContext from the init dictionary and returns it (focus tracking and IME wiring happen in the instance).

nodes.name: EditContext.h
nodes.summary: Header for the EditContext DOM API (w3c/edit-context). EditContext derives from DOMEventTargetHelper and SupportsWeakPtr, maintaining its own text state, selection, control/selection/character bounds, an anonymous text container element, and IME composition/event plumbing (textupdate, compositionstart/end, textformatupdate, characterboundsupdate).

nodes.name: EditContext
nodes.summary: Implements the EditContext API: holds editable text (mText nsTextNode inside mTextContainer div), selection range, codepoint rects, control/selection bounds; exposes UpdateText/UpdateSelection/UpdateControlBounds/UpdateSelectionBounds/UpdateCharacterBounds, fires textupdate and composition events, suppresses IME notifications via timer, and can attach to a canvas-based or element-based editing surface via SetAssociatedElement.

nodes.name: EditContext::UpdateText
nodes.summary: WebIDL method replacing the text in [aRangeStart, aRangeEnd) with aText, updating internal text state and selection.

nodes.name: EditContext::StartComposition
nodes.summary: Handles WidgetCompositionEvent to begin IME composition: marks composing state and routes composition data into the EditContext text model.

nodes.name: ElementInternals.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of ElementInternals: form-associated custom element support (setFormValue, setValidity, validation), nsIFormControl plumbing (form/fieldset wiring, submit/reset), ARIA attribute reflection backed by an own AttrArray, and explicitly-set attr-element(s) maps per HTML spec.

nodes.name: ElementInternals.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring ElementInternals (nsIFormControl + nsIConstraintValidation + nsWrapperCache) with WebIDL accessors (shadowRoot, form, validity, labels, states), ARIA_REFLECT_ATTR* macros generating ~50 reflected ARIA getters/setters, and storage for submission value/state, validation anchor, and attr-element maps.

nodes.name: ElementInternals
nodes.summary: Per-custom-element internals object (element.internals). Implements nsIFormControl and nsIConstraintValidation for form-associated custom elements, stores FACE submission value/state/state key, validation message/anchor, a shadow AttrArray for reflected ARIA attributes, and explicitly-set attr-element caches (mAttrElementMap/mAttrElementsMap).

nodes.name: ElementInternals::SetFormValue
nodes.summary: WebIDL setFormValue(): stores the element's submission value and optional state (File/USVString/FormData) and invalidates form state per the FACE spec.

nodes.name: ElementInternals::SetValidity
nodes.summary: WebIDL setValidity(): merges ValidityStateFlags into the internal validity state, sets an optional validation message and validation anchor element, updating constraint-validation UI state.

nodes.name: ElementInternals::ReportValidity
nodes.summary: WebIDL reportValidity(): reports the validation message (e.g. via error popup anchored at the validation anchor) and returns whether the element is valid.

nodes.name: ElementInternals::SubmitNamesValues
nodes.summary: nsIFormControl override that appends the FACE submission name/value into the FormData during form submission.

nodes.name: ElementInternals::GetAttrElements
nodes.summary: Resolves the cached explicitly-set attr-elements (e.g. aria-describedby elements) for an attribute, materializing weak references into a returned element array.

nodes.name: FetchPriority.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements conversion from RequestPriority to FetchPriority and DEBUG-only logging that maps a FetchPriority to nsISupportsPriority constants for diagnostic output.

nodes.name: FetchPriority.h
nodes.summary: Defines the FetchPriority enum (High/Low/Auto) per the HTML fetch priority attributes spec, ToFetchPriority conversion, FETCH_PRIORITY_ADJUSTMENT_FOR pref macro mapping to network.fetchpriority.adjustments.* prefs, and attribute string constants.

nodes.name: FetchPriority
nodes.summary: enum class FetchPriority : uint8_t { High, Low, Auto } representing the fetchpriority attribute values shared by img/link/script elements.

nodes.name: ToFetchPriority
nodes.summary: Converts a dom::RequestPriority (fetch API) into the corresponding FetchPriority enum value.

nodes.name: LogPriorityMapping
nodes.summary: DEBUG-only logger that records how a FetchPriority maps onto an nsISupportsPriority value for debugging network prioritization.

nodes.name: HTMLAllCollection.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements document.all: lazily builds an all-elements ContentList, resolves named results by id or by name attribute on a legacy list of named elements (IsAllNamedElement), returning an element or sub-collection.

nodes.name: HTMLAllCollection.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLAllCollection (nsISupports + nsWrapperCache), the [LegacyUnenumerableNamedProperties] object behind document.all, exposing Length, indexed/named getters, Item and LegacyCall.

nodes.name: HTMLAllCollection
nodes.summary: Represents document.all; wraps a Document, a lazily created ContentList of every element, and a cache of per-name ContentLists used to resolve indexed and named lookups with document.all's falsy semantics handled by bindings.

nodes.name: HTMLAllCollection::NamedGetter
nodes.summary: Resolves document.all[name]: looks up the cached ContentList for the name (matching by id or name attribute on named elements) and returns the single element if exactly one match, the collection if multiple, or null.

nodes.name: HTMLAllCollection::Item
nodes.summary: Spec Item()/legacy call handler: treats the string argument as an array index when possible, otherwise delegates to NamedItem.

nodes.name: HTMLAllCollection::GetDocumentAllList
nodes.summary: LookupOrInsertWith helper creating and caching a ContentList (DocAllResultMatch predicate) for a given id/name used by document.all named access.

nodes.name: HTMLAreaElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the <area> element: Link integration (href state reset on attribute change, cached URI), anchor-like event handling, target resolution falling back to <base target>, and relList token list creation.

nodes.name: HTMLAreaElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLAreaElement (nsGenericHTMLElement + Link): reflected attributes alt/coords/shape/href/target/download/hreflang/type/ping/rel/referrerpolicy/nohref, reusing Link's URL attribute accessors, plus tree binding and event override declarations.

nodes.name: HTMLAreaElement
nodes.summary: The <area> element: a hypertext link inside an image map, combining nsGenericHTMLElement with Link for URL/href state; supports tabindex default 0, target resolution via base target, and relList backed by sAnchorAndFormRelValues.

nodes.name: HTMLAreaElement::GetHrefURI
nodes.summary: Returns the link URI, preferring Link's cached URI and otherwise computing it via GetHrefURIForAnchors (document base URL resolution).

nodes.name: HTMLAreaElement::AfterSetAttr
nodes.summary: Resets the Link state whenever the href attribute is set or removed, then defers to the base implementation.

nodes.name: HTMLAreaElement::RelList
nodes.summary: Lazily creates the DOMTokenList for the rel attribute, validated against anchor/form rel values.

nodes.name: HTMLBRElement.cpp
nodes.summary:
Implementation of the
element: parses the legacy clear attribute as an enum, maps it into the clear CSS property via MapAttributesIntoRule, and declares attribute-mapping tables.

nodes.name: HTMLBRElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLBRElement: defines BR element flag bits used by editor (NS_PADDING_FOR_EMPTY_EDITOR, NS_PADDING_FOR_EMPTY_LAST_LINE), the clear attribute accessors, and attribute mapping hooks.

nodes.name: HTMLBRElement
nodes.summary:
The
line break element; carries editor padding flags for empty editors/last lines and maps the legacy clear attribute to the CSS clear property.

nodes.name: HTMLBRElement::MapAttributesIntoRule
nodes.summary: Presentational hint mapping: converts the parsed clear enum (left/right/all/both) into eCSSProperty_clear via MappedDeclarationsBuilder, then applies common attribute mapping.

nodes.name: HTMLBRElement::ParseAttribute
nodes.summary: Parses the clear attribute into the kClearTable enum (left/right/all/both), falling back to the generic element parser.

nodes.name: HTMLButtonElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the <button> form control: type resolution including type=auto relative to owning <select>, activation behavior for submit/reset/button, form association and disabled fieldset handling, constraint validation barredness, state save/restore, and the command/commandfor API.

nodes.name: HTMLButtonElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLButtonElement (nsGenericHTMLFormControlElementWithState + ConstraintValidation): WebIDL attributes (disabled, form*, name, type, value), event/activation overrides, focusability, state restoration, and command-for-element plumbing.

nodes.name: HTMLButtonElement
nodes.summary: The <button> element: a labeled button supporting submit/reset/button (and auto resolving against a parent select), participating in form submission and constraint validation, with SaveState/RestoreState support and command/commandfor bindings.

nodes.name: HTMLButtonElement::ActivationBehavior
nodes.summary: Handles click activation: dispatches form submission or form reset depending on the resolved type, honoring formaction/formmethod/formtarget/formnovalidate overrides.

nodes.name: HTMLButtonElement::PostHandleEvent
nodes.summary: Post-handler for keyboard/mouse activation that simulates click for space/enter activation and manages internal-activate state.

nodes.name: HTMLButtonElement::SubmitNamesValues
nodes.summary: nsIFormControl override appending name/value to FormData when the button is the submitter (or qualifies) during form submission.

nodes.name: HTMLButtonElement::UpdateBarredFromConstraintValidation
nodes.summary: Recomputes whether the button is barred from constraint validation (e.g. disabled, readonly state, type=button/reset) and updates validity element states.

nodes.name: HTMLCanvasElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the <canvas> element: context creation for 2d/webgl/webgpu/OffscreenCanvas transfer, width/height handling, toDataURL/toBlob image extraction, captureStream frame capture, invalidation of canvas content and placeholders, print callbacks, write-only tainting checks, and moz-opaque attribute mapping.

nodes.name: HTMLCanvasElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLCanvasElement (nsGenericHTMLElement + CanvasRenderingContextHelper + SupportsWeakPtr) and the FrameCaptureListener interface used by captureStream() to receive canvas video frames on refresh-driver ticks.

nodes.name: HTMLCanvasElement
nodes.summary: The <canvas> element: manages a rendering context (2D/WebGL/WebGPU), intrinsic width/height, opaque flag, data URL/blob encoding with origin tainting (IsWriteOnly/CallerCanRead), offscreen canvas transfer, print callback, and frame capture for MediaStreams.

nodes.name: FrameCaptureListener
nodes.summary: Abstract SupportsWeakPtr interface letting captureStream() consumers register to receive copies of the canvas (NewFrame) when they report FrameCaptureRequested on a tick after painting.

nodes.name: HTMLCanvasElement::CreateContext
nodes.summary: Instantiates the requested canvas rendering context (CanvasContextType) and wires it to this canvas element.

nodes.name: HTMLCanvasElement::ToBlob
nodes.summary: Async WebIDL toBlob(): encodes the canvas image buffer (via ExtractData/GetImageBuffer) respecting write-only taint checks and calls the BlobCallback with the resulting Blob.

nodes.name: HTMLCanvasElement::CaptureStream
nodes.summary: WebIDL captureStream(): creates a CanvasCaptureMediaStream, registering a FrameCaptureListener so painted canvas frames become video frames at the requested frame rate.

nodes.name: HTMLCanvasElement::InvalidateCanvasContent
nodes.summary: Notifies that canvas pixels changed within a damage rect: marks the frame dirty, updates layer/WebRender canvas data, and schedules repaint for both in-process and offscreen-backed canvases.

nodes.name: HTMLCanvasElement::MapAttributesIntoRule
nodes.summary: Presentational hint mapping for canvas width/height attributes into aspect-ratio/width/height via MappedDeclarationsBuilder.

nodes.name: HTMLDataElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Trivial implementation of the <data> element: element construction, clone support, and WebIDL binding wrap; value attribute accessors live inline in the header.

nodes.name: HTMLDataElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLDataElement (nsGenericHTMLElement): the machine-readable value attribute accessors and clone declaration for the <data> element.

nodes.name: HTMLDataElement
nodes.summary: The <data> element linking content to a machine-readable value via the reflected value attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLDataElement::WrapNode
nodes.summary: Wraps the element with the HTMLDataElement binding prototype.

nodes.name: HTMLDataListElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the <datalist> element: cycle-collected mOptions ContentList and the MatchOptions predicate selecting non-disabled <option> children used for suggestion lists.

nodes.name: HTMLDataListElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLDataListElement (nsGenericHTMLElement): sets ELEMENT_IS_DATALIST_OR_HAS_DATALIST_ANCESTOR on construction and exposes Options() returning a cached ContentList of matching <option> elements.

nodes.name: HTMLDataListElement
nodes.summary: The <datalist> element providing predefined options for other form controls; flags itself and exposes a lazily created ContentList of enabled option descendants via Options().

nodes.name: HTMLDataListElement::MatchOptions
nodes.summary: ContentList predicate: matches XHTML option elements that are not disabled, defining the datalist's option collection.

nodes.name: HTMLDetailsElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the <details> disclosure widget: builds a UA shadow tree with named slots for the main summary and DetailsContent pseudo, fires async toggle events on open state changes, enforces exclusive-open groups by name, and supports command/commandfor toggle/open/close actions.

nodes.name: HTMLDetailsElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLDetailsElement (nsGenericHTMLElement): open/name WebIDL attributes, ToggleOpen, first-summary lookup, UA shadow tree setup, slot name customization hooks, and command handling overrides.

nodes.name: HTMLDetailsElement
nodes.summary: The <details> element: interactive disclosure widget whose open state drives a ToggleEvent, a UA shadow root with an internal-main-summary slot, name-based exclusivity groups, and toggle/open/close command support.

nodes.name: HTMLDetailsElement::SetupShadowTree
nodes.summary: Attaches the UA shadow root, appends the built-in Details stylesheet, and constructs the internal-main-summary named slot containing the default localized <summary>, plus a second slot for DetailsContent.

nodes.name: HTMLDetailsElement::AfterSetAttr
nodes.summary: On open attribute change: cancels/merges pending ToggleEvent with the old state, posts a new async toggle event, sets ElementState::OPEN, and closes same-named open details elements; on name change enforces exclusivity.

nodes.name: HTMLDetailsElement::CloseOtherElementsIfNeeded
nodes.summary: Spec algorithm ensuring details exclusivity: walks the subtree root closing other open <details> elements sharing this element's name.

nodes.name: HTMLDetailsElement::HandleCommandInternal
nodes.summary: Handles commandfor commands Toggle/Open/Close (behind dom.element.commandfor.on_details.enabled) by mutating the open state.

nodes.name: HTMLDialogElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the <dialog> element: show/showModal/close/requestClose per HTML spec, top-layer (modal) management, CloseWatcher integration with DialogCloseWatcherListener, toggle/beforetoggle/cancel event queuing, focus restoration, closedby attribute parsing and command handling.

nodes.name: HTMLDialogElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLDialogElement: open/closedby/returnValue accessors, ClosedBy enum (Auto/None/Any/CloseRequest), CloseWatcher member, setup/cleanup steps, previously-focused-element tracking, and command action support.

nodes.name: HTMLDivElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the <div> element: align attribute parsing (ParseDivAlignValue) and style mapping (MapDivAlignAttributeInto) plus common attribute mapping.

nodes.name: HTMLDivElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLDivElement, a minimal nsGenericHTMLElement subclass for <div> with legacy align attribute accessors and mapped-attribute support.

nodes.name: HTMLDNSPrefetch.cpp
nodes.summary: DNS-prefetch machinery for <link rel=dns-prefetch> and speculative anchor prefetch: permission checks, immediate and deferred (DeferredDNSPrefetches ring-buffer queue, flushed on load end via timer/web-progress) lookups through nsIDNSService, cancellation, NoOpDNSListener, and SupportsDNSPrefetch mixin implementation.

nodes.name: HTMLDNSPrefetch.h
nodes.summary: Declares static HTMLDNSPrefetch service (IsAllowed/Prefetch/CancelPrefetch/DeferPrefetch, Priority and PrefetchSource enums) and the SupportsDNSPrefetch mixin that element subclasses (link, anchor) embed to track in-flight DNS prefetch state.

nodes.name: HTMLEmbedElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the <embed> element on top of nsObjectLoadingContent: deferred StartObjectLoad on tree binding, src attribute change handling that triggers LoadObject, allowfullscreen propagation to the BrowsingContext, image margin/size/align attribute mapping, focus behavior and content-policy type.

nodes.name: HTMLEmbedElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLEmbedElement (nsGenericHTMLElement + nsObjectLoadingContent): WebIDL accessors for align/height/name/width/src/type, GetSVGDocument, AllowFullscreen, object-load entry points and capability flags.

nodes.name: HTMLFieldSetElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the <fieldset> element: elements ContentList of listed form controls, first-legend tracking on child insertion/removal with notifications, disabled state propagation to dependent elements, aggregated validity (UpdateValidity) propagated across nested fieldsets, and ConstraintValidation barred state.

nodes.name: HTMLFieldSetElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLFieldSetElement (nsGenericHTMLFormControlElement + ConstraintValidation): disabled/name/type WebIDL, Elements() collection, dependent-element registry, first legend tracking and validity aggregation members.

nodes.name: HTMLFontElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the legacy <font> element: legacy font size parsing, color parsing, and MapAttributesIntoRule mapping face/size/color to font-family/font-size/color CSS (with quirks-mode text-decoration color override).

nodes.name: HTMLFontElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLFontElement, a minimal nsGenericHTMLElement subclass exposing legacy color/face/size attribute accessors and mapped-attribute support.

nodes.name: HTMLFormControlsCollection.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of form.elements collection: ShouldBeInElements control-type filter, tree-order merge of mElements/mNotInElements into GetSortedControls, named-item lookup table maintenance (RadioNodeList or Element), and HTMLCollection interface surface.

nodes.name: HTMLFormControlsCollection.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLFormControlsCollection (an HTMLCollection): weak form back-pointer, TreeOrderedArray mElements/mNotInElements, name lookup hashtable, and sorted-controls builder used for form submission.

nodes.name: HTMLFormElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the <form> element: submit/reset event handling (MaybeSubmit/RequestSubmit/DoSubmit), entry-list construction firing formdata, submission building and dispatch (BuildSubmission/SubmitSubmission, dialog method, secure-to-insecure check), control/image registration tables and past-names map, validity checks, implicit submission and default-submit tracking.

nodes.name: HTMLFormElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLFormElement: WebIDL form attributes (action/method/enctype/novalidate/target/rel...), elements collection and length, submit/reset APIs, element and image registration tables, pending-submission state, default submit element tracking, and RemoveElementRunnable.

nodes.name: HTMLFormSubmission.cpp
nodes.summary: Form submission encoders: GetFromForm factory choosing urlencoded/multipart/text-plain/dialog submissions from method/enctype attributes; EncodingFormSubmission charset encoding with newline/escaping modes; FSMultipartFormData multipart bodies with random boundary and multiplexed streams; DialogFormSubmission collecting the dialog return value.

nodes.name: HTMLFormSubmission.h
nodes.summary: Declares the HTMLFormSubmission abstract base (AddNameValuePair/AddNameBlobPair/AddNameDirectoryPair/GetEncodedSubmission) and subclasses EncodingFormSubmission, DialogFormSubmission and FSMultipartFormData.

nodes.name: HTMLFormSubmissionConstants.h
nodes.summary: Constants for form method (NS_FORM_METHOD_GET/POST/DIALOG) and enctype (URLENCODED/MULTIPART/TEXTPLAIN) plus the kFormMethodTable/kFormEnctypeTable enum tables with defaults used when parsing form attributes.

nodes.name: HTMLFrameElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the legacy <frame> element on nsGenericHTMLFrameElement: parsing of bordercolor/frameborder/marginwidth/marginheight/scrolling attributes and WebIDL binding wrap.

nodes.name: HTMLFrameElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLFrameElement: WebIDL accessors for frameborder/longdesc/marginheight/marginwidth/name/noresize/scrolling/src plus contentDocument/contentWindow inherited from the frame-element base.

nodes.name: HTMLFrameSetElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the legacy <frameset> element: rows/cols spec parsing into nsFramesetSpec arrays (percent/relative/fixed units, quirks-mode quirks), reflow vs frame-reconstruction change hints, bordercolor/frameborder/border attribute parsing, and window event-handler forwarding (onload etc.) to the inner window.

nodes.name: HTMLDialogElement
nodes.summary: DOM class for the <dialog> element. Implements the HTML dialog algorithms (show, showModal, close, requestClose), computes closedby state, integrates with CloseWatcher for light dismiss, manages top-layer/modal state and focus restoration, and supports command actions (showmodal/close/requestclose).

nodes.name: HTMLDivElement
nodes.summary: DOM class for the <div> element; provides legacy align attribute accessors, its parsing, and mapped-attribute-to-style conversion.

nodes.name: HTMLDNSPrefetch
nodes.summary: Static helper coordinating DNS prefetches initiated by link/anchor elements: checks document permission, submits or defers lookups to nsIDNSService with partitioned OriginAttributes and TRR mode, and cancels in-flight requests.

nodes.name: SupportsDNSPrefetch
nodes.summary: Mixin subclassed by elements supporting DNS prefetch (HTMLLinkElement, HTMLAnchorElement); tracks request/deferred/destroyed state bits and offers TryDNSPrefetch/CancelDNSPrefetch/Destroyed hooks without virtual overhead.

nodes.name: HTMLEmbedElement
nodes.summary: DOM class for the <embed> element combining nsGenericHTMLElement with nsObjectLoadingContent to load plugin/image/document content, expose the embed WebIDL API, and manage focusability and fullscreen allowance.

nodes.name: HTMLFieldSetElement
nodes.summary: DOM class for the <fieldset> form-associated element; tracks dependent form controls, aggregates their validity, manages disabled-state propagation and the first <legend> child, and is always barred from constraint validation.

nodes.name: HTMLFontElement
nodes.summary: DOM class for the legacy <font> element exposing color/face/size attributes which are mapped into presentation CSS.

nodes.name: HTMLFormControlsCollection
nodes.summary: HTMLCollection backing form.elements: holds weak form reference, tree-ordered arrays of controls in and out of elements, name->control lookup table with RadioNodeList support, and produces sorted control lists for submission.

nodes.name: HTMLFormElement
nodes.summary: DOM class for the <form> element: association of form controls and images, entry-list construction, submit/reset pipelines with validation and event firing, deferred submissions from script, default-submit-element tracking, and named-item resolution via past-names map.

nodes.name: HTMLFormSubmission
nodes.summary: Abstract base for form submissions holding action URL, target, encoding and FormData; declares AddNameValuePair/AddNameBlobPair/AddNameDirectoryPair and GetEncodedSubmission implemented by encoding-specific subclasses.

nodes.name: EncodingFormSubmission
nodes.summary: Intermediate submission base adding character-encoding support via EncodeVal with newline normalization and Content-Disposition escaping modes (name/filename/value).

nodes.name: DialogFormSubmission
nodes.summary: Submission variant for method=dialog: collects the dialog's return value instead of producing an HTTP submission; data-adding methods MOZ_CRASH.

nodes.name: FSMultipartFormData
nodes.summary: multipart/form-data encoder: interleaves string/file chunks into an nsIMultiplexInputStream with a random boundary, handling name/value, blob/file and directory entries; always POSTs.

nodes.name: HTMLFrameElement
nodes.summary: DOM class for the legacy <frame> element, subclass of nsGenericHTMLFrameElement exposing frameborder/longdesc/marginheight/marginwidth/name/noresize/scrolling/src and contentDocument/contentWindow.

nodes.name: HTMLFrameSetElement
nodes.summary: DOM class for the legacy <frameset> element: parses rows/cols specs, computes layout change hints for row/col count changes, and forwards window event handlers (WINDOW_EVENT_* helpers) to the inner window.

nodes.name: HTMLDialogElement::Close
nodes.summary: Closes the dialog per spec: fires beforetoggle, removes the open attribute and top-layer membership, records the return value, restores focus to the previously focused element, and async-dispatches the close event.

nodes.name: HTMLDialogElement::RequestClose
nodes.summary: Implements requestClose(): stores request-close return value and source element, enables the CloseWatcher, and requests close (falling back to RunCancelDialogSteps when the CloseWatcher pref is off).

nodes.name: HTMLDialogElement::Show
nodes.summary: Non-modal show(): validates state, fires cancelable beforetoggle, sets the open attribute, hides popovers until the topmost popover ancestor, stores previously focused element and runs dialog focusing steps.

nodes.name: HTMLDialogElement::ShowModal
nodes.summary: Modal show(): throws InvalidStateError when appropriate, adds the dialog to the top layer via AddToTopLayerIfNeeded, blocks the document, hides popovers, and focuses the dialog.

nodes.name: HTMLDialogElement::SetDialogCloseWatcherIfNeeded
nodes.summary: Creates the dialog's CloseWatcher, installs DialogCloseWatcherListener for cancel/close events, syncs its enabled state from the computed closedby value, and registers it with the window's CloseWatcherManager.

nodes.name: HTMLDivElement::ParseAttribute
nodes.summary: Parses the legacy align attribute via ParseDivAlignValue, delegating other attributes to nsGenericHTMLElement.

nodes.name: HTMLDivElement::MapAttributesIntoRule
nodes.summary: Maps the div align attribute into CSS declarations through MapDivAlignAttributeInto and applies common attribute mapping via MappedDeclarationsBuilder.

nodes.name: HTMLDNSPrefetch::IsAllowed
nodes.summary: Checks preferences and document/link state to decide whether DNS prefetching is permitted for the requesting document.

nodes.name: HTMLDNSPrefetch::DeferPrefetch
nodes.summary: Enqueues an element's DNS lookup in the DeferredDNSPrefetches queue so it is submitted after page load, tracking the SupportsDNSPrefetch state.

nodes.name: HTMLDNSPrefetch::Prefetch
nodes.summary: Submits an async DNS lookup for a hostname via nsIDNSService with priority-derived flags and partitioned OriginAttributes, ignoring completion through NoOpDNSListener.

nodes.name: HTMLDNSPrefetch::CancelPrefetch
nodes.summary: Cancels a pending DNS prefetch for the given host/TRR mode/priority, reporting the reason to the DNS service.

nodes.name: HTMLDNSPrefetch::SendRequest
nodes.summary: Resolves the element's prefetch URI (via SupportsDNSPrefetch::GetURIForDNSPrefetch) and issues the actual DNS request with the supplied DNS flags.

nodes.name: SupportsDNSPrefetch::GetURIForDNSPrefetch
nodes.summary: Returns the URI whose host should be prefetched, unwrapping the owning element as either an HTMLLinkElement (its href URI) or an HTMLAnchorElement (its URI).

nodes.name: HTMLEmbedElement::StartObjectLoad
nodes.summary: Initiates the object load via LoadObject when the embed is in an active document, then clears the network-created flag; used by BindToTree's script runner.

nodes.name: HTMLEmbedElement::AfterMaybeChangeAttr
nodes.summary: On src attribute changes (when notified and in-document, and loading not blocked), schedules LoadObject asynchronously via a script runner.

nodes.name: HTMLEmbedElement::MapAttributesIntoRule
nodes.summary: Maps image margin/size/align attributes into CSS declarations plus common attributes using MappedDeclarationsBuilder; a hidden-excepting variant serves as the attribute mapping function.

nodes.name: HTMLEmbedElement::ParseAttribute
nodes.summary: Parses align (ParseAlignValue) and width/height/hspace/vspace as HTML dimensions, delegating remaining attributes to the base class.

nodes.name: HTMLEmbedElement::GetCapabilities
nodes.summary: Reports object-loading capabilities: images, documents, and the plugin skip-channel allowance.

nodes.name: HTMLFieldSetElement::Elements
nodes.summary: Lazily creates and returns the fieldset's ContentList of listed form-control descendants filtered by MatchListedElements (controls whose GetFieldSet is this fieldset).

nodes.name: HTMLFieldSetElement::AddElement
nodes.summary: Registers a dependent control or nested fieldset: folds nested invalid counts into this fieldset's validity, marks ContentLists dirty for form-associated custom elements, and updates validity for invalid controls.

nodes.name: HTMLFieldSetElement::UpdateValidity
nodes.summary: Adjusts the invalid-elements counter, toggles VALID/INVALID element states at transitions, and propagates the change up the ancestor fieldset chain.

nodes.name: HTMLFieldSetElement::UpdateDisabledState
nodes.summary: Updates the fieldset's own disabled state and notifies every dependent element via FieldSetDisabledChanged so descendants recompute their disabledness.

nodes.name: HTMLFieldSetElement::NotifyElementsForFirstLegendChange
nodes.summary: When the first legend changes, iterates the listed-elements ContentList and calls FieldSetFirstLegendChanged on each control.

nodes.name: HTMLFontElement::ParseAttribute
nodes.summary: Parses the legacy size attribute with ParseLegacyFontSize and color with ParseColor, delegating others to the base class.

nodes.name: HTMLFontElement::MapAttributesIntoRule
nodes.summary: Maps face/size/color into font-family/font-size/color CSS properties (quirks mode adds text-decoration color override) via MappedDeclarationsBuilder, then applies common attributes.

nodes.name: HTMLFormControlsCollection::ShouldBeInElements
nodes.summary: Static filter deciding which FormControlTypes appear in form.elements (everything but InputImage, for IE/4.x compatibility).

nodes.name: HTMLFormControlsCollection::GetSortedControls
nodes.summary: Merges the already-sorted mElements and mNotInElements arrays into a single document-order control list using CompareTreePosition with an index cache; consumed by form submission.

nodes.name: HTMLFormControlsCollection::NamedGetter
nodes.summary: Resolves a name/id through the lookup table to either an Element or a RadioNodeList for the WebIDL named getter.

nodes.name: HTMLFormControlsCollection::AddElementToTable
nodes.summary: Adds a named control into mNameLookupTable via the form's AddElementToTableInternal, skipping controls that ShouldBeInElements rejects.

nodes.name: HTMLFormElement::MaybeSubmit
nodes.summary: Implements the front of the concept-form-submit algorithm: checks whether submission can proceed (novalidate, firing submit events, submitter handling) before invoking DoSubmit.

nodes.name: HTMLFormElement::DoSubmit
nodes.summary: Drives submission: builds the HTMLFormSubmission, defers when script-triggered (mDeferSubmission), performs secure-to-insecure checks, dispatches chrome before-submit notification, and submits via SubmitSubmission or SubmitDialog.

nodes.name: HTMLFormElement::SubmitSubmission
nodes.summary: Encodes the submission, resolves the action URL and target browsing context, applies popup-blocker state and double-submit protection, and loads the resulting document/channel.

nodes.name: HTMLFormElement::ConstructEntryList
nodes.summary: Constructs the form data set: iterates sorted controls, gathers entries (including submitter, disabled filtering, files/directories), populates FormData, and fires the formdata event.

nodes.name: HTMLFormElement::CheckFormValidity
nodes.summary: Statically validates constraints across controls, collecting invalid elements and dispatching invalid events; backs CheckValidity()/ReportValidity() paths.

nodes.name: HTMLFormSubmission::GetFromForm
nodes.summary: Factory creating the appropriate HTMLFormSubmission from the form's method/enctype attributes (GET/POST x urlencoded/multipart/text-plain, or DialogFormSubmission for method=dialog), resolving the action URL and submitter encoding.

nodes.name: HTMLFormSubmission::GetSubmitterElement
nodes.summary: Returns the submitter element recorded by encoding submissions (null for the base class).

nodes.name: EncodingFormSubmission::EncodeVal
nodes.summary: Encodes a Unicode string to bytes in the submission charset, applying CRLF normalization and Content-Disposition escaping depending on the EncodeType (name/filename/value).

nodes.name: FSMultipartFormData::AddNameValuePair
nodes.summary: Appends a name/value entry as a multipart part, encoding both and wrapping them in the accumulated post-data chunk.

nodes.name: FSMultipartFormData::GetEncodedSubmission
nodes.summary: Rolls up the multiplexed post-data stream (AddPostDataStream) and returns the final URI and POST stream for the multipart submission.

nodes.name: HTMLFrameElement::ParseAttribute
nodes.summary: Parses bordercolor as a color, frameborder/scrolling via their value parsers, and marginwidth/marginheight as non-negative integers, delegating the rest to nsGenericHTMLFrameElement.

nodes.name: HTMLFrameSetElement::BeforeSetAttr
nodes.summary: Re-parses rows/cols when those attributes change, choosing between reflow and frame reconstruction hints depending on whether the spec count changed.

nodes.name: HTMLFrameSetElement::GetRowSpec
nodes.summary: Lazily parses and returns the rows spec as a Span of nsFramesetSpec, defaulting to a single relative 1* spec when absent.

nodes.name: HTMLFrameSetElement::GetColSpec
nodes.summary: Lazily parses and returns the cols spec as a Span of nsFramesetSpec, defaulting to a single relative 1* spec when absent.

nodes.name: HTMLFrameSetElement::ParseRowCol
nodes.summary: Translates a rows/cols attribute value into nsFramesetSpec units (fixed/percent/relative), handling whitespace/quote stripping, * and *% suffixes, 0* as 1* in quirks mode, and the NS_MAX_FRAMESET_SPEC_COUNT cap.

nodes.name: HTMLFrameSetElement::ParseAttribute
nodes.summary: Parses bordercolor as color, frameborder via ParseFrameborderValue, and border as an integer bounded 0..100; delegates the rest to the base class.

nodes.name: HTMLFrameSetElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for the <frameset> element. Defines the nsFramesetUnit enum and nsFramesetSpec struct used to represent parsed rows/cols size specifications, plus the HTMLFrameSetElement class with row/col spec accessors and window event handler forwarding.

nodes.name: HTMLHeadingElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of <h1>-<h6>: computes the spec-defined heading level including the headingoffset/headingreset ancestor traversal, updates HEADING_LEVEL_BITS element state, and maps the legacy align attribute into style.

nodes.name: HTMLHeadingElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLHeadingElement declaring ComputedLevel/GetComputedHeadingOffset, level updating on bind, align accessors, and attribute mapping hooks.

nodes.name: HTMLHRElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the <hr> element: parses width/size/align/color/noshade presentational attributes and maps them into margin, height, border, and color declarations.

nodes.name: HTMLHRElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLHRElement declaring WebIDL accessors for align, color, noshade, size, and width plus the style mapping hooks.

nodes.name: HTMLIFrameElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of <iframe>: lazy-load state management, sandbox flag handling, feature policy creation/refresh and cross-process storage, referrerpolicy propagation to the embedder browsing context, srcdoc trusted-type handling, and frame border/size attribute mapping.

nodes.name: HTMLIFrameElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLIFrameElement (derived from nsGenericHTMLFrameElement) declaring sandbox token list, feature policy members, lazy loading API, fullscreen flag, and the full iframe WebIDL surface.

nodes.name: HTMLImageElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of : responsive image source selection with ResponsiveImageSelector over srcset/sizes and siblings, lazy loading, sizes=auto resize observation, form ownership, image load task queueing, and legacy presentational attribute mapping.

nodes.name: HTMLImageElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLImageElement (nsGenericHTMLElement + nsImageLoadingContent) declaring the responsive selection pipeline, picture/source notification hooks, form wiring, lazy loading, and the img WebIDL API.

nodes.name: HTMLInputElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of <input> (~7700 lines): value/checked state machinery for all input types, text editor state via TextControlState, file and color pickers, radio group management, date/number stepping, range thumb dragging, activation behavior and event handling, form submission, and constraint validation plumbing.

nodes.name: HTMLInputElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLInputElement (TextControlElement + nsImageLoadingContent + ConstraintValidation) and the UploadLastDir per-domain last-upload-directory helper; declares the input type dispatch, value/checked/file APIs, and event handling overrides.

nodes.name: HTMLLabelElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of <label>: resolves the labeled control via the for attribute or first labelable descendant, forwards focus and accesskeys to the control, and implements click/mousedown forwarding including drag-select suppression.

nodes.name: HTMLLabelElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLLabelElement declaring labeled-control resolution, Focus/PerformAccesskey overrides, form access for bindings, and the for-attribute WebIDL accessor.

nodes.name: HTMLLegendElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of <legend>: locates the containing fieldset, parses the legacy align enum, resolves logical alignment against the fieldset writing mode, and forwards focus to the next focusable element when the legend itself is not focusable.

nodes.name: HTMLLegendElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLLegendElement declaring the LegendAlignValue enum, LogicalAlign, fieldset lookup, form plumbing, and focus/accesskey overrides.

nodes.name: HTMLLIElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of <li>: parses the ordered/unordered list type enums and the value integer, maps type to list-style-type and value to counter-set: list-item in the style rule.

nodes.name: HTMLLIElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLLIElement declaring the kOLTypeTable/kULTypeTable enum tables and the type/value WebIDL accessors.

nodes.name: HTMLLinkElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of <link>: rel link-type processing driving stylesheet loading via LinkStyle, DNS prefetch/preconnect/prefetch/preload/modulepreload handling, DOMLinkAdded/DOMLinkChanged dispatch, localization link registration, and blocking token (render-blocking) support.

nodes.name: HTMLLinkElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLLinkElement (nsGenericHTMLElement + LinkStyle + SupportsDNSPrefetch) declaring rel/relList/sizes/blocking token lists, preload bookkeeping, cached href URI, and the stylesheet info hook.

nodes.name: HTMLMapElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of <map>: lazily creates an uncached ContentList of <area> children for the areas HTMLCollection and wraps the node for the binding.

nodes.name: HTMLMapElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLMapElement declaring the name accessor and the areas HTMLCollection backed by ContentList.

nodes.name: HTMLMarqueeElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the non-standard <marquee>: attaches a UA widget shadow root on bind, parses behavior/direction/scroll metrics attributes, maps margin/size/bgcolor attributes, and forwards start/stop as trusted events into the shadow root.

nodes.name: HTMLMarqueeElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLMarqueeElement declaring the marquee WebIDL accessors (behavior, direction, loop, scrollamount, scrolldelay, truespeed, etc.), default constants, and Start/Stop.

nodes.name: HTMLMenuElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of <menu>: constructor, clone support, and JS wrapping only.

nodes.name: HTMLMenuElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for HTMLMenuElement declaring the compact boolean WebIDL accessor and clone support.

nodes.name: HTMLFrameSetElement
nodes.summary: Final class for the <frameset> element. Parses and stores rows/cols nsFramesetSpec arrays, exposes GetRowSpec/GetColSpec spans to the frameset frame, forwards window event handlers, and reports reflow hints when rows/cols change.

nodes.name: HTMLHeadingElement
nodes.summary: Final class for <h1>-<h6>. Computes the heading level per spec including headingoffset/headingreset ancestors, maintains the level in element state, and maps the align attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLHRElement
nodes.summary: Final class for the <hr> element with presentational attribute parsing and style mapping for align, color, noshade, size, and width.

nodes.name: HTMLIFrameElement
nodes.summary: Final class for <iframe>, derived from nsGenericHTMLFrameElement. Owns a FeaturePolicy instance, sandbox token list, lazy-load resumption state, and handles attribute-triggered reloads, policy refresh, and referrerpolicy propagation.

nodes.name: HTMLImageElement
nodes.summary: Final class for combining nsGenericHTMLElement and nsImageLoadingContent. Runs the responsive image selection algorithm (srcset/sizes/picture), manages lazy loading and sizes=auto, tracks form ownership, and implements the img WebIDL API including the Image() constructor factory.

nodes.name: HTMLInputElement
nodes.summary: Final class for <input>: TextControlElement + nsImageLoadingContent + ConstraintValidation. Implements per-type value sanitization and semantics via InputType subclasses, radio group containers, file/color/date pickers, editor state, stepping, and full form-control event handling.

nodes.name: UploadLastDir
nodes.summary: Singleton nsIObserver that remembers the last directory used for <input type=file> picks per domain through the content pref service, honoring private browsing persistence.

nodes.name: HTMLLabelElement
nodes.summary: Final class for <label>. Resolves its labeled control (for attribute or first labelable descendant), forwards focus and accesskey activation, and handles click forwarding in PostHandleEvent.

nodes.name: HTMLLegendElement
nodes.summary: Final class for <legend>. Finds its fieldset parent, exposes the containing form, resolves left/right align to inline-start/end per writing mode, and forwards focus when not focusable.

nodes.name: HTMLLIElement
nodes.summary: Final class for <li> with type/value attribute parsing and mapping of value to the list-item counter.

nodes.name: HTMLLinkElement
nodes.summary: Final class for <link> mixing in LinkStyle (stylesheet handling) and SupportsDNSPrefetch. Manages rel-based resource hints, preload cancellation/updates, render-blocking tokens, and dispatches DOMLinkAdded/Changed events.

nodes.name: HTMLMapElement
nodes.summary: Final class for <map> exposing the name attribute and an areas HTMLCollection of child <area> elements.

nodes.name: HTMLMarqueeElement
nodes.summary: Final class for the non-standard <marquee>, implemented as a UA widget shadow root host with Start/Stop controls and marquee-specific attribute accessors.

nodes.name: HTMLMenuElement
nodes.summary: Final class for <menu>; minimal element with only the compact legacy accessor.

nodes.name: HTMLFrameSetElement::GetRowSpec
nodes.summary: Returns a lifetime-bound span of the parsed rows attribute specifications for the frameset frame.

nodes.name: HTMLFrameSetElement::GetColSpec
nodes.summary: Returns a lifetime-bound span of the parsed cols attribute specifications for the frameset frame.

nodes.name: HTMLFrameSetElement::ParseRowCol
nodes.summary: Parses a comma-separated rows/cols attribute value into nsFramesetSpec entries of fixed, percent, or relative units, capped at NS_MAX_FRAMESET_SPEC_COUNT.

nodes.name: HTMLFrameSetElement::ParseAttribute
nodes.summary: Attribute parsing override that reparses the rows/cols specs when those attributes change, deferring other attributes to the base class.

nodes.name: HTMLFrameSetElement::GetAttributeChangeHint
nodes.summary: Returns the reflow hint (mCurrentRowColHint) for rows/cols attribute modifications so frames recompute the frame grid.

nodes.name: HTMLHeadingElement::ComputedLevel
nodes.summary: Implements the spec algorithm get-an-element's-computed-heading-offset: derives the base level from h1-h6 and adds the accumulated heading offset, clamped to 9.

nodes.name: HTMLHeadingElement::GetComputedHeadingOffset
nodes.summary: Walks flattened-tree ancestors summing headingoffset values and stopping at headingreset, early-returning once the max possible level is reached.

nodes.name: HTMLHeadingElement::UpdateLevel
nodes.summary: Silently replaces the element HEADING_LEVEL_BITS state with the computed level (shifted into 4 state bits), notifying observers via AutoStateChangeNotifier.

nodes.name: HTMLHeadingElement::MapAttributesIntoRule
nodes.summary: Static presentation-attribute mapper that applies the div-align mapping and common attributes into the style rule.

nodes.name: HTMLHRElement::ParseAttribute
nodes.summary: Parses width as an HTML dimension, size as an int bounded 1-1000, align against the left/right/center table, and color as a color value.

nodes.name: HTMLHRElement::MapAttributesIntoRule
nodes.summary: Maps hr presentational attributes into style: align to side margins, size/noshade to height and border widths/styles (with circular end caps via border-radius), color, and width.

nodes.name: HTMLHRElement::IsNoNamespaceAttrMapped
nodes.summary: Reports which attributes (align, width, size, color, noshade plus common ones) participate in attribute-to-style mapping.

nodes.name: HTMLIFrameElement::ParseAttribute
nodes.summary: Parses marginwidth/marginheight as non-negative ints, width/height as HTML dimensions, frameborder/scrolling/align enums, sandbox as atom array, and loading as the lazy-load enum.

nodes.name: HTMLIFrameElement::MapAttributesIntoRule
nodes.summary: Zeroes border widths when frameborder is 0/NO and delegates to image size, image align, and common attribute mapping.

nodes.name: HTMLIFrameElement::AfterSetAttr
nodes.summary: Reacts to attribute changes: toggles lazy loading, reapplies sandbox flags to the frame loader, refreshes feature policy for allow/src/srcdoc/sandbox/allowfullscreen, refreshes embedder referrer policy, and loads srcdoc.

nodes.name: HTMLIFrameElement::RefreshFeaturePolicy
nodes.summary: Recomputes the declared feature policy from the allow attribute, default origin from src/srcdoc, fullscreen allow policy, and inherited document policy, then stores cross-origin policy if needed.

nodes.name: HTMLIFrameElement::StopLazyLoading
nodes.summary: Ends lazy-load tracking, optionally triggering the src load and resetting the nsSubDocumentFrame loader, clearing the resumption state.

nodes.name: HTMLImageElement::ParseAttribute
nodes.summary: Parses align, crossorigin, decoding, loading, fetchpriority, and generic image attributes (width/height/hspace/vspace/border) for the img element.

nodes.name: HTMLImageElement::MapAttributesIntoRule
nodes.summary: Composes image align, border, margin, size (with aspect-ratio), and common attribute mappings into the style rule.

nodes.name: HTMLImageElement::UpdateResponsiveSource
nodes.summary: Core of the responsive selection algorithm: walks previous <source> siblings inside <picture>, keeps or recreates the ResponsiveImageSelector, and reports whether the selected source changed.

nodes.name: HTMLImageElement::LoadSelectedImage
nodes.summary: Loads the image from the responsive selector or src attribute, skipping redundant loads when the selected URL matches the last one and handling density updates and error cleanup.

nodes.name: HTMLImageElement::SelectSourceForTagWithAttrs
nodes.summary: Static helper used by the preloader to resolve which URL a hypothetical img/source tag with the given src/srcset/sizes/type/media attributes would select.

nodes.name: HTMLInputElement::GetValue
nodes.summary: WebIDL value getter that returns the (possibly sanitized) current value, with file inputs returning the display filename through GetValueInternal.

nodes.name: HTMLInputElement::SetValueInternal
nodes.summary: Central value setter handling text editor updates, file list clearing, checked-state side effects for checkbox/radio, and value-changed bookkeeping across setter options.

nodes.name: HTMLInputElement::PostHandleEvent
nodes.summary: Post-event handling for all input types: activation behavior (checkbox/radio toggling, image submission), keyboard stepping for number/range/date, spinner and range thumb updates, and implicit form submission.

nodes.name: HTMLInputElement::RadioSetChecked
nodes.summary: Updates the radio group container so the newly checked radio clears the previously checked member, coordinating state across the group.

nodes.name: HTMLInputElement::MaybeInitPickers
nodes.summary: On mouse/keyboard activation, opens the file picker (with last-dir restoration via UploadLastDir), color picker, or date/time picker depending on the input type.

nodes.name: HTMLLabelElement::PostHandleEvent
nodes.summary: Forwards left-clicks and mousedowns to the labeled control: records the mousedown point, suppresses forwarding on drag-selection or modifier keys, sets focus via nsFocusManager, and dispatches a synthesized click event.

nodes.name: HTMLLabelElement::GetLabeledElementInternal
nodes.summary: Resolves the labeled control: the element referenced by the for attribute (if labelable), otherwise the first labelable descendant in document order.

nodes.name: HTMLLabelElement::GetFirstLabelableDescendant
nodes.summary: Depth-first traversal finding the first descendant element whose reference target is labelable, used when the label has no for attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLLabelElement::Focus
nodes.summary: Focuses the label itself if focusable, otherwise forwards focus to the labeled element.

nodes.name: HTMLLegendElement::LogicalAlign
nodes.summary: Resolves the parsed align value to InlineStart/InlineEnd based on the fieldset writing mode direction, defaulting to InlineStart.

nodes.name: HTMLLegendElement::GetFieldSet
nodes.summary: Returns the parent element when it is a fieldset, else null; used for form association and rendering context.

nodes.name: HTMLLegendElement::Focus
nodes.summary: Focuses the legend when its frame is focusable; otherwise asks nsFocusManager to move focus forward to the next focusable element (bug 81481).

nodes.name: HTMLLegendElement::PerformAccesskey
nodes.summary: Accesskey activation that simply forwards to Focus with system caller type.

nodes.name: HTMLLIElement::ParseAttribute
nodes.summary: Parses type against the ordered then unordered list style tables and value as an integer.

nodes.name: HTMLLIElement::MapAttributesIntoRule
nodes.summary: Maps the type attribute to list-style-type and the integer value attribute to counter-set: list-item, then applies common attributes.

nodes.name: HTMLLIElement::IsNoNamespaceAttrMapped
nodes.summary: Declares type and value (plus common attributes) as style-mapped for dependency checks.

nodes.name: HTMLLinkElement::GetStyleSheetInfo
nodes.summary: LinkStyle hook producing the SheetInfo for rel=stylesheet links: validates the stylesheet link type, text/css MIME type, disabled state, alternate title requirements, href, integrity, nonce, CORS mode, and explicitly-enabled flag.

nodes.name: HTMLLinkElement::TryDNSPrefetchOrPreconnectOrPrefetchOrPreloadOrPrerender
nodes.summary: On bind or href/rel change, dispatches resource hints by rel type: prefetch/next via the prefetch service, compression-dictionary and preload via StartPreload (with destination validation and imagesrcset support), modulepreload via the module loader, preconnect, and DNS prefetch.

nodes.name: HTMLLinkElement::UpdatePreload
