nodes.summary: Recomputes the preload when as/type/crossorigin/media attributes change, cancelling and restarting the preload when the effective content policy type changes.

nodes.name: HTMLLinkElement::StartPreload
nodes.summary: Requests a preload through the document Preloader and keeps a weak reference so the node can cancel it later.

nodes.name: HTMLLinkElement::CreateAndDispatchEvent
nodes.summary: Posts an async chrome-only bubbling event (DOMLinkAdded/DOMLinkChanged), skipping rel=stylesheet links that lack a rev attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLMapElement::Areas
nodes.summary: Lazily creates and returns an uncached ContentList of the map's XHTML area children as the areas HTMLCollection.

nodes.name: HTMLMarqueeElement::ParseAttribute
nodes.summary: Parses marquee attributes: width/height/hspace/vspace as dimensions, bgcolor as color, behavior and direction enums with defaults, loop as int, scrollamount/scrolldelay as non-negative ints.

nodes.name: HTMLMarqueeElement::MapAttributesIntoRule
nodes.summary: Delegates to image margin, image size, common, and background color attribute mapping for marquee presentational attributes.

nodes.name: HTMLMarqueeElement::DispatchEventToShadowRoot
nodes.summary: Creates a trusted event and dispatches it directly to the UA widget shadow root so it stays inaccessible to the document.

nodes.name: HTMLMarqueeElement::Start
nodes.summary: Resumes scrolling by dispatching marquee-start into the UA shadow root when one exists.

nodes.name: HTMLMarqueeElement::Stop
nodes.summary: Pauses scrolling by dispatching marquee-stop into the UA shadow root when one exists.

nodes.name: HTMLMenuElement::WrapNode
nodes.summary: Wraps the element with the HTMLMenuElement binding prototype object.

nodes.name: HTMLMetaElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of <meta>: handles attribute changes and tree binding to process viewport/referrer/color-scheme metadata, apply meta CSP, and dispatch chrome-only DOMMetaAdded/Changed/Removed events.

nodes.name: HTMLMetaElement.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring mozilla::dom::HTMLMetaElement with WebIDL attribute accessors (name, httpEquiv, content, scheme, media) and private meta-processing helpers.

nodes.name: HTMLMeterElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of <meter>: parses value/min/max/low/high/optimum as doubles, clamps them per spec, and maintains the METER_OPTIMUM_STATES element state for styling.

nodes.name: HTMLMeterElement.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring mozilla::dom::HTMLMeterElement with WebIDL double getters/setters for value, min, max, low, high, optimum and private optimum-state computation.

nodes.name: HTMLModElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of <ins>/<del> (HTMLModElement): element construction, cloning, and JS wrapping only; behavior comes from nsGenericHTMLElement.

nodes.name: HTMLModElement.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring mozilla::dom::HTMLModElement with cite and dateTime WebIDL accessors.

nodes.name: HTMLObjectElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of <object>: combines a form control element with nsObjectLoadingContent to load plugin/document content, triggers loads on bind/attribute change, maps image alignment/border/margin/size attributes to style, and manages focusability.

nodes.name: HTMLObjectElement.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring mozilla::dom::HTMLObjectElement (nsGenericHTMLFormControlElement + nsObjectLoadingContent + ConstraintValidation) with the full legacy WebIDL attribute surface (data, type, name, useMap, width, height, align, archive, code, etc.).

nodes.name: HTMLOptGroupElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of <optgroup>: manages ENABLED/DISABLED element state from the disabled attribute and propagates disabled-state changes to descendant <option> elements.

nodes.name: HTMLOptGroupElement.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring mozilla::dom::HTMLOptGroupElement with disabled/label WebIDL accessors and GetSelect to find the owning select.

nodes.name: HTMLOptionElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of <option>: maintains CHECKED (selected) and ENABLED/DISABLED states, caches the nearest ancestor select, implements the spec's selectedness and ask-for-a-reset algorithms, text/label/value getters, and the Option() constructor.

nodes.name: HTMLOptionElement.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring mozilla::dom::HTMLOptionElement with selected/disabled/label/value/text/index WebIDL surface, mCachedNearestAncestorSelect, and disabled-state propagation hooks from optgroup.

nodes.name: HTMLOptionsCollection.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of select.options (HTMLOptionsCollection): a live ContentList of valid options in a select, with indexed setter, add/remove, selectedIndex passthrough, and SetLength.

nodes.name: HTMLOptionsCollection.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring mozilla::dom::HTMLOptionsCollection (a ContentList of <option> elements) with ItemAsOption, GetOptionIndex, Add/Remove, SelectedIndex and IndexedSetter.

nodes.name: HTMLOutputElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of <output>: observes DOM mutations to track defaultValue, switches between default/value modes for the value IDL attribute, implements reset, and exposes the htmlFor token list.

nodes.name: HTMLOutputElement.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring mozilla::dom::HTMLOutputElement (form control + nsStubMutationObserver + ConstraintValidation) with value/defaultValue/htmlFor/name/type WebIDL surface.

nodes.name: HTMLParagraphElement.cpp
nodes.summary:
Implementation of

: parses the legacy align attribute and maps it (plus common attributes) into style declarations.

nodes.name: HTMLParagraphElement.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring mozilla::dom::HTMLParagraphElement with an align WebIDL accessor and attribute-mapping hooks.

nodes.name: HTMLPictureElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of : on child insertion/removal notifies sibling elements about changes so they re-evaluate their selected image source.

nodes.name: HTMLPictureElement.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring mozilla::dom::HTMLPictureElement with InsertChildBefore/RemoveChildNode overrides used to notify images of source changes.

nodes.name: HTMLPreElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of <pre> (also shared by listing/plaintext): parses the width attribute and maps the wrap attribute to white-space-collapse/text-wrap-mode style declarations.

nodes.name: HTMLPreElement.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring mozilla::dom::HTMLPreElement with a width WebIDL accessor and attribute-mapping hooks.

nodes.name: HTMLProgressElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of <progress>: parses value/max doubles, toggles the INDETERMINATE state when value is absent or invalid, and computes clamped value/max/position.

nodes.name: HTMLProgressElement.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring mozilla::dom::HTMLProgressElement with value/max/position WebIDL surface (max reflects only positive values).

nodes.name: HTMLScriptElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of <script>: parses crossorigin/integrity/fetchpriority/blocking attributes, freezes execution attributes (kind, URI, async/defer), processes scripts on bind, applies Trusted Types to text/innerText/textContent/src, supports speculationrules unregistration, and implements script.supports().

nodes.name: HTMLMetaElement
nodes.summary: DOM class for <meta> elements; reacts to content/name attribute changes and tree binding to feed document metadata (viewport, referrer, color-scheme, CSP) and notify observers via chrome events.

nodes.name: HTMLMeterElement
nodes.summary: DOM class for <meter> elements; computes spec-compliant clamped min/max/value/low/high/optimum values and derives the meter optimum element state used by styling.

nodes.name: HTMLModElement
nodes.summary: DOM class for <ins> and <del> elements; exposes cite and dateTime IDL attributes reflected from content attributes.

nodes.name: HTMLObjectElement
nodes.summary: DOM class for <object> elements; a form control that is also an object-loading content implementing nsIObjectLoadingContent, nsFrameLoaderOwner and constraint validation, handling load triggering and legacy attribute surface.

nodes.name: HTMLOptGroupElement
nodes.summary: DOM class for <optgroup> elements; reflects disabled/label and forwards disabled-state changes to contained options.

nodes.name: HTMLOptionElement
nodes.summary: DOM class for <option> elements; tracks selectedness (CHECKED state), caches its nearest ancestor select, follows the option disabled algorithm, and provides text/label/value/index APIs.

nodes.name: HTMLOptionsCollection
nodes.summary: Live list of <option> elements for a select (the select.options WebIDL collection), delegating mutations (add, remove, indexed setter, length) to HTMLSelectElement.

nodes.name: HTMLOutputElement
nodes.summary: DOM class for <output> elements; keeps defaultValue in sync with text descendants via mutation observation, supports the value/defaultValue mode flag and htmlFor token list, and is barred from constraint validation.

nodes.name: HTMLParagraphElement
nodes.summary:
DOM class for

elements; reflects the legacy align attribute and maps it into CSS declarations.

nodes.name: HTMLPictureElement
nodes.summary: DOM class for containers; overrides child insertion/removal to notify siblings about additions and removals.

nodes.name: HTMLPreElement
nodes.summary: DOM class for <pre> elements (also used for listing/plaintext); reflects width and maps wrap into white-space style properties.

nodes.name: HTMLProgressElement
nodes.summary: DOM class for <progress> elements; maintains INDETERMINATE state and exposes clamped value/max and position.

nodes.name: HTMLScriptElement
nodes.summary: DOM class for <script> elements; implements the script processing model hooks (freeze execution attrs, process on bind, CORS/referrer/fetch-priority), Trusted Types-protected text APIs, blocking token list, and speculationrules registration.

nodes.name: HTMLMetaElement::BindToTree
nodes.summary: On binding into an uncomposed doc, runs Document::ProcessMETATag, applies meta-declared CSP when http-equiv=Content-Security-Policy inside <head>, records viewport/referrer/color-scheme metadata, and dispatches DOMMetaAdded.

nodes.name: HTMLMetaElement::AfterSetAttr
nodes.summary: Responds to content/name attribute changes on documents by running MetaAddedOrChanged/MetaRemoved and dispatching DOMMetaChanged.

nodes.name: HTMLMetaElement::MetaAddedOrChanged
nodes.summary: Handles recognized meta names: viewport (SetMetaViewportData with ViewportMetaData), referrer (UpdateReferrerInfoFromMeta), and color-scheme (AddColorSchemeMeta or RecomputeColorScheme).

nodes.name: HTMLMetaElement::UnbindFromTree
nodes.summary: Removes color-scheme metadata contributions from the old document and dispatches DOMMetaRemoved before delegating to the base unbind.

nodes.name: HTMLMetaElement::CreateAndDispatchEvent
nodes.summary: Dispatches a chrome-only, bubbling DOM event (DOMMetaAdded/Changed/Removed) asynchronously when safe via AsyncEventDispatcher.

nodes.name: HTMLMeterElement::UpdateOptimumState
nodes.summary: Recomputes and silently swaps the element's METER_OPTIMUM_STATES (OPTIMUM/SUB_OPTIMUM/SUB_SUB_OPTIMUM) after relevant attribute changes.

nodes.name: HTMLMeterElement::GetOptimumState
nodes.summary: Determines the optimum region state by comparing value, low, high and optimum as specified for <meter> gauges.

nodes.name: HTMLMeterElement::Value
nodes.summary: Returns the meter's actual value clamped to [min, max] with a default of 0 when the value attribute is missing.

nodes.name: HTMLMeterElement::Position
nodes.summary: Computes the 0..1 fill position of the meter from value relative to the min/max range (1.0 for a zero range).

nodes.name: HTMLMeterElement::Min
nodes.summary: Returns the parsed min attribute or the default minimum 0.0.

nodes.name: HTMLModElement::WrapNode
nodes.summary: Wraps the element in a JS object using HTMLModElement_Binding.

nodes.name: HTMLObjectElement::BindToTree
nodes.summary: After binding into a composed document, schedules StartObjectLoad via a script runner once all children have been added.

nodes.name: HTMLObjectElement::AfterMaybeChangeAttr
nodes.summary: Called from AfterSetAttr/OnAttrSetButNotChanged; when the data attribute changes on a fully-parsed, in-document object, schedules LoadObject through a script runner.

nodes.name: HTMLObjectElement::StartObjectLoad
nodes.summary: Guards against inactive documents and blocked embed/object content loading, then calls LoadObject to start the object load and clears the network-created flag.

nodes.name: HTMLObjectElement::MapAttributesIntoRule
nodes.summary: Maps image align/border/margin/width/height presentation attributes plus common attributes into declarations via the MapImage*AttributeInto helpers.

nodes.name: HTMLObjectElement::GetContentWindow
nodes.summary: Returns the WindowProxyHolder of the nested browsing context from the object's content document, or null.

nodes.name: HTMLOptGroupElement::AfterSetAttr
nodes.summary: Toggles ENABLED/DISABLED states on the disabled attribute and walks descendant options (skipping select/optgroup boundaries) to invoke OptGroupDisabledChanged.

nodes.name: HTMLOptGroupElement::GetSelect
nodes.summary: Returns the parent node cast to HTMLSelectElement, or null when the optgroup is not inside a select.

nodes.name: HTMLOptGroupElement::GetEventTargetParent
nodes.summary: Marks the optgroup as unable to handle events itself before delegating to the base implementation.

nodes.name: HTMLOptionElement::SetSelected
nodes.summary: Sets selectedness through the owning select (SetOptionsSelectedByIndex) and explicitly schedules the selectedcontent update per the spec's ask-for-a-reset; falls back to SetSelectedInternal when select-less.

nodes.name: HTMLOptionElement::BeforeSetAttr
nodes.summary: Intercepts changes to the selected content attribute to update CHECKED state and trigger the select's ask-for-a-reset flow.

nodes.name: HTMLOptionElement::UpdateDisabledState
nodes.summary: Implements the concept-option-disabled algorithm: combines the disabled attribute with the nearest optgroup's disabled state and toggles ENABLED/DISABLED element states.

nodes.name: HTMLOptionElement::UpdateNearestAncestorSelect
nodes.summary: Recaches the option's nearest ancestor select element (via HTMLSelectElement::ComputeNearestAncestors) on tree insertion/removal, per the HTML spec.

nodes.name: HTMLOptionElement::Option
nodes.summary: Static WebIDL constructor: creates an <option> element with an optional text child, value/selected attributes, and initial selectedness.

nodes.name: HTMLOptionsCollection::IsValidOption
nodes.summary: Checks that an option's cached nearest ancestor select is the collection's root select, implementing the concept-select-option-list membership rule.

nodes.name: HTMLOptionsCollection::GetOptionIndex
nodes.summary: Finds a given option element's index in the live list, scanning forward or backward from a start index after bringing the list up to date.

nodes.name: HTMLOptionsCollection::IndexedSetter
nodes.summary: WebIDL indexed setter: removes the option at an index when null, pads the select with blank options via SetLength, appends, or replaces the existing option at the index.

nodes.name: HTMLOptionsCollection::SetLength
nodes.summary: Delegates to HTMLSelectElement::SetLength to grow or shrink the option list.

nodes.name: HTMLOutputElement::Reset
nodes.summary: Resets the value mode to default and restores the element's text content from the cached defaultValue.

nodes.name: HTMLOutputElement::DescendantsChanged
nodes.summary: Refreshes the cached defaultValue from the element's text content when children change while in default value mode.

nodes.name: HTMLOutputElement::HtmlFor
nodes.summary: Lazily creates and returns the nsDOMTokenList backing the htmlFor IDL attribute over the for content attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLOutputElement::SetValue
nodes.summary: Sets the value mode flag to eModeValue and replaces the element's text content with the given value.

nodes.name: HTMLParagraphElement::MapAttributesIntoRule
nodes.summary: Maps the legacy div-style align attribute and common attributes into CSS declarations.

nodes.name: HTMLPictureElement::InsertChildBefore
nodes.summary: After inserting a child, notifies an inserted or all subsequent sibling elements (PictureSourceAdded) when a is added.

nodes.name: HTMLPictureElement::RemoveChildNode
nodes.summary: Before removing a child, notifies an or following sibling elements (PictureSourceRemoved) about a removed .

nodes.name: HTMLPreElement::MapAttributesIntoRule
nodes.summary: Maps the wrap attribute to white-space-collapse: preserve and text-wrap-mode: wrap, plus common attributes.

nodes.name: HTMLProgressElement::AfterSetAttr
nodes.summary: Toggles the INDETERMINATE element state whenever the value attribute is set or removed with a non-double value.

nodes.name: HTMLProgressElement::Position
nodes.summary: Returns -1 while indeterminate, otherwise the ratio value/max for rendering the progress bar.

nodes.name: HTMLProgressElement::Value
nodes.summary: Returns the clamped progress value: 0 for missing/negative values, otherwise min(value, max).

nodes.name: HTMLScriptElement::FreezeExecutionAttrs
nodes.summary: Determines the script kind (classic/module/importmap/speculationrules), resolves the src URI with warnings for invalid or empty values, and freezes the async/defer execution flags before first execution.

nodes.name: HTMLScriptElement::Supports
nodes.summary: Static HTMLScriptElement.supports() implementation: reports support for classic, module, importmap, and (pref-gated) speculationrules script types.

nodes.name: HTMLScriptElement::BindToTree
nodes.summary: Starts script processing (MaybeProcessScript) once the element is bound into a composed document.

nodes.name: HTMLScriptElement::SetText
nodes.summary: Validates the value through TrustedTypeUtils.GetTrustedTypesCompliantString for the 'HTMLScriptElement text' sink before replacing the element's text content while preserving trustworthiness.

nodes.name: HTMLScriptElement.h
nodes.summary: Header for the <script> element implementation. HTMLScriptElement combines nsGenericHTMLElement with ScriptElement and implements the script text/charset/freeze-execution-attrs/CORS/fetchpriority/referrer-policy hooks of nsIScriptElement, plus the HTMLScriptElement WebIDL attributes (src, type, defer, async, nomodule, crossorigin, integrity, referrerpolicy, blocking, charset, for, event) and Trusted Types-aware text/innerHTML setters.

nodes.name: HTMLScriptElement
nodes.summary: Final mozilla::dom class implementing <script>. Inherits nsGenericHTMLElement and ScriptElement; overrides GetScriptText/GetScriptCharset/FreezeExecutionAttrs/GetCORSMode/GetFetchPriority/GetReferrerPolicy, BindToTree/UnbindFromTree, ParseAttribute and AfterSetAttr, and exposes the script-related WebIDL bindings including TrustedScript or string setters and the static Supports() classic-scripts check. Holds an optional mBlocking DOMTokenList for render-blocking.

nodes.name: HTMLScriptElement::SetInnerHTMLTrusted
nodes.summary: Trusted innerHTML setter override for script elements, allowing privileged callers to install script content without stripping trustworthiness.

nodes.name: HTMLScriptElement::GetScriptText
nodes.summary: nsIScriptElement override returning the element's inline script source text used by the script loader.

nodes.name: HTMLScriptElement::Blocking
nodes.summary: Returns the lazily created nsDOMTokenList backing the blocking attribute, supporting the render-blocking tokens (e.g. render).

nodes.name: HTMLScriptElement::Supports
nodes.summary: Static WebIDL supports(type) implementation reporting which script type values (classic, module, importmap, speculationrules) the engine supports.

nodes.name: HTMLSelectedContentElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the customizable <selectedcontent> element. Provides the element-constructor hook gated on the dom.select.customizable-select.enabled pref, the spec's clear-a-selectedcontent algorithm (ClearContent), and the insertion steps that walk ancestors to disable the element when nested under option/selectedcontent or a second select, scheduling an update on the nearest select.

nodes.name: HTMLSelectedContentElement.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring HTMLSelectedContentElement, a final nsGenericHTMLElement subclass for <selectedcontent> that tracks a mDisabled flag, exposes ClearContent() and a BindToTree override implementing the HTML spec's selectedcontent insertion steps.

nodes.name: HTMLSelectedContentElement
nodes.summary: The <selectedcontent> element class. Carries a disabled flag computed during tree binding, mirrors the selected option's content into itself via the select element, and implements https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-selectedcontent-element behaviors.

nodes.name: NS_NewHTMLSelectedContentElement
nodes.summary: Element factory: falls back to a generic HTML element unless the dom.select.customizable-select.enabled pref is on, otherwise allocates a HTMLSelectedContentElement from the node info manager.

nodes.name: HTMLSelectedContentElement::ClearContent

nodes.name: InputType.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the InputType strategy hierarchy: the Create() factory dispatching every FormControlType to a concrete input-type class placed in preallocated memory, default validity predicates, localized validation-message formatting, and HTML date/time string parsing helpers delegated to HTMLInputElement.

nodes.name: InputType.h
nodes.summary: Declares InputType, the common abstract superclass for all HTMLInputElement value types, plus NS_floorModulo for Decimal step arithmetic, the StringToNumberResult struct, virtual validity predicates (IsTooLong, HasStepMismatch, ...), validation message getters, and date/time parsing helpers.

nodes.name: InputType
nodes.summary: Abstract strategy base class for HTMLInputElement's per-type behavior. Holds a non-owning mInputElement pointer, defines kStepAny, virtual constraint-validation predicates and message getters, string/number conversions, and date parsing utilities; instances are constructed into caller-provided memory and deleted without operator delete (DoNotDelete deleter).

nodes.name: InputType::Create
nodes.summary: Static factory mapping a FormControlType (InputText, InputNumber, InputDate, ...) to the matching concrete InputType subclass, constructing it via placement new into aMemory and returning a UniquePtr with the DoNotDelete deleter; defaults to TextInputType for unknown types.

nodes.name: InputType::GetValidationMessage
nodes.summary: Switches over the ValidityStateType to build the localized constraint-validation message (too long/short, value missing, type/pattern mismatch including the title attribute variant, range overflow/underflow, step mismatch with the two nearest valid values, bad input).

nodes.name: moz.build
nodes.summary: Build script for dom/html/input: exports the input-type headers under mozilla/dom, compiles the Checkable/DateTime/File/Input/Numeric/SingleLineText input type sources, adds includes for dom/base, dom/html and layout/forms, and links into libxul.

nodes.name: NumericInputTypes.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements numeric input types: range overflow/underflow and step-mismatch checks against HTMLInputElement min/max/step, localized number formatting/parsing via ICUUtils for type=number, and RangeInputType's MinMaxStepAttrChanged which re-snaps the value when min/max/step attributes change.

nodes.name: NumericInputTypes.h
nodes.summary: Declares NumericInputTypeBase (shared range/step validation and Decimal conversions) and its subclasses NumberInputType (type=number, with localized parsing and bad-input checks) and RangeInputType (type=range, reacting to min/max/step changes).

nodes.name: NumericInputTypeBase
nodes.summary: Intermediate InputType base for numeric inputs. Implements IsRangeOverflow/IsRangeUnderflow by comparing GetValueAsDecimal to the element's max/min, HasStepMismatch via ValueIsStepMismatch, the corresponding localized messages, and Decimal string/number conversions.

nodes.name: NumberInputType
nodes.summary: InputType for <input type=number>: value-missing and bad-input checks, localized number parsing/formatting through ICUUtils, and mutability based on disabled/read-only state.

nodes.name: RangeInputType
nodes.summary: InputType for <input type=range>. Its MinMaxStepAttrChanged override re-sets the element value so the nearest valid step/range value is chosen whenever the min, max or step attributes change.

nodes.name: SingleLineTextInputTypes.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements single-line text input types: maxlength/minlength and required validation, pattern matching via nsContentUtils::IsPatternMatching, URL parseability checks through nsIIOService, and email validation including punycode encoding of the domain part and per-label length checks.

nodes.name: SingleLineTextInputTypes.h
nodes.summary: Declares SingleLineTextInputTypeBase (maxlength/minlength/required/pattern validation applying to all single-line types) and the concrete text, search, tel, url, email, and password input type classes, including EmailInputType's static email validity and punycode helpers.

nodes.name: SingleLineTextInputTypeBase
nodes.summary: Base class for single-line text input types; finalizes MinAndMaxLengthApply, IsTooLong/IsTooShort (against maxlength/minlength attributes), IsValueMissing (required + empty), and HasPatternMismatch using the JS regex engine, with mutability covering disabled and read-only.

nodes.name: URLInputType
nodes.summary: InputType for <input type=url>: HasTypeMismatch parses the value with nsIIOService::NewURI (full RFC 3986/3987 validation is not implemented) and provides the localized type-mismatch message.

nodes.name: EmailInputType
nodes.summary: InputType for <input type=email>: type-mismatch via IsValidEmailAddress/IsValidEmailAddressList (comma-separated, multiple attribute aware), bad-input detection through punycode encoding, and static helpers IsValidEmailAddress, IsValidEmailAddressList and PunycodeEncodeEmailAddress.

nodes.name: MediaDocument.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements MediaDocument, the nsHTMLDocument base for synthetic standalone media views (image/video/plain text): builds the synthetic HTML shell (html/head/meta viewport/body), links stylesheets and scripts, inherits the parent charset on load, formats localized titles from MediaDocument.properties, and implements MediaDocumentStreamListener which triggers StartLayout on the first stream callback and safely releases the document reference off-main-thread.

nodes.name: MediaDocument.h
nodes.summary: Declares MediaDocument (nsHTMLDocument subclass with MediaDocumentKind, synthetic-document setup, string-bundle based title/charset updating) and MediaDocumentStreamListener, a thread-retargetable stream listener holding a weak-ish reference to the document.

nodes.name: MediaDocument
nodes.summary: Abstract nsHTMLDocument subclass for standalone media documents (full standards mode, synthetic document flag). Provides StartDocumentLoad charset inheritance from the parent docshell, InitialSetupDone ready-state transition, CreateSyntheticDocument, LinkStylesheet/LinkScript, and UpdateTitleAndCharset with four format-name variants (no info / file / dimensions / both).

nodes.name: MediaDocumentStreamListener
nodes.summary: nsIThreadRetargetableStreamListener chained in front of the real stream listener; calls MediaDocument::StartLayout on OnStartRequest, forwards data events to mNextStream, keeps the document alive across multipart responses, and proxies the document release to the main thread when destroyed off-main-thread.

nodes.name: moz.build
nodes.summary: Build script for dom/html: declares the input subdirectory, mochitest/chrome/browser-chrome manifests, exports of generic HTML headers and TextControlState, the full EXPORTS.mozilla.dom list of HTML* element headers plus MediaDocument/RadioNodeList/ValidityState, and UNIFIED_SOURCES for every corresponding implementation file, all linked into libxul.

nodes.name: nsDOMStringMap.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the element.dataset DOMStringMap: named getter/setter/deleter backed by data-* attributes, camelCase <-> data-attribute name conversion (DataPropToAttr/AttrToDataProp), supported-name enumeration over element attributes, mutation-observer bumping of mExpandoAndGeneration.generation so expandos are invalidated when data-* attributes change, and cycle-collection unlinking that clears the element's dataset back-reference.

nodes.name: nsDOMStringMap.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsDOMStringMap, a nsStubMutationObserver/nsWrapperCache implementing the DOMStringMap WebIDL named-property interface over an Element's data-* attributes, with an JS::ExpandoAndGeneration member used for proxy expando invalidation.

nodes.name: nsDOMStringMap
nodes.summary: Implements element.dataset: NamedGetter/NamedSetter/NamedDeleter/GetSupportedNames mapped to data-* attributes, DataPropToAttr/AttrToDataProp camelCase conversion helpers, AttributeChanged observation to bump the expando generation, and a mRemovingProp recursion guard around deleter-driven attribute removal.

nodes.name: nsDOMStringMap::DataPropToAttr
nodes.summary: Static converter from a dataset property name to its data-* attribute name: prefixes 'data-', uncamelCases capital letters to '-' plus lowercase, and rejects sequences of '-' followed by a-z (syntax error), e.g. aBigFish -> data-a-big-fish.

nodes.name: nsGenericHTMLFrameElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the shared frame-element behavior for iframe/frame/browser hosts: lazy nsFrameLoader creation, LoadSrc honoring lazy-loading and src-once semantics, BindToTree/UnbindFromTree/DestroyContent frame-loader lifecycle, contentDocument/contentWindow access with same-origin checks and depth limits, frame-loader swapping, scrolling attribute to ScrollbarPreference mapping propagated to docshell or BrowserBridgeChild, src triggering-principal capture and name propagation to the BrowsingContext.

nodes.name: nsGenericHTMLFrameElement.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsGenericHTMLFrameElement, the nsGenericHTMLElement + nsFrameLoaderOwner helper base for frame elements (iframe, XUL frame), with focusability, frame-loader lifecycle, SwapFrameLoaders overloads, MapScrollingAttribute, and state flags for src load, network creation, fullscreen and lazy loading.

nodes.name: nsGenericHTMLFrameElement
nodes.summary: Base class for HTML frame elements: owns the nsFrameLoader, loads src on bind to tree, exposes GetContentDocument/GetContentWindow with principal subsumption and browsing-context depth checks, handles src/name attribute changes (triggering principal capture, load kick-off, bc SetName), maps the scrolling attribute to scrollbar preference, and is always HTML-focusable with TabIndexDefault 0.

nodes.name: nsGenericHTMLFrameElement::LoadSrc
nodes.summary: Ensures the frame loader then loads the element's src: while mLazyLoading is set it only script-runs loader initialization so a browsing context exists, otherwise it records mSrcLoadHappened and calls nsFrameLoader::LoadFrame with recursion checking.

nodes.name: nsHTMLDocument.cpp
nodes.summary: Core HTML document implementation: NS_NewHTMLDocument factory, StartDocumentLoad with HTML5/XHTML/plain-text parser selection (nsHtml5Parser, nsParser, PrototypeDocumentParser) and multi-source charset determination (channel, user-forced, reload, parent frame), the document named-property getters resolving named elements/iframes/HTMLCollections with shadowing telemetry, form counting, charset-override policy (WillIgnoreCharsetOverride), and temporary forms/form-controls ContentList management via ContentListHolder.

nodes.name: nsHTMLDocument.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsHTMLDocument, the Document subclass for text/html (and XHTML/plain-text) documents: document load/reset lifecycle, charset source negotiation helpers, HTMLDocument WebIDL named getter and window-name resolution, form bookkeeping (AddedForm/RemovedForm/GetNumFormsSynchronous), and Document::AsHTMLDocument casts.

nodes.name: nsHTMLDocument
nodes.summary: The classic HTML document class (quirks-mode default, eHTML/eXHTML type flag). Implements StartDocumentLoad parser and charset selection, the HTMLDocument named-property API (NamedGetter/GetSupportedNames, ResolveNameForWindow), form counting, view-source/plain-text modes, and forms/form-controls live list access used by document.forms and document.all-style queries.

nodes.name: nsHTMLDocument::StartDocumentLoad
nodes.summary: Validates the load command and content type, picks the parser (HTML5 parser for HTML/plain-text/view-source including the about:blank non-script special case, XML or prototype content sink for XHTML), negotiates the document charset from channel/user/reload/parent sources, configures the content sink, and starts parsing the channel URI.

nodes.name: nsHTMLDocument::NamedGetter
nodes.summary: Implements the HTML document named-property getter: resolves a name against mIdentifierMap document-name entries, returning an iframe's WindowProxy for a single iframe, the element itself for a single element, or a document-rooted HTMLCollection; tracks shadowed HTMLDocument properties and reports the corresponding use counter.

nodes.name: nsIConstraintValidation.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the constraint-validation API plumbing: lazily created ValidityState, CheckValidity dispatching the non-bubbling 'invalid' event, ReportValidity additionally dispatching the chrome-only MozInvalidForm CustomEvent with the invalid element list, and DoSetValidityState/SetBarredFromConstraintValidation notifying the owning form and fieldset via UpdateValidity when validity changes.

nodes.name: nsIConstraintValidation.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsIConstraintValidation, the nsISupports interface implemented by all form elements supporting the constraint-validation API: ValidityStateType bit flags, validity bitfield and barred-from-validation tracking, IsValid/WillValidate/Validity/ReportValidity and CheckValidity entry points.

nodes.name: nsIConstraintValidation
nodes.summary: Mixin interface for constraint validation: keeps an int16 bitfield of ValidityStateType flags plus a barred flag, exposes IsValid/IsCandidateForConstraintValidation/WillValidate, lazily creates the ValidityState object, and on state changes informs the associated form and fieldset so their validity aggregate stays in sync.

nodes.name: nsIFormControl.h
nodes.summary: Declares FormControlType (fieldset/output/select/textarea/object/form-associated custom element plus masked button-element and input-element type ranges with static_assert bounds) and the nsIFormControl interface all form controls implement: form/fieldset association, reset, SubmitNamesValues, and inline classification helpers (IsSubmitControl, IsTextControl, IsSubmittableControl, IsConceptButton, AllowDraggableChildren).

nodes.name: nsIFormControl
nodes.summary: Interface implemented by every form control: stores its FormControlType, exposes FromNode/FromEventTarget downcasts, virtual GetFieldSet/GetFormInternal/SetForm/ClearForm association, Reset and SubmitNamesValues, plus inline type-based predicates and static IsSingleLineTextControl/IsButtonElement/IsInputElement classification used across forms code.

nodes.name: RadioNodeList.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements RadioNodeList's value access: the GetAsRadio helper filters list items to radio HTMLInputElements, GetValue returns the value of the checked radio, and SetValue checks the first radio whose value matches, wrapping it via RadioNodeListBinding.

nodes.name: RadioNodeList.h
nodes.summary: Declares RadioNodeList, a SimpleContentList rooted at an HTMLFormElement exposing the RadioNodeList WebIDL binding with GetValue/SetValue semantics for radio button groups.

nodes.name: RadioNodeList
nodes.summary: Final SimpleContentList subclass for radio groups: WrapObject binds via RadioNodeList_Binding; GetValue reads the checked radio input's value and SetValue selects the radio matching the given value, both iterating the list and casting nodes with HTMLInputElement::FromNode.

nodes.name: 741776-1.vtt
nodes.summary: WebVTT test fixture containing only non-ASCII characters, used by reftest 741776-1 to verify text track/subtitle encoding handling.

nodes.name: reftest.list
nodes.summary: Reftest manifest for the autofocus attribute: checks that autofocus applies at load and on dynamically created input, button, textarea and select elements (needs-focus).

nodes.name: reftest.list
nodes.summary: Top-level reftest manifest for dom/html: includes autofocus and toblob-todataurl sub-manifests plus tests for image loading, tables, video rotation, body margins and mapped presentation attributes.

nodes.name: table-border-2.html
nodes.summary: Reftest page exercising border attribute parsing edge cases on <table> (0foo, +0, -0, percentages) to verify per-spec invalid-value handling.

nodes.name: blob.js
nodes.summary: Test helper for toBlob reftests: loads the sample data URL into an , draws it on a canvas, exports via canvas.toBlob (with optional quality), then displays the blob through an object URL.

nodes.name: dataurl.js
nodes.summary: Test helper for toDataURL reftests: draws the sample image onto a canvas and re-imports canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality) output as a new image.

nodes.name: reftest.list
nodes.summary: Reftest manifest comparing toBlob and toDataURL quality variants (0/25/50/75/92/100/undefined/default) against reference images, with Android fuzz factors.

nodes.name: sample.js
nodes.summary: Declares the base64 PNG sample image (as a data URL string) used as source input by the toBlob/toDataURL reftests.

nodes.name: todataurl-quality-default.html
nodes.summary: Reftest wrapper page running dataurl.js without defining a quality global, exercising the default JPEG encoder quality of canvas.toDataURL.

nodes.name: todataurl-quality-undefined.html
nodes.summary: Reftest wrapper page setting quality = undefined before running dataurl.js, checking that an explicitly undefined quality argument behaves like the default.

nodes.name: TextControlElement.h
nodes.summary: Declares mozilla::TextControlElement, the abstract base class shared by text-bearing form controls (<input> text-like types and <textarea>) that exposes editor, selection controller and shadow-tree helpers to nsTextControlFrame.

nodes.name: TextControlElement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements TextControlElement behavior: UA shadow-tree construction (editing root, placeholder, preview, auxiliary buttons), preview/placeholder updates, focus/blur editor hooks, selection display and select-all.

nodes.name: TextControlState.h
nodes.summary: Declares TextControlState, the central state manager for plaintext controls (value storage, TextEditor lifecycle, selection controller, cached selection properties), plus PasswordMaskData and SelectionProperties helper structs.

nodes.name: TextControlState.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of TextControlState (~2800 lines): editor initialization and destruction, value get/set with or without an editor, selection range/direction APIs, setRangeText, IME composition handling, password masking and instance caching for reuse.

nodes.name: TextInputListener.h
nodes.summary: Declares TextInputListener, an nsIDOMEventListener/nsSupportsWeakReference bridging TextEditor edit actions and selection changes back to the TextControlElement/TextControlState, including undo/redo command updates.

nodes.name: ValidityState.h
nodes.summary: Declares mozilla::dom::ValidityState, the IDL ValidityState object that reflects the constraint-validation flags (valueMissing, typeMismatch, rangeOverflow, etc.) of its owning nsIConstraintValidation element.

nodes.name: ValidityState.cpp
nodes.summary: Cycle-collected nsISupports implementation and JS wrapper binding (ValidityState_Binding::Wrap) for ValidityState.

nodes.name: VideoDocument.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements VideoDocument, a MediaDocument subclass that synthesizes a document containing a single <video> element fed from the loaded channel, sets autoplay/controls and derives the document title from the file name.

nodes.name: TextControlElement
nodes.summary: Abstract base class for text controls (derives nsGenericHTMLFormControlElementWithState); lets the text control frame obtain the TextEditor, selection controller, value change notifications and shadow-tree pseudo-elements, with pure-virtual hooks implemented by HTMLInputElement and HTMLTextAreaElement.

nodes.name: MakeAnonElement
nodes.summary: Static helper creating an anonymous element for a PseudoStyleType; marks the editing root NODE_IS_EDITABLE and sets aria-hidden on the other pseudo-elements so they stay out of the a11y tree.

nodes.name: TextControlElement::SetupShadowTree
nodes.summary:
Builds the text control's UA shadow tree: an editing root containing the value text node (masked for passwords) and a padding
, plus the placeholder pseudo-element derived from the placeholder attribute, then updates the value display.

nodes.name: TextControlElement::CreateButton
nodes.summary: Creates the auxiliary anonymous button for the control type: password reveal (:::-moz-reveal), search clear button (chrome/pref-gated) or the number spin box with up/down spinners.

nodes.name: TextControlElement::WillFocus
nodes.summary: Pre-focus hook: shows the control's own selection, selects all text for keyboard-driven focus when the platform pref allows (excluding JS-triggered focus), and notifies the extant TextEditor via OnFocus.

nodes.name: TextControlElement::SelectAll
nodes.summary: Selects the entire control value by delegating to TextControlState::SetSelectionRange(0, UINT32_MAX) without scrolling ancestors.

nodes.name: TextControlState
nodes.summary: State manager for plaintext controls: owns the value (string fallback or TextEditor-managed), the TextInputSelectionController, TextInputListener and cached selection properties; supports editor lazy initialization, password masking and instance reuse via Construct/Shutdown.

nodes.name: PasswordMaskData
nodes.summary: Struct storing password masking state: an auto-mask timer, the unmasked character range and flags controlling temporary echo prevention.

nodes.name: TextControlState::SelectionProperties
nodes.summary: Cached selection representation used while no frame exists: start, end and direction with max-length clamping and dirty tracking so values can be restored when a frame rebinds.

nodes.name: TextControlState::Construct
nodes.summary: Static factory returning a new TextControlState for the owning element, reusing a cached spare instance when available to avoid repeated allocations.

nodes.name: TextControlState::GetValue
nodes.summary: Returns the current value either from the editor (when initialized and framed) or the internal mValue string, normalizing line breaks for display vs. API consumers.

nodes.name: TextControlState::SetValue
nodes.summary: Sets the control value with CR/LF normalization, dispatching to SetValueWithTextEditor or SetValueWithoutTextEditor according to editor state and honoring ValueSetterOptions (user input, setRangeText, undo preservation, cursor movement).

nodes.name: TextControlState::SetValueWithTextEditor
nodes.summary: Applies a value change through the live TextEditor (text replacement, transaction handling, composition awareness); may cause re-entrant destruction of the editor or the state itself.

nodes.name: TextControlState::SetSelectionRange
nodes.summary: Implements the HTML 'set the selection range' algorithm: coerces offsets, updates the editor or cached SelectionProperties, and optionally scrolls the selection into view.

nodes.name: TextInputListener
nodes.summary: Final class implementing nsIDOMEventListener and nsSupportsWeakReference; listens to editor events, forwards value/selection changes to the TextControlElement and its WeakPtr<TextControlState>, and updates undo/redo and text-input commands.

nodes.name: TextInputListener::OnEditActionHandled
nodes.summary: Called after the editor handles each edit action, immediately before the input event is dispatched, to propagate the value change.

nodes.name: TextInputListener::OnSelectionChange
nodes.summary: MOZ_CAN_RUN_SCRIPT callback invoked when the selection changes inside the editor, keeping frame/cached selection state in sync.

nodes.name: TextInputListener::HandleValueChanged
nodes.summary: Notifies the owning text control that the editor value changed, updating undo/redo menu command state as needed.

nodes.name: ValidityState
nodes.summary: Final nsWrapperCache-backed IDL ValidityState; each getter (valueMissing, typeMismatch, patternMismatch, tooLong/Short, rangeUnderflow/Overflow, stepMismatch, badInput, customError, valid) reads the corresponding flag from the owner's nsIConstraintValidation.

nodes.name: ValidityState::GetValidityState
nodes.summary: Inline helper returning the requested validity flag from the owning nsIConstraintValidation instance, defaulting to false when there is no owner.

nodes.name: ValidityState::WrapObject
nodes.summary: Creates the JS wrapper for ValidityState via ValidityState_Binding::Wrap with the given prototype.

nodes.name: VideoDocument
nodes.summary: Final MediaDocument subclass (MediaDocumentKind::Video) that builds a synthetic document wrapping the video stream in a single <video> element, delaying element creation until layout so the decoder can pick a compositor.

nodes.name: VideoDocument::CreateVideoElement
nodes.summary: Creates an HTMLVideoElement via NS_NewHTMLVideoElement, sets autoplay (unless forced as media document) and controls, wires LoadWithChannel through the stream listener, links the top-level stylesheet/script, and appends the element to the body.

nodes.name: VideoDocument::StartDocumentLoad
nodes.summary: Chains to MediaDocument::StartDocumentLoad and installs a MediaDocumentStreamListener as the document's stream listener.

nodes.name: VideoDocument::UpdateTitle
nodes.summary: Sets the document title to the media file name extracted from the channel.

nodes.name: NS_NewVideoDocument
nodes.summary: Module constructor allocating a VideoDocument, initializing it with the node/principals, and returning it as a Document.

nodes.name: compressAndDisplay
nodes.summary: Draws the sample image onto a canvas sized to its natural dimensions and exports it with canvas.toBlob('image/jpeg', quality), appending the resulting blob-backed image to the document.

nodes.name: compressAndDisplay
nodes.summary: Draws the sample image onto a canvas and re-imports canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality) output as a new image appended to the document.

nodes.name: jArray.h
nodes.summary: C++ header providing Java-like array abstractions (jArray, staticJArray, autoJArray, jInlineArray) used throughout the generated HTML5 parser code for buffers and lookup tables.

nodes.name: jArray
nodes.summary: Templated heap-allocated array wrapper (pointer + length) with bounds-checked indexing and fallible allocation; the C++ translation of Java arrays in the HTML5 parser.

nodes.name: staticJArray
nodes.summary: Wrapper around const static arrays (e.g. element/attribute name tables) that adds binarySearch for name lookups during tokenization.

nodes.name: autoJArray
nodes.summary: Ownership-owning variant of jArray that deletes the backing store on destruction or null assignment, mirroring Java garbage collection for parser buffers.

nodes.name: AttributeName.java
nodes.summary: Java source (translator snapshot) defining the AttributeName class and the static ATTRIBUTE_NAMES table of all HTML/SVG/MathML attribute names consumed by the HTML5 tokenizer.

nodes.name: AttributeName
nodes.summary: Represents a single attribute name with local/HTML/SVG/MathML variants and flags (boolean attributes etc.); interned instances are shared by the tokenizer when tagging tokens.

nodes.name: ATTRIBUTE_NAMES
nodes.summary: Static table of every predefined AttributeName instance; consulted via nameByBuffer to map UTF-16 attribute-name buffers to interned constants during tokenization.

nodes.name: nameByBuffer
nodes.summary: Looks up a char buffer in the ATTRIBUTE_NAMES table and returns the interned AttributeName, creating a non-interned one for unknown/custom attributes.

nodes.name: createAttributeName
nodes.summary: Constructs an AttributeName (choosing SVG/MathML casing variants and NCName checks) for names not found in the static table.

nodes.name: ElementName.java
nodes.summary: Java source (translator snapshot) defining the ElementName class and the ELEMENT_NAMES table of all HTML/SVG/MathML element names with their grouping/scoping flags used by the tree builder.

nodes.name: ElementName
nodes.summary: Represents a single element name plus flags (SPECIAL, SCOPING, FOSTER_PARENTING, HTML_INTEGRATION_POINT, groups) that drive tree construction decisions.

nodes.name: ELEMENT_NAMES
nodes.summary: Static interned table of all ElementName constants; the canonical element-name machinery the tokenizer and tree builder index into by buffer lookup.

nodes.name: elementNameByBuffer
nodes.summary: Maps a UTF-16 tag-name buffer to the interned ElementName constant (or a fresh non-interned one for custom elements), used by the tokenizer when emitting start/end tags.

nodes.name: isInterned
nodes.summary: Reports whether an ElementName came from the static table; StackNode asserts on it to avoid using non-interned names for well-known HTML elements.

nodes.name: Portability.java
nodes.summary: Java source (translator snapshot) of the Portability helper whose string allocation, release, and ASCII-case-insensitive comparison routines are translated to nsHtml5Portability for cross-runtime parser support.

nodes.name: Portability
nodes.summary: Static utility layer abstracting local-name interning, string creation/release, and literal comparisons so the same parser code runs as Java and C++.

nodes.name: README.txt
nodes.summary: Explains that these .java files are a translator-generated snapshot of the Java sources compiled into the neighboring nsHtml5*.h/.cpp files and must not be edited directly.

nodes.name: StackNode.java
nodes.summary: Java source (translator snapshot) of the open-elements stack entry, wrapping an ElementName's flags plus namespace, node handle, and attributes for tree construction (translated to nsHtml5StackNode).

nodes.name: StackNode
nodes.summary: Refcounted entry of the open element stack and list of active formatting elements; exposes isSpecial/isScoping/isHtmlIntegrationPoint predicates derived from ElementName flags.

nodes.name: prepareSvgFlags
nodes.summary: Adjusts an ElementName's flags for SVG context, clearing HTML-specific bits and mapping SCOPING_AS_SVG to scoping/special/integration-point flags.

nodes.name: StateSnapshot.java
nodes.summary: Java source (translator snapshot) implementing TreeBuilderState as an immutable copy of the tree builder state (stacks, form/head pointers, mode, quirks) for speculation resumption (translated to nsHtml5StateSnapshot).

nodes.name: StateSnapshot
nodes.summary: Holds copied StackNode arrays, the template mode stack, form/head pointers, and tokenizer-relevant flags so a speculative parse can be verified or discarded.

nodes.name: Tokenizer.java
nodes.summary: Java source (translator snapshot) of the HTML5 tokenizer state machine (~7700 lines) that turns UTF-16 buffers into start/end tag, character, comment, and DOCTYPE tokens (translated to nsHtml5Tokenizer).

nodes.name: Tokenizer
nodes.summary: Implements the tokenization phase of the HTML5 parsing pipeline, holding the current state, tag/attribute buffers, and interner, and feeding tokens to a TokenHandler (the tree builder).

nodes.name: tokenizeBuffer
nodes.summary: Entry point that consumes a UTF16Buffer, performs CR/LF normalization, and drives stateLoop over each character until the buffer is exhausted.

nodes.name: stateLoop
nodes.summary: The inlined DATA/TAG/ATTRIBUTE/RCDATA/SCRIPT/PLAINTXT/CDATA state machine core that emits tokens via the TokenHandler as it scans characters.

nodes.name: setStateAndEndTagExpectation
nodes.summary: Reconfigures the tokenizer (e.g. for RCDATA/RAWTEXT/script after start tags or after meta charset) using elementNameByBuffer to resolve the expected end tag name.

nodes.name: TreeBuilder.java
nodes.summary: Java source (translator snapshot) of the HTML5 tree construction phase (~6700 lines) implementing TokenHandler: insertion modes, open element stack, active formatting elements, and speculation snapshots (translated to nsHtml5TreeBuilder).

nodes.name: TreeBuilder
nodes.summary: Abstract generic tree builder that consumes tokenizer tokens and maintains the open-element stack, formatting-element list, and template mode stack per the HTML5 spec.

nodes.name: startTag
nodes.summary: Dispatches a start tag token through the insertion modes, using ElementName groups/flags to decide push, foster parenting, implied end tags, or foreign-content handling.

nodes.name: endTag
nodes.summary: Handles end tag tokens by popping matching StackNodes, generating implied end tags, and running the adoption agency algorithm for formatting elements.

nodes.name: newSnapshot
nodes.summary: Creates a StateSnapshot deep copy of the current tree construction state so speculative parsing can later be validated with snapshotMatches.

nodes.name: appendToCurrentNodeAndPushElement
nodes.summary: Core element-creation helper: creates the DOM node for an ElementName, appends it to the current node, and pushes a new StackNode with HTML/SVG/MathML-adjusted flags.

nodes.name: UTF16Buffer.java
nodes.summary: Java source (translator snapshot) of the UTF-16 code unit buffer with start/end cursors that the tokenizer consumes chunk by chunk (translated to nsHtml5UTF16Buffer).

nodes.name: UTF16Buffer
nodes.summary: Wraps a char array with unconsumed-range tracking, hasMore/getLength accessors, and adjust() to skip LF after CR during newline normalization.

nodes.name: moz.build
nodes.summary: Build file for the HTML5 parser: exports jArray.h and the nsHtml5* headers, compiles the translated tokenizer/tree builder sources, and selects SIMD/ALU tokenizer variants per CPU.

nodes.name: nsAHtml5TreeBuilderState.h
nodes.summary: C++ interface exposing the tree builder's internal state (stacks, pointers, mode flags) for speculation comparison, mirroring the Java StateSnapshot/TreeBuilderState API.

nodes.name: nsAHtml5TreeBuilderState
nodes.summary: Abstract accessors (getStack, getListOfActiveFormattingElements, getTemplateModeStack, getMode, isQuirks, ...) implemented by nsHtml5StateSnapshot to let the tree builder verify speculative parses.

nodes.name: nsAHtml5TreeOpSink.h
nodes.summary: C++ interface connecting tree-op producers to consumers: the main-thread executor, the off-main-thread tree op stage, and speculative flushes all implement MoveOpsFrom.

nodes.name: nsAHtml5TreeOpSink
nodes.summary: Declares MoveOpsFrom(nsTArray<nsHtml5TreeOperation>&), the single operation by which queued tree construction ops are handed to executors, stages, or speculations.

nodes.name: nsHtml5ArrayCopy.h
nodes.summary: C++ helper providing arraycopy overloads (char16_t, int32_t, nsHtml5StackNode*) that translate Java System.arraycopy calls used by the tokenizer and tree builder buffers.

nodes.name: nsHtml5ArrayCopy
nodes.summary: Static inline memcpy/memmove wrappers emulating Java's System.arraycopy for UTF-16 text, integer arrays, and nsHtml5StackNode arrays.

nodes.name: nsHtml5AttributeEntry.h
nodes.summary: Value type for one parsed attribute: a tagged pointer that is either an interned nsHtml5AttributeName* or a custom nsAtom* (low bit tag), plus an nsHtml5String value. Provides namespace-triple accessors (NameHTML/NameSVG/NameMathML) and refcount handling for custom atoms.

nodes.name: nsHtml5AttributeEntry
nodes.summary: Final movable class holding an attribute name (tagged pointer BitsFromName/BitsFromKnownName) and its value; distinguishes known/interned vs custom atom names via IsCustom/IsKnown and exposes NameBitsMatch/NameMatches/ValueMatches for duplicate detection and comparisons.

nodes.name: BitsFromName
nodes.summary: Static helper returning the name as a tagged uintptr_t: reinterprets interned nsHtml5AttributeName*, otherwise takes the HTML-local nsAtom without AddRef and sets the custom tag bit.

nodes.name: ForgetNameHTML
nodes.summary: Releases the stored name as an already_AddRefed<nsAtom> (HTML local name for known names, custom atom otherwise) and zeroes the tagged bits.

nodes.name: nsHtml5AttributeName.cpp
nodes.summary: Generated (from AttributeName.java) static tables for all HTML/MathML/SVG attribute names: the ATTRIBUTE_NAMES array with per-namespace URI/prefix/local atoms, hash table, and initializeStatics/releaseStatics lifecycle used by nsHtml5Module.

nodes.name: initializeStatics
nodes.summary: Allocates the interned nsHtml5AttributeName singletons (ATTR_* entries) plus ALL_NO_NS/ALL_NO_PREFIX and namespace-specific arrays that the tokenizer matches attributes against.

nodes.name: releaseStatics
nodes.summary: Deletes all ATTR_* nsHtml5AttributeName singletons and namespace arrays allocated by initializeStatics.

nodes.name: nsHtml5AttributeName.h
nodes.summary: Generated header for nsHtml5AttributeName: per-namespace (HTML/MathML/SVG) uri/local/prefix triples for every known attribute, static ATTR_* singletons, level-order hash binary search, and nameByBuffer lookup used by the tokenizer's attribute-name state.

nodes.name: nsHtml5AttributeName
nodes.summary: Represents one attribute name across the HTML, MathML and SVG namespaces (jInlineArray triples), supports non-interned/custom names (isInterned, setNameForNonInterned) and exposes getUri/getLocal/getPrefix per mode plus hundreds of static ATTR_* singletons.

nodes.name: nameByBuffer
nodes.summary: Fast-path attribute-name lookup from a char16_t buffer: literal matches for common names (class, value, data-*, checked, type, href, id), then bufToHash + levelOrderBinarySearch into ATTRIBUTE_NAMES with a final localEqualsBuffer check.

nodes.name: bufToHash
nodes.summary: Computes the 32-bit attribute-name hash from selected buffer positions (length-dependent shift layout) used to index ATTRIBUTE_HASHES.

nodes.name: levelOrderBinarySearch
nodes.summary: Searches a level-order-serialized binary search tree of hashes (ATTRIBUTE_HASHES) for the key hash, returning the index into ATTRIBUTE_NAMES or -1.

nodes.name: nsHtml5AutoPauseUpdate.h
nodes.summary: MOZ_RAII helper that pauses document updates around a code region: calls nsHtml5DocumentBuilder::EndDocUpdate on construction and BeginDocUpdate on destruction unless the parser completed in between.

nodes.name: nsHtml5AutoPauseUpdate
nodes.summary: RAII guard holding a RefPtr<nsHtml5DocumentBuilder>; ctor ends the doc update batch, dtor restarts it if IsComplete() is false.

nodes.name: nsHtml5ByteReadable.h
nodes.summary: Weak-reference wrapper around a raw byte array (current/end pointers) with a read() that returns the next byte or -1 at EOF; used by meta-charset scanning code.

nodes.name: nsHtml5ByteReadable
nodes.summary: Holds const uint8_t* current/end and returns successive bytes via inline read(), -1 once exhausted; does not own the buffer.

nodes.name: nsHtml5ContentCreatorFunction.h
nodes.summary: Union of mozilla::dom::HTMLContentCreatorFunction and SVGContentCreatorFunction so tree builders/highlighter can pass the right element factory function when creating content.

nodes.name: nsHtml5ContentCreatorFunction
nodes.summary: Union discriminated by element kind pairing the HTML or SVG element-creator function pointer used by CreateElement tree ops.

nodes.name: nsHtml5DependentUTF16Buffer.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements nsHtml5DependentUTF16Buffer: wraps an existing nsAString without owning it and provides FalliblyCopyAsOwningBuffer, which memcpy's the unconsumed range into a new heap nsHtml5OwningUTF16Buffer (returns nullptr on OOM).

nodes.name: FalliblyCopyAsOwningBuffer
nodes.summary: Copies the unconsumed part of the wrapped string into a fallibly allocated nsHtml5OwningUTF16Buffer via nsHtml5OwningUTF16Buffer::FalliblyCreate and memcpy; used when the stream parser must retain pending data.

nodes.name: nsHtml5DependentUTF16Buffer.h
nodes.summary: MOZ_STACK_CLASS subclass of nsHtml5UTF16Buffer that wraps (does not own) an nsAString, plus declaration of FalliblyCopyAsOwningBuffer for handing the remaining data to an owning buffer.

nodes.name: nsHtml5DependentUTF16Buffer
nodes.summary: Stack-only UTF-16 buffer view over a caller-owned string; the wrapped string must outlive the buffer and must not be shortened while in use.

nodes.name: nsHtml5DocumentBuilder.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the shared nsContentSink subclass for HTML5 parsing: cycle collection, MarkAsBroken, UpdateStyleSheet (LinkStyle updates and parser-blocking script blockers), and SetDocumentMode mapping nsHtml5DocumentMode to compatibility modes with console warnings for quirky doctypes.

nodes.name: MarkAsBroken
nodes.summary: Stores the failure reason in mBroken so IsBroken() refuses further input (e.g. after OOM dropped input) and returns the reason.

nodes.name: UpdateStyleSheet
nodes.summary: Casts the element to LinkStyle, enables style updates and, when a blocking stylesheet is encountered in non-runs-to-completion mode, bumps mPendingSheetCount and adds a parser-blocking script execution blocker.

nodes.name: SetDocumentMode
nodes.summary: Maps STANDARDS/ALMOST_STANDARDS/QUIRKS nsHtml5DocumentMode onto the document's compatibility mode and reports a console warning for almost-standards/quirky doctypes (skipping null-principal non-http docs).

nodes.name: nsHtml5DocumentBuilder.h
nodes.summary: Base class for nsHtml5TreeOpExecutor/nsHtml5BuilderSink-style parsers: nsContentSink subclass with element retention (HoldElement/mOwnedElements), broken-state tracking, and flush/doc-update state machine (BeginFlush/EndFlush/BeginDocUpdate/EndDocUpdate), plus eHtml5FlushState.

nodes.name: nsHtml5DocumentBuilder
nodes.summary: Abstract nsContentSink derivative shared by the HTML5 tree op executor and page load / fragment sinking builders; owns mOwnedElements, mBroken and mFlushState and defines the update batching and stylesheet hookup API.

nodes.name: BeginDocUpdate
nodes.summary: Asserts a flush is open and a parser exists, switches mFlushState to eInDocUpdate and calls mDocument->BeginUpdate().

nodes.name: EndDocUpdate
nodes.summary: Closes the document update batch: resets mFlushState to eInFlush and calls mDocument->EndUpdate().

nodes.name: eHtml5FlushState
nodes.summary: Enum for the builder's flushing state: eNotFlushing, eInFlush (Flush() on stack) and eInDocUpdate (inside a document update batch).

nodes.name: nsHtml5DocumentMode.h
nodes.summary: Defines enum nsHtml5DocumentMode { STANDARDS_MODE, ALMOST_STANDARDS_MODE, QUIRKS_MODE } produced by the tree builder for doctype handling.

nodes.name: nsHtml5DocumentMode
nodes.summary: Enumerates the three rendering modes a parsed doctype maps to; consumed by nsHtml5DocumentBuilder::SetDocumentMode.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Highlighter.cpp
nodes.summary: View-source syntax highlighter: mirrors tokenizer state transitions to emit an HTML document (html/head/meta/title/link/body/pre with line spans and colored spans/anchors) as a queue of nsHtml5TreeOperation ops flushed into an nsAHtml5TreeOpSink; supports linkification of URL attributes, error annotations, base href and charset source updates.

nodes.name: Transition
nodes.summary: Core state machine method: reacts to tokenizer state transitions (DATA, SCRIPT_DATA, tag states, comment, CDATA, character reference, etc.), flushing characters and opening/closing spans, links and error annotations as the source is highlighted.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Emits the generated view-source document skeleton: doctype, standards-mode op, html/head/meta viewport/title/link and body elements via CreateElement/Push, plus opStartLayout.

nodes.name: FlushChars
nodes.summary: Appends the pending character run (mCStart..mPos) from mBuffer as text content via AppendCharacters and starts a new character wrapper, handling line counting.

nodes.name: MaybeLinkifyAttributeValue
nodes.summary: Checks the attribute name against known URL attributes (href, src, action, etc.) and, if it matches and no base was seen, enqueues an op adding a view-source: href to linkify the value.

nodes.name: CreateElement
nodes.summary: Allocates a content handle from the handle pool and enqueues an opCreateElement tree operation with the given atoms/attributes/creator function, returning the handle the executor will fill.

nodes.name: Push
nodes.summary: Creates an element under the current node and pushes its handle on the highlighter's element stack, mirroring tree construction for the generated output document.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Highlighter.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsHtml5Highlighter, a state machine that generates HTML for view-source from tokenizer transitions; owns the op queue, op sink, element-handle pool (NS_HTML5_HIGHLIGHTER_HANDLE_ARRAY_LENGTH), element stack, and current run/ampersand/slash anchors for error annotation.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Highlighter
nodes.summary: Public API: Start/Rewind/End lifecycle, Transition per tokenizer state change, SetBuffer/DropBuffer character flushing, ShouldFlushOps/FlushOps into nsAHtml5TreeOpSink, linkification, error annotation helpers (AddErrorToCurrentRun/Node/Ampersand/Slash) and base/href handling.

nodes.name: nsHtml5HtmlAttributes.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the attribute list used by tokenizer/tree builder: getValue/contains via tagged-name bit matching against nsHtml5AttributeEntry storage, addAttribute, clear, cloneAttributes (per-entry Clone), equalsAnother, and EMPTY_ATTRIBUTES static lifecycle.

nodes.name: getValue
nodes.summary: Computes BitsFromKnownName for the requested nsHtml5AttributeName and returns the value of the first matching nsHtml5AttributeEntry, or nullptr.

nodes.name: addAttribute
nodes.summary: Appends a new nsHtml5AttributeEntry(name, value) to mStorage, asserting the count stays within INT32_MAX.

nodes.name: cloneAttributes
nodes.summary: Deep-clones the attribute list for speculation or tree-op use by cloning each nsHtml5AttributeEntry into a fresh nsHtml5HtmlAttributes.

nodes.name: equalsAnother
nodes.summary: Order-insensitive comparison of two attribute lists: every entry must name-match and value-match an entry in the other list.

nodes.name: nsHtml5HtmlAttributes.h
nodes.summary: Generated header for the tokenizer/tree-builder attribute holder: AutoTArray<nsHtml5AttributeEntry,5> storage with raw-pointer iteration, duplicate-attribute error flag, empty singleton EMPTY_ATTRIBUTES, and no-op adjustForMath/adjustForSvg hooks.

nodes.name: nsHtml5HtmlAttributes
nodes.summary: Attribute bag created per tag by the tokenizer: entry access/removal, contains/getValue lookups, cloning, equality, DEBUG moved-from tracking and static EMPTY_ATTRIBUTES initialization.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Macros.h
nodes.summary: Control-flow macros NS_HTML5_CONTINUE(target) and NS_HTML5_BREAK(target) that expand to goto statements, translating Java loop control in generated parser code to C++.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Module.cpp
nodes.summary: Module-wide static lifecycle: InitializeStatics calls initializeStatics on AttributeName/ElementName/HtmlAttributes/NamedCharacters/Portability/StackNode/Tokenizer/TreeBuilder/UTF16Buffer and TreeOpExecutor, and spawns the dedicated 'HTML5 Parser' stream-parser thread; ReleaseStatics tears them down; NewHtml5Parser creates nsHtml5Parser instances.

nodes.name: InitializeStatics
nodes.summary: Initializes all generated nsHtml5* static tables and creates sStreamParserThread via NS_NewNamedThread("HTML5 Parser"), setting the DEBUG init flag.

nodes.name: ReleaseStatics
nodes.summary: Mirrors InitializeStatics by calling releaseStatics on every generated class and releasing the stream parser thread.

nodes.name: NewHtml5Parser
nodes.summary: Factory returning a new already_AddRefed<nsHtml5Parser> after asserting module initialization.

nodes.name: GetStreamParserEventTarget
nodes.summary: Returns the dedicated stream parser thread as an nsISerialEventTarget, falling back to the main thread if the named thread is unavailable.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Module.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsHtml5Module: static init/release of generated parser tables, NewHtml5Parser factory, and GetStreamParserEventTarget for the off-main-thread parsing thread; friends nsHtml5ParserThreadTerminator.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Module
nodes.summary: Static-only holder of sStreamParserThread and (DEBUG) sNsHtml5ModuleInitialized used as the entry point for creating HTML5 parsers and managing parser statics.

nodes.name: nsHtml5NamedCharacters.cpp
nodes.summary: Generated tables for HTML named character references: VALUES[][2] replacement pairs and packed ALL_NAMES string data from nsHtml5NamedCharactersInclude.inc, the WINDOWS_1252 table data, and initializeStatics/releaseStatics allocating the WINDOWS_1252 char16_t* index.

nodes.name: initializeStatics
nodes.summary: Builds the WINDOWS_1252 pointer table from WINDOWS_1252_DATA used to remap legacy windows-1252 codepoints in character reference values.

nodes.name: nsHtml5NamedCharacters.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsHtml5CharacterName (offset/length into the packed name string data with length()/charAt()) and nsHtml5NamedCharacters holding NAMES[], VALUES[][2] replacement pairs and the WINDOWS_1252 table with static lifecycle.

nodes.name: nsHtml5NamedCharacters
nodes.summary: Static registry of every named character reference: NAMES entries pointing into packed name data, VALUES 2xUTF-16 replacement values, and WINDOWS_1252 mapping consumed by the tokenizer's character reference states.

nodes.name: nsHtml5CharacterName
nodes.summary: Compact struct (nameStart, nameLen, DEBUG n) referencing a name inside the packed ALL_NAMES array with inline length() and charAt() accessors.

nodes.name: nsHtml5NamedCharactersAccel.cpp
nodes.summary: Generated hilo-acceleration tables for named character reference lookup: per-first-character HILO_ACCEL_NN arrays of packed low/high indices, aggregated into nsHtml5NamedCharactersAccel::HILO_ACCEL[] to let the tokenizer bail out fast on impossible ampersand names.

nodes.name: HILO_ACCEL
nodes.summary: Public const int32_t* table indexed by first character, pointing at the static per-letter hilo acceleration arrays used by the tokenizer's character-reference matching.

nodes.name: nsHtml5NamedCharactersAccel.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsHtml5NamedCharactersAccel with the static HILO_ACCEL[] table of per-character accelerator arrays for fast named character reference rejection.

nodes.name: nsHtml5NamedCharactersAccel
nodes.summary: Static-only class exposing HILO_ACCEL, consumed by nsHtml5Tokenizer when matching named character references.

nodes.name: nsHtml5NamedCharactersInclude.inc
nodes.summary: Generated data table of HTML named character references, expanded via the NAMED_CHARACTER_REFERENCE macro (name chars, length, placeholder flag, code points). Included by nsHtml5Tokenizer.cpp to power HTML entity lookup during tokenization.

nodes.name: nsHtml5OplessBuilder.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of nsHtml5OplessBuilder: Start/Finish wrap tree building in a document update batch and flush, then reset nsContentSink fields; used when tree op queues are not used (off-main-thread machinery bypassed).

nodes.name: nsHtml5OplessBuilder.h
nodes.summary: Minimal nsHtml5DocumentBuilder subclass for cases where nsHtml5TreeOpExecutor is not used; wraps tree building in an update batch and resets nsContentSink state on finish. Tuned owned-element array recycling for Speedometer 3.1.

nodes.name: nsHtml5OwningUTF16Buffer.cpp
nodes.summary: Refcounted owning UTF-16 buffer for parser input queues: fallible allocation, iterative destructor to avoid recursion through the next-chain (bug 706932), span-based tail access and end advancement.

nodes.name: nsHtml5OwningUTF16Buffer.h
nodes.summary: Threadsafe-refcounted nsHtml5UTF16Buffer subclass that owns its buffer; forms the linked queue of pending input buffers (next/key fields) used by nsHtml5Parser and the stream parser.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Parser.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the nsIParser-facing HTML5 parser used for document.write/script-created parses and non-initial about:blank: drives the tokenizer over an nsHtml5OwningUTF16Buffer queue in ParseUntilBlocked, coordinates with nsHtml5TreeOpExecutor, stream parser handoff, document.write speculation, and script nesting levels.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Parser.h
nodes.summary: nsHtml5Parser class declaration: nsIParser + nsIStreamListener implementation owning a tree builder, tokenizer, doc.write speculator pair, tree op executor and stream listener; manages parser blocking, insertion point, script nesting and about:blank mode.

nodes.name: nsHtml5PlainTextUtils.cpp
nodes.summary: Builds synthetic link (rel=stylesheet pointing at plaintext.css) and body attributes used when parsing plain-text documents as HTML; body gets a nowrap class unless the wrap-long-lines pref is set.

nodes.name: nsHtml5PlainTextUtils.h
nodes.summary: Static helpers NewLinkAttributes/NewBodyAttributes producing nsHtml5HtmlAttributes for plain-text presentation documents.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Portability.cpp
nodes.summary: Generated portability layer between the Java-derived HTML5 parser and Gecko: interning local names via nsHtml5AtomTable, nsHtml5String creation/comparison helpers, char array conversion and literal comparisons.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Portability.h
nodes.summary: Static portability API for string/atom/jArray operations used across the generated HTML5 parser; augmented by nsHtml5PortabilityHSupplement.h templates.

nodes.name: nsHtml5PortabilityHSupplement.h
nodes.summary: Hand-written supplement to nsHtml5Portability.h: template memcmp-based bufferStartsWithLiteral(AssumeSufficientLength) helpers for fast UTF-16 literal prefix checks.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Speculation.cpp
nodes.summary: Speculation record holding the pending input buffer, start line/column, tree-builder state snapshot and an ops queue; MoveOpsFrom appends tree operations fallibly and FlushToSink hands them to a sink.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Speculation.h
nodes.summary: nsAHtml5TreeOpSink subclass capturing speculative tree operations and parser state so speculative loads (e.g. document.write lookahead) can be replayed or discarded when speculation fails.

nodes.name: nsHtml5SpeculativeLoad.cpp
nodes.summary: Executes a queued speculative load by dispatching on its opcode to nsHtml5TreeOpExecutor preload APIs (image/script/style/font/fetch/preconnect/picture, base URL, CSP, meta referrer, document charset/mode).

nodes.name: nsHtml5SpeculativeLoad.h
nodes.summary: Value type for one speculative load with opcode enum and overloaded string fields (url/charset/srcset/crossorigin/media/nonce/integrity/fetchpriority...); Init* methods record attributes for later main-thread preload via Perform().

nodes.name: nsHtml5StackNode.cpp
nodes.summary: Generated open-element stack node for the tree builder: multiple setValues overloads for HTML/SVG/MathML (flag preparation for scoping/integration points), manual refcounting with release back to the tree builder pool or delete, and HTMLContentCreatorFunction carrying the element creation chain.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StackNode.h
nodes.summary: Stack node class declaration: element/pop name atoms, namespace, nsIContentHandle, attributes, element-name flags and the mozilla::dom::HTMLContentCreatorFunction used by the tree builder to create DOM elements.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StateSnapshot.cpp
nodes.summary: Generated immutable snapshot of tree builder state (stack, list of active formatting elements, template mode stack, form/head pointers, insertion mode, quirks) for speculation and document.write; destructor releases retained stack nodes.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StateSnapshot.h
nodes.summary: nsAHtml5TreeBuilderState implementation holding autoJArray copies of parser stacks plus mode/quirks flags, enabling tree builder state restore after failed speculations.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StreamListener.cpp
nodes.summary: Thread-safe nsIThreadRetargetableStreamListener that delegates OnStartRequest/OnDataAvailable/OnStopRequest to nsHtml5StreamParser under a ReentrantMonitor and proxies parser release to the main thread via nsHtml5StreamParserReleaser.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StreamListener.h
nodes.summary: Wrapper solving the refcounting mismatch between cycle-collected nsHtml5StreamParser (main-thread only) and retargetable stream listeners (off-main-thread); holds an atomic, monitor-protected delegate pointer.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StreamParser.cpp
nodes.summary: Core off-main-thread HTML5 stream parser: encoding sniffing (BOM, chardetng, meta charset scanning with UTF-16 decoder re-switching), feeding decoded UTF-16 to the tokenizer, buffering/speculation around scripts, timer-driven flushes, and Necko OnStartRequest/OnDataAvailable/OnStopRequest handling for normal, view-source, plain-text, data-URL and about:blank modes.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StreamParser.h
nodes.summary: nsHtml5StreamParser declaration (cycle-collected, parser-thread operated): parser modes enum, BOM sniffing states, stream states, tokenizer/tree builder ownership, speculation and flush timer members, encoding-declaration handler interface.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StreamParserPtr.h
nodes.summary: Smart pointer for nsHtml5StreamParser whose release is proxied to the main thread via nsHtml5StreamParserReleaser runnable, mirroring nsCOMPtr semantics (assign, swap, forget, getter_AddRefs).

nodes.name: nsHtml5OplessBuilder
nodes.summary: Minimal nsHtml5DocumentBuilder subclass for parses that bypass the tree op executor; owns document/node info manager/doc shell fields and recycles its owned-elements array.

nodes.name: nsHtml5OplessBuilder::Start
nodes.summary: Begins a flush and a document update batch before tree building without tree ops.

nodes.name: nsHtml5OplessBuilder::Finish
nodes.summary: Ends the doc update batch and flush, drops parser/perf hint, nulls sink fields and recycles the owned-elements array storage.

nodes.name: nsHtml5OwningUTF16Buffer
nodes.summary: Owning, threadsafe-refcounted UTF-16 buffer node with next/key links forming the parser's pending input queue.

nodes.name: nsHtml5OwningUTF16Buffer::FalliblyCreate
nodes.summary: Static fallible factory allocating a char16_t buffer and wrapping it in a refcounted buffer object.

nodes.name: nsHtml5OwningUTF16Buffer::TailAsSpan
nodes.summary: Returns a Span over the unfilled tail of the buffer so decoders can write directly into it.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Parser
nodes.summary: nsIParser/nsIStreamListener implementation for script-created parses, document.write and non-initial about:blank; owns tokenizer, tree builder, doc.write speculator, executor and stream listener.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Parser::ParseUntilBlocked
nodes.summary: Main pump loop: feeds queued buffers to the tokenizer until blocked, EOF/closed (tokenizer eof, tree builder flush/StreamEnded) or returns control to the stream parser via ContinueAfterScriptsOrEncodingCommitment.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Parser::Parse(nsAString,void*,bool)
nodes.summary: document.write/close entry point: queues the source buffer under a script-element key, optionally runs the doc.write speculator for preloading, and kicks ParseUntilBlocked.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Parser::StartExecutor
