nodes.summary: document.open()-only executor setup: sets scripting/declarative-shadow-roots on the tree builder, starts tokenizer and executor, and runs WillBuildModel.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Parser::StartTokenizer
nodes.summary: Initializes tokenizer state (interner, scripting flag) before parsing begins.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Parser::InitializeDocWriteParserState
nodes.summary: Restores tokenizer and main tree builder state from an nsAHtml5TreeBuilderState snapshot after a document.write speculation, at a given line number.

nodes.name: nsHtml5PlainTextUtils
nodes.summary: Static factory for the synthetic stylesheet link and body attributes injected when rendering plain text through the HTML5 parser.

nodes.name: nsHtml5PlainTextUtils::NewLinkAttributes
nodes.summary: Creates rel=stylesheet/href=plaintext.css attributes for the synthesized <link> in plain-text documents.

nodes.name: nsHtml5PlainTextUtils::NewBodyAttributes
nodes.summary: Adds a nowrap class to the synthesized <body> unless plain_text_wrap_long_lines is enabled.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Portability
nodes.summary: Static adapter between generated parser code and Gecko string/atom primitives: atom interning, nsHtml5String factories, comparisons and jArray conversions.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Portability::newStringFromBuffer
nodes.summary: Creates an nsHtml5String from a UTF-16 range, interning to an atom via the parser's atom table when available, otherwise buffering via the tree builder.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Portability::newLocalNameFromBuffer
nodes.summary: Interns a UTF-16 name range into an nsAtom using the parser-scoped nsHtml5AtomTable.

nodes.name: bufferStartsWithLiteralAssumeSufficientLength<N>
nodes.summary: Template memcmp over the literal length checking whether a char16_t buffer starts with a compile-time literal; used for fast BOM/XML-declaration sniffing.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Speculation
nodes.summary: nsAHtml5TreeOpSink capturing speculative tree operations plus buffer/start-position/snapshot so failed speculations can be rewound and replayed.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Speculation::MoveOpsFrom
nodes.summary: Fallibly appends a moved-in tree operation queue to this speculation's queue.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Speculation::FlushToSink
nodes.summary: Moves this speculation's queued operations into another nsAHtml5TreeOpSink.

nodes.name: nsHtml5SpeculativeLoad
nodes.summary: Opcode-tagged record of one preload-worthy resource discovered on the parser thread, with overloaded string fields; replayed on the main thread through Perform().

nodes.name: nsHtml5SpeculativeLoad::Perform
nodes.summary: Dispatches on the opcode to the matching nsHtml5TreeOpExecutor preload/config API (PreloadImage/Script/Style/Font/Fetch, Preconnect, SetSpeculationBase, charset/mode, CSP, referrer).

nodes.name: nsHtml5SpeculativeLoad::InitScript
nodes.summary: Records a speculative <script> load (URL, charset, type, crossorigin, media, nonce, fetchpriority, integrity, referrer policy, async/defer/link-preload flags).

nodes.name: nsHtml5SpeculativeLoad::InitImage
nodes.summary: Records a speculative load including srcset/sizes, crossorigin, media, referrer policy, fetchpriority and type/nonce.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StackNode
nodes.summary: Open-element stack entry for the tree builder carrying element/pop names, namespace, content handle, flags and the HTMLContentCreatorFunction linking to DOM element creation.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StackNode::setValues
nodes.summary: Family of overloads initializing the node for HTML, SVG (prepareSvgFlags) or MathML (prepareMathFlags) elements from an nsHtml5ElementName, attributes and pop name.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StackNode::release
nodes.summary: Manual refcount decrement; on zero drops attributes and either recycles the node via nsHtml5TreeBuilder::notifyUnusedStackNode or deletes a standalone snapshot node.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StackNode::prepareSvgFlags
nodes.summary: Adjusts element-name flags for SVG subtree rules: clears HTML scoping flags, maps SCOPING_AS_SVG to scoping/special/HTML integration point.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StateSnapshot
nodes.summary: Immutable nsAHtml5TreeBuilderState capturing the full insertion-mode/stack state for speculation rollback and document.write state save/restore.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StreamListener
nodes.summary: Threadsafe retargetable stream listener shell whose monitor-protected delegate (nsHtml5StreamParser) receives Necko callbacks; release of the parser is proxied to the main thread.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StreamListener::DropDelegateImpl
nodes.summary: Under the delegate monitor, clears the parser pointer and dispatches an nsHtml5StreamParserReleaser runnable to the main thread to release it safely.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StreamListener::OnDataAvailable
nodes.summary: Forwards Necko data-available callbacks to nsHtml5StreamParser::OnDataAvailable while holding the delegate monitor.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StreamParser
nodes.summary: Cycle-collected off-main-thread HTML5 stream parser: owns tokenizer/tree builder pair, performs encoding sniffing and meta charset scanning, buffers data during script speculation, and flushes tree ops via timer to the executor.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StreamParser::OnStartRequest
nodes.summary: Necko start callback: sets view-source title, kickstarts the executor/tree builder, and begins the stream state machine on the parser thread.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StreamParser::OnDataAvailable
nodes.summary: Necko data callback dispatching buffered segment copies to the parser thread via CopySegmentsToParser/DoDataAvailable.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StreamParser::GuessEncoding
nodes.summary: Determines initial encoding from BOM/channel charset/prefs/chardetng detection results and picks the unicode decoder.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StreamParser::SniffStreamBytes
nodes.summary: BOM/bogo-XML-declaration sniffing state machine over raw bytes, transitioning to decoding setup (including UTF-16 bogo-XML handling) before normal tokenization begins.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StreamParser::WriteStreamBytes
nodes.summary: Decodes incoming bytes to UTF-16 (with ASCII-fast path and re-switching decoder support), optionally scanning for meta charset, and tokenizes the decoded segments.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StreamParser::ParseAvailableData
nodes.summary: Parser-thread pump: feeds buffered/speculative data to the tokenizer, manages speculation failure/rollback with nsHtml5Speculation and nsHtml5StateSnapshot, and coordinates executor flushing.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StreamParser::ProcessLookingForMetaCharset
nodes.summary: Scans the decoded ASCII-presumed prefix for <meta charset>, tracking '>' positions across buffers, and triggers decoder switches when an eligible meta is found.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StreamParser::internalEncodingDeclaration
nodes.summary: EncodingDeclarationHandler callback from the tree builder for late <meta charset> reports; validates and requests an encoding switch mid-stream.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StreamParser::ContinueAfterScriptsOrEncodingCommitment
nodes.summary: Resumes parser-thread parsing after nsHtml5Parser blocked on scripts or an encoding commitment, restoring tokenizer/tree builder and replaying or discarding the speculation.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StreamParser::SwitchDecoderIfAsciiSoFar
nodes.summary: Re-encodes already-decoded ASCII-only prefix bytes so the stream can be re-decoded under a newly detected non-ASCII encoding.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StreamParserPtr
nodes.summary: nsCOMPtr-style smart pointer for nsHtml5StreamParser that proxies Release to the main thread through an nsHtml5StreamParserReleaser runnable.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StreamParserPtr::release
nodes.summary: Wraps the parser pointer in an nsHtml5StreamParserReleaser and dispatches it via DispatchToMain so refcount drops happen on the main thread.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StreamParserReleaser.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsHtml5StreamParserReleaser, a runnable that releases a raw nsHtml5StreamParser pointer on a specific thread, used by the stream parser for thread-safe teardown.

nodes.name: nsHtml5String.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the nsHtml5String value type: ToString/MoveToString conversion, ASCII comparisons, Clone/Release, and factory methods FromBuffer/FromLiteral/FromString/FromAtom backed by tagged StringBuffer or nsAtom pointers.

nodes.name: nsHtml5String.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsHtml5String, a pass-by-value tagged-pointer type (2 low tag bits) representing null, empty, exactly-sized StringBuffer, or nsAtom strings shared between tokenizer and tree builder.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StringParser.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the off-main-thread-free fragment/document string parser: ParseFragment (innerHTML algorithm), ParseDocument, and the Tokenize driver loop that feeds nsHtml5DependentUTF16Buffer chunks into a tokenizer plus op-less tree builder, with cache trimming via TryCache.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StringParser.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsHtml5StringParser (nsParserBase subclass) owning an nsHtml5OplessBuilder, nsHtml5TreeBuilder, nsHtml5Tokenizer and atom table, plus an internal CacheClearer runnable for idle cache drops.

nodes.name: nsHtml5SVGLoadDispatcher.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements nsHtml5SVGLoadDispatcher::Run: blocks document onload at construction, then dispatches an eSVGLoad widget event on the SVG element via EventDispatcher and unblocks onload.

nodes.name: nsHtml5SVGLoadDispatcher.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsHtml5SVGLoadDispatcher, a runnable holding an nsIContent element and its document to fire the SVG load event asynchronously from tree operations.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Tokenizer.cpp
nodes.summary: Generated (from Tokenizer.java) implementation of the HTML5 tokenizer state machine: constructor, literal arrays (TITLE/SCRIPT/STYLE etc.), start/tokenizeBuffer/eof/stateLoop driver, character reference handling, and error hooks. One of the hottest parsing files.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Tokenizer.h
nodes.summary: Generated class declaration of nsHtml5Tokenizer with all HTML5 tokenizer state constants (DATA, RCDATA, SCRIPT_DATA, TAG_OPEN, ...), buffers, and the template stateLoop driver plus start/tokenizeBuffer/eof API; augmented by TokenizerHSupplement.h.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TokenizerALU.cpp
nodes.summary: Instantiates nsHtml5Tokenizer::stateLoop with the ALU loop policies (nsHtml5FastestPolicyALU, nsHtml5LineColPolicyALU, nsHtml5ViewSourcePolicyALU) into this translation unit so LLVM can LICM SIMD-unrelated constants.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TokenizerALUStubs.cpp
nodes.summary: Fallback stub definitions of the ALU state-loop entry points (StateLoopFastestALU/LineColALU/ViewSourceALU) that MOZ_RELEASE_ASSERT on inconsistent build configuration.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TokenizerCppSupplement.h
nodes.summary: Hand-written C++ methods appended to the generated tokenizer: EnsureBufferSpace power-of-two buffer growth with overflow checks, view-source plumbing (EnableViewSource/FlushViewSource/StartViewSource), StartPlainText, column tracking and encoding-declaration hooks.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TokenizerHSupplement.h
nodes.summary: Hand-written declarations injected into the nsHtml5Tokenizer class body: column tracking state, StateLoopFastest/LineCol/ViewSource wrappers for SIMD and ALU policies, EnsureBufferSpace, view-source API, TryAtomizeForSingleDigit and the err* error-reporting methods.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TokenizerLoopPoliciesALU.h
nodes.summary: Scalar (non-SIMD) tokenizer loop policy structs nsHtml5FastestPolicyALU (no errors, no line/col, used for innerHTML), nsHtml5LineColPolicyALU (tracks line/column) and nsHtml5ViewSourcePolicyALU (reports transitions to the highlighter).

nodes.name: nsHtml5TokenizerLoopPoliciesSIMD.h
nodes.summary: SIMD tokenizer loop policy structs nsHtml5FastestPolicySIMD, nsHtml5LineColPolicySIMD and nsHtml5ViewSourcePolicySIMD that accelerate buffer advancement through DATA, RAWTEXT, script-data-escaped, comment and attribute-value states.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TokenizerSIMD.cpp
nodes.summary: Instantiates nsHtml5Tokenizer::stateLoop with the SIMD loop policies (nsHtml5FastestPolicySIMD, nsHtml5LineColPolicySIMD, nsHtml5ViewSourcePolicySIMD) in a dedicated translation unit compiled with SIMD flags.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TokenizerSIMDStubs.cpp
nodes.summary: Fallback stub definitions of the SIMD state-loop entry points (StateLoopFastestSIMD/LineColSIMD/ViewSourceSIMD) that MOZ_RELEASE_ASSERT on inconsistent build configuration.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TreeBuilderCppSupplement.h
nodes.summary: Hand-written out-of-line body of nsHtml5TreeBuilder: element creation (createElement overloads enqueueing create-element tree ops), append/foster-parent operations, Flush of the op queue to the executor or op sink, charset reporting (SetDocumentCharset, StreamEnded), documentMode, and the SanitizerState class implementing sanitize-while-parsing insertion hooks.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TreeBuilderHSupplement.h
nodes.summary: Hand-written declarations injected into nsHtml5TreeBuilder: dual construction modes (op-less builder vs op queue with nsAHtml5TreeOpSink and speculative-load stage), nsIContentHandle allocation strategy (nsIContent** handles filled on the main thread), Flush/FlushLoads/SetDocumentCharset, template and shadow-root helpers, and sanitizer insertion hooks.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TreeOperation.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the tree operation value type: Perform dispatches each queued op on the main thread (append, detach, foster parent, insert, attributes, comments, doctype, charset updates, script running), and CreateHTMLElement/CreateSVGElement/CreateMathMLElement construct DOM elements for the parser including custom element and declarative shadow DOM handling.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TreeOperation.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsHtml5TreeOperation as a mozilla::Variant of op structs (opAppend, opDetach, opFosterParent, opCreateHTMLElement, opCreateSVGElement, opCreateMathMLElement, opAppendText, opAppendComment, opAppendDoctypeToDocument, opRunScript, opUpdateCharset etc.) modeling deferred main-thread DOM mutations of the HTML5 parse.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TreeOpExecutor.cpp
nodes.summary: Main-thread executor of the HTML5 tree op queue: RunFlushLoop/FlushDocumentWrite drain nsHtml5TreeOperation batches with DidBuildModel EOF emission, RunScript feeds script elements to the script loader with document.write handling, speculative load preloading (PreloadScript/Style/Image), charset complaint reporting, and the nsHtml5ExecutorReflusher runnable for interrupted flushes.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TreeOpExecutor.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsHtml5TreeOpExecutor, an nsHtml5DocumentBuilder/nsIContentSink/nsAHtml5TreeOpSink/LinkedListElement that owns the op queue and speculation stage, implements nsIContentSink lifecycle (WillParse/DidBuildModel), RunScript, flush loops, and the preload/speculation-base API used by the tree builder.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StreamParserReleaser
nodes.summary: mozilla::Runnable holding a raw nsHtml5StreamParser* whose Run() calls Release() on it, enabling cross-thread release of the stream parser on its owning thread.

nodes.name: nsHtml5String
nodes.summary: Pass-by-value string with 2 tag bits distinguishing null, empty, StringBuffer-owned and nsAtom-owned representations; supports cheap cloning, ASCII comparisons and move-out without reallocation.

nodes.name: nsHtml5String::FromBuffer
nodes.summary: Static factory wrapping a tokenizer buffer as an exactly-sized mozilla::StringBuffer so allocation matches nsAttrValue::GetStringBuffer; on OOM marks the tree builder broken and substitutes U+FFFD.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StringParser
nodes.summary: nsParserBase subclass instantiated as a process-wide singleton by nsContentUtils; drives a tokenizer and op-less tree builder synchronously over a string for innerHTML/fragment and whole-document parsing with sanitizer support.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StringParser::ParseFragment
nodes.summary: Implements the HTML fragment parsing algorithm: sets fragment context, sanitizer configuration, custom element registry and script-execution prevention on the tree builder, then tokenizes into the target node.

nodes.name: nsHtml5StringParser::Tokenize
nodes.summary: Core synchronous parse driver: initializes the op-less builder with document and node info manager, feeds the source through an nsHtml5DependentUTF16Buffer handling CR normalization, runs tokenizer->tokenizeBuffer/eof/end and finishes the builder, then trims caches.

nodes.name: nsHtml5SVGLoadDispatcher
nodes.summary: Runnable created by nsHtml5TreeOperation::SvgLoad to fire the SVG load event on a freshly parsed SVG element after the current parser task completes.

nodes.name: nsHtml5SVGLoadDispatcher::Run
nodes.summary: Dispatches a non-bubbling eSVGLoad WidgetEvent via EventDispatcher using the owner document's pres context, then unblocks onload on the originally blocking document.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Tokenizer
nodes.summary: The HTML5 tokenizer state machine: converts UTF-16 buffers into start/end tags, attributes, comments, doctypes and character tokens delivered to nsHtml5TreeBuilder; supports suspension, snapshots for document.write, plain-text/view-source modes and interning via nsHtml5AtomTable.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Tokenizer::stateLoop
nodes.summary: Template-driven core loop of the tokenizer parameterized on a policy struct (error reporting, line/col tracking, SIMD acceleration); processes buffer characters through HTML5 states and returns the position where suspension occurred.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Tokenizer::tokenizeBuffer
nodes.summary: Entry point feeding one nsHtml5UTF16Buffer into the state machine: adjusts for pending CR, chooses the stateLoop instantiation per view-source/line-col needs, handles suspension and EmittedToken boundaries.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Tokenizer::EnsureBufferSpace
nodes.summary: Checks worst-case strBuf growth with CheckedInt (capped at 2^30 char16_t units), asks the token handler to reserve space, and grows strBuf to the next power of two fallibly.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Tokenizer::StateLoopFastestALU
nodes.summary: Scalar-compiled instantiation of stateLoop<nsHtml5FastestPolicyALU> used for innerHTML parsing where no error or position reporting is needed.

nodes.name: nsHtml5Tokenizer::StateLoopFastestSIMD
nodes.summary: SIMD-compiled instantiation of stateLoop<nsHtml5FastestPolicySIMD> giving accelerated advancement through large plain-data regions of the tokenizer input.

nodes.name: nsHtml5FastestPolicyALU
nodes.summary: Scalar loop policy that never reports errors or transitions and returns 0 from all accelerateAdvancement* hooks; chosen for fragment parsing.

nodes.name: nsHtml5FastestPolicySIMD
nodes.summary: SIMD loop policy providing vectorized accelerateAdvancement* scans of the input buffer for the DATA, RAWTEXT, script-data and attribute-value states without position tracking.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TreeBuilder::SanitizerState
nodes.summary: Bookkeeping for the spec's parser sanitizer configuration: sanitizes start-tag tokens in createElement, remembers adjusted insertion locations (including foster parenting) and redirects clone/furthest-block insertions during the adoption agency algorithm.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TreeBuilder::createElement
nodes.summary: Element-creation hook called by the generated tree construction code: in op-less mode builds the element immediately via nsHtml5TreeOperation creators (respecting sanitizer, custom element registry and declarative shadow roots); otherwise allocates an nsIContentHandle and enqueues opCreateHTMLElement/opCreateSVGElement/opCreateMathMLElement.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TreeBuilder::Flush
nodes.summary: Moves the accumulated op queue to the op sink (executor or view-source highlighter), returning whether ops were flushed or an error; supports discretionary flushes that only run when safe.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TreeBuilder::SetDocumentCharset
nodes.summary: Forwards the encoding, its confidence source and the encoding-speculation commit flag through the speculative load stage so the main thread adopts the parser thread's charset decision.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TreeOperation
nodes.summary: Variant-based deferred DOM mutation record exchanged between parser thread and main thread; each instance wraps one op struct with nsIContent** handles and carries Perform() for main-thread execution by the executor.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TreeOperation::Perform
nodes.summary: Giant switch executing one tree op against the DOM on the main thread: appends, foster parenting, text/comment insertion, attribute setting, doctype creation, template/shadow-root wiring, SVG load dispatch, script marking and running scripts via the executor.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TreeOperation::CreateHTMLElement
nodes.summary: Creates an HTML element for the parser: dispatches through the HTML content creator functions / element factory machinery, applying parser-set attributes, custom element upgrades, form association and declarative shadow root setup.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TreeOpExecutor
nodes.summary: Main-thread content sink and op sink for stream parsing: extends nsHtml5DocumentBuilder, drains the tree op queue (RunFlushLoop/FlushDocumentWrite), manages speculative loads and charset reporting, and interfaces with nsHtml5Parser and nsHtml5StreamParser.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TreeOpExecutor::RunFlushLoop
nodes.summary: Bounded flush loop that performs queued tree ops in batches while yielding to the event loop on long parses (MaybeSuspend, nsHtml5ExecutorReflusher re-queues), handling broken-parser aborts and pending sheet/script waits.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TreeOpExecutor::RunScript
nodes.summary: Handles opRunScript: pauses parsing, optionally enters the document-write-capable path, hands the script element to the document's ScriptLoader, and resumes/continues parsing after the script depending on whether it blocked or wrote.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TreeOpExecutor::DidBuildModel
nodes.summary: nsIContentSink EOF hook: flushes remaining ops, notifies the content sink (DidBuildModelImpl), unblocks onload, stops layout updates and tears down the association with the stream parser when the parse terminates.

nodes.name: nsHtml5ExecutorReflusher
nodes.summary: Runnable that re-enters nsHtml5TreeOpExecutor::RunFlushLoop when a flush was interrupted, deferring if a high-priority event for the top-level document is still pending in content processes.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TreeOpStage.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the mutex-guarded tree-operation stage: moves nsHtml5TreeOperation queues in/out and moves nsHtml5SpeculativeLoad queues, all under mozilla::MutexAutoLock with fallible appends, plus a DEBUG-only AssertEmpty.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TreeOpStage.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsHtml5TreeOpStage, an nsAHtml5TreeOpSink that buffers tree operations and speculative loads behind a mutex so the off-main-thread parser can hand batches to the main-thread tree builder.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TreeOpStage
nodes.summary: Mutex-protected staging sink for the HTML5 parser thread: holds mOpQueue and mSpeculativeLoadQueue, supporting MoveOpsFrom (flush in), MoveOpsTo/MoveOpsAndSpeculativeLoadsTo (flush out) and speculative-load transfers. Implements nsAHtml5TreeOpSink.

nodes.name: nsHtml5TreeOpStage::MoveOpsFrom
nodes.summary: nsAHtml5TreeOpSink override: unconditionally appends the parser thread's operation queue into the staged queue under the mutex; returns false on OOM (fallible append).

nodes.name: nsHtml5TreeOpStage::MoveOpsAndSpeculativeLoadsTo
nodes.summary: Drains both staged queues into the caller's tree-operation and speculative-load arrays in one mutex-locked step, used when the main thread executes a parser-stage batch.

nodes.name: nsHtml5UTF16Buffer.cpp
nodes.summary: Generated (from UTF16Buffer.java) implementation of the UTF-16 input buffer accessors: getStart/setStart/getBuffer/getEnd/setEnd, hasMore, getLength and adjust (skips LF after CR for newline normalization), plus empty static init/release hooks.

nodes.name: nsHtml5UTF16Buffer.h
nodes.summary: Generated declaration of nsHtml5UTF16Buffer, the tokenizer's char16_t buffer window (buffer/start/end) with hasMore/adjust semantics; extended via included Cpp/H supplement headers for Gecko-side constructors.

nodes.name: nsHtml5UTF16Buffer
nodes.summary: Base class of the HTML5 tokenizer input: wraps a UTF-16 code-unit buffer with start/end cursors; hasMore() reports unconsumed data and adjust(lastWasCR) drops a leading LF so CRLF counts as one newline.

nodes.name: nsHtml5UTF16Buffer::adjust
nodes.summary: Implements HTML newline normalization at buffer seams: when the previous buffer ended with CR, advances start past a leading LF in this buffer.

nodes.name: nsHtml5UTF16BufferCppSupplement.h
nodes.summary: Gecko supplement included at the end of nsHtml5UTF16Buffer.cpp: defines the protected ctor/dtor with MOZ_COUNT_CTOR/DTOR lifetime tracking, DeleteBuffer() and Swap() for working around buffer privacy in generated code.

nodes.name: nsHtml5UTF16Buffer::Swap
nodes.summary: Exchanges buffer/start/end with another nsHtml5UTF16Buffer, used by the stream parser to hand a freshly filled buffer to the tokenizer without copying.

nodes.name: nsHtml5UTF16BufferHSupplement.h
nodes.summary: Gecko supplement included inside the nsHtml5UTF16Buffer class body: declares the protected constructor/destructor and the DeleteBuffer()/Swap() helpers that the Cpp supplement defines.

nodes.name: nsHtml5ViewSourceUtils.cpp
nodes.summary: Builds synthesized view-source markup attributes: body gets id=viewsource plus a tab-size style from the view_source.tab_size pref, a stylesheet link to resource://content-accessible/viewsource.css, and a width=device-width meta viewport.

nodes.name: nsHtml5ViewSourceUtils.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsHtml5ViewSourceUtils, a static-only helper that produces nsHtml5HtmlAttributes for the synthetic body/link/meta elements injected when parsing view-source documents.

nodes.name: nsHtml5ViewSourceUtils
nodes.summary: Static factory for view-source attributes: NewBodyAttributes (id=viewsource + tab-size style), NewLinkAttributes (rel=stylesheet text/css viewsource.css) and NewMetaViewportAttributes (viewport width=device-width).

nodes.name: nsHtml5ViewSourceUtils::NewBodyAttributes
nodes.summary: Creates the attributes for the synthesized view-source body: id=viewsource plus a tab-size style derived from the view_source.tab_size static pref when positive.

nodes.name: nsHtml5ViewSourceUtils::NewLinkAttributes
nodes.summary: Creates rel=stylesheet/type=text/css/href=resource://content-accessible/viewsource.css attributes for the view-source styling link element.
Creates name=viewport/content=width=device-width attributes for the synthesized view-source meta element so mobile rendering matches page width.
nodes.name: firefox/parser/html/nsHtml5ViewSourceUtils.h#NewMetaViewportAttributes
nsIContentHandle.h
nodes.summary: Defines nsIContentHandle as a typedef for void: the opaque handle type the generated HTML5 tree builder uses for content nodes, letting the parser code compile without depending on the real nsIContent DOM class.

nodes.name: nsIParserUtils.idl
nodes.summary: XPIDL interface exposing non-web HTML parser functionality to extensions: sanitize(src, flags) with Sanitizer* bit flags (AllowComments, AllowStyle, CidEmbedsOnly, DropNonCSSPresentation, DropForms, DropMedia, LogRemovals), removeConditionalCSS, convertToPlainText and parseFragment; contract id @mozilla.org/parserutils;1.

nodes.name: nsIParserUtils
nodes.summary: Scriptable builtinclass interface (nsISupports-derived) for parsing/sanitizing HTML outside the DOM: sanitize to a string, strip conditional CSS, convert HTML to plain text, and parse a markup fragment into a DocumentFragment given a context element and base URI.

nodes.name: nsParserUtils.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements nsIParserUtils via nsContentUtils helpers: SanitizeWith template parses an inert HTML document, applies a sanitizer callable, and serializes with an HTML document encoder; Sanitize runs nsTreeSanitizer, RemoveConditionalCSS strips @media CSS, ParseFragment builds a fragment with scripts disabled (HTML into body context, XML wrapped in an XHTML div).

nodes.name: nsParserUtils.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsParserUtils, the final nsIParserUtils implementation behind the @mozilla.org/parserutils;1 contract, expanding NS_DECL_ISUPPORTS and NS_DECL_NSIPARSERUTILS.

nodes.name: nsParserUtils
nodes.summary: XPCOM component implementing nsIParserUtils by delegating to nsContentUtils parsing helpers and nsTreeSanitizer; instantiated under the parserutils contract for extension use.

nodes.name: SanitizeWith
nodes.summary: Static template helper shared by Sanitize/RemoveConditionalCSS: creates an inert HTML document via nsContentUtils::CreateInertHTMLDocument, parses input with ParseDocumentHTML, invokes the callable sanitizer on it, then serializes with a text/html nsIDocumentEncoder.

nodes.name: nsParserUtils::Sanitize
nodes.summary: Parses the source into an inert document and runs nsTreeSanitizer with the caller's Sanitizer* flags, returning the sanitized HTML serialized to a string; designed to prevent XSS when embedding into another origin.

nodes.name: nsParserUtils::ParseFragment
nodes.summary: Parses markup into a sanitized DocumentFragment with the context element's document: temporarily disables the script loader, uses ParseFragmentHTML into a body-context fragment for HTML or ParseFragmentXML wrapped in an XHTML div for XML, and restores script enabling afterwards.

nodes.name: HTMLAllCollection.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLAllCollection: the legacy document.all collection exposing indexed/named element access with undefined-emulating behavior via getter, item, namedItem and legacycaller.

nodes.name: HTMLAnchorElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLAnchorElement: <a> hyperlink DOM surface with download/ping/rel/referrerPolicy/text attributes plus obsolete coords/charset/name/rev/shape, and HyperlinkElementUtils mixins.

nodes.name: HTMLAreaElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLAreaElement: <area> image-map hotspot DOM surface with alt/coords/shape/download/ping/rel attributes and hyperlink URL utilities.

nodes.name: HTMLAudioElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLAudioElement: <audio> element extending HTMLMediaElement with only the Audio(src) legacy factory function.

nodes.name: HTMLBaseElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLBaseElement: <base> element DOM surface exposing href and target attributes.

nodes.name: HTMLBodyElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLBodyElement: <body> element with obsolete text/link/vLink/aLink/bgColor/background attributes and the WindowEventHandlers mixin.

nodes.name: HTMLBRElement.webidl
nodes.summary:
WebIDL interface definition for HTMLBRElement:
element DOM surface with obsolete clear attribute and ChromeOnly editor padding flags.

nodes.name: HTMLButtonElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLButtonElement: <button> form control DOM surface with form submission attributes, constraint validation, labels, and command/popover invoker support.

nodes.name: HTMLCanvasElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLCanvasElement: <canvas> element DOM surface with width/height, getContext, toDataURL/toBlob, captureStream and transferControlToOffscreen.

nodes.name: HTMLCollection.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLCollection: the generic live element collection DOM surface with length, item() and namedItem().

nodes.name: HTMLDataElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLDataElement: <data> element DOM surface exposing the machine-readable value attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLDataListElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLDataListElement: <datalist> element DOM surface exposing the options HTMLCollection.

nodes.name: HTMLDetailsElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLDetailsElement: <details> disclosure widget DOM surface with name and open attributes.

nodes.name: HTMLDialogElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLDialogElement: <dialog> element DOM surface with open/returnValue/closedBy and show/showModal/close/requestClose methods.

nodes.name: HTMLDirectoryElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLDirectoryElement: obsolete <dir> element DOM surface with the compact attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLDivElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLDivElement: <div> generic container DOM surface with the obsolete align attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLDListElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLDListElement: <dl> description list DOM surface with the obsolete compact attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLDocument.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLDocument: legacy Document subclass adding the named-property getter for document.<name> tree access.

nodes.name: HTMLElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLElement: the base HTML element DOM surface with metadata attributes, user interaction (hidden/inert/contentEditable), popover API, offset attributes, event handler mixins, and HTMLUnknownElement.

nodes.name: HTMLEmbedElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLEmbedElement: <embed> external content element DOM surface with src/type/width/height and plugin-loading chrome mixins.

nodes.name: HTMLFieldSetElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLFieldSetElement: <fieldset> grouping element DOM surface with disabled/name, elements collection, and constraint validation.

nodes.name: HTMLFontElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLFontElement: obsolete <font> element DOM surface with color/face/size attributes.

nodes.name: HTMLFormControlsCollection.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLFormControlsCollection: HTMLCollection subtype whose namedItem returns a RadioNodeList or Element for form controls.

nodes.name: HTMLFormElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLFormElement: <form> element DOM surface with submission attributes, elements collection, submit/requestSubmit/reset and validity checking.

nodes.name: HTMLFrameElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLFrameElement: obsolete <frame> element DOM surface with name/src/scrolling attributes and nested browsing context access.

nodes.name: HTMLFrameSetElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLFrameSetElement: obsolete <frameset> element DOM surface with cols/rows attributes and WindowEventHandlers.

nodes.name: HTMLHeadElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLHeadElement: <head> document metadata container with no additional members.

nodes.name: HTMLHeadingElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLHeadingElement: <h1>-<h6> heading elements DOM surface with the obsolete align attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLHRElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLHRElement: <hr> thematic break element DOM surface with obsolete align/color/noShade/size/width attributes.

nodes.name: HTMLHtmlElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLHtmlElement: root <html> element DOM surface with the obsolete version attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLHyperlinkElementUtils.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for the HTMLHyperlinkElementUtils mixin: adds stringifier href and target attributes to hyperlink elements.

nodes.name: HTMLIFrameElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLIFrameElement: <iframe> nested browsing context DOM surface with src/srcdoc/sandbox/allowFullscreen/loading, contentDocument/contentWindow, and feature policy.

nodes.name: HTMLImageElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLImageElement: element DOM surface with src/srcset/sizes/decoding/loading, intrinsic dimensions, decode(), and chrome image-loading mixins.

nodes.name: HTMLInputElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLInputElement: <input> control DOM surface with value/checked/files, form association, selection API, constraint validation, pickers, and many ChromeOnly autofill/testing hooks.

nodes.name: HTMLLabelElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLLabelElement: <label> element DOM surface with htmlFor attribute and labeled control access.

nodes.name: HTMLLegendElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLLegendElement: <legend> element DOM surface with form association and obsolete align attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLLIElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLLIElement: <li> list item DOM surface with the value attribute and obsolete type attribute.

nodes.name: HTMLLinkElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLLinkElement: <link> element DOM surface with rel/href/media/sizes, relList, preload/blocking/fetchpriority, and the LinkStyle mixin.

nodes.name: HTMLMapElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLMapElement: <map> client-side image map DOM surface with name attribute and areas collection.

nodes.name: HTMLMarqueeElement.webidl
nodes.summary: WebIDL interface definition for HTMLMarqueeElement: obsolete <marquee> scrolling text element DOM surface with behavior/direction/speed attributes and start/stop methods.

nodes.name: HTMLMediaElement.webidl

nodes.name: nsCSSFrameConstructor.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the style-to-frame bridge: builds the frame tree from content and computed style, handling insertion/removal, generated content, tables, inlines, and lazy construction.

nodes.name: nsCSSFrameConstructor.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsCSSFrameConstructor (extending nsFrameManager), the API content mutations call to keep the frame tree in sync with the DOM and computed style.

nodes.name: nsBlockFrame.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of block-level frame reflow: line box management, float handling, inline/block line layout, and block display-list building.

nodes.name: nsBlockFrame.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsBlockFrame, the block-level container frame class that manages child frames as line boxes and implements block reflow and display-list building.

nodes.name: nsContainerFrame.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the container-frame base: child reflow helpers (ReflowChild/FinishReflowChild), overflow and continuation management, and container display-list building.

nodes.name: nsContainerFrame.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsContainerFrame (extending nsSplittableFrame), the base class for frames with children, including overflow-container lists and continuation plumbing.

nodes.name: nsIFrame.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the frame base class: display-list building entry points (BuildDisplayListForStackingContext/ForChild), geometry, transforms, size computation, and invalidation.

nodes.name: nsIFrame.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsIFrame, the abstract base class of every layout frame; its BuildDisplayList contract is how each frame contributes to the display list.

nodes.name: nsImageFrame.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of image frames: reacting to imgINotificationObserver callbacks, image reflow, painting via PaintImage, and event/cursor handling.

nodes.name: nsImageFrame.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsImageFrame (extending nsAtomicContainerFrame) and the nsDisplayImage display item used to paint image content.

nodes.name: nsTextFrame.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of text frames: glyph run configuration, line-layout driven ReflowText, text painting with selection decorations, and intrinsic width computation.

nodes.name: nsTextFrame.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsTextFrame, the frame class rendering runs of text content, including paint-text parameters and selection painting helpers.

nodes.name: nsCSSRendering.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of CSS background/border/box-shadow painting primitives used by frame display-list items, including background frame resolution and border radii.

nodes.name: nsCSSRendering.h
nodes.summary: Declares the nsCSSRendering struct of static painting helpers (backgrounds, borders, box shadows, decoration lines) plus supporting parameter structs and nsContextBoxBlur.

nodes.name: nsDisplayItemTypes.h
nodes.summary: Defines the DisplayItemType enum and flags for all display item classes, generated from nsDisplayItemTypesList.inc for type identification and matching.

nodes.name: nsCSSFrameConstructor
nodes.summary: Style-to-frame bridge extending nsFrameManager: constructs frames per computed display/type in response to content mutation callbacks and style changes, driving style-driven frame construction.

nodes.name: ContentAppended
nodes.summary: nsCSSFrameConstructor content-mutation callback that constructs frames for a run of newly appended child nodes.

nodes.name: ContentInserted
nodes.summary: nsCSSFrameConstructor content-mutation callback that constructs and inserts frames for a single newly inserted node at its insertion point.

nodes.name: CreateGeneratedContent
nodes.summary: Creates frames for CSS ::before/::after style generated content by synthesizing anonymous content from the parent's computed style.

nodes.name: ConstructFrameFromItemInternal
nodes.summary: Central dispatch that turns a FrameConstructionItem into concrete frames using per-display-type constructor tables (block, inline, table, SVG, text controls, etc.).

nodes.name: ConstructDocElementFrame
nodes.summary: Constructs the root element frame (e.g. the html element) beneath the viewport, seeding the whole frame tree.

nodes.name: ConstructRootFrame
nodes.summary: Creates the initial ViewportFrame (and print/page scaffolding) that anchors the frame tree.

nodes.name: ConstructBlock
nodes.summary: Constructs a block frame (with possible scrolling wrapper) and initializes its child lists from the frame construction items.

nodes.name: ConstructInline
nodes.summary: Constructs inline frames, splitting across block boundaries into a chain of inline-block-inline continuations when needed.

nodes.name: CreateContinuingFrame
nodes.summary: API to create a next-in-flow continuation frame for fragmentation when a frame's content overflows its fixed area.

nodes.name: nsBlockFrame
nodes.summary: Block-level container frame extending nsContainerFrame that lays out children as line boxes (nsLineBox), handles floats, and builds its own display list including bullets.

nodes.name: BuildDisplayList
nodes.summary: nsBlockFrame display-list builder: paints background/borders, bullet, and delegates children into the display list set, using line cursors to cull.

nodes.name: Reflow
nodes.summary: Entry point for block reflow: sets up BlockReflowState, reflows dirty lines, places floats, and computes overflow areas and desired size.

nodes.name: ReflowDirtyLines
nodes.summary: Iterates the line list reflowing each dirty line (ReflowLine), sliding clean lines, and propagating float damage until the block is up to date.

nodes.name: AddFrames
nodes.summary: Inserts a list of child frames into the block's line boxes, splitting/merging lines and fixing up block/inline relationships.

nodes.name: BlockCanIntersectFloats
nodes.summary: Static predicate telling whether a child block's lines may be shortened by floats, used to decide float-damage propagation during reflow.

nodes.name: nsContainerFrame
nodes.summary: Base class for frames containing children (extends nsSplittableFrame): manages child lists, overflow containers, continuations, and shared reflow/display-list helpers.

nodes.name: BuildDisplayList
nodes.summary: Default container display-list builder that appends the frame's own item and recurses into non-block child lists.

nodes.name: BuildDisplayListForNonBlockChildren
nodes.summary: Builds display lists for the frame's non-block (e.g. inline or positional) child lists, sorting content into the passed nsDisplayListSet.

nodes.name: ReflowChild
nodes.summary: Shared helper that invokes a child frame's Reflow with the container-provided ReflowInput, applying positioning and flags.

nodes.name: FinishReflowChild
nodes.summary: Post-reflow helper that positions the child, stores its overflow areas, and completes the reflow protocol for a child frame.

nodes.name: CreateNextInFlow
nodes.summary: Creates (or reuses) the next-in-flow continuation for a child frame during fragmentation and registers it with the continuation tracker.

nodes.name: MoveOverflowToChildList
nodes.summary: Moves frames pushed to the overflow list during reflow back onto the principal or overflow-continuations child lists.

nodes.name: nsIFrame
nodes.summary: Abstract base class of all layout frames (extending nsQueryFrame): owns geometry, frame state bits, style resolution, and the virtual BuildDisplayList contract whose implementations generate the display list.

nodes.name: BuildDisplayListForStackingContext
nodes.summary: Wraps a frame that forms a stacking context into an nsDisplayWrapList, applying opacity/transform/filters/clipping per computed style before building children.

nodes.name: BuildDisplayListForChild
nodes.summary: Parent-side driver of display-list construction: decides stacking vs simple child, applies positioning and out-of-flow handling, then invokes the child's BuildDisplayList.

nodes.name: Destroy
nodes.summary: Frame teardown: destroys child lists, releases frame properties, clears continuations, and returns the frame to the pres shell arena.

nodes.name: ComputeSize
nodes.summary: Computes a frame's used inline/block sizes from computed style, box-sizing, aspect-ratio, and intrinsic sizes for a given available space.

nodes.name: GetTransformMatrix
nodes.summary: Returns the 4x4 matrix accumulated from CSS transforms, fixed-position/scroll ancestors, and cross-doc offsets between this frame and a target ancestor.

nodes.name: InvalidateFrame
nodes.summary: Marks the frame's display items invalid for a given display item key, scheduling display-list rebuild/painting updates.

nodes.name: nsImageFrame
nodes.summary: Atomic frame for image elements extending nsAtomicContainerFrame and nsIReflowCallback; tracks imgIContainer state and builds the display list via the nsDisplayImage item.

nodes.name: nsDisplayImage
nodes.summary: Painted display item that renders an nsImageFrame's current image during display-list painting.

nodes.name: Reflow
nodes.summary: Sizes the image frame from intrinsic image dimensions and style (width/height/object-fit), handling alt-text and icon fallbacks.

nodes.name: BuildDisplayList
nodes.summary: Display-list builder for image frames: appends border/background items and the nsDisplayImage item for the image content.

nodes.name: PaintImage
nodes.summary: Draws the image content respecting object-fit/object-position, returns the ImgDrawResult, and reports image visibility.

nodes.name: OnSizeAvailable
nodes.summary: imgINotificationObserver callback invoked when the decoded image's intrinsic size becomes known, triggering reflow as needed.

nodes.name: HandleEvent
nodes.summary: Handles mouse events over image maps (click/hover/move) by hit-testing areas and dispatching to the appropriate link/content.

nodes.name: nsTextFrame
nodes.summary: Frame class rendering runs of character data extending nsIFrame: owns glyph runs/offsets, supports selection painting, and implements Reflow/ReflowText and BuildDisplayList.

nodes.name: BuildDisplayList
nodes.summary: Display-list builder for text: appends the text display item plus selection/underline decoration items as needed.

nodes.name: ReflowText
nodes.summary: Line-layout driven text reflow: measures glyphs with the text run, breaks lines, sets metrics, and reports nsReflowStatus for continuation frames.

nodes.name: PaintText
nodes.summary: Paints the text run for the visible range, including shadows, decorations, and selection colors via DrawTextRun/DrawText helpers.

nodes.name: CharacterDataChanged
nodes.summary: Content-change callback that re-maps text offsets across the text frame chain and dirties affected frames when character data mutates.

nodes.name: TrimTrailingWhiteSpace
nodes.summary: Computes how much trailing whitespace should be trimmed at line end, returning the trim width and any continuation that still holds text.

nodes.name: nsCSSRendering
nodes.summary: Namespace-like struct of static CSS painting helpers: background/border/box-shadow/outline painting and background frame resolution used by display items.

nodes.name: PaintBorder
nodes.summary: Paints a frame's border from its ComputedStyle (dispatching to border-image or nsCSSRenderingBorders as appropriate).

nodes.name: PaintBoxShadowOuter
nodes.summary: Paints outer box-shadow layers for a frame, clipping out the frame's own area and blurring via nsContextBoxBlur.

nodes.name: PaintBoxShadowInner
nodes.summary: Paints inner box-shadow layers within a frame's padding box, respecting border radii and child clipping.

nodes.name: FindBackground
nodes.summary: Resolves the ComputedStyle that actually supplies a frame's background, walking to the canvas/propagated background frame when the element itself has none.

nodes.name: GetBorderRadii
nodes.summary: Computes the physical corner radii for a frame box from border-radius style, scaled to the given frame rect.

nodes.name: DisplayItemType
nodes.summary: Enum of every display item type (generated from nsDisplayItemTypesList.inc) used for item comparison, invalidation keys, and type queries.

nodes.name: nsDisplayList.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the core display-list machinery and the biggest concrete display items (background images, borders, text, shadows, transforms, layers). This file is the CHAIN BOUNDARY where layout trees are flattened into ordered display items whose Paint/CreateWebRenderCommands methods consume nsStyle* structs (StyleBackground, StyleBorder, StyleText) from the style chain.

nodes.name: nsDisplayList.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsDisplayListBuilder, nsDisplayList, and the full hierarchy of display item classes (nsDisplayItem, nsPaintedDisplayItem, nsDisplayBackgroundImage, nsDisplayBorder, nsDisplayText, layer/effects items). Defines the contract by which display items read nsStyle* structs during building, hit-testing, invalidation, and painting.

nodes.name: nsDisplayListInvalidation.h
nodes.summary: Geometry snapshot classes (nsDisplayItemGeometry and subclasses for background, border, box-shadow, filters) used to compute invalidation regions when display items are reused across paints. Snapshots capture style-derived data such as positioning-area size so style/geometry changes repaint the right region.

nodes.name: nsImageRenderer.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements nsImageRenderer, the shared engine that prepares and draws any CSS image (raster, SVG, gradient, element) for backgrounds, borders (border-image components), masks, and shape-outside. Draw methods translate nsStyleImage sizing/repeat data from the style structs into gfx draws or WebRender commands.

nodes.name: nsImageRenderer.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsImageRenderer and its enums, including nsStyleStruct.h to work directly with nsStyleImage/nsStyleBackground layer data. Acts as the painting-side bridge between style struct image layers and actual drawing backends.

nodes.name: nsDisplayListBuilder
nodes.summary: Stateful context object that drives display-list construction: tracks dirty rects, clipping, ASRs, painting/destroy modes, and current frame. All display item construction and the style-struct reads that feed it flow through this builder, making it the entry point of the layout-to-paint CHAIN BOUNDARY.

nodes.name: nsDisplayItem
nodes.summary: Abstract base class of every display item: defines Paint, CreateWebRenderCommands, GetBounds, HitTest, and GetOpaqueRegion. Concrete items pull the values they need out of nsStyle* structs obtained from their frame's ComputedStyle.

nodes.name: nsDisplayList
nodes.summary: Doubly-linked ordered container of display items produced by frame BuildDisplayList passes. Its ordering plus Paint/PaintInternal is the final flattening step of the style chain into paint commands.

nodes.name: nsPaintedDisplayItem
nodes.summary: Intermediate base class for items that render via gfxContext painting (as opposed to pure structural items). Hosts most style-consuming visual items such as borders, backgrounds, and text.

nodes.name: nsDisplayWrapList
nodes.summary: Display item that wraps a nested display list, used for grouping children under opacity, blend mode, transforms, and layers. Structural item that aggregates child items rather than directly reading a specific style struct.

nodes.name: nsDisplayBorder
nodes.summary: Display item that paints a frame's CSS border. Reads nsStyleBorder (widths, style, colors, radii) from the frame's style and delegates to nsCSSRendering border painters, including WebRender command generation.

nodes.name: nsDisplayBackgroundImage
nodes.summary: Display item representing a single background-image layer of a frame. Consumes nsStyleBackground layer data (image, positioning area, clip/origin boxes) and paints via nsImageRenderer/nsCSSRendering; also drives opaque-region and invalidation decisions.

nodes.name: nsDisplayText
nodes.summary: Display item that paints a frame's text content. Reads nsStyleText (and color) from the frame style and renders glyphs through the text rendering stack or emits WebRender text commands.

nodes.name: nsDisplayBackgroundImage::AppendBackgroundItemsToTop
nodes.summary: Static helper that walks a frame's nsStyleBackground layers and appends one nsDisplayBackgroundImage (or themed/backgroundColor item) per layer to the top of the given display list. This is where style background data is translated into concrete display items at the CHAIN BOUNDARY.

nodes.name: nsDisplayBackgroundImage::Paint
nodes.summary: Paints one background-image layer into the given gfxContext by dispatching to nsImageRenderer/nsCSSRendering with data taken from the frame's nsStyleBackground. Shows the read-style-then-paint flow of a style-consuming display item.

nodes.name: nsDisplayBorder::Paint
nodes.summary: Paints the CSS border by handing the frame's nsStyleBorder and border rect to nsCSSRendering::PaintBorder. Direct consumer of border style struct data during painting.

nodes.name: nsDisplayText::Paint
nodes.summary: Paints the frame's text using nsStyleText/nbsp-aware text frames, delegating to RenderToContext with glyphs, decorations, and shadows derived from style struct values.

nodes.name: nsDisplayText::RenderToContext
nodes.summary: Renders the text run into a gfxContext (or WebRender via callers) using text style, shadows, and colors from the frame's nsStyleText. Core style-to-glyph translation for text painting.

nodes.name: nsDisplayItemGeometry
nodes.summary: Base class snapshotting a display item's bounds and visibility so retained display lists can compute invalidation regions between paints. Subclasses add style-derived state per item type.

nodes.name: nsDisplayBackgroundGeometry
nodes.summary: Geometry snapshot for nsDisplayBackgroundImage, recording the background positioning-area rect. Detects style- or size-driven changes that require repainting background layers.

nodes.name: nsDisplayBorderGeometry
nodes.summary: Geometry snapshot for nsDisplayBorder used to compute invalidation regions when border painting geometry changes between builds.

nodes.name: nsImageRenderer
nodes.summary: Universal CSS image painter: prepares an nsStyleImage (checking load/SVG readiness) and draws it scaled/tiled into a destination rect, or emits equivalent WebRender commands. Reads image layer configuration from nsStyleBackground/nsStyleBorder (border-image) style structs.

nodes.name: nsImageRenderer::Draw
nodes.summary: Draws the prepared image into a single destination rect via the appropriate image type backend, applying scaling flags derived from style-specified sizing.

nodes.name: nsImageRenderer::DrawLayer
nodes.summary: Tiles the image across a layer fill area according to the nsStyleBackground layer's repeat rules, painting each tile with Draw. The main path for background-image painting.

nodes.name: nsImageRenderer::DrawBorderImageComponent
nodes.summary: Draws one slice/component of a border-image as specified by the border-image slice and repeat data in nsStyleBorder. Couples border style struct data to tiled image drawing.

nodes.name: nsImageRenderer::BuildWebRenderDisplayItems
nodes.summary: WebRender path of Draw: emits image display items into a WebRenderLayerManager instead of rasterizing via gfxContext, honoring the same style-derived sizing/repeat data.

nodes.name: nsImageRenderer::DrawShapeImage
nodes.summary: Renders an image used by shape-outside for float shape extraction, converting style-specified shape images into an alpha mask for layout.

nodes.name: nsHTMLTagList.inc
nodes.summary: Canonical X-macro list of all HTML tags: each entry is an HTML_TAG (or HTML_HTMLELEMENT_TAG/HTML_OTHER) macro row giving the tag name, the NS_New*Element creator method used by HTMLElementFactory.cpp, and the spec interface name. It is included by nsHTMLTags.h to build the eHTMLTag enum and is also consumed by the parser's Java-to-C++ translation (ElementName.java).

nodes.name: nsElementTable.cpp
nodes.summary: Legacy HTML parser element-properties table: defines the HTMLElement struct and the static gHTMLElements[] array (one ELEM row per eHTMLTag_ value) recording whether each tag is a block or a container. Exposes nsHTMLElement::IsBlock/IsContainer lookups and a DEBUG-only CheckElementTable consistency check.

nodes.name: HTMLElement
nodes.summary: Struct describing one row of the legacy element table: mIsBlock and mIsContainer flags, plus a DEBUG-only mTagID used to verify table ordering against the eHTMLTag enum.

nodes.name: nsHTMLElement::IsContainer
nodes.summary: Returns the mIsContainer flag from gHTMLElements[] for a given nsHTMLTag, telling the old parser whether an element can contain other content.

nodes.name: nsHTMLElement::IsBlock
nodes.summary: Returns the mIsBlock flag from gHTMLElements[] for a given nsHTMLTag; values derive from the old HTML4 DTD and intentionally diverge from the modern block-level element list for some tags.

nodes.name: CheckElementTable
nodes.summary: DEBUG-only assertion helper that walks every eHTMLTag value and MOZ_ASSERTs that gHTMLElements[] rows stay in one-to-one order with the nsHTMLTagList.inc tag enum.

nodes.name: geckolib Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Manifest of the geckoservo crate, the Rust static library embedding Servo's style system into Gecko. It wires up dependencies on the style, selectors, cssparser, servo_arc, and nsstring crates with gecko-specific features.

nodes.name: geckolib cbindgen.toml
nodes.summary: cbindgen configuration that generates the C++ headers (mozilla/ServoStyleConsts.h and ServoBindings) from Rust type definitions so Gecko's C++ style system can share Servo's structs. Controls parsing of the style/app_units/cssparser/style_traits/servo_arc crates and C++ namespace/layout settings.

nodes.name: error_reporter.rs
nodes.summary: CSS error reporting glue: an ErrorReporter implementing the style crate's ParseErrorReporter trait that forwards parse errors to Gecko's console service via Gecko_ErrorReportingEnabled/Gecko_ReportError bindings. Maps Rust parse-error kinds to localized Gecko CSS messages.

nodes.name: glue.rs
nodes.summary: THE C-ABI implementation of every Servo_* function the C++ style system calls: CSS parsing, selector matching, style traversal, computed values, animation values, CSSOM rule manipulation, and style-set management. The ~11k-line boundary layer between Gecko and the Servo style engine.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root of geckoservo: declares the glue, error_reporter, and stylesheet_loader modules and links the style crate with #[macro_use]. Also provides the je_malloc_usable_size stub to harmonize allocators with Gecko.

nodes.name: stylesheet_loader.rs
nodes.summary: Sheet loading glue: StylesheetLoader and AsyncStylesheetParser implement the style crate's StylesheetLoader trait, delegating @import child-sheet loads to Gecko via Gecko_LoadStyleSheet(Async) and finishing async parses with Gecko_StyleSheet_FinishAsyncParse.

nodes.name: Servo_TraverseSubtree
nodes.summary: Drives a style recalc traversal of an element's subtree from C++, using Gecko's traversal flags and Servo's traversal machinery to compute styles for dirty elements.

nodes.name: Servo_StyleSet_Init
nodes.summary: Creates the PerDocumentStyleData (ServoStyleSet) backing a Gecko Document, initializing the shared stylist, rule tree, and per-document style state.

nodes.name: Servo_StyleSet_AppendStyleSheet
nodes.summary: Registers a stylesheet with the document's ServoStyleSet at a given cascade level, marking the stylist dirty so selectors are rehashed on the next flush.

nodes.name: Servo_StyleSet_ResolveForDeclarations
nodes.summary: Resolves computed values from a declaration block against an optional parent style, used for anonymous boxes and pseudo-element styles without a full traversal.

nodes.name: Servo_StyleSet_HasStateDependency
nodes.summary: Queries the stylist's selector maps to determine whether any rule matches this element depends on the given element state bits (:hover, :active, etc.), driving Gecko's state-change restyle hints.

nodes.name: Servo_ComputedValues_ShouldTransition
nodes.summary: Decides whether a CSS transition should start between an old and new computed style by consulting transition properties and updating the transition manager state.

nodes.name: Servo_ComputedValues_ExtractAnimationValue
nodes.summary: Extracts an uncomputed AnimationValue for a property from a computed style, the representation used to interpolate and compose CSS animations and transitions.

nodes.name: Servo_ParseProperty
nodes.summary: Parses a single CSS property declaration string into a PropertyDeclaration via the style crate's property parser, reporting errors through the Gecko error reporter.

nodes.name: Servo_StyleSheet_FromUTF8Bytes
nodes.summary: Parses a stylesheet from UTF-8 bytes into StylesheetContents with the shared lock, origin, quirks mode, and loader glue, the entry point for all Gecko sheet loads (sync and async).

nodes.name: Servo_DeclarationBlock_Parse
nodes.summary: Parses one CSS property/value pair into an existing LockedDeclarationBlock for the CSSOM (style.setAttribute-style mutation), replacing an existing declaration when requested.

nodes.name: Servo_Element_ClearData
nodes.summary: Drops the element's cached style data (ComputedStyles) and unlinks it from the rule tree, used when the element leaves the document or its style is invalidated.

nodes.name: Servo_CssRules_InsertRule
nodes.summary: Implements CSSOM CSSRuleList.insertRule: parses a rule string in the right nesting context and splices the resulting rule into the locked rule list, returning Gecko nsresult codes.

nodes.name: nsBlockReflowContext.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements nsBlockReflowContext, the helper a parent frame uses to reflow a block child. As a style-struct consumer it reads style-derived ReflowInput state (e.g. StyleDisplay()->mClear) and propagates -webkit-line-clamp container flags (mIsInLineClampContainer, mBOffsetToLineClampRoot) from the parent reflow input into the child's.

nodes.name: nsBlockReflowContext.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsBlockReflowContext, the interface used by parent frames (chiefly nsBlockFrame) to reflow and place block-level children. It threads style-struct-carrying ReflowInput objects (mOuterReflowInput) through block reflow, including line-clamp container state.

nodes.name: nsLineBox.h
nodes.summary: Declares nsLineBox and the intrusive nsLineList/nsLineLink containers that represent horizontal lines of frames in block layout. nsLineBox stores per-line layout state consumed by -webkit-line-clamp handling, notably the mHasLineClampEllipsis flag set by LineClampLineIterator.

nodes.name: nsBlockReflowContext::nsBlockReflowContext
nodes.summary: Constructor that caches the parent ReflowInput (mOuterReflowInput), which carries style-struct-derived state such as margins, borders, and line-clamp container flags into the child block reflow.

nodes.name: nsBlockReflowContext::ComputeCollapsedBStartMargin
nodes.summary: Computes the collapsed block-start margin for a child block using the parent's ReflowInput state (writing mode, style margins) so adjoining margins collapse across block boundaries.

nodes.name: nsBlockReflowContext::ReflowBlock
nodes.summary: Main entry point that reflows a block child, forwarding the style-struct-carrying ReflowInput into the child. For -webkit-line-clamp containers it maintains mFlags.mIsInLineClampContainer and accumulates mBOffsetToLineClampRoot so descendants can clamp their lines against the clamp root.

nodes.name: nsBlockReflowContext::PlaceBlock
nodes.summary: Positions a reflowed block child within its parent, deciding fit against available block size and recording whether the child (and its line-clamp-constrained content) fits or overflows.

nodes.name: nsBlockReflowContext
nodes.summary: RAII-style helper class that a parent frame uses to reflow a block frame: it wraps the child's ReflowInput (which aggregates style-struct data like StyleDisplay and StyleMargin) and offers ReflowBlock/PlaceBlock/ComputeCollapsedBStartMargin, propagating line-clamp container state between parent and child reflow inputs.

nodes.name: nsLineBox
nodes.summary: Represents a horizontal line of frames in block layout, holding per-line metrics, child-frame iteration helpers, and FlagBits that include mHasLineClampEllipsis - the per-line marker set while -webkit-line-clamp suppresses overflowing lines on behalf of TextOverflow-style ellipsization.

nodes.name: nsLineLink
nodes.summary: Intrusive doubly-linked-list link node that nsLineBox inherits from, enabling lines to be chained in an nsLineList without separate allocations.

nodes.name: nsLineList
nodes.summary: Intrusive linked list of nsLineBox lines (C++ std::list-style API) that block frames use to store and iterate per-line state, including line-clamp ellipsis flags, during reflow.

nodes.name: GenericLineListIterator
nodes.summary: Templated iterator over nsLineList that provides const/non-const traversal of line boxes and their frames, used by block reflow to walk lines carrying clamp/overflow state.

nodes.name: nsLineIterator
nodes.summary: nsILineIterator implementation that exposes a block's cached line boxes (including per-line clamp-ellipsis state) to callers such as caret/selection code and the -webkit-line-clamp line walk.

nodes.name: TextOverflow.cpp
nodes.summary: THE text-overflow core algorithm implementation: during display-list construction it scans line boxes, reads nsStyleText::mTextOverflow, decides which frames to hide/clip, and creates nsDisplayTextOverflowMarker ellipsis/clip markers; also integrates -webkit-line-clamp block ellipsis.

nodes.name: TextOverflow.h
nodes.summary: Declares mozilla::css::TextOverflow, the renderer for CSS3 text-overflow: clients allocate an object via WillProcessLines and call ProcessLine for each line being built into display lists. Also defines the Marker helper class tracking per-side (IStart/IEnd) marker style, size, and block-ellipsis state.

nodes.name: ReflowInput.h
nodes.summary: Declares SizeComputationInput (padding/border/margin computation) and ReflowInput, the struct containing all input parameters to nsIFrame::Reflow: available space, computed sizes, writing mode, floats, and reflow flags. Central to the reflow algorithm that produces the line boxes TextOverflow later analyzes.

nodes.name: SizeComputationInput
nodes.summary: Base class of ReflowInput that computes only padding, border, and margin for a frame being reflowed, exposing both logical and physical accessors since these values are needed more often.

nodes.name: ReflowInput
nodes.summary: The input struct for nsIFrame::Reflow, extending SizeComputationInput with available space, computed inline/block sizes, writing mode, float manager state, and min/max size application used throughout frame reflow.

nodes.name: TextOverflow
nodes.summary: Non-reassignable factory-constructed class for rendering CSS3 text-overflow: WillProcessLines creates instances, ProcessLine analyzes each line's display lists and adds nsDisplayTextOverflowMarker items or clips/removes overlapping items. Honors line-clamp context by suppressing inline-end markers.

nodes.name: TextOverflow::Marker
nodes.summary: Per-side (inline-start/inline-end) marker state: holds the StyleTextOverflowSide or StyleBlockEllipsis style, intrinsic and current marker sizes, and flags like mHasOverflow, mActive, and mEdgeAligned used to decide whether and how a marker is drawn.

nodes.name: nsDisplayTextOverflowMarker
nodes.summary: Painted display item created by TextOverflow::CreateMarkers that renders an ellipsis (or custom marker string) or an opaque clip rectangle at the content edge of a line, used by text-overflow and line-clamp.

nodes.name: TextOverflow::WillProcessLines
nodes.summary: Factory function that allocates a TextOverflow object for a block frame, checking CanHaveOverflowMarkers and reading the text-overflow style; returns nullptr when no text-overflow processing is needed.

nodes.name: TextOverflow::ProcessLine
nodes.summary: Core per-line algorithm: examines the line's frames against the content area, determines whether IStart/IEnd markers are needed, hides or clips overlapping display items via PruneDisplayListContents, and calls CreateMarkers for the required sides.

nodes.name: TextOverflow::CreateMarkers
nodes.summary: Creates new nsDisplayTextOverflowMarker display items for the requested inline-start/inline-end sides and inserts them into the marker list, positioning them within the inside-markers area of the line's content box.
